--!strict
-- Curve clips as stored: the limits and names used throughout, and how a clip's
-- curves, keys and markers are found, read, written and played. Keys are read and
-- written through `Store.backend`, Studio's own methods unless a test replaces them.

local Rig = require("../../Rigs/Rig")
local Roblox = require("../../Core/Roblox")

local Store = {}

Store.TIME_TOLERANCE = 0.001
-- How many times a second Studio samples a curve clip as it plays.
Store.FRAME_RATE = 30
Store.MAX_TIME = 300
Store.MAX_POSITION = 1000
Store.MAX_KEYS = 2000
Store.MAX_OPERATIONS = 256
Store.MAX_SNAPS = 16
Store.MAX_JOINTS = 32
Store.MAX_NAME = 100
Store.MAX_MARKER_VALUE = 200
-- The longest a pin may take to blend in or out, in seconds.
Store.MAX_BLEND = 2
Store.HOLDS = { "full", "position" }
Store.PIVOTS = { "ankle", "toe", "heel" }
Store.FLOOR_MODES = { "lift", "touch" }
Store.MIRROR_MODES = { "flip", "left_to_right", "right_to_left" }
Store.MIN_SCALE = 0.01
-- How far a reduced curve may stray from the original at any frame, by default.
Store.REDUCE_DEGREES = 0.1
Store.REDUCE_STUDS = 0.002
-- The longest range reduced in one go: the work grows with the square of its frames.
Store.MAX_REDUCE = 60
-- Noise: the slowest and fastest it may sway, in waves a second, and the largest swing.
Store.MIN_FREQUENCY = 0.1
Store.MAX_FREQUENCY = 10
Store.MAX_NOISE_DEGREES = 90
Store.MAX_NOISE_STUDS = 5
-- Overlap: how long a joint may trail, in seconds, and how springy it may be.
Store.MIN_LAG = 0.02
Store.MAX_LAG = 0.5
Store.MAX_BOUNCE = 0.9
Store.MAX_SCALE = 100
Store.MAX_LISTED = 500
Store.DEFAULT_KEYS = 400
Store.MAX_PAGE = 20000
Store.PRIORITIES = { "Idle", "Movement", "Action", "Action2", "Action3", "Action4", "Core" }
Store.INTERPOLATIONS = { "Cubic", "Linear", "Constant" }
Store.CHANNELS = { "position.x", "position.y", "position.z", "rotation.x", "rotation.y", "rotation.z" }

export type Key = {
	time: number,
	value: number,
	interpolation: string,
	left: number?,
	right: number?,
}

export type Marker = { time: number, value: string }

export type Backend = {
	keys: (curve: Instance) -> { Key },
	setKeys: (curve: Instance, keys: { Key }) -> (),
	markers: (curve: Instance) -> { Marker },
	setMarkers: (curve: Instance, markers: { Marker }) -> (),
}

local function studio(): Backend
	return {
		keys = function(curve: Instance): { Key }
			local list = {}
			for _, key: any in (curve :: any):GetKeys() do
				local right = nil
				if key.Interpolation == Enum.KeyInterpolationMode.Cubic then
					right = key.RightTangent
				end
				table.insert(list, {
					time = key.Time,
					value = key.Value,
					interpolation = key.Interpolation.Name,
					left = key.LeftTangent,
					right = right,
				})
			end
			return list
		end,
		setKeys = function(curve: Instance, keys: { Key })
			local float = curve :: any
			local existing = #float:GetKeys()
			if existing > 0 then
				float:RemoveKeyAtIndex(1, existing)
			end
			for _, key in keys do
				local made: any =
					FloatCurveKey.new(key.time, key.value, (Enum.KeyInterpolationMode :: any)[key.interpolation])
				if key.left ~= nil then
					made.LeftTangent = key.left
				end
				if key.right ~= nil and key.interpolation == "Cubic" then
					made.RightTangent = key.right
				end
				float:InsertKey(made)
			end
		end,
		markers = function(curve: Instance): { Marker }
			local list = {}
			for _, marker: any in (curve :: any):GetMarkers() do
				table.insert(list, { time = marker.Time, value = marker.Value })
			end
			return list
		end,
		setMarkers = function(curve: Instance, markers: { Marker })
			local markerCurve = curve :: any
			local existing = #markerCurve:GetMarkers()
			if existing > 0 then
				markerCurve:RemoveMarkerAtIndex(1, existing)
			end
			for _, marker in markers do
				markerCurve:InsertMarkerAtTime(marker.time, marker.value)
			end
		end,
	}
end

Store.backend = nil :: Backend?

local function currentBackend(): Backend
	local current = Store.backend
	if not current then
		current = studio()
		Store.backend = current
	end
	return current :: Backend
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Layout

local function sortKeys(keys: { Key })
	table.sort(keys, function(a, b)
		return a.time < b.time
	end)
end

function Store.isCurves(clip: Instance): boolean
	return clip:IsA("CurveAnimation")
end

-- The Folder of a joint, made along with any of its ancestors if `create` is true.
function Store.folder(clip: Instance, joint: string, create: boolean): Instance?
	local parent: Instance = clip
	for _, name in Rig.chain(joint) do
		local child = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
		if not child or not child:IsA("Folder") then
			if not create then
				return nil
			end
			local made = Roblox.Instance.new("Folder")
			made.Name = name
			made.Parent = parent
			child = made
		end
		parent = child :: Instance
	end
	return parent
end

-- The FloatCurve of one channel of a joint ("rotation.x" and so on), made if `create`.
function Store.channel(clip: Instance, joint: string, channel: string, create: boolean): Instance?
	local folder = Store.folder(clip, joint, create)
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	local kind, axis = string.match(channel, "^(%a+)%.(%a)$")
	local groupName = if kind == "position" then "Position" else "Rotation"
	local groupClass = if kind == "position" then "Vector3Curve" else "EulerRotationCurve"
	local group = folder:FindFirstChild(groupName)
	if not group or not group:IsA(groupClass) then
		if not create then
			return nil
		end
		local made = Roblox.Instance.new(groupClass)
		made.Name = groupName
		if groupClass == "EulerRotationCurve" then
			(made :: any).RotationOrder = Roblox.Enum.RotationOrder.XYZ
		end
		made.Parent = folder
		group = made
	end
	local name = string.upper(axis :: string)
	local curve = (group :: Instance):FindFirstChild(name)
	if not curve or not curve:IsA("FloatCurve") then
		if not create then
			return nil
		end
		local made = Roblox.Instance.new("FloatCurve")
		made.Name = name
		made.Parent = group
		curve = made
	end
	return curve
end

export type Track = { joint: string, channel: string, curve: Instance, path: string }

-- Every channel curve in the clip, wherever it is, with the joint it belongs to.
function Store.tracks(clip: Instance): { Track }
	local tracks: { Track } = {}
	local function walk(instance: Instance, path: string)
		for _, child in instance:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Folder") then
				local here = if path == "" then child.Name else `{path}/{child.Name}`
				for _, group in child:GetChildren() do
					local kind = if group:IsA("Vector3Curve")
						then "position"
						elseif group:IsA("EulerRotationCurve") then "rotation"
						else nil
					if kind then
						for _, curve in group:GetChildren() do
							if curve:IsA("FloatCurve") and #curve.Name == 1 then
								table.insert(tracks, {
									joint = child.Name,
									channel = `{kind}.{string.lower(curve.Name)}`,
									curve = curve :: Instance,
									path = `{here}/{group.Name}/{curve.Name}`,
								})
							end
						end
					end
				end
				walk(child, here)
			end
		end
	end
	walk(clip, "")
	table.sort(tracks, function(a, b)
		return a.path < b.path
	end)
	return tracks
end

function Store.markerCurves(clip: Instance): { Instance }
	local list = {}
	for _, child in clip:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("MarkerCurve") then
			table.insert(list, child :: Instance)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	return list
end

function Store.keys(curve: Instance): { Key }
	local keys = currentBackend().keys(curve)
	sortKeys(keys)
	return keys
end

function Store.setKeys(curve: Instance, keys: { Key })
	sortKeys(keys)
	currentBackend().setKeys(curve, keys)
end

-- The value of a channel at a time, as Studio plays it: the first key's value before it,
-- the last key's after it, and between two keys by the first one's interpolation.
-- An attribute on a curve clip made only to hold poses sampled from a keyframe clip.
Store.SAMPLED = "KeywrightSampled"

function Store.evaluate(keys: { Key }, time: number): number
	local count = #keys
	if count == 0 then
		return 0
	elseif time <= keys[1].time then
		return keys[1].value
	elseif time >= keys[count].time then
		return keys[count].value
	end
	for index = 1, count - 1 do
		local a, b = keys[index], keys[index + 1]
		-- At a key's own time, the curve has that key's value, whatever comes before it:
		-- after a Constant stretch it is where the step lands.
		if time < b.time then
			local length = b.time - a.time
			if length <= 0 or a.interpolation == "Constant" then
				return a.value
			end
			local u = (time - a.time) / length
			if a.interpolation == "Linear" then
				return a.value + (b.value - a.value) * u
			end
			local m0, m1 = a.right or 0, b.left or 0
			local u2, u3 = u * u, u * u * u
			return (2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1) * a.value
				+ (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * length * m0
				+ (-2 * u3 + 3 * u2) * b.value
				+ (u3 - u2) * length * m1
		end
	end
	return keys[count].value
end

-- The time of the clip's last key or marker.
function Store.duration(clip: Instance): number
	local last = 0
	for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
		local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
		if #keys > 0 then
			last = math.max(last, keys[#keys].time)
		end
	end
	for _, curve in Store.markerCurves(clip) do
		for _, marker in currentBackend().markers(curve) do
			last = math.max(last, marker.time)
		end
	end
	return last
end

-- Every time at which any channel has a key, in order, a millisecond apart at least.
function Store.keyTimes(clip: Instance): { number }
	local seen: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
		for _, key in Store.keys(track.curve) do
			seen[math.round(key.time * 1000)] = true
		end
	end
	local list = {}
	for slot in seen do
		table.insert(list, slot / 1000)
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

-- What a channel's numbers mean to the outside: degrees for rotation, studs for position.
local function outward(channel: string): number
	return if string.sub(channel, 1, 8) == "rotation" then 180 / math.pi else 1
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Checking what was asked for

local function markerCurve(clip: Instance, name: string, create: boolean): Instance?
	local found = clip:FindFirstChild(name)
	if found and found:IsA("MarkerCurve") then
		return found
	end
	if not create then
		return nil
	end
	local made = Roblox.Instance.new("MarkerCurve")
	made.Name = name
	made.Parent = clip
	return made
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Mirroring, across the rig's own plane between its left and right sides
--
-- Seen in a mirror, a turn about the rig's X axis (across it) is the same turn, and turns
-- about Y and Z go the other way; a move along X goes the other way. When each joint's rest
-- offsets on one side are the mirror image of the other side's, as on an R15 rig, this
-- holds joint by joint for the angles a curve clip keys: rotation (x, y, z) mirrors to
-- (x, -y, -z) and position (x, y, z) to (-x, y, z). So a mirrored clip is made by
-- mirroring its keys, tangents included, and is exact, with the keys a person can still
-- edit, rather than a pose baked at every frame.

Store.currentBackend = currentBackend
Store.sortKeys = sortKeys
Store.outward = outward
Store.markerCurve = markerCurve

return Store

-- ScrollingFrame: AbsoluteWindowSize and AbsoluteCanvasSize by canvas
-- size, bar insets, thickness, border and direction; CanvasPosition kept
-- within the canvas when set; children on the scrolled canvas; and
-- AutomaticCanvasSize. Each frame is 200 x 100 in a 400 x 300 box.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Parent = screen

local function scroller(props)
	local f = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 100)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.CanvasSize = props.CanvasSize or f.CanvasSize
	for k, value in props do
		f[k] = value
	end
	local c = Instance.new("Frame")
	c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 20)
	c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	c.Parent = f
	f.Parent = box
	return f, c
end
local function sizes(name, props)
	local f, c = scroller(props)
	log(name, "window", v(f.AbsoluteWindowSize), "canvas", v(f.AbsoluteCanvasSize), "child", v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition), v(c.AbsoluteSize))
	f:Destroy()
end

local both = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 400)
sizes("default", {})
sizes("both", { CanvasSize = both })
sizes("vertical", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 400) })
sizes("horizontal", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 50) })

--!nonstrict
-- Boot.lua -- find a guest machine supplied by the surrounding game.
--
-- RVPC core ships no ROM or OS media. A game provides one of the ModuleScripts
-- below in ReplicatedStorage:
--
--   RvpcBoot, Boot, boot, Machine
--
-- Each may return:
--   * function(Rvpc, RvpcUi) -> Machine
--   * a table with :boot(Rvpc, RvpcUi), :create(...) or :new(...)
--   * a ready Machine table (run, pressKey, releaseKey, mouseMove, vga)
--
-- A "Machine" here is the configured instance, not core/Machine.lua's class.

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Boot = {}

const MODULE_NAMES = { "RvpcBoot", "Boot", "boot", "Machine" }

local function isMachine(value: any): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	const vga = value.vga
	return type(value.run) == "function"
		and type(value.pressKey) == "function"
		and type(value.releaseKey) == "function"
		and type(value.mouseMove) == "function"
		and type(vga) == "table"
		and type(vga.width) == "function"
		and type(vga.height) == "function"
end

local function callFactory(factory: any, Rvpc: any, RvpcUi: any): (any?, string?)
	if type(factory) == "function" then
		const ok, machine = pcall(factory, Rvpc, RvpcUi)
		if not ok then
			return nil, tostring(machine)
		end
		return machine, nil
	end
	if type(factory) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "module did not return a function or table"
	end
	if isMachine(factory) then
		return factory, nil
	end
	if factory == Rvpc.Machine then
		return nil, "core Machine class needs a configured factory"
	end
	for _, methodName in { "boot", "create", "new" } do
		const method = factory[methodName]
		if type(method) == "function" then
			const ok, machine = pcall(method, factory, Rvpc, RvpcUi)
			if not ok then
				return nil, tostring(machine)
			end
			return machine, nil
		end
	end
	return nil, "module has no boot/create/new method"
end

-- Returns machine, sourceName, details. details is filled when nothing loaded.
function Boot.resolve(Rvpc: any, RvpcUi: any, container: Instance?): (any?, string?, string?)
	const root = container or ReplicatedStorage
	const problems: { string } = {}
	local found = false
	for _, name in MODULE_NAMES do
		const module = root:FindFirstChild(name)
		if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			found = true
			const okRequire, factory = pcall(require, module)
			if not okRequire then
				problems[#problems + 1] = name .. ": require failed: " .. tostring(factory)
			else
				const machine, err = callFactory(factory, Rvpc, RvpcUi)
				if isMachine(machine) then
					return machine, name, nil
				end
				problems[#problems + 1] = name .. ": " .. (err or "factory returned no machine")
			end
		end
	end
	if not found then
		problems[#problems + 1] = "no RvpcBoot/Boot/boot/Machine ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage"
	end
	return nil, nil, table.concat(problems, "\n")
end

-- A text-mode VGA showing the shell's instructions. This exercises the real
-- Vga -> VgaView path even when no guest machine exists.
function Boot.diagnosticVga(Rvpc: any, details: string?): any
	const mem = Rvpc.Memory.new(1024 * 1024)
	const vga = Rvpc.Vga.new(mem)
	vga:setMode(0x03)
	for row = 0, 24 do
		vga:writeText(row, 0, string.rep(" ", 80), 0x07)
	end

	local function put(row: number, text: string, attr: number)
		if row >= 25 then
			return
		end
		vga:writeText(row, 0, string.sub(text, 1, 80), attr)
	end

	put(0, " RVPC / 98  -  CLIENT DIAGNOSTIC", 0x1F)
	put(2, "No boot machine is available.", 0x0F)
	put(3, "The VGA presenter and input bridge are running.", 0x07)
	put(5, "Supply a ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage named:", 0x0F)
	put(6, "  RvpcBoot, Boot, boot or Machine", 0x0E)
	put(8, "Return one of:", 0x0F)
	put(9, "  function(Rvpc, RvpcUi) -> Machine", 0x07)
	put(10, "  table:boot(...) / :create(...) / :new(...)", 0x07)
	put(11, "  a ready Machine table", 0x07)
	put(13, "Machine fields: run, pressKey, releaseKey, mouseMove, vga.", 0x0F)
	put(15, "No SeaBIOS/SeaVGABIOS ROM or guest OS media is bundled.", 0x07)
	put(17, "Details:", 0x0F)

	if details and #details > 0 then
		local row = 18
		for line in string.gmatch(details, "[^\r\n]+") do
			local position = 1
			while position <= #line and row < 25 do
				vga:writeText(row, 0, string.sub(line, position, position + 79), 0x0C)
				row += 1
				position += 80
			end
			if row >= 25 then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return vga
end

return Boot

-- binary: byte packing, hex, base64 in both directions
local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(data)
  local out = {}
  local i = 1
  while i <= #data do
    local b1, b2, b3 = data:byte(i, i + 2)
    local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
    local c1 = math.floor(n / 262144) % 64
    local c2 = math.floor(n / 4096) % 64
    local c3 = math.floor(n / 64) % 64
    local c4 = n % 64
    out[#out + 1] = B64:sub(c1 + 1, c1 + 1) .. B64:sub(c2 + 1, c2 + 1)
      .. (b2 and B64:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1) or "=")
      .. (b3 and B64:sub(c4 + 1, c4 + 1) or "=")
    i = i + 3
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end
local function unb64(text)
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #text, 4 do
    local chunk = text:sub(i, i + 3)
    local v = 0
    local pad = 0
    for j = 1, 4 do
      local c = chunk:sub(j, j)
      if c == "=" then
        pad = pad + 1
        v = v * 64
      else
        v = v * 64 + (B64:find(c, 1, true) - 1)
      end
    end
    out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(v / 65536) % 256)
    if pad < 2 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(v / 256) % 256) end
    if pad < 1 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(v % 256) end
  end
  return table.concat(out)
end

local payload = "Eatfuscator\x00\x01\x02 payload"
local enc = b64(payload)
print(enc)
print(unb64(enc) == payload, #payload, #enc)

local function hex(data)
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #data do out[i] = string.format("%02x", data:byte(i)) end
  return table.concat(out)
end
print(hex("Luau"), hex("\255\0\16"))

local bytes = {}
for i = 0, 255, 17 do bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.format("%02X", i) end
print(table.concat(bytes, " "))
print(#b64(""), b64("ab"), b64("abc"))

--!strict
-- Timing: shifting, scaling and reversing ranges, and reducing a range to few keys.

local Frames = require("./Frames")
local Need = require("./Need")
local Store = require("./Store")
local Write = require("./Write")

local count = Frames.count
local currentBackend = Store.currentBackend
local isFinite = Need.isFinite
local milliseconds = Need.milliseconds
local near = Frames.near
local needJoints = Need.needJoints
local needRange = Need.needRange
local needTime = Need.needTime
local onFrame = Write.onFrame
local reduced = Write.reduced
local refuse = Need.refuse
local sortKeys = Store.sortKeys
local wrapped = Write.wrapped

type Changed = Frames.Changed
type Context = Frames.Context
type Key = Store.Key

local Ops = {}

-- Moves the keys of every channel, and the markers, that lie from `from` to `to` to the
-- times `place` gives, on the nearest whole frame. Tangents are divided by `rate`: how many
-- times faster the moved keys now go by. A moved key may not land on or pass a key that
-- stays; two moved keys that land on one frame become one, between the two.
local function retimeCurves(
	where: string,
	clip: Instance,
	from: number,
	to: number,
	place: (time: number) -> number,
	rate: (time: number) -> number,
	changed: Changed
)
	local tolerance = Store.TIME_TOLERANCE
	local function inside(time: number): boolean
		return time >= from - tolerance and time <= to + tolerance
	end
	local plans: { { curve: Instance, keys: { Key } } } = {}
	local moved, merged = 0, 0
	local mergedAt = math.huge
	for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
		local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
		local still: { Key } = {}
		local going: { Key } = {}
		for _, key in keys do
			if inside(key.time) then
				local copy = table.clone(key)
				local speed = rate(key.time)
				copy.time = onFrame(place(key.time))
				copy.left = if key.left then key.left / speed else nil
				copy.right = if key.right then key.right / speed else nil
				if copy.time < -tolerance or copy.time > Store.MAX_TIME then
					refuse(
						where,
						`a key of "{track.joint}" at {milliseconds(key.time)} seconds would move to {milliseconds(
							copy.time
						)}, outside 0 to {Store.MAX_TIME}.`
					)
				end
				copy.time = math.max(0, copy.time)
				table.insert(going, copy)
				moved += 1
				-- Remember where it came from, to say what it would pass.
				(copy :: any).from = key.time
			else
				table.insert(still, key)
			end
		end
		if #going == 0 then
			continue
		end
		for _, key in going do
			for _, other in still do
				local origin = (key :: any).from
				if math.abs(key.time - other.time) < tolerance then
					refuse(
						where,
						`the key of "{track.joint}" {track.channel} at {milliseconds(origin)} seconds would land on the one at {milliseconds(
							other.time
						)}.`,
						"Widen the range to take that key along, or use ripple."
					)
				elseif (origin < other.time) ~= (key.time < other.time) then
					refuse(
						where,
						`the key of "{track.joint}" {track.channel} at {milliseconds(origin)} seconds would pass the one at {milliseconds(
							other.time
						)}.`,
						"Widen the range to take that key along, or use ripple."
					)
				end
			end
		end
		sortKeys(going)
		local joined: { Key } = {}
		for _, key in going do
			local last = joined[#joined]
			if last and math.abs(last.time - key.time) < tolerance then
				-- Two keys on one frame: one key, halfway between them.
				last.value = (last.value + key.value) / 2
				last.left = ((last.left or 0) + (key.left or 0)) / 2
				last.right = key.right
				last.interpolation = key.interpolation
				merged += 1
				mergedAt = math.min(mergedAt, key.time)
			else
				(key :: any).from = nil
				table.insert(joined, key)
			end
		end
		for _, key in still do
			table.insert(joined, key)
		end
		sortKeys(joined)
		table.insert(plans, { curve = track.curve, keys = joined })
	end
	local markersMoved = 0
	for _, curve in Store.markerCurves(clip) do
		local markers = currentBackend().markers(curve)
		local touched = false
		for _, marker in markers do
			if inside(marker.time) then
				marker.time = math.max(0, onFrame(place(marker.time)))
				touched = true
				markersMoved += 1
			end
		end
		if touched then
			table.sort(markers, function(a, b)
				return a.time < b.time
			end)
			currentBackend().setMarkers(curve, markers)
		end
	end
	if moved == 0 and markersMoved == 0 then
		refuse(where, `there are no keys from {milliseconds(from)} to {milliseconds(to)} seconds.`)
	end
	for _, plan in plans do
		Store.setKeys(plan.curve, plan.keys)
	end
	count(changed, "keys_moved", moved)
	if markersMoved > 0 then
		count(changed, "markers_moved", markersMoved)
	end
	if merged > 0 then
		count(changed, "keys_merged", merged)
		changed.first_merge_at = math.min(changed.first_merge_at or math.huge, milliseconds(mergedAt))
	end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reducing keys

Ops.shift_time = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any)
		needRange(where, operation)
		if not isFinite(operation.offset) or operation.offset == 0 then
			refuse(where, "offset must be a number of seconds other than 0.")
		end
		if operation.wrap ~= nil and type(operation.wrap) ~= "boolean" then
			refuse(where, "wrap must be true or false.")
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		if operation.wrap then
			-- A loop started elsewhere: everything moves on by the offset, and what goes past
			-- the end comes round to the start, the curves cut where the loop now begins.
			local duration = Store.duration(clip)
			if not (clip :: any).Loop then
				refuse(where, "wrap carries motion round from the end to the start, so it needs a looping clip.")
			end
			if not (near(operation.time_from, 0) and near(operation.time_to, duration)) then
				refuse(where, `with wrap, the range must be the whole clip, 0 to {milliseconds(duration)} seconds.`)
			end
			local moved = 0
			for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
				local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
				if #keys > 0 then
					local out = wrapped(keys, operation.offset, duration)
					Store.setKeys(track.curve, out)
					moved += #keys
				end
			end
			for _, curve in Store.markerCurves(clip) do
				local markers = currentBackend().markers(curve)
				for _, marker in markers do
					marker.time = (marker.time + operation.offset) % duration
				end
				table.sort(markers, function(a, b)
					return a.time < b.time
				end)
				currentBackend().setMarkers(curve, markers)
			end
			count(changed, "keys_moved", moved)
			return
		end
		retimeCurves(where, clip, operation.time_from, operation.time_to, function(time)
			return time + operation.offset
		end, function()
			return 1
		end, changed)
	end,
}

Ops.scale_time = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any)
		needRange(where, operation)
		local factor = operation.factor
		if not isFinite(factor) or factor < Store.MIN_SCALE or factor > Store.MAX_SCALE or factor == 1 then
			refuse(where, `factor must be from {Store.MIN_SCALE} to {Store.MAX_SCALE}, and not 1.`)
		end
		if operation.anchor ~= nil then
			needTime(where, operation.anchor, "anchor")
		end
		if operation.ripple ~= nil and type(operation.ripple) ~= "boolean" then
			refuse(where, "ripple must be true or false.")
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local anchor = if operation.anchor ~= nil then operation.anchor else operation.time_from
		local factor = operation.factor
		local to = operation.time_to
		local function scaled(time: number): number
			return anchor + (time - anchor) * factor
		end
		-- With ripple, everything after the range moves by as much as its end does, at the
		-- speed it had.
		local stretch = scaled(to) - to
		local last = if operation.ripple then Store.MAX_TIME else to
		retimeCurves(where, clip, operation.time_from, last, function(time)
			return if time <= to + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then scaled(time) else time + stretch
		end, function(time)
			return if time <= to + Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then factor else 1
		end, changed)
	end,
}

Ops.reverse_time = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any)
		needRange(where, operation)
		if operation.time_to - operation.time_from < Store.TIME_TOLERANCE then
			refuse(where, "the range must have some length.")
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		local from, to = operation.time_from, operation.time_to
		local tolerance = Store.TIME_TOLERANCE
		local reversed = 0
		for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
			local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
			local first, last = nil, nil
			for index, key in keys do
				if key.time >= from - tolerance and key.time <= to + tolerance then
					first = first or index
					last = index
				end
			end
			if not first then
				continue
			end
			local out: { Key } = {}
			for index, key in keys do
				if index < first or index > last then
					table.insert(out, key)
					continue
				end
				-- Played backward, the stretch that now leaves this key is the one that used
				-- to arrive at it, shaped by the key before; the last one in the range leaves
				-- toward the key after it, as the range's last key used to.
				local shape = if index > first then keys[index - 1].interpolation else keys[last].interpolation
				table.insert(out, {
					time = onFrame(from + to - key.time),
					value = key.value,
					interpolation = shape,
					left = -(key.right or 0),
					right = if shape == "Cubic" then -(key.left or 0) else nil,
				})
				reversed += 1
			end
			sortKeys(out)
			Store.setKeys(track.curve, out)
		end
		for _, curve in Store.markerCurves(clip) do
			local markers = currentBackend().markers(curve)
			for _, marker in markers do
				if marker.time >= from - tolerance and marker.time <= to + tolerance then
					marker.time = onFrame(from + to - marker.time)
				end
			end
			table.sort(markers, function(a, b)
				return a.time < b.time
			end)
			currentBackend().setMarkers(curve, markers)
		end
		if reversed == 0 then
			refuse(where, `there are no keys from {milliseconds(from)} to {milliseconds(to)} seconds.`)
		end
		count(changed, "keys_reversed", reversed)
	end,
}

Ops.reduce_keys = {
	check = function(where: string, operation: any, joints: { [string]: any })
		needRange(where, operation)
		needJoints(where, operation.joints, joints)
		for _, field in { "rotation_degrees", "position_studs" } do
			local value = operation[field]
			if value ~= nil and (not isFinite(value) or value <= 0 or value > 10) then
				refuse(where, `{field} must be more than 0 and at most 10.`)
			end
		end
	end,

	apply = function(where: string, clip: Instance, operation: any, _context: Context, changed: Changed)
		if operation.time_to - operation.time_from > Store.MAX_REDUCE then
			refuse(where, `at most {Store.MAX_REDUCE} seconds are reduced at once.`, "Reduce the clip in parts.")
		end
		local wanted: { [string]: boolean }? = nil
		if operation.joints then
			wanted = {}
			for _, name in operation.joints do
				(wanted :: { [string]: boolean })[name] = true
			end
		end
		local degrees = math.rad(operation.rotation_degrees or Store.REDUCE_DEGREES)
		local studs = operation.position_studs or Store.REDUCE_STUDS
		local before, after = 0, 0
		for _, track in Store.tracks(clip) do
			if wanted and not wanted[track.joint] then
				continue
			end
			local keys = Store.keys(track.curve)
			local tolerance = if string.sub(track.channel, 1, 8) == "rotation" then degrees else studs
			local out = reduced(keys, operation.time_from, operation.time_to, tolerance)
			if out then
				before += #keys
				after += #out
				Store.setKeys(track.curve, out)
			end
		end
		count(changed, "keys_removed", before - after)
	end,
}

return Ops

end

	c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	c.Parent = f
	return c
end

for _, s in Enum.ButtonStyle:GetEnumItems() do
	table.insert(styled, { "TextButton", s })

	local f = Instance.new(e[1])
	f.Style = e[2]
	f.Parent = screen
	local c = inside(f)
	local row = {}
	for _, size in { Vector2.new(120, 80), Vector2.new(200, 10), Vector2.new(30, 40) } do
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
		table.insert(row, v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition) .. " " .. v(c.AbsoluteSize))

	f:Destroy()
end

-- bits: bit operations spelled with arithmetic, so the fixture is 5.1-clean
local function band(a, b)
  local out, bit = 0, 1
  while a > 0 and b > 0 do
    if a % 2 == 1 and b % 2 == 1 then out = out + bit end
    a, b, bit = math.floor(a / 2), math.floor(b / 2), bit * 2
  end
  return out
end
local function bor(a, b)
  local out, bit = 0, 1
  while a > 0 or b > 0 do
    if a % 2 == 1 or b % 2 == 1 then out = out + bit end
    a, b, bit = math.floor(a / 2), math.floor(b / 2), bit * 2
  end
  return out
end
local function bxor(a, b)
  local out, bit = 0, 1
  while a > 0 or b > 0 do
    if (a % 2) ~= (b % 2) then out = out + bit end
    a, b, bit = math.floor(a / 2), math.floor(b / 2), bit * 2
  end
  return out
end
local function shl(a, n) return a * 2 ^ n end
local function shr(a, n) return math.floor(a / 2 ^ n) end
local function popcount(a)
  local n = 0
  while a > 0 do
    n = n + a % 2
    a = math.floor(a / 2)
  end
  return n
end

print(band(12, 10), bor(12, 10), bxor(12, 10))
print(shl(3, 4), shr(48, 4), popcount(255), popcount(1023))
local acc = 0
for i = 0, 15 do acc = acc + bxor(i, shr(i, 1)) end
print(acc)
print(band(0xFFFF, 0x0F0F), bor(0, 0), bxor(1, 1))
local pattern = {}
for i = 7, 0, -1 do pattern[#pattern + 1] = tostring(math.floor(170 / 2 ^ i) % 2) end
print(table.concat(pattern))

-- UITableLayout: where it puts two rows of cells and what it reports, in
-- a fixed 400 x 300 box.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
-- A new table each time: Studio uses stale sizes when a live table's
-- MajorAxis changes.
local function table_of(tag, setup)
	local box = Instance.new("Frame")
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
	box.Parent = screen
	local layout = Instance.new("UITableLayout")
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	setup(layout)
	layout.Parent = box
	local all = {}
	for r, row in { { { 50, 20 }, { 80, 30 }, { 20, 10 } }, { { 70, 25 }, { 30, 40 } } } do
		local rf = Instance.new("Frame")
		rf.Name = "R" .. r
		rf.LayoutOrder = r
		rf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 5)
		rf.Parent = box
		table.insert(all, rf)
		for c, size in row do
			local cf = Instance.new("Frame")
			cf.Name = "C" .. r .. c
			cf.LayoutOrder = c
			cf.Size = if r == 1 and c == 1 and tag == "scaled cell"
				then UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				else UDim2.fromOffset(size[1], size[2])
			cf.Parent = rf
			table.insert(all, cf)
		end
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, f in all do
		table.insert(out, f.Name .. "@" .. v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition) .. "/" .. v(f.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(tag, table.concat(out, " "), "content", v(layout.AbsoluteContentSize))
	box:Destroy()
end

table_of("rows", function() end)
table_of("padded", function(t)
	t.Padding = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 7)
end)
table_of("fill columns", function(t)
	t.FillEmptySpaceColumns = true
end)
table_of("fill rows", function(t)
	t.FillEmptySpaceRows = true
end)
table_of("columns", function(t)
	t.MajorAxis = Enum.TableMajorAxis.ColumnMajor
end)
table_of("horizontal", function(t)
	t.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
end)
table_of("centered, bottom", function(t)
	t.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	t.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
end)
table_of("scaled cell", function() end)

screen:Destroy()

-- control flow: early exits, nested loops, repeat/while, else-if chains
local function grade(score)
  if score >= 90 then return "A"
  elseif score >= 80 then return "B"
  elseif score >= 70 then return "C"
  elseif score >= 60 then return "D"
  else return "F" end
end
local dist = {}
for _, s in ipairs({ 95, 83, 71, 60, 12, 88, 91, 70 }) do
  local g = grade(s)
  dist[g] = (dist[g] or 0) + 1
end
local order = { "A", "B", "C", "D", "F" }
local cells = {}
for i, g in ipairs(order) do cells[i] = g .. "=" .. tostring(dist[g] or 0) end
print(table.concat(cells, " "))

local function findPair(list, target)
  for i = 1, #list do
    for j = i + 1, #list do
      if list[i] + list[j] == target then return i, j end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
print(findPair({ 3, 8, 12, 5, 9 }, 17))
print(findPair({ 1, 2 }, 99))

local n, steps = 27, 0
repeat
  n = (n % 2 == 0) and n / 2 or 3 * n + 1
  steps = steps + 1
until n == 1
print(steps)

local i, acc = 0, {}
while i < 5 do
  i = i + 1
  if i == 3 then acc[#acc + 1] = "skip" else acc[#acc + 1] = i end
end
print(table.concat(acc, ","))

local found
for x = 1, 50 do
  if x * x > 200 then
    found = x
    break
  end
end
print(found)

-- coroutines: resume/yield values, status, wrap, error propagation
local co = coroutine.create(function(a, b)
  local c = coroutine.yield(a + b)
  local d = coroutine.yield(c * 2)
  return d + 1
end)
print(coroutine.status(co))
local ok1, v1 = coroutine.resume(co, 2, 3)
print(ok1, v1, coroutine.status(co))
local ok2, v2 = coroutine.resume(co, 10)
print(ok2, v2)
local ok3, v3 = coroutine.resume(co, 100)
print(ok3, v3, coroutine.status(co))

local gen = coroutine.wrap(function()
  for i = 1, 4 do coroutine.yield(i * 10) end
end)
print(gen(), gen(), gen(), gen())

local bad = coroutine.create(function() error("boom") end)
local okb, errb = coroutine.resume(bad)
print(okb, type(errb), coroutine.status(bad))

-- UIListLayout, UIGridLayout and UIPadding: where they put children and
-- what they report, in a fixed 400 x 300 box.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Rounded, and + 0 turns -0 (float noise) into 0.
local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 20)
box.Parent = screen
local function dump(tag, list)
	local out = {}
	for _, f in list do
		table.insert(out, f.Name .. "@" .. v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition) .. "/" .. v(f.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(tag, table.concat(out, " "))
end
local function frame(name, size, order)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = name
	f.Size = size
	f.LayoutOrder = order or 0
	f.Parent = box
	return f
end

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
list.Parent = box
local c = frame("C", UDim2.fromOffset(50, 40), 2)
local a = frame("A", UDim2.fromOffset(50, 40), 1)
a.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(99, 99)
a.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
local b = frame("B", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.1), 1)
local items = { a, b, c }
list.Padding = UDim.new(0.1, 5)
dump("vertical", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
dump("centered", items)
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
dump("horizontal, right, bottom", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
c.Visible = false
dump("C hidden", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
c.Visible = true

local z = frame("Z", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 3)
local y = frame("Y", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 3)
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name
local lower = frame("a", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10))
dump("by name", { a, b, c, y, z, lower })
z:Destroy()
y:Destroy()
lower:Destroy()
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 10)
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.1, 0)
padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 13)
padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
padding.Parent = box
dump("padded", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
list:Destroy()
b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
dump("padded, no list", { b })
padding:Destroy()
for _, f in items do
	f:Destroy()
end

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name
grid.Parent = box
local cells = {}
for i = 1, 5 do
	cells[i] = frame("K" .. i, UDim2.fromOffset(50, 40), 6 - i)
end
dump("grid", cells)
log("cells", v(grid.AbsoluteCellSize), v(grid.AbsoluteCellCount), v(grid.AbsoluteContentSize))
grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 50)
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.1, 0)
grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 2
grid.StartCorner = Enum.StartCorner.BottomRight
dump("two a row, from bottom right", cells)
log("cells", v(grid.AbsoluteCellSize), v(grid.AbsoluteCellCount), v(grid.AbsoluteContentSize))
grid.StartCorner = Enum.StartCorner.TopLeft
grid.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 0
grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
grid.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
dump("vertical, centered", cells)
log("cells", v(grid.AbsoluteCellCount), v(grid.AbsoluteContentSize))
local second = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
second.Parent = box
dump("a list after the grid", cells)

screen:Destroy()

-- errors: pcall, error objects, xpcall, nested protection
-- error() prefixes a position; the position belongs to the file, not to the
-- program, so it is stripped before printing
local function strip(msg) return (tostring(msg):gsub("^[^:]*:%d+: ", "")) end

local function risky(n)
  if n < 0 then error({ code = "negative", n = n }) end
  if n == 0 then error("zero") end
  return n * 2
end
print(pcall(risky, 4))
local ok, e = pcall(risky, 0)
print(ok, strip(e))
local ok2, obj = pcall(risky, -3)
print(ok2, type(obj), obj.code, obj.n)

local function handler(err)
  return "handled: " .. tostring(type(err) == "table" and err.code or strip(err))
end
print(xpcall(function() error("inner") end, handler))
print(xpcall(function() return "fine" end, handler))

local depth = 0
local function nest(n)
  depth = depth + 1
  if n <= 0 then error("bottom") end
  local ok3, err2 = pcall(nest, n - 1)
  if not ok3 and n == 1 then return "propagated" end
  if not ok3 then error(err2, 0) end
  return "clean"
end
print(nest(3), depth)

local ok4, msg4 = pcall(function() local t = nil return t.x end)
print(ok4, strip(msg4))

--!strict
-- Bios.lua -- INT 10h teletype into the 0xB8000 text screen, INT 16h keyboard.

const band, bnot, bor, lshift, rshift =
	bit32.band, bit32.bnot, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const ZF = 64

const Bios = {}
Bios.__index = Bios

Bios.BASE = 0xB8000
Bios.COLS = 80
Bios.ROWS = 25

type CpuLike = {
	r: { number },
	es: number,
	halted: boolean,
	setbits: (self: any, mask: number, on: boolean) -> (),
	wr: (self: any, index: number, value: number) -> (),
	wb: (self: any, index: number, value: number) -> (),
	io: { in8: (port: number) -> number },
}

type ScreenMemory = {
	read8: (self: any, addr: number) -> number,
	write8: (self: any, addr: number, value: number) -> (),
	write16: (self: any, addr: number, value: number) -> (),
	copyTo: (self: any, addr: number, length: number) -> buffer,
	copyFrom: (self: any, addr: number, src: buffer) -> (),
}

export type Host = {
	mem: ScreenMemory,
	cpu: CpuLike,
	vga: any?,
	keys: { number },
	waiting: string?,
	pendingInt: number?,
	picInService: number,
	logChar: (self: any, ch: number) -> (),
	log: (self: any, message: string) -> (),
}

export type Bios = {
	machine: Host,
	cursorX: number,
	cursorY: number,
	attr: number,
	isText: (self: Bios) -> boolean,
	putChar: (self: Bios, ch: number, attr: number?) -> (),
	scroll: (self: Bios) -> (),
	advance: (self: Bios) -> (),
	teletype: (self: Bios, ch: number, attr: number?) -> (),
	write: (self: Bios, str: string) -> (),
	updateBDA: (self: Bios) -> (),
	int9: (self: Bios) -> (),
	int10: (self: Bios) -> (),
	int16: (self: Bios) -> (),
}

function Bios.new(machine: Host): Bios
	return setmetatable({
		machine = machine,
		cursorX = 0,
		cursorY = 0,
		attr = 0x07,
	}, Bios) :: any
end

function Bios.isText(self: Bios): boolean
	const vga = self.machine.vga
	return not vga or vga:modeInfo().kind == "text"
end

function Bios.putChar(self: Bios, ch: number, attr: number?)
	if not self:isText() then
		return
	end
	const cell = Bios.BASE + (self.cursorY * Bios.COLS + self.cursorX) * 2
	self.machine.mem:write8(cell, ch)
	self.machine.mem:write8(cell + 1, attr or self.attr)
end

function Bios.scroll(self: Bios)
	if not self:isText() then
		return
	end
	const mem = self.machine.mem
	const rowBytes = Bios.COLS * 2
	const src = mem:copyTo(Bios.BASE + rowBytes, rowBytes * (Bios.ROWS - 1))
	mem:copyFrom(Bios.BASE, src)
	const last = Bios.BASE + (Bios.ROWS - 1) * rowBytes
	for index = 0, Bios.COLS - 1 do
		mem:write8(last + index * 2, 0x20)
		mem:write8(last + index * 2 + 1, self.attr)
	end
	self.cursorY = Bios.ROWS - 1
end

function Bios.advance(self: Bios)
	self.cursorX += 1
	if self.cursorX >= Bios.COLS then
		self.cursorX = 0
		self.cursorY += 1
		if self.cursorY >= Bios.ROWS then
			self:scroll()
		end
	end
end

-- one character with control-char handling; also appends to the machine log
function Bios.teletype(self: Bios, ch: number, attr: number?)
	if ch == 0x0D then
		self.cursorX = 0
	elseif ch == 0x0A then
		self.cursorY += 1
		if self.cursorY >= Bios.ROWS then
			self:scroll()
		end
	elseif ch == 0x08 then
		if self.cursorX > 0 then
			self.cursorX -= 1
		end
	elseif ch == 0x09 then
		self.cursorX = math.min((math.floor(self.cursorX / 8) + 1) * 8, Bios.COLS - 1)
	else
		self:putChar(ch, attr)
		self:advance()
	end
	self.machine:logChar(ch)
end

-- display a string via teletype (logging happens per character)
function Bios.write(self: Bios, str: string)
	for index = 1, #str do
		self:teletype(string.byte(str, index) :: number)
	end
end

function Bios.updateBDA(self: Bios)
	const mem = self.machine.mem
	mem:write8(0x450, self.cursorX)
	mem:write8(0x451, self.cursorY)
	const vga = self.machine.vga
	if vga then
		const info = vga:modeInfo()
		const columns = info.kind == "text" and 80 or math.floor(info.width / 8)
		const charHeight = info.kind == "text" and 16 or (info.height >= 400 and 16 or 8)
		const rows = info.kind == "text" and 25 or math.max(math.floor(info.height / charHeight), 1)
		mem:write8(0x449, info.mode)
		mem:write16(0x44A, columns)
		mem:write8(0x484, rows - 1)
		mem:write8(0x485, charHeight)
	end
end

function Bios.int10(self: Bios)
	const machine = self.machine
	const cpu = machine.cpu
	const vga = machine.vga
	const ah = band(rshift(cpu.r[1], 8), 0xFF)
	if ah == 0x00 then -- set video mode
		if vga then
			vga:setMode(band(cpu.r[1], 0xFF))
			const width, height = vga:width() :: number, vga:height() :: number
			self.machine:log(
				("INT10 mode=%d w=%d h=%d"):format(band(cpu.r[1], 0xFF), width, height)
			)
		end
		self.cursorX, self.cursorY = 0, 0
	elseif ah == 0x0F then -- get video mode
		if vga then
			const info = vga:modeInfo()
			cpu:wb(0, info.mode)
			cpu:wb(4, info.kind == "text" and 80 or math.floor(info.width / 8))
			cpu:wb(7, 0)
		else
			cpu:wb(0, 0x03)
			cpu:wb(4, 80)
			cpu:wb(7, 0)
		end
	elseif ah == 0x02 then
		self.cursorY = band(rshift(cpu.r[3], 8), 0xFF)
		self.cursorX = band(cpu.r[3], 0xFF)
	elseif ah == 0x03 then
		cpu.r[3] = bor(lshift(self.cursorY, 8), self.cursorX)
		cpu.r[2] = 0x0607
	elseif ah == 0x06 then -- scroll up AL lines (AL=0 clears)
		const count = band(cpu.r[1], 0xFF)
		if count == 0 then
			for _ = 1, Bios.ROWS do
				self:scroll()
			end
		else
			for _ = 1, count do
				self:scroll()
			end
		end
		self.cursorX, self.cursorY = 0, 0
	elseif ah == 0x0E then
		self:teletype(band(cpu.r[3], 0xFF), band(cpu.r[4], 0xFF))
	elseif ah == 0x13 then -- write string at ES:BP, length CX
		const mem = machine.mem
		const base = lshift(cpu.es, 4) + cpu.r[6]
		const count = cpu.r[2]
		const mode = band(cpu.r[1], 0xFF)
		const stride = mode >= 2 and 2 or 1
		for index = 0, count - 1 do
			const ch = mem:read8(base + index * stride)
			const attr = (mode == 1 or mode == 3) and mem:read8(base + index * stride + 1)
				or band(cpu.r[4], 0xFF)
			self:teletype(ch, attr)
		end
	elseif ah == 0x1A then -- get display combination
		cpu:wb(0, 0x1A)
		cpu:wb(6, 0x08) -- VGA with colour display
		cpu:wb(7, 0)
	elseif ah == 0x1B then -- get functionality/state
		cpu:wb(0, 0x1B)
		cpu:wb(6, 0x08)
		cpu:wb(7, 0)
	elseif ah == 0x10 or ah == 0x12 then
		-- palette / alternate select: VGA.DRV programs the DAC directly
	else
		machine:log(("unhandled INT 10h AH=%02X"):format(ah))
	end
	self:updateBDA()
end

-- BIOS INT 9h entry. The guest driver has already read the scan code from
-- port 0x60; reading it again returns the same latched byte. The BIOS only
-- has to acknowledge IRQ1. Windows' KEYBOARD.DRV handles translation itself
-- and chains here for the keys it wants the BIOS to process.
function Bios.int9(self: Bios)
	const machine = self.machine
	machine.cpu.io.in8(0x60)
	if band(machine.picInService, 2) ~= 0 then
		machine.picInService = band(machine.picInService, bnot(2))
	end
end

function Bios.int16(self: Bios)
	const machine = self.machine
	const cpu = machine.cpu
	const ah = band(rshift(cpu.r[1], 8), 0xFF)
	if ah == 0x00 or ah == 0x10 then
		if #machine.keys == 0 then
			cpu.halted = true
			machine.waiting = "keyboard"
			machine.pendingInt = 0x16
			return
		end
		cpu:wr(0, table.remove(machine.keys, 1) :: number) -- AL = ascii, AH = scan (0)
	elseif ah == 0x01 or ah == 0x11 then
		if #machine.keys == 0 then
			cpu:setbits(ZF, true)
		else
			cpu:setbits(ZF, false)
			cpu:wr(0, machine.keys[1])
		end
	elseif ah == 0x02 then
		cpu:wb(0, 0)
	else
		machine:log(("unhandled INT 16h AH=%02X"):format(ah))
	end
end

return Bios

-- GUI buttons under the mouse: the order of MouseButton1Down, Up, Click,
-- Activated (with its click count), InputBegan and InputEnded, GuiState
-- and UserInputService's events with gameProcessedEvent; pressing on one
-- button and releasing on another; button 2. A at (100, 100), B at
-- (300, 100), each 100 x 50.
--! client input 150,125 down up down 350,125 up 150,125 down2 up2 down up 600,400
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false

local releases = 0
local connections = {}
local function on(signal, f)
	table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(f))
end
local function button(name, x)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = name
	b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 100)
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 50)
	for _, event in { "MouseButton1Down", "MouseButton1Up", "MouseButton2Down", "MouseButton2Up" } do
		on(b[event], function(px, py)
			log(name, event, px, py)
		end)
	end
	for _, event in { "MouseButton1Click", "MouseButton2Click", "MouseEnter", "MouseLeave" } do
		on(b[event], function()
			log(name, event)
		end)
	end
	on(b.Activated, function(input, count)
		log(name, "Activated", input.UserInputType, count)
	end)
	for _, event in { "InputBegan", "InputEnded" } do
		on(b[event], function(input)
			log(name, event, input.UserInputType, input.UserInputState)
		end)
	end
	on(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"), function()
		log(name, "GuiState", b.GuiState)
	end)
	b.Parent = screen
	return b
end
button("A", 100)
button("B", 300)
local mouse = { [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = true, [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = true }
on(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
	if mouse[input.UserInputType] then
		log("UIS InputBegan", input.UserInputType, processed, input.Position)
	end
end)
on(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input, processed)
	if mouse[input.UserInputType] then
		log("UIS InputEnded", input.UserInputType, processed, input.Position)
		releases += 1
	end
end)
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local start = os.clock()
while releases < 4 and os.clock() - start < 20 do
	task.wait()
end
task.wait(0.6)
for _, c in connections do
	c:Disconnect()
end
screen:Destroy()
