	end
	const vga = machine.vfs:readFile("C:\\WINDOWS\\VGA.DRV") or ""
	const vgaSys = machine.vfs:readFile("C:\\WINDOWS\\VGASYS.FON") or ""
	const vgaFix = machine.vfs:readFile("C:\\WINDOWS\\VGAFIX.FON") or ""
	const vgaOem = machine.vfs:readFile("C:\\WINDOWS\\VGAOEM.FON") or ""
	for _, dir in { "C:\\WINDOWS", "C:\\WINDOWS\\SYSTEM" } do
		machine.vfs:writeFile(dir .. "\\DISPLAY.DRV", vga)
		machine.vfs:writeFile(dir .. "\\FONTS.FON", vgaSys)
		machine.vfs:writeFile(dir .. "\\FIXEDFON.FON", vgaFix)
		machine.vfs:writeFile(dir .. "\\OEMFONTS.FON", vgaOem)
	end
	machine.dos.cwd = "C:\\WINDOWS"
	machine.vfs.cwd = "C:\\WINDOWS"
	machine:loadCOM(buffer.fromstring(WinBoot.winCom), nil, "C:\\WINDOWS\\WIN.COM")
else
	require(Fixtures.Kernel16).register(machine)
	require(Fixtures.TestApps).register(machine)
	machine.vfs:writeFile("C:\\TEXT.TXT", "Vdm on Roblox, client-side.\r\n")
	machine:loadNE(buffer.fromstring(require(Fixtures.Apps)["NE4.EXE"]))
end

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------- input
-- keyboard: Windows reads make/break scan codes from the 8042; the DOS test
-- path still uses the BIOS INT 16h ASCII queue.
const heldKeys: { [number]: boolean } = {}
const keyRepeatAt: { [number]: number } = {}
const REPEAT_DELAY = 0.45
const REPEAT_INTERVAL = 0.05
-- Modifiers and lock keys do not repeat on a PC keyboard.
const NO_REPEAT: { [number]: boolean } = {
	[0x1D] = true,
	[0x2A] = true,
	[0x36] = true,
	[0x38] = true,
	[0x3A] = true,
	[0x45] = true,
	[0x46] = true,
}

local guestPointerAvailable = false
local mouseButtons = 0
local mouseSynced = false
local lastPointer = Vector2.zero
local lastSinkPosition = Vector2.zero
local lastSinkSize = Vector2.zero
local vgaSink: any = nil
local vgaWidth, vgaHeight = 0, 0
-- The entry anchor sends the cursor to (0,0) followed by the real target.
-- Hold the next frame so the intermediate position is never displayed.
local suppressVideoUntil = 0

local function hasGuestPointer(): boolean
	return machine.mousePs2Enabled and machine.mouseDeviceHandler ~= nil
end

local pointerInsideVideo = false

local function refreshPointerVisibility()
	-- The real pointer stays free: the guest cursor follows its absolute
	-- position (see updateMouse). An earlier Studio mode locked the host
	-- pointer and integrated GetMouseDelta into a virtual one, which drifted
	-- off the video, released the lock mid-gesture and made the guest feel
	-- slow. Hide the host arrow only while it is over the video, where Windows
	-- draws its own cursor; the title and status bars keep the normal arrow.
	guestPointerAvailable = hasGuestPointer()
	const hide = pointerInsideVideo and guestPointerAvailable
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = not hide
	if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	end
end

local function setPointerState(overWindow: boolean, insideVideo: boolean?)
	pointerInsideVideo = overWindow and insideVideo == true
	refreshPointerVisibility()
end

local function updateVideo()
	const vga = machine.vga
	if not vga then
		return
	end
	const info = vga:modeInfo()
	if info.kind == "text" then
		videoHost.Visible = false
		return
	end
	if not vgaSink or vgaWidth ~= info.width or vgaHeight ~= info.height then
		if vgaSink then
			vgaSink:Destroy()
		end
		vgaSink = VgaSink.new(videoHost, info.width, info.height)
		vgaWidth, vgaHeight = info.width, info.height
		mouseSynced = false
		vga:markAllDirty()
	end
	videoHost.Visible = true
	if os.clock() < suppressVideoUntil then
		return
	end
	const dirty = vga:consumeDirty()
	if dirty then
		-- Convert only the dirty rectangle; the rest of the retained RGBA
		-- buffer is from the previous frame. This is the difference between
		-- repainting a 16x16 cursor and repainting 640x480 every tick.
		vgaSink:UpdateRegionRGBA(
			vga:snapshotRegionRGBA(dirty.x, dirty.y, dirty.width, dirty.height),
			dirty.x,
			dirty.y,
			dirty.width,
			dirty.height
		)
	end
end

local lastMousePump = 0
local function updateMouse(position: Vector2?)
	if not vgaSink or not vgaSink.root or not videoHost.Visible then
		setPointerState(false)
		return
	end
	if position then
		-- InputObject.Position is a Vector3; lastPointer stays a Vector2 in
		-- GUI space, and the Heartbeat poll adds Vector2 deltas to it.
		const guiPos = Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)
		lastPointer = guiPos
	end
	const size = vgaSink.root.AbsoluteSize
	const at = vgaSink.root.AbsolutePosition
	if size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 then
		setPointerState(false)
		return
	end
	-- AbsolutePosition/AbsoluteSize are read on every sample, including the
	-- Heartbeat poll below, so a window move or clamp cannot leave the cached
	-- rect making a pointer that is visually inside look outside.
	const resized = size ~= lastSinkSize
	const jumped = math.abs(at.X - lastSinkPosition.X) > 32
		or math.abs(at.Y - lastSinkPosition.Y) > 32
	lastSinkPosition = at
	lastSinkSize = size
	if (resized or jumped) and hasGuestPointer() then
		-- Re-anchor after a resize or a clamp jump: a smooth drag is only a few
		-- pixels per frame, while a clamp can move the window far enough that a
		-- missed relative packet would leave the guest cursor offset.
		mouseSynced = false
		suppressVideoUntil = os.clock() + 0.05
	end
	const winAt = window.Gui.AbsolutePosition
	const winSize = window.Gui.AbsoluteSize
	const overWindow = lastPointer.X >= winAt.X
		and lastPointer.X <= winAt.X + winSize.X
		and lastPointer.Y >= winAt.Y
		and lastPointer.Y <= winAt.Y + winSize.Y
	-- InputObject.Position and AbsolutePosition share the same GUI space (both
	-- exclude the topbar inset). GetMouseLocation adds the inset, so the
	-- Heartbeat poll subtracts it before reaching this function.
	const pos = lastPointer
	const fx = (pos.X - at.X) / size.X
	const fy = (pos.Y - at.Y) / size.Y
	const inside = fx >= 0 and fx <= 1 and fy >= 0 and fy <= 1
	setPointerState(overWindow, inside)
	if not inside then
		if window.Gui then
			window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmPointerInside", false)
			window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmWindowHover", overWindow)
			window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmPointerGuest", Vector2.new(-1, -1))
			window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmSinkPosition", at)
			window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmSinkSize", size)
		end
		return
	end
	if hasGuestPointer() and not mouseSynced then
		-- Anchor once, when the guest mouse driver first becomes available or
		-- after the host window changed geometry. Never re-clamp on clicks: that
		-- teleports the guest cursor to (0,0) for a frame.
		mouseSynced = machine:syncMouse()
		if mouseSynced then
			suppressVideoUntil = os.clock() + 0.05
		end
		refreshPointerVisibility()
	end
	const guestX = math.clamp(math.floor(fx * vgaSink.width), 0, vgaSink.width - 1)
	const guestY = math.clamp(math.floor(fy * vgaSink.height), 0, vgaSink.height - 1)
	machine:setMouse(guestX, guestY - MOUSE_DRV_Y_BIAS, mouseButtons)
	if window.Gui then
		window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmPointerInside", true)
		window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmWindowHover", overWindow)
		window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmPointerGuest", Vector2.new(guestX, guestY))
		window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmSinkPosition", at)
		window.Gui:SetAttribute("VdmSinkSize", size)
	end
	-- Deliver the packet and repaint before the next Heartbeat. Without this
	-- the guest cursor trails the host by a frame or two, which makes slow
	-- window drags slip off the title bar.
	const now = os.clock()
	if now - lastMousePump >= 0.008 then
		lastMousePump = now
		machine:run(1500)
		updateVideo()
	end
end

local function releaseKeys()
	for scan in pairs(heldKeys) do
		machine:keyUp(scan)
	end
	table.clear(heldKeys)
	table.clear(keyRepeatAt)
end

cleaner:Connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, _processed)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		return
	end
	-- The guest owns the keyboard for the whole experience. CoreGui hotkeys are
	-- disabled above, but Roblox still marks some keys (notably O, the emotes
	-- menu) as processed; the emulator has no competing text field, so forward
	-- every mapped key instead of dropping the reserved ones.
	const key = input.KeyCode
	if BOOT_WINDOWS then
		const scan = KeyboardMap[key]
		if scan and not heldKeys[scan] then
			heldKeys[scan] = true
			keyRepeatAt[scan] = os.clock() + REPEAT_DELAY
			machine:keyDown(scan)
		end
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Return then
		machine:pushKeys("\r")
	elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
		machine:pushKeys("\b")
	else
		const char = UserInputService:GetStringForKeyCode(key.Name)
		if char and #char == 1 then
			machine:pushKeys(string.upper(char))
		end
	end
end)
cleaner:Connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
	if not BOOT_WINDOWS or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		return
	end
	const scan = KeyboardMap[input.KeyCode]
	if scan and heldKeys[scan] then
		heldKeys[scan] = nil
		keyRepeatAt[scan] = nil
		machine:keyUp(scan)
	end
end)
cleaner:Connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, releaseKeys)

cleaner:Connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		updateMouse(input.Position)
	end
end)
cleaner:Connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		mouseButtons = bit32.bor(mouseButtons, 1)
		updateMouse(input.Position)
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		mouseButtons = bit32.bor(mouseButtons, 2)
		updateMouse(input.Position)
	end
end)
cleaner:Connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		mouseButtons = bit32.band(mouseButtons, bit32.bnot(1))
		updateMouse(input.Position)
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		mouseButtons = bit32.band(mouseButtons, bit32.bnot(2))
		updateMouse(input.Position)
	end
end)

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------- render
local function colourLabel(info: any): string
	if info.kind == "text" then
		return "text mode"
	end
	if info.bitsPerPixel == 8 then
		return "256 colours"
	end
	return "16 colours"
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ main loop
const INITIAL_STEPS = 50_000
const MIN_STEPS = 12_000
const MAX_STEPS = 80_000
const TARGET_SECONDS = 0.004
local steps = 0
local stepsPerFrame = INITIAL_STEPS
local haltedLogged = false
local faultMessage: string? = nil
local lastStatusAt = 0

local function refreshStatus()
	const now = os.clock()
	if now - lastStatusAt < 0.25 and not faultMessage then
		return
	end
	lastStatusAt = now
	refreshPointerVisibility()
	-- Small read-only diagnostics for Studio probes. These are local
	-- attributes and cost nothing on the network.
	screenGui:SetAttribute("VdmMouseVisible", machine.mouseVisible)
	screenGui:SetAttribute("VdmMouseX", machine.mouseX)
	screenGui:SetAttribute("VdmMouseY", machine.mouseY)
	if faultMessage then
		setStatus("Fault", faultMessage, Theme.Colors.Danger)
		return
	end
	if machine.exitCode then
		setStatus("Stopped", "exit " .. tostring(machine.exitCode), Theme.Colors.Danger)
		return
	end
	const vga = machine.vga
	if vga and vga:modeInfo().kind ~= "text" then
		const info = vga:modeInfo()
		setStatus(
			"Running",
			("%d × %d · %s"):format(info.width, info.height, colourLabel(info)),
			Color3.fromRGB(84, 200, 120)
		)
	else
		setStatus("Starting Windows...", "DOS / BIOS", Color3.fromRGB(220, 160, 64))
	end
end

refreshStatus()

cleaner:Connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function()
	if BOOT_WINDOWS then
		const now = os.clock()
		for scan in pairs(heldKeys) do
			const repeatAt = keyRepeatAt[scan]
			if not NO_REPEAT[scan] and repeatAt ~= nil and now >= repeatAt then
				keyRepeatAt[scan] = now + REPEAT_INTERVAL
				machine:keyDown(scan)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Poll the pointer every frame instead of trusting the last InputChanged
	-- sample. The host window can move or clamp under a stationary pointer, and
	-- a cached rect must never make a visually-inside pointer look outside (or
	-- leave the OS cursor visible over the guest).
	const mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	-- IgnoreGuiInset is on, so GUI space and GetMouseLocation share the same
	-- origin (true screen top-left); no inset compensation.
	if mouse.X >= 0 and mouse.Y >= 0 then
		updateMouse(Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y))
	else
		updateMouse(nil)
	end

	-- Keep calling run() even when the guest HLTs: Machine.run wakes idle
	-- Windows on the next timer tick and dispatches queued PS/2 packets.
	if not faultMessage and not machine.exitCode then
		-- a guest fault must not kill the whole client script
		const started = os.clock()
		const ok, err = pcall(function()
			steps += machine:run(stepsPerFrame)
		end)
		const elapsed = os.clock() - started
		if elapsed > TARGET_SECONDS * 1.25 then
			stepsPerFrame = math.max(MIN_STEPS, math.floor(stepsPerFrame * 0.8))
		elseif elapsed < TARGET_SECONDS * 0.5 then
			stepsPerFrame = math.min(MAX_STEPS, math.floor(stepsPerFrame * 1.06) + 500)
		end
		if not ok then
			faultMessage = tostring(err)
			machine.cpu.halted = true
			warn("[Vdm] guest fault: " .. faultMessage)
		end
		if not faultMessage then
			const vga = machine.vga
			if vga and vga:modeInfo().kind ~= "text" then
				updateVideo()
			else
				videoHost.Visible = false
				sink:update(machine.mem)
			end
		end
	end

	refreshStatus()
	-- Guard against a stale Studio core that predates the 8254 speaker model.
	const speaker = if machine.speakerState then machine:speakerState() else nil
	if speaker and speaker.sequence ~= lastSpeakerSequence then
		lastSpeakerSequence = speaker.sequence
		if speaker.enabled and speaker.frequency > 0 and os.clock() - lastBeepAt >= 0.03 then
			lastBeepAt = os.clock()
			speakerBeep.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(speaker.frequency / 880, 0.5, 2)
			speakerBeep.TimePosition = 0
			pcall(function()
				speakerBeep:Play()
			end)
		end
	end
	window.Gui:SetAttribute(
		"VdmSpeaker",
		Vector2.new(speaker.frequency, if speaker.enabled then 1 else 0)
	)
	if machine.cpu.halted and not haltedLogged then
		haltedLogged = true
		print(
			("[Vdm] halted exit=%s cs:ip=%04X:%04X steps=%d"):format(
				tostring(machine.exitCode),
				machine.cpu.cs,
				machine.cpu.ip,
				steps
			)
		)
	end
end)

window.Closed:Subscribe(function(closed)
	if closed then
		releaseKeys()
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
		if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		end
		cleaner:Clean()
	end
end)

--!strict
-- Discovers and runs unit test cases below ServerStorage.UnitTest.Cases.
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local function format(value: unknown): string
	return type(value) == "string" and string.format("%q", value) or tostring(value)
end

local expect = {}
function expect.equal(actual: unknown, expected: unknown)
	if actual ~= expected then
		error(string.format("expected %s, got %s", format(expected), format(actual)), 2)
	end
end
function expect.truthy(value: unknown)
	if not value then
		error(string.format("expected truthy, got %s", format(value)), 2)
	end
end
function expect.falsy(value: unknown)
	if value then
		error(string.format("expected falsy, got %s", format(value)), 2)
	end
end
function expect.throws(fn: () -> ())
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if ok then
		error("expected function to throw", 2)
	end
	return err
end

return function(filter: string?, timeout: number?)
	local cases = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("UnitTest"):WaitForChild("Cases")
	local limit = timeout or 5
	local totals = { run = 0, passed = 0, failed = 0 }
	for _, module in ipairs(cases:GetDescendants()) do
		if module:IsA("ModuleScript") and (filter == nil or string.find(module.Name, filter, 1, true)) then
			local loaded, factory = pcall(require, module)
			if not loaded or type(factory) ~= "function" then
				totals.run += 1
				totals.failed += 1
				warn(string.format("[FAIL] %s could not load: %s", module.Name, tostring(factory)))
			else
				local context = { expect = expect }
				function context.test(name: string, fn: () -> ())
					totals.run += 1
					local done, passed, message = false, false, nil
					task.spawn(function()
						passed, message = pcall(fn)
						done = true
					end)
					local elapsed = 0
					while not done and elapsed < limit do
						elapsed += task.wait()
					end
					if not done then
						totals.failed += 1
						warn(string.format("[TIMEOUT] %s > %s", module.Name, name))
					elseif passed then
						totals.passed += 1
						print(string.format("[PASS] %s > %s", module.Name, name))
					else
						totals.failed += 1
						warn(string.format("[FAIL] %s > %s | %s", module.Name, name, tostring(message)))
					end
				end
				local built, buildError = pcall(factory, context)
				if not built then
					totals.run += 1
					totals.failed += 1
					warn(string.format("[FAIL] %s setup | %s", module.Name, tostring(buildError)))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	print(string.format("[SUMMARY] %d run, %d passed, %d failed", totals.run, totals.passed, totals.failed))
	return totals
end

-- probe: player-state
-- datamodel: any
-- params: name=""
-- purpose: Where a player is and what state they are in: position, velocity, humanoid state and health, floor
--   material, the player's and character's attributes. On the Client it reads the local player; on the Server pass
--   a name (empty = first player). Use it instead of guessing from a screenshot.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
if not plr then
	local want = {{name}}
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if want == "" or p.Name == want or p.DisplayName == want then plr = p break end
	end
end
if not plr then return "no player" end
local char = plr.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local out = { "player " .. plr.Name }
if hrp then
	table.insert(out, string.format("pos %s  vel %.1f studs/s", tostring(hrp.Position), hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude))
end
if hum then
	table.insert(out, string.format("state %s  health %.0f/%.0f  floor %s  walkspeed %.0f", hum:GetState().Name, hum.Health, hum.MaxHealth, hum.FloorMaterial.Name, hum.WalkSpeed))
end
local function attrs(inst, label)
	local parts = {}
	for k, v in inst:GetAttributes() do table.insert(parts, k .. "=" .. tostring(v)) end
	table.sort(parts)
	if #parts > 0 then table.insert(out, label .. ": " .. table.concat(parts, "  ")) end
end
attrs(plr, "player attrs")
if char then attrs(char, "character attrs") end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remotes: { [any]: any } = {}

export type Input = {
	throttle: number,
	steer: number,
	aim: Vector3,
}
local INPUT = "TankInput"
local EXIT = "TankExit"

local function event(name: string): RemoteEvent
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		-- If the event can be found, return it
		local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
		if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			return existing
		end

		-- Otherwise just create one anew.
		local remote: RemoteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		return remote
	end

	-- Fallback to returning the first instance matching the event name.
	return (ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteEvent)
end

function Remotes.input(): RemoteEvent
	return event(INPUT)
end

function Remotes.exit(): RemoteEvent
	return event(EXIT)
end

function Remotes.valid(packet: unknown): boolean
	-- Refuse non-tables first
	if typeof(packet) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	-- if an invalid member is found, we'll reject it.
	local input: Input = (packet :: Input)
	if typeof(input.throttle) ~= "number" or input.throttle ~= input.throttle then
		return false
	end
	if typeof(input.steer) ~= "number" or input.steer ~= input.steer then
		return false
	end
	if typeof(input.aim) ~= "Vector3" or input.aim ~= input.aim then
		return false
	end
	return input.aim.Magnitude > 1e-4
end

return Remotes

--!nonstrict
-- Headless tests of the art pipeline: normalizer, verifier, Open Cloud client with
-- fake HTTP, asset spec, a real `rojo build`, and (when Blender is installed) the exporter.
-- Run: lune run tests/tools/art_pipeline.luau
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local roblox = require("@lune/roblox")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

local ArtPalette = require("../../src/shared/ArtPalette")
local AssetSpec = require("../../tools/art/lib/AssetSpec")
local Blender = require("../../tools/art/lib/Blender")
local Config = require("../../tools/art/lib/Config")
local Normalize = require("../../tools/art/lib/Normalize")
local OpenCloud = require("../../tools/art/lib/OpenCloud")
local Paths = require("../../tools/art/lib/Paths")
local Verify = require("../../tools/art/lib/Verify")

local CFrame, Color3, Content, Enum, Instance, Vector3 =
	roblox.CFrame, roblox.Color3, roblox.Content, roblox.Enum, roblox.Instance, roblox.Vector3

local FIXTURE_ROOT = "tests/fixtures/art"
local PROBE_PATH = "Props/ArtPipelineProbe"

-- Harness ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local run, passed, failed, skipped = 0, 0, 0, 0
local function test(name: string, fn: () -> ())
	run += 1
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if ok then
		passed += 1
		print(string.format("[ART-TEST] PASS %s", name))
	else
		failed += 1
		print(string.format("[ART-TEST] FAIL %s | %s", name, tostring(err)))
	end
end
local function skip(name: string, reason: string)
	run += 1
	skipped += 1
	print(string.format("[ART-TEST] SKIP %s | %s", name, reason))
end

local function eq(actual: any, expected: any, label: string?)
	if actual ~= expected then
		error(
			string.format(
				"%sexpected %s, got %s",
				if label then label .. ": " else "",
				tostring(expected),
				tostring(actual)
			),
			2
		)
	end
end
local function near(actual: number, expected: number, tolerance: number, label: string?)
	if math.abs(actual - expected) > tolerance then
		error(
			string.format(
				"%sexpected %s +-%s, got %s",
				if label then label .. ": " else "",
				tostring(expected),
				tostring(tolerance),
				tostring(actual)
			),
			2
		)
	end
end
local function truthy(value: any, label: string?)
	if not value then
		error((label or "expected truthy") .. ", got " .. tostring(value), 2)
	end
end

-- Fixtures --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function vectorOf(values: { number }): any
	return Vector3.new(values[1], values[2], values[3])
end

-- Report of the generated probe (Roblox axes, studs).
local function probeReport(): any
	return {
		schemaVersion = 1,
		blenderVersion = "test",
		size = { 4, 3.5, 5 },
		bboxMin = { -2, 0, -3 },
		bboxMax = { 2, 3.5, 2 },
		triangles = 36,
		objects = {
			{ name = "Body__WoodWarm", center = { 0, 1.5, 0 }, size = { 4, 3, 4 }, triangles = 12 },
			{ name = "Nose__RoofRed", center = { 0, 1.5, -2.5 }, size = { 1, 1, 1 }, triangles = 12 },
			{ name = "Top__SnowWhite", center = { -1, 3.25, 0 }, size = { 2, 0.5, 2 }, triangles = 12 },
		},
		attachments = { Front = { 0, 0, -3 } },
		colliders = { { name = "Body", center = { 0, 1.5, 0 }, size = { 4, 3, 4 } } },
	}
end

local function probeSpec(): any
	return {
		schemaVersion = 1,
		artPath = PROBE_PATH,
		displayName = "Art pipeline probe",
		tier = "B",
		version = 1,
		requiredAttachments = { "Front" },
		upload = {},
	}
end

-- Builds the raw import of a report: parts shifted by `offset`, scaled by 1/scale, turned by
-- -yaw (so Normalize has to find `yaw` again), optionally mirrored along X.
local function makeRaw(report: any, options: any?): any
	options = options or {}
	local yaw = options.yaw or 0
	local scale = options.scale or 1
	local reportCentre = (vectorOf(report.bboxMin) + vectorOf(report.bboxMax)) / 2
	local rawCentre = options.offset or reportCentre
	local inverse = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0):Inverse()
	local wrapper = Instance.new("Model")
	wrapper.Name = "RawImport"
	for _, object in ipairs(report.objects) do
		local part = Instance.new("MeshPart")
		part.Name = object.name
		local position = inverse * ((vectorOf(object.center) - reportCentre) / scale) + rawCentre
		if options.mirror then
			position = Vector3.new(2 * rawCentre.X - position.X, position.Y, position.Z)
		end
		local size = vectorOf(object.size) / scale
		if yaw % 180 == 90 then
			size = Vector3.new(size.Z, size.Y, size.X)
		end
		part.Size = size
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		part.MeshContent = Content.fromUri("rbxassetid://1001")
		part.Parent = wrapper
	end
	return wrapper
end

local function normalized(report: any, spec: any, raw: any): any
	local model, code, detail, info = Normalize.normalize({ raw }, report, spec, ArtPalette, 0)
	if model == nil then
		error(string.format("normalize failed: %s %s", tostring(code), tostring(detail)), 2)
	end
	return model, info
end

local function failureOf(report: any, spec: any, raw: any): (string?, string?)
	local model, code, detail = Normalize.normalize({ raw }, report, spec, ArtPalette, 0)
	eq(model, nil, "expected a failure")
	return code, detail
end

local function partOf(model: any, name: string): any
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
	truthy(part, "missing part " .. name)
	return part
end

local function checkIdentity(cframe: any)
	local components = { cframe:GetComponents() }
	local identity = { 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1 }
	for index, expected in ipairs(identity) do
		near(components[index], expected, 1e-4, "CFrame component " .. index)
	end
end

local function placeWith(model: any, artPath: string): any
	local place = Instance.new("DataModel")
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ArtAssets"
	folder.Parent = place:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local parent = folder
	local segments = {}
	for segment in string.gmatch(artPath, "[^/]+") do
		table.insert(segments, segment)
	end
	for index = 1, #segments - 1 do
		local category = Instance.new("Folder")
		category.Name = segments[index]
		category.Parent = parent
		parent = category
	end
	model.Parent = parent
	return place
end

local function codes(failures: { any }): { string }
	local list = {}
	for _, failure in ipairs(failures) do
		table.insert(list, failure.code)
	end
	return list
end

-- Normalize -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
test("N1 identity import normalizes to the report", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local model, info = normalized(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	eq(model.Name, "ArtPipelineProbe")
	eq(info.yaw, 0)
	near(info.scale, 1, 1e-4)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	eq(root and root.Name, "ArtRoot")
	checkIdentity(root.CFrame)
	near(root.Size.X, 0.05, 1e-3)
	eq(root.Transparency, 1)
	eq(root.Anchored, true)
	eq(root.CanCollide, false)
	eq(root.CanQuery, false)
	eq(root.CanTouch, false)
	for _, object in ipairs(report.objects) do
		local partName, key = string.match(object.name, "^(.-)__(.+)$")
		local part = partOf(model, partName)
		eq(part.ClassName, "MeshPart")
		eq(part.Color, Color3.fromRGB(ArtPalette[key].rgb[1], ArtPalette[key].rgb[2], ArtPalette[key].rgb[3]), partName)
		eq(part.Material, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, partName)
		eq(part.Anchored, true)
		eq(part.MeshContent.Uri, "rbxassetid://1001")
		for axis, name in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			near(part.CFrame.Position[name], object.center[axis], 1e-3, partName .. " centre " .. name)
			near(part.Size[name], object.size[axis], 1e-3, partName .. " size " .. name)
		end
	end
	eq(model:GetAttribute("ArtAssetId"), "ArtPipelineProbe")
	eq(model:GetAttribute("ArtPath"), PROBE_PATH)
	eq(model:GetAttribute("ArtSource"), "blender")
	eq(model:GetAttribute("ArtVersion"), 1)
	eq(model:GetAttribute("ArtTier"), "B")
end)

test("N2 yaw 180, scale 0.5 and an offset are detected and undone", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local raw = makeRaw(report, { yaw = 180, scale = 0.5, offset = Vector3.new(10, -3, 7) })
	local model, info = normalized(report, probeSpec(), raw)
	eq(info.yaw, 180)
	near(info.scale, 0.5, 1e-3)
	for _, object in ipairs(report.objects) do
		local part = partOf(model, string.match(object.name, "^(.-)__"))
		for axis, name in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			near(part.CFrame.Position[name], object.center[axis], 2e-3, object.name .. " centre " .. name)
			near(part.Size[name], object.size[axis], 2e-3, object.name .. " size " .. name)
		end
	end
	local expected = { CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0):GetComponents() }
	local actual = { partOf(model, "Body").CFrame:GetComponents() }
	for index = 4, 12 do
		near(actual[index], expected[index], 1e-4, "rotation " .. index)
	end
end)

test("N3 yaw 90 is detected", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local raw = makeRaw(report, { yaw = 90, offset = Vector3.new(-5, 2, 3) })
	local model, info = normalized(report, probeSpec(), raw)
	eq(info.yaw, 90)
	near(info.scale, 1, 1e-3)
	for _, object in ipairs(report.objects) do
		local part = partOf(model, string.match(object.name, "^(.-)__"))
		for axis, name in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
			near(part.CFrame.Position[name], object.center[axis], 2e-3, object.name .. " centre " .. name)
		end
	end
	local expected = { CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0):GetComponents() }
	local actual = { partOf(model, "Top").CFrame:GetComponents() }
	for index = 4, 12 do
		near(actual[index], expected[index], 1e-4, "rotation " .. index)
	end
end)

test("N4 a mirrored import fails with ART_AXIS_MISMATCH", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local code = failureOf(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report, { mirror = true }))
	eq(code, "ART_AXIS_MISMATCH")
end)

test("N5 an unknown palette key fails with ART_UNKNOWN_PALETTE", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	report.objects[1].name = "Body__Unobtainium"
	local code, detail = failureOf(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	eq(code, "ART_UNKNOWN_PALETTE")
	eq(detail, "Unobtainium")
end)

test("N6 unmatched parts fail with ART_UNKNOWN_PART and ART_MISSING_PART", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local raw = makeRaw(report)
	local stray = Instance.new("MeshPart")
	stray.Name = "Stray__WoodWarm"
	stray.Parent = raw
	local code, detail = failureOf(report, probeSpec(), raw)
	eq(code, "ART_UNKNOWN_PART")
	eq(detail, "Stray__WoodWarm")
	local missing = makeRaw(report)
	partOf(missing, "Nose__RoofRed"):Destroy()
	code, detail = failureOf(report, probeSpec(), missing)
	eq(code, "ART_MISSING_PART")
	eq(detail, "Nose__RoofRed")
end)

test("N7 scripts are rejected and textures are stripped", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local raw = makeRaw(report)
	local script = Instance.new("Script")
	script.Name = "Sneaky"
	script.Parent = partOf(raw, "Body__WoodWarm")
	local code, detail = failureOf(report, probeSpec(), raw)
	eq(code, "ART_SCRIPT_FOUND")
	eq(detail, "Sneaky")

	local textured = makeRaw(report)
	Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance").Parent = partOf(textured, "Body__WoodWarm")
	Instance.new("Decal").Parent = partOf(textured, "Top__SnowWhite")
	local model = normalized(report, probeSpec(), textured)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.ClassName == "SurfaceAppearance" or descendant.ClassName == "Decal" then
			error("texture survived: " .. descendant.ClassName)
		end
	end
	eq(model:FindFirstChild("RawImport"), nil)
end)

test("N8 triangle and MeshPart budgets fail with ART_BUDGET", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local spec = probeSpec()
	spec.maxTriangles = 30
	local code, detail = failureOf(report, spec, makeRaw(report))
	eq(code, "ART_BUDGET")
	truthy(string.find(detail, "triangles", 1, true), "detail names triangles")
	spec = probeSpec()
	spec.maxMeshParts = 2
	code, detail = failureOf(report, spec, makeRaw(report))
	eq(code, "ART_BUDGET")
	truthy(string.find(detail, "meshParts", 1, true), "detail names meshParts")
	-- The tier default applies without a spec limit: tier B allows 1000 triangles.
	report.triangles = 1001
	code = failureOf(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	eq(code, "ART_BUDGET")
end)

test("N9 colliders switch the MeshPart collision", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local withColliders = normalized(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Body", "Nose", "Top" }) do
		eq(partOf(withColliders, name).CanCollide, false, name)
	end
	local collider = partOf(withColliders, "Collider_Body")
	eq(collider.ClassName, "Part")
	eq(collider.Transparency, 1)
	eq(collider.CanCollide, true)
	eq(collider.CanQuery, false)
	eq(collider.CanTouch, false)
	eq(collider.Anchored, true)
	near(collider.Size.Y, 3, 1e-3)
	near(collider.CFrame.Position.Y, 1.5, 1e-3)

	local bare = probeReport()
	bare.colliders = {}
	local withoutColliders = normalized(bare, probeSpec(), makeRaw(bare))
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Body", "Nose", "Top" }) do
		eq(partOf(withoutColliders, name).CanCollide, true, name)
	end
	eq(withoutColliders:FindFirstChild("Collider_Body"), nil)
end)

test("N10 attachments are created and required ones are enforced", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local model = normalized(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	local attachment = model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("Front")
	truthy(attachment and attachment.ClassName == "Attachment", "Front attachment")
	near(attachment.Position.Z, -3, 1e-3)

	local noFront = probeReport()
	noFront.attachments = {}
	local code, detail = failureOf(noFront, probeSpec(), makeRaw(noFront))
	eq(code, "ART_MISSING_ATTACHMENT")
	eq(detail, "Front")

	-- Trees always need TreeBase, even when asset.json lists nothing.
	local treeSpec = probeSpec()
	treeSpec.artPath = "Trees/DouglasFir/Medium"
	treeSpec.requiredAttachments = {}
	code, detail = failureOf(report, treeSpec, makeRaw(report))
	eq(code, "ART_MISSING_ATTACHMENT")
	eq(detail, "TreeBase")
	local treeReport = probeReport()
	treeReport.attachments.TreeBase = { 0, 0, 0 }
	local tree = normalized(treeReport, treeSpec, makeRaw(treeReport))
	eq(tree.Name, "Medium")
	truthy(tree.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("TreeBase"), "TreeBase attachment")
end)

test("N11 a serialized model survives a round trip and passes verifyPlace", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local model = normalized(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	local back = roblox.deserializeModel(roblox.serializeModel({ model }))[1]
	local place = placeWith(back, PROBE_PATH)
	local failures = Verify.verifyPlace(place, { { artPath = PROBE_PATH, spec = probeSpec(), hasRbxm = true } })
	eq(#failures, 0, table.concat(codes(failures), ","))
end)

-- Verify ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
test("V1 verifyPlace reports a missing asset", function()
	local place = Instance.new("DataModel")
	local failures = Verify.verifyPlace(place, {
		{ artPath = PROBE_PATH, spec = probeSpec(), hasRbxm = true },
		{ artPath = "Props/Pending", spec = probeSpec(), hasRbxm = false },
	})
	eq(#failures, 1)
	eq(failures[1].code, "MissingArtAsset")
	eq(failures[1].artPath, PROBE_PATH)
end)

test("V2 verifyPlace reports empty meshes and a stale version", function()
	local report = probeReport()
	local model = normalized(report, probeSpec(), makeRaw(report))
	partOf(model, "Nose").MeshContent = Content.none
	local spec = probeSpec()
	spec.version = 2
	local place = placeWith(model, PROBE_PATH)
	local found = codes(Verify.verifyPlace(place, { { artPath = PROBE_PATH, spec = spec, hasRbxm = true } }))
	table.sort(found)
	eq(table.concat(found, ","), "ART_BAD_MESH,ART_VERSION_MISMATCH")
end)

test("V3 verifyFiles flags an orphan .rbxm and lists pending specs", function()
	local failures, pending = Verify.verifyFiles({ "Props/Orphan", "Props/Done" }, { "Props/Done", "Props/Later" })
	eq(#failures, 1)
	eq(failures[1].code, "ART_ORPHAN_RBXM")
	eq(failures[1].artPath, "Props/Orphan")
	eq(table.concat(pending, ","), "Props/Later")

-- OpenCloud (fake HTTP) -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local KEY = "TEST-KEY-do-not-print-123"
local session = { apiKey = KEY, creator = { userId = "42" } }

-- handler(request, callNumber) -> response table or nil, message
local function fakeDeps(handler: (any, number) -> (any, string?))
	local log, sleeps = {}, {}
	local deps = {
		request = function(req: any)
			table.insert(log, req)
			return handler(req, #log)
		end,
		sleep = function(seconds: number)
			table.insert(sleeps, seconds)
		end,
	}
	return deps, log, sleeps
end

local function json(status: number, value: any): any
	return { status = status, body = serde.encode("json", value), headers = {} }
end

local function assertNoKey(...: any)
	for _, value in ipairs({ ... }) do
		if type(value) == "string" and string.find(value, KEY, 1, true) then
			error("API key leaked into a result")
		end
	end
end

test("O1 upload posts the FBX, polls and returns the asset id", function()
	local deps, log, sleeps = fakeDeps(function(req, call)
		if req.method == "POST" then
			return json(200, { path = "operations/op1", done = false })
		end
		if call < 3 then
			return json(200, { path = "operations/op1", done = false })
		end
		return json(200, { path = "operations/op1", done = true, response = { assetId = "123" } })
	end)
	local assetId, code, detail = OpenCloud.upload(deps, session, PROBE_PATH, "Probe", "FBXBYTES")
	eq(assetId, "123")
	eq(code, nil)
	assertNoKey(assetId, code, detail)
	eq(#log, 3)
	eq(log[1].url, Config.ASSETS_URL)
	eq(log[1].headers["x-api-key"], KEY)
	truthy(
		string.find(
			log[1].headers["Content-Type"],
			"^multipart/form%-data; boundary=gameart%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$"
		),
		"boundary"
	)
	truthy(string.find(log[1].body, '"assetType":"Model"', 1, true), "assetType")
	truthy(string.find(log[1].body, '"userId":"42"', 1, true), "creator")
	truthy(string.find(log[1].body, "model/fbx", 1, true), "content type")
	truthy(string.find(log[1].body, "FBXBYTES", 1, true), "file bytes")
	eq(log[2].url, Config.OPERATIONS_URL .. "op1")
	eq(log[2].method, "GET")
	eq(#sleeps, 2)
	eq(sleeps[1], Config.POLL_SECONDS)
end)

test("O2 upload failures, rate limits, timeouts and ambiguity", function()
	-- 401 is a failure, and the key never shows even when the server echoes it.
	local deps = fakeDeps(function()
		return { status = 401, body = "bad key " .. KEY, headers = {} }
	end)
	local assetId, code, detail = OpenCloud.upload(deps, session, PROBE_PATH, "Probe", "x")
	eq(assetId, nil)
	eq(code, "ART_UPLOAD_FAILED")
	truthy(string.find(detail, "^401"), "status in detail")
	assertNoKey(code, detail)

	-- 429 three times, then success.
	local rateDeps, rateLog, rateSleeps = fakeDeps(function(_, call)
		if call <= 3 then
			return { status = 429, body = "slow down", headers = { ["Retry-After"] = "7" } }
		end
		return json(200, { done = true, response = { assetId = 777 } })
	end)
	assetId, code = OpenCloud.upload(rateDeps, session, PROBE_PATH, "Probe", "x")
	eq(assetId, "777")
	eq(#rateLog, 4)
	eq(#rateSleeps, 3)
	eq(rateSleeps[1], 7)
	-- A fourth 429 gives up.
	local stuck = fakeDeps(function()
		return { status = 429, body = "no", headers = {} }
	end)
	assetId, code, detail = OpenCloud.upload(stuck, session, PROBE_PATH, "Probe", "x")
	eq(code, "ART_UPLOAD_FAILED")
	truthy(string.find(detail, "^429"), "429 in detail")

	-- Sixty polls without a result time out.
	local pollDeps, pollLog = fakeDeps(function()
		return json(200, { path = "operations/op2", done = false })

	eq(code, "ART_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT")
	eq(#pollLog, 1 + Config.MAX_POLLS)

	-- An operation error is a failure.
	local errorDeps = fakeDeps(function()
		return json(200, { path = "operations/op3", done = true, error = { code = 3, message = "bad mesh" } })
	end)
	assetId, code, detail = OpenCloud.upload(errorDeps, session, PROBE_PATH, "Probe", "x")
	eq(code, "ART_UPLOAD_FAILED")
	truthy(string.find(detail, "bad mesh", 1, true), "operation error text")

	-- A transport error is ambiguous and never retried.
	local lostDeps, lostLog = fakeDeps(function()
		return nil, "connection reset"
	end)

export type Tank = {
	model: Model,
	hull: BasePart,
	turret: BasePart,
	mantlet: BasePart,
	gun: BasePart,
	traverse: Motor6D,
	elevate: Motor6D,
	traverseRest: CFrame,
	elevateRest: CFrame,
	leftTrack: BasePart,
	rightTrack: BasePart,
	rideHeight: number,
	halfTrackWidth: number,
	leftSign: number,
}

local Rig: { [any]: any } = {}

local function need(parent: Instance, name: string, class: string): Instance
	local child = parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	-- If the parent hasn't got a child matching the name, error
	if not child then
		error(`{parent:GetFullName()} has no {name}`, 1)
	end

	-- If the expected class doesn't match that of the found child, error
	if not child:IsA(class) then
		error(`{child:GetFullName()} is a {child.ClassName},expected a {class}`, 1)
	end
	return child
end

function Rig.resolve(model: Model): ()
	-- Get the main body models first.
	local hullModel: Instance = need(model, "Hull", "Model")
	local turretModel: Instance = need(model, "Turret", "Model")
	local weapon: Instance = need(turretModel, "Weapon", "Model")

	-- Get all required BaseParts and Motor6Ds for the final dictionary.
	local hull = need(hullModel, "Hull", "BasePart") :: BasePart
	local turret = need(turretModel, "Main", "BasePart") :: BasePart
	local mantlet = need(weapon, "Mantlet", "BasePart") :: BasePart
	local gun = need(weapon, "Gun", "BasePart") :: BasePart
	local leftTrack = need(hullModel, "LeftTrack", "BasePart") :: BasePart
	local rightTrack = need(hullModel, "RightTrack", "BasePart") :: BasePart
	local traverse = need(hull, "Main", "Motor6D") :: Motor6D
	local elevate = need(turret, "Mantlet", "") :: Motor6D
	local rig: Tank = {
		model = model,
		hull = hull,
		turret = turret,
		mantlet = mantlet,
		gun = gun,
		traverse = traverse,
		elevate = elevate,
		traverseRest = (traverse :: Motor6D).C0,
		elevateRest = (elevate :: Motor6D).C0,
		leftTrack = leftTrack,
		rightTrack = rightTrack,
		rideHeight = (hull.Position.Y - lefTrack.Position.Y) + leftTrack.Size.Y / 2,
		halfTrackWidth = (rightTrack.Position - leftTrack.Position) / 2,
		leftSign = if hull.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(leftTrack.Position).X < 0 then 1 else -1,
	}

	local function drives(joint: Motor6D): string
		return if joint.Part1 then joint.Part1.Name else "nothing"
	end

end

return Rig

-- probe: ray-all
-- datamodel: any
-- params: ox=0 oy=10 oz=0 tx=0 ty=10 tz=-100 root=workspace max=12
-- purpose: Everything a sight line passes through, INCLUDING parts workspace:Raycast skips (CanQuery = false,
--   transparent parts carrying SurfaceGuis/Decals). Sorted by distance. Use the capture camera position as the
--   origin and the pixel you are asking about as the target.
local root = {{root}}
local o, target = Vector3.new({{ox}}, {{oy}}, {{oz}}), Vector3.new({{tx}}, {{ty}}, {{tz}})
local dir = (target - o).Unit
local LIMIT = (target - o).Magnitude * 4
local function slab(p)
	local lo, ld = p.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(o), p.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(dir)
	local h = p.Size / 2
	local tmin, tmax = -math.huge, math.huge
	for _, ax in { "X", "Y", "Z" } do
		local a, b, e = lo[ax], ld[ax], h[ax]
		if math.abs(b) < 1e-9 then
			if math.abs(a) > e then return nil end
		else
			local t1, t2 = (-e - a) / b, (e - a) / b
			if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 end
			tmin, tmax = math.max(tmin, t1), math.min(tmax, t2)
			if tmin > tmax then return nil end
		end
	end
	if tmax < 0 then return nil end
	return math.max(tmin, 0)
end
local hits = {}
for _, p in root:GetDescendants() do
	if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p:IsA("Terrain") then
		local t = slab(p)
		if t and t < LIMIT then table.insert(hits, { p = p, t = t }) end
	end
end
table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
local out = { string.format("%d parts on the line (first %d):", #hits, math.min(#hits, {{max}})) }
for i = 1, math.min(#hits, {{max}}) do
	local p = hits[i].p
	local extras = {}
	if not p.CanQuery then table.insert(extras, "CanQuery=false") end
	if p.Transparency >= 0.95 then table.insert(extras, "invisible") end
	if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui") then table.insert(extras, "SurfaceGui") end
	if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture") then table.insert(extras, "Decal") end
	table.insert(out, string.format("%5.1f  %s  %s", hits[i].t, p:GetFullName(), table.concat(extras, " ")))
end
local r = workspace:Raycast(o, dir * LIMIT)
table.insert(out, "workspace:Raycast says: " .. (r and (r.Instance:GetFullName() .. string.format(" at %.1f", (r.Position - o).Magnitude)) or "nothing"))
table.insert(out, "Nothing here but the artefact is on screen? It is not geometry: run gui-overflow, then bisect with hide.")
return table.concat(out, "\n")

--!nonstrict
-- ScreenSink.lua -- client-side renderer for the emulated 80x25 text screen.
-- One monospace TextLabel per row inside the window content.

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Vdm = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Vdm"))
const VdmUi = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VdmUi"))

const ScreenSink = {}
ScreenSink.__index = ScreenSink

export type ScreenSink = {
	update: (self: ScreenSink, mem: any) -> (),
}

function ScreenSink.new(cleaner: any, parent: Instance): ScreenSink
	const surface = cleaner:Add(Instance.new("Frame"))
	surface.Name = "Screen"
	surface.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	surface.BackgroundColor3 = VdmUi.Theme.Colors.Screen
	surface.BorderSizePixel = 0
	surface.Parent = parent

	const labels = table.create(Vdm.TextScreen.ROWS) :: { TextLabel }
	for row = 1, Vdm.TextScreen.ROWS do
		const label = cleaner:Add(Instance.new("TextLabel"))
		label.Name = "Row" .. row
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1 / Vdm.TextScreen.ROWS)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, (row - 1) / Vdm.TextScreen.ROWS)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Font = VdmUi.Theme.Fonts.Mono
		label.TextSize = VdmUi.Theme.Sizes.ScreenText
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.TextColor3 = VdmUi.Theme.Colors.ScreenText
		label.Text = ""
		label.Parent = surface
		labels[row] = label
	end

	return setmetatable({ labels = labels }, ScreenSink) :: any
end

function ScreenSink.update(self: ScreenSink, mem: any)
	const rows = Vdm.TextScreen.rows(mem)
	const labels = (self :: any).labels
	for index, row in rows do
		labels[index].Text = row.text
	end
end

return ScreenSink

--!nonstrict
-- Art pipeline CLI: .blend -> FBX -> Roblox mesh -> normalized .rbxm.
-- Run from the repository root:  lune run tools/art/art.luau <command> [args]
--   doctor                     Blender, API key and creator status (exit 0 / 2 / 1)
--   export <artPath>           .blend -> _build/<artPath>/model.fbx + report.json
--   render <artPath>           Workbench previews, no upload needed
--   upload <artPath> [--force] FBX -> Open Cloud -> _build/<artPath>/raw.rbxm
--   normalize <artPath> [--raw <file>]
--   build <artPath>            export, upload, normalize
--   verify <placeFile>         integrated art vs the built place
--   probe                      the generated pipeline probe, end to end
-- Every command takes --root <dir> (default assets/art). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error,
-- 2 missing API key or creator.
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local net = require("@lune/net")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local roblox = require("@lune/roblox")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")
local task = require("@lune/task")

local ArtPalette = require("../../src/shared/ArtPalette")
local AssetSpec = require("./lib/AssetSpec")
local Blender = require("./lib/Blender")
local Config = require("./lib/Config")
local OpenCloud = require("./lib/OpenCloud")
local Normalize = require("./lib/Normalize")
local Paths = require("./lib/Paths")
local Verify = require("./lib/Verify")

local PROBE_ROOT = "tests/fixtures/art"
local PROBE_PATH = "Props/ArtPipelineProbe"
local EXPORT_SCRIPT = "tools/art/blender_export.py"
local RENDER_SCRIPT = "tools/art/blender_render.py"
local PROBE_SCRIPT = "tools/art/make_probe.py"
local NO_KEY_MESSAGE = "ART_NO_API_KEY: set ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY and ART_CREATOR (README, Art pipeline setup)"

local function die(message: string, code: number?)
	stdio.ewrite(message .. "\n")
	process.exit(code or 1)
end

-- Argument parsing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local positional: { string } = {}
local options: { [string]: string | boolean } = {}
do
	local args = process.args
	local index = 1
	while index <= #args do
		local value = args[index]
		if value == "--root" or value == "--raw" then
			options[value] = args[index + 1]
			index += 2
		elseif value == "--force" then
			options[value] = true
			index += 1
		else
			table.insert(positional, value)
			index += 1
		end
	end
end
local command = positional[1]
local root: string = if type(options["--root"]) == "string" then options["--root"] :: string else Paths.DEFAULT_ROOT

-- Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function requireArtPath(): string
	local artPath = positional[2]
	if artPath == nil or not Paths.isValid(artPath) then
		die("ART_BAD_PATH: expected an art path such as Buildings/MarketStarter, got " .. tostring(artPath))
	end
	return artPath
end

local function loadSpec(rootDir: string, artPath: string): any
	local file = Paths.specFile(rootDir, artPath)
	if not fs.isFile(file) then
		die("ART_BAD_SPEC file " .. file)
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(serde.decode, "json", fs.readFile(file))
	if not ok then
		die("ART_BAD_SPEC json " .. file)
	end
	local spec, problem = AssetSpec.validate(data, artPath)
	if spec == nil then
		die(problem :: string)
	end
	return spec
end

local function requireBlender(): string
	local blender = Blender.resolve()
	if blender == nil then
		die(Blender.MISSING_CODE .. ": " .. Blender.MISSING_HINT)
	end
	return blender :: string
end

local function requireBlend(rootDir: string, artPath: string): string
	local blendFile = Paths.blendFile(rootDir, artPath)
	if not fs.isFile(blendFile) then
		die("ART_NO_BLEND: " .. blendFile)
	end
	return blendFile
end

local function showBlenderFailure(what: string, result: any)
	for _, line in ipairs(Blender.artLines(result)) do
		stdio.ewrite(line .. "\n")
	end
	die(string.format("ART_%s_FAILED: Blender exit code %d", what, result.code))
end

local function readSession(): any
	local key = process.env.ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY
	local creator = OpenCloud.parseCreator(process.env.ART_CREATOR)
	if key == nil or key == "" or creator == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return { apiKey = key, creator = creator }
end

local deps = {
	request = function(req: any): (any, string?)
		local ok, response = pcall(net.request, {
			url = req.url,
			method = req.method,
			headers = req.headers,
			body = req.body,
		})
		if not ok then
			return nil, tostring(response)
		end
		return { status = response.statusCode, body = response.body, headers = response.headers }, nil
	end,
	sleep = function(seconds: number)
		task.wait(seconds)
	end,
}

local function scan(dir: string, prefix: string, matchFile: (string) -> string?, found: { string })
	if not fs.isDir(dir) then
		return
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(fs.readDir(dir)) do
		local path = dir .. "/" .. name
		if fs.isDir(path) then
			scan(path, prefix .. name .. "/", matchFile, found)
		else
			local stem = matchFile(name)
			if stem ~= nil then
				table.insert(found, if stem == "" then string.sub(prefix, 1, -2) else prefix .. stem)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function listSpecs(rootDir: string): { string }
	local found: { string } = {}
	scan(rootDir .. "/source", "", function(name)
		return if name == "asset.json" then "" else nil
	end, found)
	table.sort(found)
	return found
end

local function listRbxm(rootDir: string): { string }
	local found: { string } = {}
	scan(rootDir .. "/rbxm", "", function(name)
		return string.match(name, "^(.+)%.rbxm$")
	end, found)
	table.sort(found)
	return found
end

-- Commands --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function doctor()
	local blender = Blender.resolve()
	local session = readSession()
	local creator = process.env.ART_CREATOR
	if blender ~= nil then
		print(string.format("Blender: %s (%s)", blender, Blender.version(blender) or "unknown version"))
	else
		print("Blender: missing (" .. Blender.MISSING_CODE .. ": " .. Blender.MISSING_HINT .. ")")
	end
	local keySet = process.env.ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY ~= nil and process.env.ROBLOX_OPEN_CLOUD_API_KEY ~= ""
	print("API key: " .. (if keySet then "set" else "missing"))
	print("Creator: " .. (if creator ~= nil and creator ~= "" then creator else "missing"))
	if blender == nil then
		process.exit(1)
	end
	if session == nil then
		process.exit(2)
	end
	process.exit(0)
end

local function exportArt(rootDir: string, artPath: string)
	loadSpec(rootDir, artPath)
	local blender = requireBlender()
	local buildDir = Paths.buildDir(rootDir, artPath)
	fs.writeDir(buildDir)
	local result = Blender.run(blender, requireBlend(rootDir, artPath), EXPORT_SCRIPT, {
		"--fbx",
		buildDir .. "/model.fbx",
		"--report",
		buildDir .. "/report.json",
	})
	if result.code ~= 0 then
		showBlenderFailure("EXPORT", result)
	end
	print(string.format("[ART] exported %s to %s/model.fbx", artPath, buildDir))
end

local function renderArt(rootDir: string, artPath: string)
	loadSpec(rootDir, artPath)
	local blender = requireBlender()
	local buildDir = Paths.buildDir(rootDir, artPath)
	fs.writeDir(buildDir)
	local extra = { "--out-dir", buildDir, "--colors" }
	local keys = {}
	for key in pairs(ArtPalette) do
		table.insert(keys, key)
	end
	table.sort(keys)
	for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
		local rgb = ArtPalette[key].rgb
		table.insert(extra, string.format("%s=%d,%d,%d", key, rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]))
	end
	local result = Blender.run(blender, requireBlend(rootDir, artPath), RENDER_SCRIPT, extra)
	if result.code ~= 0 then
		showBlenderFailure("RENDER", result)
	end
	print(string.format("[ART] rendered %s to %s/preview_front.png and preview_34.png", artPath, buildDir))
end

-- Returns the asset id of the uploaded (or previously recorded) model.
local function uploadArt(rootDir: string, artPath: string, force: boolean): string
	local session = readSession()
	if session == nil then
		die(NO_KEY_MESSAGE, 2)
	end
	local spec = loadSpec(rootDir, artPath)
	local blendFile = requireBlend(rootDir, artPath)
	local sha = serde.hash("sha256", fs.readFile(blendFile))
	local buildDir = Paths.buildDir(rootDir, artPath)
	local assetId = spec.upload.modelAssetId
	if force or spec.upload.sourceSha256 ~= sha or assetId == nil then
		local fbxFile = buildDir .. "/model.fbx"
		if not fs.isFile(fbxFile) then
			die("ART_NO_FBX: run export first (" .. fbxFile .. ")")
		end
		local uploaded, code, detail = OpenCloud.upload(deps, session, artPath, spec.displayName, fs.readFile(fbxFile))
		if uploaded == nil then
			die(string.format("%s %s", code :: string, detail or ""))
		end
		assetId = uploaded
		spec.version += 1
		spec.upload = { modelAssetId = uploaded, sourceSha256 = sha, uploadedAt = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") }
		fs.writeFile(Paths.specFile(rootDir, artPath), AssetSpec.encode(spec))
	end
	local bytes, code, detail = OpenCloud.download(deps, session, assetId)
	if bytes == nil then
		die(string.format("%s %s", code :: string, detail or ""))
	end
	fs.writeDir(buildDir)
	fs.writeFile(buildDir .. "/raw.rbxm", bytes)
	print(string.format("[ART] uploaded %s asset %s", artPath, assetId))
	return assetId
end

-- Returns the detected yaw and scale.
local function normalizeArt(rootDir: string, artPath: string, rawFile: string?): (number, number)
	local spec = loadSpec(rootDir, artPath)
	local buildDir = Paths.buildDir(rootDir, artPath)
	local rawPath = rawFile or (buildDir .. "/raw.rbxm")
	if not fs.isFile(rawPath) then
		die("ART_NO_RAW: " .. rawPath)
	end
	local reportPath = buildDir .. "/report.json"
	if not fs.isFile(reportPath) then
		die("ART_NO_REPORT: run export first (" .. reportPath .. ")")
	end
	local reportOk, report = pcall(serde.decode, "json", fs.readFile(reportPath))
	if not reportOk or type(report) ~= "table" or report.schemaVersion ~= 1 then
		die("ART_BAD_REPORT: " .. reportPath)
	end
	local rawOk, raw = pcall(roblox.deserializeModel, fs.readFile(rawPath))
	if not rawOk then
		die("ART_BAD_RAW: " .. rawPath)
	end
	local model, code, detail, info = Normalize.normalize(raw, report, spec, ArtPalette, Config.IMPORT_YAW_DEGREES)
	if model == nil then
		die(string.format("%s %s", code :: string, detail or ""))
	end
	local output = Paths.rbxmFile(rootDir, artPath)
	fs.writeDir(Paths.parentDir(output))
	fs.writeFile(output, roblox.serializeModel({ model }))
	print(string.format("[ART] normalized %s yaw %d scale %.4f", artPath, info.yaw, info.scale))
	return info.yaw, info.scale
end

local function buildArt(rootDir: string, artPath: string): (number, number, string)
	exportArt(rootDir, artPath)
	local assetId = uploadArt(rootDir, artPath, false)
	local yaw, scale = normalizeArt(rootDir, artPath, nil)
	return yaw, scale, assetId
end

local function verifyPlace(placeFile: string?)
	if placeFile == nil or not fs.isFile(placeFile) then
		die("ART_NO_PLACE: " .. tostring(placeFile))
	end
	local ok, place = pcall(roblox.deserializePlace, fs.readFile(placeFile :: string))
	if not ok then
		die("ART_BAD_PLACE: " .. tostring(placeFile))
	end
	local specPaths = listSpecs(root)
	local rbxmPaths = listRbxm(root)
	local hasRbxm: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, artPath in ipairs(rbxmPaths) do
		hasRbxm[artPath] = true
	end
	local entries = {}
	local failures = {}
	for _, artPath in ipairs(specPaths) do
		local data = nil
		local decoded, value = pcall(serde.decode, "json", fs.readFile(Paths.specFile(root, artPath)))
		if decoded then
			data = value
		end
		local spec, problem = AssetSpec.validate(data, artPath)
		if spec == nil then
			table.insert(failures, { artPath = artPath, code = "ART_BAD_SPEC", detail = (problem :: string):sub(14) })
		else
			table.insert(entries, { artPath = artPath, spec = spec, hasRbxm = hasRbxm[artPath] == true })
		end
	end
	for _, failure in ipairs(Verify.verifyPlace(place, entries)) do
		table.insert(failures, failure)
	end
	local fileFailures, pending = Verify.verifyFiles(rbxmPaths, specPaths)
	for _, failure in ipairs(fileFailures) do
		table.insert(failures, failure)
	end
	local failed: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, failure in ipairs(failures) do
		failed[failure.artPath] = true
		print(string.format("[ART] FAIL %s %s %s", failure.artPath, failure.code, failure.detail or ""))
	end
	local integrated = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if entry.hasRbxm and not failed[entry.artPath] then
			integrated += 1
		end
	end
	print(string.format("[ART] %d integrated, %d pending, %d failed", integrated, #pending, #failures))
	process.exit(if #failures > 0 then 1 else 0)
end

local function probe()
	local blender = requireBlender()
	local result = Blender.run(blender, nil, PROBE_SCRIPT, { "--out", Paths.blendFile(PROBE_ROOT, PROBE_PATH) })
	if result.code ~= 0 then
		showBlenderFailure("PROBE", result)
	end
	local yaw, scale, assetId = buildArt(PROBE_ROOT, PROBE_PATH)
	print(string.format("[ART] probe OK yaw %d scale %.4f asset %s", yaw, scale, assetId))
end

if command == "doctor" then
	doctor()
elseif command == "export" then
	exportArt(root, requireArtPath())
elseif command == "render" then
	renderArt(root, requireArtPath())
elseif command == "upload" then
	uploadArt(root, requireArtPath(), options["--force"] == true)
elseif command == "normalize" then
	normalizeArt(root, requireArtPath(), if type(options["--raw"]) == "string" then options["--raw"] :: string else nil)
elseif command == "build" then
	buildArt(root, requireArtPath())
elseif command == "verify" then
	verifyPlace(positional[2])
elseif command == "probe" then
	probe()
else
	die(
		"usage: lune run tools/art/art.luau doctor|export|render|upload|normalize|build|verify|probe [args] [--root <dir>]"
	)
end

--!nonstrict
-- VgaSink.lua -- Roblox display sink for core/Vga framebuffers.
--
-- Pixel format: flat RGBA8, four bytes per pixel (R, G, B, A), row-major from
-- the top-left. This is exactly what Vga:snapshotRGBA() returns (and what
-- EditableImage:WritePixelsBuffer expects). Alpha is always 255 in VGA output.
--
-- Cadence: call UpdateRGBA / UpdateRegionRGBA at most once per rendered frame,
-- ideally from RunService.RenderStepped or a 30/60 Hz accumulator. Roblox only
-- applies one EditableImage update per displayed frame, so pushing every
-- emulated instruction would queue work without improving the picture. A full
-- 640x480 upload is 1,228,800 bytes; use UpdateRegionRGBA with the rectangle
-- from Vga:consumeDirty() when only part of the screen changed.
--
-- The sink is fixed-size. Create it with the active VGA mode's dimensions and
-- recreate it when the mode changes (640x480 for mode 12h, 320x200 for 13h,
-- 640x400 for the text fallback).
--
-- API:
--   VgaSink.new(parent, width, height) -> VgaSink
--   sink:UpdateRGBA(buffer)                    -- full frame
--   sink:UpdateRegionRGBA(buffer, x, y, w, h)  -- full-frame buffer + dirty rect
--   sink:UpdatePixels(table)                   -- full frame, flat RGBA8 table
--   sink:Destroy()
--   sink.kind: "editable" | "grid" | "placeholder"
--
-- If EditableImage cannot be created, attached, or written (permission,
-- memory-budget, or client-version problems), the sink builds a coarse Frame
-- grid (32 x ~24 cells) so the emulator still shows a low-resolution picture.
-- If even that is unavailable it leaves a labelled placeholder. Current
-- clients cap EditableImage at 1024x1024; 640x480 fits comfortably.

const AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

const VgaSink = {}
VgaSink.__index = VgaSink

const GRID_COLUMNS = 32
const GRID_INTERVAL = 1 / 15

local function toChannel(value: number): number
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0), 0, 255)
end

local function makeRoot(parent: Instance, width: number, height: number): Frame
	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "VgaSink"
	root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.ClipsDescendants = true
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	-- The aspect constraint may letterbox a 4:3 screen inside a wider host
	-- window; center it so the bars are symmetric instead of one black band.
	root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Parent = parent

	pcall(function()
		const aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
		aspect.AspectRatio = width / height
		aspect.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize
		aspect.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Width
		aspect.Parent = root
	end)
	return root
end

local function makeEditableImage(width: number, height: number): any?
	const ok, image = pcall(function()
		return AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(width, height) })
	end)
	if not ok or image == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return image
end

local function attachEditableImage(label: ImageLabel, image: any): boolean
	const ok = pcall(function()
		label.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(image)
	end)
	return ok
end

local function makeImageLabel(root: Frame): ImageLabel
	const label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	label.Name = "Screen"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	pcall(function()
		label.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
	end)
	label.Parent = root
	return label
end

local function makePlaceholder(root: Frame, message: string): TextLabel
	const label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Placeholder"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 16)
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.Text = message
	label.Parent = root
	return label
end

local function buildGrid(root: Frame, width: number, height: number): ({ Frame }, number, number)
	const columns = math.min(GRID_COLUMNS, width)
	const rows = math.max(1, math.floor(columns * height / width + 0.5))
	const cells = table.create(columns * rows)
	local index = 1
	for row = 0, rows - 1 do
		for column = 0, columns - 1 do
			const cell = Instance.new("Frame")
			cell.Name = string.format("Cell_%d_%d", column, row)
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			cell.BorderSizePixel = 0
			cell.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / columns, 1 / rows)
			cell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(column / columns, row / rows)
			cell.Parent = root
			cells[index] = cell
			index += 1
		end
	end
	return cells, columns, rows
end

function VgaSink.new(parent: Instance, width: number, height: number): VgaSink
	assert(parent ~= nil, "VgaSink.new needs a parent Instance")
	assert(width > 0 and height > 0, "VgaSink dimensions must be positive")

	const self = setmetatable({}, VgaSink) :: any
	self.width = math.max(1, math.floor(width))
	self.height = math.max(1, math.floor(height))
	self.kind = "placeholder"
	self.updateCount = 0
	self.lastError = nil
	self.warned = false
	self.lastGridUpdate = -GRID_INTERVAL
	self.regionBuffer = nil
	self.root = makeRoot(parent, self.width, self.height)

	const image = makeEditableImage(self.width, self.height)
	if image ~= nil then
		const label = makeImageLabel(self.root)
		if attachEditableImage(label, image) then
			self.kind = "editable"
			self.imageLabel = label
			self.editableImage = image
			return self
		end
		pcall(function()
			image:Destroy()
		end)
		label:Destroy()
		self.lastError = "EditableImage could not be attached to an ImageLabel"
	end

	const gridOk, cells, columns, rows = pcall(buildGrid, self.root, self.width, self.height)
	if gridOk then
		self.cells = cells
		self.gridColumns = columns
		self.gridRows = rows
		self.kind = "grid"
		if self.lastError == nil then
			self.lastError = "EditableImage unavailable; using a coarse Frame grid"
		end
	else
		self.kind = "placeholder"
		self.lastError = "VGA display unavailable: " .. tostring(cells)
		makePlaceholder(self.root, "VGA display unavailable\n" .. tostring(cells))
	end
	if self.lastError ~= nil then
		self:reportError(self.lastError)
	end
	return self
end

function VgaSink.reportError(self: VgaSink, message: string)
	self.lastError = message
	if not self.warned then
		self.warned = true
		warn("[VgaSink] " .. message)
	end
end

function VgaSink.fallbackToGrid(self: VgaSink, reason: string)
	if self.kind == "grid" or self.kind == "placeholder" or self.root == nil then
		return
	end
	if self.imageLabel ~= nil then
		self.imageLabel:Destroy()
		self.imageLabel = nil
	end
	if self.editableImage ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			self.editableImage:Destroy()
		end)
		self.editableImage = nil
	end
	const gridOk, cells, columns, rows = pcall(buildGrid, self.root, self.width, self.height)
	if gridOk then
		self.cells = cells
		self.gridColumns = columns
		self.gridRows = rows
		self.kind = "grid"
	else
		self.kind = "placeholder"
		makePlaceholder(self.root, "VGA display unavailable\n" .. tostring(cells))
	end
	self:reportError(reason)
end

function VgaSink.updateGridFromBuffer(self: VgaSink, pixels: buffer): boolean
	const needed = self.width * self.height * 4
	if buffer.len(pixels) < needed then
		self:reportError("UpdateRGBA buffer is too small")
		return false
	end
	const now = os.clock()
	if now - self.lastGridUpdate < GRID_INTERVAL then
		return true
	end
	self.lastGridUpdate = now

	local index = 1
	for row = 0, self.gridRows - 1 do
		const y = math.min(self.height - 1, math.floor((row + 0.5) * self.height / self.gridRows))
		for column = 0, self.gridColumns - 1 do
			const x =
				math.min(self.width - 1, math.floor((column + 0.5) * self.width / self.gridColumns))
			const offset = (y * self.width + x) * 4
			const cell = self.cells[index]
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
				buffer.readu8(pixels, offset),
				buffer.readu8(pixels, offset + 1),
				buffer.readu8(pixels, offset + 2)
			)
			index += 1
		end
	end
	return true
end

function VgaSink.updateGridFromTable(self: VgaSink, pixels: { number }): boolean
	const needed = self.width * self.height * 4
	if #pixels < needed then
		self:reportError("UpdatePixels table is too small")
		return false
	end
	const now = os.clock()
	if now - self.lastGridUpdate < GRID_INTERVAL then
		return true
	end
	self.lastGridUpdate = now

	local index = 1
	for row = 0, self.gridRows - 1 do
		const y = math.min(self.height - 1, math.floor((row + 0.5) * self.height / self.gridRows))
		for column = 0, self.gridColumns - 1 do
			const x =
				math.min(self.width - 1, math.floor((column + 0.5) * self.width / self.gridColumns))
			const offset = (y * self.width + x) * 4 + 1
			const cell = self.cells[index]
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
				toChannel(pixels[offset]),
				toChannel(pixels[offset + 1]),
				toChannel(pixels[offset + 2])
			)
			index += 1
		end
	end
	return true
end

function VgaSink.UpdateRGBA(self: VgaSink, pixels: buffer): boolean
	if pixels == nil then
		return false
	end
	if self.kind == "grid" then
		return self:updateGridFromBuffer(pixels)
	end
	if self.kind ~= "editable" or self.editableImage == nil then
		return false
	end
	const needed = self.width * self.height * 4
	if buffer.len(pixels) < needed then
		self:reportError("UpdateRGBA buffer is too small")
		return false
	end
	const ok, err = pcall(function()
		self.editableImage:WritePixelsBuffer(
			Vector2.zero,
			Vector2.new(self.width, self.height),
			pixels
		)
	end)
	if not ok then
		self:fallbackToGrid("EditableImage write failed: " .. tostring(err))
		if self.kind == "grid" then
			return self:updateGridFromBuffer(pixels)
		end
		return false
	end
	self.updateCount += 1
	return true
end

function VgaSink.UpdateRegionRGBA(
	self: VgaSink,
	pixels: buffer,
	x: number,
	y: number,
	width: number,
	height: number
): boolean
	if pixels == nil then
		return false
	end
	if self.kind == "grid" then
		return self:updateGridFromBuffer(pixels)
	end
	if self.kind ~= "editable" or self.editableImage == nil then
		return false
	end
	const needed = self.width * self.height * 4
	if buffer.len(pixels) < needed then
		self:reportError("UpdateRegionRGBA buffer must be a full-frame snapshot")
		return false
	end

	const x0 = math.max(0, math.floor(x))
	const y0 = math.max(0, math.floor(y))
	const x1 = math.min(self.width, math.floor(x + width))
	const y1 = math.min(self.height, math.floor(y + height))
	if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0 then
		return true
	end
	const regionWidth = x1 - x0
	const regionHeight = y1 - y0
	if regionWidth == self.width and regionHeight == self.height then
		return self:UpdateRGBA(pixels)
	end

	const bytes = regionWidth * regionHeight * 4
	-- EditableImage:WritePixelsBuffer requires the buffer length to equal the
	-- region size exactly. Reusing a buffer from a larger previous dirty
	-- rectangle uploads too many bytes and fails, so resize on any mismatch.
	if self.regionBuffer == nil or buffer.len(self.regionBuffer) ~= bytes then
		self.regionBuffer = buffer.create(bytes)
	end
	for row = 0, regionHeight - 1 do
		buffer.copy(
			self.regionBuffer,
			row * regionWidth * 4,
			pixels,
			((y0 + row) * self.width + x0) * 4,
			regionWidth * 4
		)
	end

	const ok, err = pcall(function()
		self.editableImage:WritePixelsBuffer(
			Vector2.new(x0, y0),
			Vector2.new(regionWidth, regionHeight),
			self.regionBuffer
		)
	end)
	if not ok then
		self:fallbackToGrid("EditableImage region write failed: " .. tostring(err))
		if self.kind == "grid" then
			return self:updateGridFromBuffer(pixels)
		end
		return false
	end
	self.updateCount += 1
	return true
end

function VgaSink.UpdatePixels(self: VgaSink, pixels: { number }): boolean
	if pixels == nil then
		return false
	end
	if self.kind == "grid" then
		return self:updateGridFromTable(pixels)
	end
	if self.kind ~= "editable" or self.editableImage == nil then
		return false
	end
	const needed = self.width * self.height * 4
	if #pixels < needed then
		self:reportError("UpdatePixels table is too small")
		return false
	end

	const ok, err = pcall(function()
		self.editableImage:WritePixels(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(self.width, self.height), pixels)
	end)
	if ok then
		self.updateCount += 1
		return true
	end

	-- Some clients removed the table API; convert once and use the buffer path.
	const converted = buffer.create(needed)
	for index = 0, self.width * self.height - 1 do
		const source = index * 4 + 1
		const destination = index * 4
		for component = 0, 3 do
			buffer.writeu8(
				converted,
				destination + component,
				toChannel(pixels[source + component])
			)
		end
	end
	self:reportError("WritePixels table API failed; converted to a buffer: " .. tostring(err))
	return self:UpdateRGBA(converted)
end

function VgaSink.Destroy(self: VgaSink)
	if self.editableImage ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			self.editableImage:Destroy()
		end)
		self.editableImage = nil
	end
	if self.root ~= nil then
		self.root:Destroy()
		self.root = nil
	end
	self.cells = nil
	self.imageLabel = nil
	self.kind = "destroyed"
end

return VgaSink

-- probe: remotes

-- purpose: Every RemoteEvent / UnreliableRemoteEvent / RemoteFunction / BindableEvent with its path. Remotes the
--   client creates never reach the server, and a typo in a name fails silently: compare this list to the names

		end
	end

table.insert(out, 1, #out .. " remote/bindable object(s)")

--!strict
-- asset.json (schemaVersion 1): validation, tier budgets and a stable serializer.
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local ArtLibrary = require("../../../src/shared/ArtLibrary")
local Config = require("./Config")

export type Upload = { modelAssetId: string?, sourceSha256: string?, uploadedAt: string? }
export type Spec = {
	schemaVersion: number,
	artPath: string,
	displayName: string,
	tier: string,
	version: number,
	maxTriangles: number?,
	maxMeshParts: number?,
	requiredAttachments: { string },
	upload: Upload,
}

local AssetSpec = {}

local function isWhole(value: any, minimum: number): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == math.floor(value) and value >= minimum
end

local function isOptionalString(value: any): boolean
	return value == nil or type(value) == "string"
end

-- Returns the spec, or nil and "ART_BAD_SPEC <field>".
function AssetSpec.validate(data: any, expectedArtPath: string?): (Spec?, string?)
	local function bad(field: string): (Spec?, string?)
		return nil, "ART_BAD_SPEC " .. field
	end
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return bad("document")
	end
	if data.schemaVersion ~= 1 then
		return bad("schemaVersion")
	end
	if type(data.artPath) ~= "string" or not ArtLibrary.isValidPath(data.artPath) then
		return bad("artPath")
	end
	if expectedArtPath ~= nil and data.artPath ~= expectedArtPath then
		return bad("artPath")
	end
	if type(data.displayName) ~= "string" or data.displayName == "" then
		return bad("displayName")
	end
	local budget = Config.BUDGET[data.tier]
	if type(data.tier) ~= "string" or budget == nil then
		return bad("tier")
	end
	if not isWhole(data.version, 1) then
		return bad("version")
	end
	if data.maxTriangles ~= nil and (not isWhole(data.maxTriangles, 1) or data.maxTriangles > budget[1]) then
		return bad("maxTriangles")
	end
	if data.maxMeshParts ~= nil and (not isWhole(data.maxMeshParts, 1) or data.maxMeshParts > budget[2]) then
		return bad("maxMeshParts")
	end
	if type(data.requiredAttachments) ~= "table" then
		return bad("requiredAttachments")
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(data.requiredAttachments) do
		if type(name) ~= "string" or string.match(name, "^%u%w*$") == nil then
			return bad("requiredAttachments")
		end
	end
	local upload = data.upload
	if
		type(upload) ~= "table"
		or not isOptionalString(upload.modelAssetId)
		or not isOptionalString(upload.sourceSha256)
		or not isOptionalString(upload.uploadedAt)
	then
		return bad("upload")
	end
	return data :: Spec, nil
end

-- The triangle and MeshPart limits of a spec: the tier default, or a lower value from the spec.
function AssetSpec.limits(spec: Spec): (number, number)
	local budget = Config.BUDGET[spec.tier]
	return spec.maxTriangles or budget[1], spec.maxMeshParts or budget[2]
end

-- Trees always need a TreeBase attachment on top of the spec's own list.
function AssetSpec.requiredAttachments(spec: Spec): { string }
	local names: { string } = {}
	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local function add(name: string)
		if not seen[name] then
			seen[name] = true
			table.insert(names, name)
		end
	end
	if string.sub(spec.artPath, 1, 6) == "Trees/" then
		add("TreeBase")
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(spec.requiredAttachments) do
		add(name)
	end
	return names
end

local function quote(value: string): string
	return serde.encode("json", value)
end

local function nullable(value: string?): string
	return if value == nil then "null" else quote(value)
end

-- Fixed key order so version control shows only real changes.
function AssetSpec.encode(spec: Spec): string
	local lines = {
		"{",
		string.format('\t"schemaVersion": %d,', spec.schemaVersion),
		string.format('\t"artPath": %s,', quote(spec.artPath)),
		string.format('\t"displayName": %s,', quote(spec.displayName)),
		string.format('\t"tier": %s,', quote(spec.tier)),
		string.format('\t"version": %d,', spec.version),
	}
	if spec.maxTriangles ~= nil then
		table.insert(lines, string.format('\t"maxTriangles": %d,', spec.maxTriangles))
	end
	if spec.maxMeshParts ~= nil then
		table.insert(lines, string.format('\t"maxMeshParts": %d,', spec.maxMeshParts))
	end
	local attachments = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(spec.requiredAttachments) do
		table.insert(attachments, quote(name))
	end
	table.insert(lines, string.format('\t"requiredAttachments": [%s],', table.concat(attachments, ", ")))
	table.insert(lines, '\t"upload": {')
	table.insert(lines, string.format('\t\t"modelAssetId": %s,', nullable(spec.upload.modelAssetId)))
	table.insert(lines, string.format('\t\t"sourceSha256": %s,', nullable(spec.upload.sourceSha256)))
	table.insert(lines, string.format('\t\t"uploadedAt": %s', nullable(spec.upload.uploadedAt)))
	table.insert(lines, "\t}")
	table.insert(lines, "}")
	return table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n"
end

return AssetSpec
