--!strict
--[[
	The camera, the controls, and knowing when you are driving.

	Everything here is intent. The server decides what the tank does with it —
	see `TankServer.server.luau` — which is why this sends the direction the
	camera is *looking* rather than an angle for the turret: how fast the turret
	can get there is the server's business, and a client sending an angle would
	be claiming it already had.

	## The camera

	A third-person orbit: the mouse swings it around the tank, and the turret and
	gun follow where it points. This is the control scheme of every tank game
	anyone has played, and it is the reason the demo reads as a tank rather than
	as a box that moves.

	Two details do most of the work.

	**The camera orbits the turret, not the hull.** Steering would otherwise drag
	the whole view around with the hull, so turning on the spot would swing the
	world instead of the tank. Orbiting a point that does not yaw with the hull
	keeps the camera where you put it and lets the tank turn underneath it.

	**It pulls in when something is behind it.** Reversing into a wall otherwise
	puts the camera inside the wall and the screen fills with backface.
]]

local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Waited for, then indexed directly, so `Remotes.Input` survives as a type. See
-- the same note in TankServer.
local Tank = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Tank")
Tank:WaitForChild("Occupancy")
Tank:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local Occupancy = require(ReplicatedStorage.Tank.Occupancy)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Tank.Remotes)

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer :: Player
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera :: Camera

local model = workspace:WaitForChild("M103") :: Model
local hullModel = model:WaitForChild("Hull") :: Model
local hull = hullModel:WaitForChild("Hull") :: BasePart
local turret = (model:WaitForChild("Turret") :: Model):WaitForChild("Main") :: BasePart
local occupantValue = model:WaitForChild(Occupancy.VALUE_NAME) :: ObjectValue

local inputRemote = Remotes.input()
local exitRemote = Remotes.exit()

--- How far back the camera sits, and how far above the turret it looks.
local DISTANCE = 55
local FOCUS_HEIGHT = 6

--- Radians per pixel of mouse movement.
local SENSITIVITY = 0.005

--- How far the camera can look down and up. Not the gun's limits — the camera
--- may look somewhere the gun cannot reach, and the gun simply stops at its own.
local MIN_PITCH = math.rad(-60)
local MAX_PITCH = math.rad(35)

--- Keep the camera this far off whatever it would otherwise be inside.
local CAMERA_MARGIN = 1.5

--- Don't spend a remote call on a packet that says what the last one said.
local SEND_EPSILON = 0.01

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local driving = false
local yaw = 0
local pitch = math.rad(-12)

-- Held per key rather than as one axis, so pressing W and S together and
-- releasing one does not leave the tank driving the way you let go of.
local forwardHeld, backHeld, leftHeld, rightHeld = 0, 0, 0, 0
local sent: Remotes.Input? = nil

local cameraCast = RaycastParams.new()
cameraCast.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
cameraCast.IgnoreWater = true

--[[
	The tank, and your own hidden body inside it.

	Same reasoning as the server's ground probe: the driver is welded at the
	hull's centre, a stud or two below where the camera is looking, and a camera
	that collides with an invisible passenger slams into the tank for no visible
	reason.
]]
local function aimCameraPast(rider: Model?)
	local list: { Instance } = { model }
	if rider then
		table.insert(list, rider)
	end
	cameraCast.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
end

aimCameraPast(nil)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Controls
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
	Bound through `ContextActionService` rather than read from
	`UserInputService.InputBegan`, for two reasons that both matter here: an
	action can be unbound again when you get out, so W does not drive a tank you
	have left; and `createTouchButton` gives mobile the same control for free.
]]
local function bindAxis(name: string, key: Enum.KeyCode, apply: (number) -> ())
	ContextActionService:BindAction(name, function(_, state: Enum.UserInputState)
		if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			apply(1)
		elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.End or state == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
			apply(0)
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, true, key)
end

local ACTIONS = { "TankForward", "TankBack", "TankLeft", "TankRight", "TankExit" }

local function bindControls()
	bindAxis("TankForward", Enum.KeyCode.W, function(v)
		forwardHeld = v
	end)
	bindAxis("TankBack", Enum.KeyCode.S, function(v)
		backHeld = v
	end)
	bindAxis("TankLeft", Enum.KeyCode.A, function(v)
		leftHeld = v
	end)
	bindAxis("TankRight", Enum.KeyCode.D, function(v)
		rightHeld = v
	end)

	ContextActionService:BindAction("TankExit", function(_, state: Enum.UserInputState)
		if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			exitRemote:FireServer()
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, true, Enum.KeyCode.E)
	ContextActionService:SetTitle("TankExit", "Exit")
end

local function unbindControls()
	for _, name in ACTIONS do
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(name)
	end
	forwardHeld, backHeld, leftHeld, rightHeld = 0, 0, 0, 0
end

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if not driving or processed then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		return
	end
	yaw -= input.Delta.X * SENSITIVITY
	pitch = math.clamp(pitch - input.Delta.Y * SENSITIVITY, MIN_PITCH, MAX_PITCH)
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Getting in and out
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
	Everything that changes when you take the tank, and unchanges when you leave.

	Driven by the `Occupant` value rather than by the button press, so a client
	that joined while somebody was already driving ends up in the same state as
	one that watched them get in — and so losing the character to a respawn,
	which the server treats as getting out, gives the camera back here too.
]]
local function setDriving(now: boolean)
	if now == driving then
		return
	end
	driving = now

	if driving then
		-- Start the camera behind the tank rather than wherever it was left, so
		-- getting in always faces the way the tank is pointed.
		local look = hull.CFrame.LookVector
		yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		pitch = math.rad(-12)
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
		aimCameraPast(localPlayer.Character)
		bindControls()
	else
		unbindControls()
		aimCameraPast(nil)
		sent = nil
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
		end
	end
end

occupantValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
	setDriving(occupantValue.Value == localPlayer)
end)
setDriving(occupantValue.Value == localPlayer)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The frame
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function changed(a: Remotes.Input?, b: Remotes.Input): boolean
	if a == nil then
		return true
	end
	return math.abs(a.throttle - b.throttle) > SEND_EPSILON
		or math.abs(a.steer - b.steer) > SEND_EPSILON
		-- A direction, so the threshold is an angle rather than a distance:
		-- about half a degree, below which the turret would not visibly move.
		or a.aim:Dot(b.aim) < 0.99996
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not driving then
		return
	end

	local focus = turret.Position + Vector3.yAxis * FOCUS_HEIGHT
	local rotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, 0)
	local wanted = focus + rotation * Vector3.new(0, 0, DISTANCE)

	-- Pulled in to whatever is in the way, so reversing into a wall does not put
	-- the camera inside it.
	local blocked = workspace:Raycast(focus, wanted - focus, cameraCast)
	local eye = if blocked then blocked.Position + blocked.Normal * CAMERA_MARGIN else wanted
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, focus)

	local packet: Remotes.Input = {
		throttle = forwardHeld - backHeld,
		steer = rightHeld - leftHeld,
		-- The camera's own direction rather than one rebuilt from yaw and pitch:
		-- if the camera was pulled in, this is still where it is looking, and the
		-- gun should agree with what is on screen.
		aim = camera.CFrame.LookVector,
	}
	if changed(sent, packet) then
		inputRemote:FireServer(packet)
		sent = packet
	end
end)

-- probe: whereis
-- datamodel: any
-- params: pattern="Door" root=game limit=30
-- purpose: Find instances by name (Lua pattern, case-insensitive) with class, path and world position. Cheaper
--   than reading the explorer tree, and it tells you which datamodel actually has the thing.
local root, pattern, LIMIT = {{root}}, string.lower({{pattern}}), {{limit}}
local out, n = {}, 0
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
	local ok, name = pcall(function() return d.Name end)
	if ok and string.find(string.lower(name), pattern) then
		n += 1
		if n <= LIMIT then
			local pos = ""
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then pos = tostring(d.Position)
			elseif d:IsA("Model") then
				local okp, pv = pcall(function() return d:GetPivot().Position end)
				if okp then pos = tostring(pv) end
			end
			table.insert(out, string.format("%-16s %s %s", d.ClassName, d:GetFullName(), pos))
		end
	end
end
table.insert(out, 1, string.format("%d match(es) for %q", n, pattern))
return table.concat(out, "\n")

--!nonstrict
-- Checks that integrated art really sits in a built place at the expected path.
-- Reads only ClassName, Name, MeshContent, Size, CFrame, PrimaryPart and attributes:
-- Lune 0.11 cannot read TextureID, WorldPivot or CollisionFidelity after a deserialize.
local AssetSpec = require("./AssetSpec")
local Paths = require("./Paths")

local Verify = {}

export type Failure = { artPath: string, code: string, detail: string? }

local SCRIPT_CLASSES = { Script = true, LocalScript = true, ModuleScript = true }
local PIVOT_EPSILON = 1e-4
local IDENTITY = { 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1 }

local function isIdentity(cframe: any): boolean
	local components = { cframe:GetComponents() }
	for index, expected in ipairs(IDENTITY) do
		if math.abs(components[index] - expected) > PIVOT_EPSILON then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function find(root: any, artPath: string): any
	local current = root
	for segment in string.gmatch(artPath .. "/", "([^/]*)/") do
		if current == nil then
			return nil
		end
		current = current:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	return current
end

-- entries: { { artPath, spec, hasRbxm } }. Only entries with an .rbxm are checked.
function Verify.verifyPlace(place: any, entries: { any }): { Failure }
	local failures: { Failure } = {}
	local artAssets = place:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ArtAssets")
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if entry.hasRbxm then
			local artPath, spec = entry.artPath, entry.spec
			local function fail(code: string, detail: string?)
				table.insert(failures, { artPath = artPath, code = code, detail = detail })
			end
			local model = find(artAssets, artPath)
			if model == nil or model.ClassName ~= "Model" then
				fail("MissingArtAsset")
			else
				local primary = model.PrimaryPart
				if primary == nil or primary.Name ~= "ArtRoot" or not isIdentity(primary.CFrame) then
					fail("ART_BAD_PIVOT")
				end
				if model:GetAttribute("ArtVersion") ~= spec.version then
					fail(
						"ART_VERSION_MISMATCH",
						string.format("%s vs %s", tostring(model:GetAttribute("ArtVersion")), tostring(spec.version))
					)
				end
				local expected = {
					ArtAssetId = Paths.leaf(artPath),
					ArtPath = artPath,
					ArtSource = "blender",
					ArtTier = spec.tier,
				}
				for name, value in pairs(expected) do
					if model:GetAttribute(name) ~= value then
						fail("ART_BAD_ATTRIBUTE", name)
					end
				end
				local meshCount, badMesh, scriptName = 0, nil, nil
				for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
					if SCRIPT_CLASSES[descendant.ClassName] then
						scriptName = scriptName or descendant.Name
					elseif descendant.ClassName == "MeshPart" then
						meshCount += 1
						local uri = descendant.MeshContent.Uri
						if type(uri) ~= "string" or string.match(uri, "^rbxassetid://%d+$") == nil then
							badMesh = badMesh or descendant.Name
						end
					end
				end
				if meshCount == 0 then
					fail("ART_BAD_MESH", "no MeshPart")
				elseif badMesh ~= nil then
					fail("ART_BAD_MESH", badMesh)
				end
				if scriptName ~= nil then
					fail("ART_SCRIPT_FOUND", scriptName)
				end
				for _, name in ipairs(AssetSpec.requiredAttachments(spec)) do
					local attachment = primary and primary:FindFirstChild(name)
					if attachment == nil or attachment.ClassName ~= "Attachment" then
						fail("ART_MISSING_ATTACHMENT", name)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return failures
end

-- Both lists hold art paths. An .rbxm without asset.json is an orphan; an asset.json without
-- an .rbxm is merely pending.
function Verify.verifyFiles(rbxmPaths: { string }, specPaths: { string }): ({ Failure }, { string })
	local hasSpec: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, artPath in ipairs(specPaths) do
		hasSpec[artPath] = true
	end
	local hasRbxm: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local failures: { Failure } = {}
	for _, artPath in ipairs(rbxmPaths) do
		hasRbxm[artPath] = true
		if not hasSpec[artPath] then
			table.insert(failures, { artPath = artPath, code = "ART_ORPHAN_RBXM", detail = nil })
		end
	end
	local pending: { string } = {}
	for _, artPath in ipairs(specPaths) do
		if not hasRbxm[artPath] then
			table.insert(pending, artPath)
		end
	end
	return failures, pending
end

return Verify

-- probe: world-audit
-- datamodel: any
-- params: root=workspace gap=1 overlap=0.35 reach=40 skip={} max=25
-- purpose: Placement audit of a built world: anchored pieces with nothing under or beside them (floating), pieces
--   whose parts stand inside another piece's parts (a tent in a tower, stones through a wagon), and attachments
--   far from their part (set by world position before they had a parent). A piece is a direct child of root, or
--   of a Folder under it. Every line names the piece and a position; every line is a lead, not a verdict. Names
--   in skip (Luau patterns) are left out of the floating check and listed, so a skip never hides silently.
--   Run after every world rebuild, then still look at a capture.
local root = {{root}}
local GAP, OVERLAP, REACH, MAX = {{gap}}, {{overlap}}, {{reach}}, {{max}}
local SKIP = {{skip}}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local last = os.clock()
local function breathe()
	-- execute_luau holds Studio's main thread until it yields; yield on elapsed time.
	if os.clock() - last > 0.05 then
		task.wait()
		last = os.clock()
	end
end
local function where(p)
	return string.format("(%.0f, %.0f, %.0f)", p.X, p.Y, p.Z)
end

-- Pieces ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local pieces = {}
local function moving(inst)
	if inst:IsA("Model") then
		if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst) or inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function collect(container)
	for _, c in container:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("Folder") then
			collect(c)
		elseif (c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("BasePart")) and not c:IsA("Terrain") and not moving(c) then
			table.insert(pieces, c)
		end
	end
end
collect(root)

local function partsOf(piece)
	local list = {}
	if piece:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(list, piece)
	end
	for _, d in piece:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			table.insert(list, d)
		end
	end
	return list
end
local function anchored(parts)
	for _, p in parts do
		if p.Anchored then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function boxOf(piece)
	if piece:IsA("BasePart") then
		return piece.CFrame, piece.Size
	end
	return piece:GetBoundingBox()
end
local function skipped(name)
	for _, pattern in SKIP do
		if string.find(name, pattern) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 1. Floating: no ray below the footprint meets anything within GAP, and nothing touches the box ----
local floating, skippedNames = {}, {}
for _, piece in pieces do
	breathe()
	local parts = partsOf(piece)
	if #parts > 0 and anchored(parts) then
		if skipped(piece.Name) then
			table.insert(skippedNames, piece.Name)
		else
			local cf, size = boxOf(piece)
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { piece }
			local bottom = cf.Position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)
			local hx, hz = size.X * 0.4, size.Z * 0.4
			local held = false
			for _, o in { Vector3.zero, cf.RightVector * hx, -cf.RightVector * hx, cf.LookVector * hz, -cf.LookVector * hz } do
				local from = bottom + Vector3.new(o.X, 0.5, o.Z)
				if workspace:Raycast(from, Vector3.new(0, -(GAP + 0.5), 0), params) then
					held = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not held then
				-- Hung on a wall or tied to a neighbour: anything else inside the slightly grown box holds it.
				local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
				overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { piece }
				held = #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, size + Vector3.new(GAP, GAP, GAP) * 2, overlapParams) > 0
			end
			if not held then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(bottom, Vector3.new(0, -2000, 0), params)
				local drop = hit and (bottom.Y - hit.Position.Y) or math.huge
				table.insert(floating, { piece = piece, at = bottom, drop = drop })
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 2. Inside each other: part pairs from different pieces whose boxes share more than OVERLAP of the smaller ---
-- Estimated in both parts' frames and the smaller estimate kept, so a rotated thin wall does not swallow
-- whatever stands beside it.
local function corners(cf, size)
	local h = size / 2
	local out = {}
	for _, sx in { -1, 1 } do
		for _, sy in { -1, 1 } do
			for _, sz in { -1, 1 } do
				table.insert(out, cf * Vector3.new(h.X * sx, h.Y * sy, h.Z * sz))
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end
local function sharedIn(a, b)
	-- volume of a's box shared with b's box as seen axis-aligned in a's frame
	local h = a.Size / 2
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, w in corners(b.CFrame, b.Size) do
		local l = a.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(w)
		lo, hi = lo:Min(l), hi:Max(l)
	end
	local dx = math.min(h.X, hi.X) - math.max(-h.X, lo.X)
	local dy = math.min(h.Y, hi.Y) - math.max(-h.Y, lo.Y)
	local dz = math.min(h.Z, hi.Z) - math.max(-h.Z, lo.Z)
	if dx <= 0 or dy <= 0 or dz <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return dx * dy * dz
end
local function worldBox(cf, size)
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, w in corners(cf, size) do
		lo, hi = lo:Min(w), hi:Max(w)
	end
	return lo, hi
end

local boxes = {}
for _, piece in pieces do
	local cf, size = boxOf(piece)
	local lo, hi = worldBox(cf, size)
	table.insert(boxes, { piece = piece, lo = lo, hi = hi })
end
table.sort(boxes, function(x, y)
	return x.lo.X < y.lo.X
end)
local partCache = {}
local function cachedParts(piece)
	-- each entry: { part, lo, hi } with the part's world bounds, computed once
	local p = partCache[piece]
	if not p then
		p = {}
		for _, part in partsOf(piece) do
			local lo, hi = worldBox(part.CFrame, part.Size)
			table.insert(p, { part = part, lo = lo, hi = hi })
		end
		partCache[piece] = p
	end
	return p
end
local function touches(x, lo, hi)
	return x.lo.X < hi.X and x.hi.X > lo.X and x.lo.Y < hi.Y and x.hi.Y > lo.Y and x.lo.Z < hi.Z and x.hi.Z > lo.Z
end
local function within(list, lo, hi)
	-- only the parts of one piece that reach into the other piece's bounds
	local out = {}
	for _, e in list do
		if touches(e, lo, hi) then
			table.insert(out, e)
		end
	end
	return out
end
local inside = {}
for i = 1, #boxes do
	local A = boxes[i]
	for j = i + 1, #boxes do
		local B = boxes[j]
		if B.lo.X > A.hi.X then
			break -- sorted by min X: nothing further along can touch A
		end
		breathe()
		if B.lo.Y < A.hi.Y and B.hi.Y > A.lo.Y and B.lo.Z < A.hi.Z and B.hi.Z > A.lo.Z then
			local worst, at = 0, nil
			local candB = within(cachedParts(B.piece), A.lo, A.hi)
			for _, ea in within(cachedParts(A.piece), B.lo, B.hi) do
				for _, eb in candB do
					local pa, pb = ea.part, eb.part
					local va, vb = pa.Size.X * pa.Size.Y * pa.Size.Z, pb.Size.X * pb.Size.Y * pb.Size.Z
					local small = math.min(va, vb)
					if small > 0.5 and touches(ea, eb.lo, eb.hi) then
						local shared = math.min(sharedIn(pa, pb), sharedIn(pb, pa))
						local ratio = shared / small
						if ratio > worst then
							worst, at = ratio, (if va < vb then pa.Position else pb.Position)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if worst > OVERLAP then
				table.insert(inside, { a = A.piece, b = B.piece, ratio = worst, at = at })
			end
		end
	end
end
table.sort(inside, function(x, y)
	return x.ratio > y.ratio
end)

-- 3. Stray attachments ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
local stray, attachments = {}, 0
for _, d in root:GetDescendants() do
	if d:IsA("Attachment") and d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
		attachments += 1
		local part = d.Parent
		local off = (d.WorldPosition - part.Position).Magnitude
		if off > part.Size.Magnitude / 2 + REACH then
			table.insert(stray, { a = d, off = off })
		end
		breathe()
	end
end

-- Report --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local leads = #floating + #inside + #stray
local out = {
	string.format(
		"WORLD-AUDIT %s: %d pieces, %d attachments under %s (gap %.1f, overlap %.2f, reach %d)",
		leads == 0 and "clean" or (leads .. " leads"),
		#pieces,
		attachments,
		root:GetFullName(),
		GAP,
		OVERLAP,
		REACH
	),
}
local function section(title, list, line)
	if #list == 0 then
		return
	end
	table.insert(out, string.format("%s (%d):", title, #list))
	for i = 1, math.min(#list, MAX) do
		table.insert(out, "  " .. line(list[i]))
	end
	if #list > MAX then
		table.insert(out, string.format("  ... %d more", #list - MAX))
	end
end
section("FLOATING", floating, function(f)
	return string.format(
		"%s bottom at %s, %s",
		f.piece:GetFullName(),
		where(f.at),
		f.drop == math.huge and "nothing below" or string.format("%.1f studs above what is below", f.drop)
	)
end)
section("INSIDE", inside, function(o)
	return string.format("%s / %s share %.0f%% near %s", o.a:GetFullName(), o.b:GetFullName(), o.ratio * 100, where(o.at))
end)
section("STRAY ATTACHMENT", stray, function(s)
	return string.format("%s %.0f studs from its part, at %s", s.a:GetFullName(), s.off, where(s.a.WorldPosition))
end)
if #skippedNames > 0 then
	table.sort(skippedNames)
	table.insert(out, string.format("SKIPPED from the floating check (%d): %s", #skippedNames, table.concat(skippedNames, ", ", 1, math.min(#skippedNames, MAX))))
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")

--!strict
-- Client entry point: input and presentation only. It shows what the server published and sends
-- intents; it never decides a reward, a price or a result.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Rules"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local doAction = Net.event("DoAction")
local buyUpgrade = Net.event("BuyUpgrade")

-- ---- HUD --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Built once. ResetOnSpawn = false, or the HUD is destroyed and rebuilt on every death.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Hud"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "Panel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -24) -- bottom centre: clear of the top bar and the thumbstick
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 132)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Parent = gui

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder -- a layout made in code sorts by Name unless told otherwise
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
layout.Parent = panel

-- Keeps the panel usable on a phone in portrait instead of running off both edges.
local limit = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
limit.MaxSize = Vector2.new(360, 160)
limit.Parent = panel

local function label(name: string, order: number): TextLabel
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = name
	text.LayoutOrder = order
	text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	text.TextSize = 20
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
	text.Parent = panel
	return text
end

local function button(name: string, order: number): TextButton
	local control = Instance.new("TextButton")
	control.Name = name
	control.LayoutOrder = order
	control.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44) -- 44 px: the smallest target a thumb hits reliably
	control.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 120, 246)
	control.BorderSizePixel = 0
	control.AutoButtonColor = true
	control.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	control.TextSize = 18
	control.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	control.Parent = panel
	return control
end

local coinsLabel = label("Coins", 1)
local actionButton = button("Action", 2)
local upgradeButton = button("Upgrade", 3)
upgradeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 90)

gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ---- state -> screen --------------------------------------------------------------------------
local power = Config.Upgrades.Power

local function render()
	local coins = (player:GetAttribute("Coins") :: number?) or 0
	local level = (player:GetAttribute("Power") :: number?) or 0
	coinsLabel.Text = `Coins: {coins}`
	actionButton.Text = `Collect +{Rules.rewardFor(Config.BaseReward, level)}  [E]`
	if level >= power.MaxLevel then
		upgradeButton.Text = "Power: MAX"
	else
		-- Shown for the player's benefit only; the server computes the real price again.
		upgradeButton.Text = `Power {level} -> {level + 1}: {Rules.upgradeCost(power.BaseCost, power.Growth, level)}`
	end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Coins"):Connect(render)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Power"):Connect(render)
render()

-- ---- input -> intent --------------------------------------------------------------------------

actionButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	doAction:FireServer()
end)
upgradeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	buyUpgrade:FireServer("Power")
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then
		return -- the player is typing in chat or pressing a button
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		doAction:FireServer()
	end
end)

--!strict
type FrameProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FrameProps)

type ComposeModule = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeModule)
type ReadOnlyValue<T> = typeof(require("@repo/src/vendor/compose/core").accumulator<<T, number>>(nil :: never))
type Use = <T>(ReadOnlyValue<T>) -> T
type NumberReadOnlyValue = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").NumberReadOnlyValue)
type Child = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").Child)
local nativeApp = require("./native_app")
return function(automatic: boolean)
	local world = nativeApp({ viewport = { w = 900, h = 900 } })
	local Compose: ComposeModule, Host = world.Compose, world.Host
	local tall = Compose.cell(false)
	local height = Compose.cell(4)
	local observed: NumberReadOnlyValue
	world.runtime.mount(function()
		local children: { Child } = { Host.UIListLayout {} }
		for index = 1, 100 do
			local animated = world.runtime.tween(function(use: Use): number
				return if automatic then (if use(tall) then 6 else 4) else use(height)
			end, { seconds = 0.2 })
			observed = animated
			table.insert(
				children,
				Host.Frame {
					Name = `Row{index}`,
					Size = function(use: Use)
						return world.types.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, use(animated))
					end,
				}
			)
		end
		return Host.Frame((children :: unknown) :: FrameProps)
	end, world.target)
	local iteration = 0
	return {
		run = function()
			iteration += 1
			if automatic then
				tall:set(not tall:peek())
			else
				height:set(if iteration % 2 == 1 then 6 else 4)
			end
			world.frame()
			assert(observed:peek() > 4 and observed:peek() < 6, "motion workload did not animate")
		end,
		dispose = world.dispose,
	}
end

--!strict
-- Server entry point: the only Script. It starts every system in a fixed order and owns the player
-- lifecycle, so "what runs when" is answered by reading this one file.
--
-- A service is a ModuleScript in Services/ that returns a table of functions. To add a system:
-- write the module, require it here, and add its functions to the lists below.
--   INIT            build own state; must not call another service
--   START           connect remotes and loops; every service is initialised by now
--   PLAYER_ADDED    runs once the player's profile is loaded
--   PLAYER_REMOVING runs while the profile is still readable; DataService goes last

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared").Net)

-- Remotes exist before any service is required, so a service may look them up at any point.
Net.setup()

local DataService = require(script.Parent.Services.DataService)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.Services.GameService)

type Step = { name: string, fn: () -> () }
type PlayerStep = { name: string, fn: (Player) -> () }

-- Explicit lists: no folder scan and no priorities to guess, and every call is one the type checker
-- can follow. Order matters and is visible here.
local INIT: { Step } = {
	{ name = "DataService.init", fn = DataService.init },
}
local START: { Step } = {
	{ name = "DataService.start", fn = DataService.start },
	{ name = "GameService.start", fn = GameService.start },
}
local PLAYER_ADDED: { PlayerStep } = {
	{ name = "GameService.playerAdded", fn = GameService.playerAdded },
}
local PLAYER_REMOVING: { PlayerStep } = {
	{ name = "GameService.playerRemoving", fn = GameService.playerRemoving },
	{ name = "DataService.playerRemoving", fn = DataService.playerRemoving }, -- saves: always last
}

-- One failing step must not take the other systems down, and it must say so loudly.
local function run(name: string, fn: (...any) -> ...any, ...: any)
	local ok, err = xpcall(fn, debug.traceback, ...)
	if not ok then
		warn(`[Boot] {name} failed:\n{err}`)
		workspace:SetAttribute("BootError", name)
	end
end

for _, step in INIT do
	run(step.name, step.fn)
end
for _, step in START do
	run(step.name, step.fn)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	-- Nothing gameplay-related sees the player until their data exists.
	if not DataService.load(player) then
		return
	end
	for _, step in PLAYER_ADDED do
		run(step.name, step.fn, player)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	for _, step in PLAYER_REMOVING do
		run(step.name, step.fn, player)
	end
end)
-- Players who joined while the modules were loading: PlayerAdded already fired for them.
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

-- Tests and tools wait for this instead of guessing with task.wait.
workspace:SetAttribute("ServerReady", true)

--!strict

local Facet = require("../../src")
local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")
local Roblox = require("@verify/src/roblox")

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

for _, count in { 100, 500 } do
	table.insert(workloads, {
		id = "inventory-" .. count,
		iterations = 200,
		what = `Select among {count} retained slots 200 times; each slot has an activation target and selected state.`,
		prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
			local UI = world.UI
			local initial: { [number]: boolean } = { [1] = true }
			local selected = S.model(world, lane, initial)
			local data: { number } = {}
			for i = 1, count do
				table.insert(data, i)
			end
			local current = 1
			local buttons: { Roblox.Instance } = {}
			local labels: { Roblox.Instance } = {}
			local plates: { Roblox.Instance } = {}
			local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
				local spec: Facet.KeyedCollectionSpec<number, number> = {
					from = data,
					key = function(id)
						return id
					end,
					mode = "all",
					columns = 10,
					itemSize = 44,
					gap = 8,
					measure = false,
					selection = assert(selected),
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
					render = function(item)
						return UI.Text("Slot" .. item:peek())({
							text = function(use: Facet.Use)
								return `Item {use(item)}`
							end,
						})
					end,
				}
				return UI.VirtualGrid "Inventory"(spec)
			end, function(screen)
				local root = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Inventory", screen, {
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
					CanvasSize = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.ceil(count / 10) * 52),
				})
				local items = S.create(
					world,
					"Frame",
					"Items",
					root,
					{ BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, math.ceil(count / 10) * 52) }
				)
				S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", items)
				for i = 1, count do
					local plate = S.create(
						world,
						"CanvasGroup",
						tostring(i),
						items,
						{ BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(56, 44) }
					)
					plate.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) % 10 * 64, math.floor((i - 1) / 10) * 52)
					plates[i] = plate
					local button = S.button(world, plate, "RowHit", "", function()
						plates[current]:RemoveTag("facet-selected")
						current = i
						plates[current]:AddTag("facet-selected")
					end)
					button.Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					if i == 1 then
						plate:AddTag("facet-selected")
					end
					buttons[i] = button
					labels[i] = S.text(world, plate, "Slot" .. i, `Item {i}`)
				end
			end)
			if lane == "facet" then
				for i = 1, count do
					labels[i] = S.find(world, "Slot" .. i)
					local row = S.find(world, tostring(i))
					local hit = row:FindFirstChild("RowHit", true)
					assert(hit)
					plates[i] = assert(hit.Parent)
					buttons[i] = hit
				end
			end
			local root = S.find(world, "Inventory")
			world.engine.environment.poke(root, "AbsoluteSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 480))
			world.engine.environment.poke(root, "AbsoluteWindowSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 480))
			local mouse = { UserInputType = world.types.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 }
			return {
				step = function(index: number)
					world.engine.environment.fire(buttons[index % count + 1], "Activated", mouse, 1)
				end,
				snapshot = function()
					local key = current
					if lane == "facet" then
						for id in assert(selected):peek() do
							key = id
						end
					end
					local selectedKeys: { string } = {}
					for i, plate in plates do
						local active = plate:HasTag("facet-selected")
						if active then
							table.insert(selectedKeys, tostring(i))
						end
					end
					assert(#selectedKeys == 1, "inventory must show one selected slot")
					return tostring(key) .. ":" .. tostring(labels[key].Text) .. ":" .. table.concat(selectedKeys, ",")
				end,
				stop = stop,
			}
		end,
	})
end

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "shop-filter-200",
	iterations = 10,
	what = "Edit a native TextBox with ten queries, including empty and no match; retain the 200 catalog rows and set their visibility.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local query = S.model(world, lane, "")
		local queries = { "1", "20", "Item", "99", "missing", "2", "10", "50", "200", "" }
		local items: { S.Node } = {}
		local function matches(label: string, value: string): boolean
			return string.find(label, value, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } =
				{ UI.TextInput "Filter" { value = assert(query), placeholder = "Filter items" } }
			for i = 1, 200 do
				local label = `Item {i}`
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Button("Item" .. i)({
						label = label,
						onActivate = function() end,
						Visible = function(use: Facet.Use)
							return matches(label, use(assert(query)))
						end,
					})
				)
			end
			return UI.ScrollView(
				{ gap = 8, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480), table.unpack(children) },
				"Shop"
			)
		end, function(screen)
			local scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Shop", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			})
			local content = S.stack(world, scroll, "Content")
			local input = S.create(world, "TextBox", "Filter", content, {
				Text = "",
				PlaceholderText = "Filter items",
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44),
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			})
			input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				local value = input.Text
				assert(type(value) == "string")
				for i = 1, 200 do
					items[i].Visible = matches(`Item {i}`, value)
				end
			end)
			for i = 1, 200 do
				local item = S.button(world, content, "Item" .. i, `Item {i}`, function() end)
				item.Visible = true
				table.insert(items, item)
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				S.fire(world, "Filter", "Focused")
				S.find(world, "Filter").Text = queries[index]
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = { tostring(S.find(world, "Filter").Text) }
				for i = 1, 200 do
					if S.find(world, "Item" .. i).Visible ~= false then
						table.insert(rows, `Item {i}`)
					end
				end
				return table.concat(rows, "\n")
			end,
			stop = stop,

	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "virtual-scroll-2000",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Scroll a fixed 40-pixel row window from top to bottom; the plain lane keeps a small reusable row pool.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local data: { string } = {}
		for i = 1, 2000 do
			table.insert(data, `Row {i}`)
		end
		local scroll: S.Node? = nil
		local pool: { S.Node } = {}
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local spec: Facet.KeyedCollectionSpec<string, string> = {
				from = data,
				key = function(item)
					return item
				end,
				itemSize = 40,
				measure = false,
				overscan = 2,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 400),
				render = function(current)
					return UI.Text { text = current }
				end,
			}
			return UI.VirtualList "Rows"(spec)
		end, function(screen)
			scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Rows", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 400),
				CanvasSize = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 80000),
				CanvasPosition = world.types.Vector2.zero,
			})
			local container = assert(scroll)
			for i = 1, 15 do
				local row = S.text(world, container, "Pool" .. i, data[i], true)
				row.Visible = i <= 12
				row.Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 40)
				row.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i - 1) * 40)
				table.insert(pool, row)
			end
			container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
				local position: unknown = container.CanvasPosition
				assert(typeof(position) == "Vector2")
				local first = math.max(1, math.floor(position.Y / 40) - 1)
				local last = math.min(2000, math.ceil((position.Y + 400) / 40) + 2)
				for i = 1, 15 do
					local row = pool[i]
					local index = first + i - 1
					S.setText(world, row, data[index] or "")
					row.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, (index - 1) * 40)
					row.Visible = index <= last
				end
			end)
		end)
		scroll = S.find(world, "Rows")
		world.engine.environment.poke(assert(scroll), "AbsoluteSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 400))
		world.engine.environment.poke(assert(scroll), "AbsoluteWindowSize", world.types.Vector2.new(640, 400))
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				assert(scroll).CanvasPosition = world.types.Vector2.new(0, math.floor(index * 79600 / 100))
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local labels: { string } = {}
				for _, node in assert(scroll):GetDescendants() do
					if
						node:IsA("TextLabel")
						and node.Visible ~= false
						and type(node.Text) == "string"
						and node.Text ~= ""
					then
						table.insert(labels, node.Text)
					end
				end

				return table.concat(labels, ",")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "chat-append-500",
	iterations = 500,
	what = "Append 500 keyed messages; remove the oldest when the log exceeds 100 rows.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local initial: { number } = {}
		local messages = S.model(world, lane, initial)
		local plainRows: { S.Node } = {}
		local plainContent: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.ScrollView "Chat" {
				gap = 8,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				Compose.keyed({
					from = assert(messages),
					key = function(id: number)
						return id
					end,
					render = function(current: Facet.ReadOnlyValue<number>)
						return UI.Text {
							text = function(use: Facet.Use)
								return `Player: message {use(current)}`
							end,
						}
					end,
				}),
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Chat", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			})
			plainContent = S.stack(world, scroll, "Content")
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if lane == "facet" then
					local nextRows = table.clone(assert(messages):peek())
					table.insert(nextRows, index)
					if #nextRows > 100 then
						table.remove(nextRows, 1)
					end
					assert(messages):set(nextRows)
				else
					table.insert(
						plainRows,
						S.text(world, assert(plainContent), "Message" .. index, `Player: message {index}`, true)
					)
					if #plainRows > 100 then
						assert(table.remove(plainRows, 1)):Destroy()
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local labels: { string } = {}
				for _, node in S.find(world, "Chat"):GetDescendants() do
					if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
						table.insert(labels, tostring(node.Text))
					end
				end
				table.sort(labels)
				return table.concat(labels, "\n")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {

	what = "Mount 60 cards with the same artwork, item title and price caption.",

		local stop: () -> () = function() end

				end, function(screen)

					for i = 1, 60 do
						local card = S.stack(world, root, "Card" .. i)
						local body = S.stack(world, card, "Body")
						S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", body)
						local image = S.create(world, "ImageLabel", "Artwork", body, {

					table.insert(

							.. ":"
							.. tostring(assert(card:FindFirstChild("Caption", true)).Text)
							.. ":"
							.. tostring(assert(card:FindFirstChild("Artwork", true)).Image)

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "mixed-scroll-300",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Scroll 300 retained mixed rows: 100 text rows, 100 action buttons and 100 text cards.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i = 1, 300 do
				local name, label = "Row" .. i, `Row {i}`
				if i % 3 == 0 then
					table.insert(children, UI.Card(name)({ title = label }))
				elseif i % 3 == 1 then
					table.insert(children, UI.Text(name)({ text = label }))
				else
					table.insert(children, UI.Button(name)({ label = label, onActivate = function() end }))
				end
			end
			return UI.ScrollView "Mixed" {
				gap = 8,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				table.unpack(children),
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Mixed", screen, {
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			})
			local content = S.stack(world, root, "Content")
			for i = 1, 300 do
				local name, label = "Row" .. i, `Row {i}`
				if i % 3 == 0 then
					local card = S.stack(world, content, name)
					local body = S.stack(world, card, "Body")
					S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", body)
					S.text(world, body, "Title", label)
				elseif i % 3 == 1 then
					S.text(world, content, name, label)
				else
					S.button(world, content, name, label, function() end)
				end
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				S.find(world, "Mixed").CanvasPosition = world.types.Vector2.new(0, index * 100)
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = {}
				for i = 1, 300 do
					local node = S.find(world, "Row" .. i)
					table.insert(
						rows,
						tostring(if i % 3 == 0 then assert(node:FindFirstChild("Title", true)).Text else node.Text)
					)
				end
				local position: unknown = S.find(world, "Mixed").CanvasPosition
				assert(typeof(position) == "Vector2")
				table.insert(rows, tostring(position.Y))
				return table.concat(rows, "\n")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

local Facet = require("../../src")
local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "settings-17-values",
	iterations = 17,
	what = "Change each of ten toggle, four slider and three segmented-picker model values; native value readouts show the result.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local toggles: { Facet.Value<boolean> } = {}
		local sliders: { Facet.Value<number> } = {}
		local pickers: { Facet.Value<string> } = {}
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(toggles, Compose.cell(false))
			end
		end
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(sliders, Compose.cell(0))
			end
		end
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(pickers, Compose.cell("low"))
			end
		end
		local options: { Facet.PickerOption<string> } =
			{ { value = "low", label = "Low" }, { value = "high", label = "High" } }
		local plainValues: { string } = table.create(17, "0")
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in toggles do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Toggle("Toggle" .. i)({ label = `Option {i}`, value = value, presentation = "button" })
				)
			end
			for i, value in sliders do
				table.insert(children, UI.Slider("Slider" .. i)({ value = value, min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.1 }))
			end
			for i, selected in pickers do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Picker("Picker" .. i)({ selected = assert(selected), options = options, style = "segmented" })
				)
			end
			for i = 1, 17 do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Text("Value" .. i)({
						text = function(use: Facet.Use)
							if i <= 10 then
								return if use(toggles[i]) then "1" else "0"
							end
							if i <= 14 then
								return tostring(use(sliders[i - 10]))
							end
							return if use(pickers[i - 14]) == "high" then "1" else "0"
						end,
					})
				)
			end
			return UI.VStack "Settings" { width = 640, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Settings")
			for i = 1, 10 do
				S.button(world, root, "Toggle" .. i, `Option {i}`, function()
					plainValues[i] = if plainValues[i] == "0" then "1" else "0"
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. i), plainValues[i])
				end)
			end
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local slider = S.stack(world, root, "Slider" .. i, true)
				local track =
					S.create(world, "Frame", "Track", slider, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44) })
				S.create(world, "Frame", "Fill", track, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) })
				local thumb = S.create(world, "Frame", "Thumb", track, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24) })
				local drag = S.create(world, "UIDragDetector", "Drag", thumb)
				S.connect(world, drag, "DragEnd", function()
					plainValues[10 + i] = "1"
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. (10 + i)), "1")
				end)
			end
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local picker = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Picker" .. i, root, {
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44),
					ScrollingDirection = world.types.Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
				})
				S.stack(world, picker, "Segments", true)
				for _, option in options do
					local label = option.label
					assert(type(label) == "string")
					S.button(world, picker, option.value .. i, label, function()
						plainValues[14 + i] = if option.value == "high" then "1" else "0"
						S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. (14 + i)), plainValues[14 + i])
					end)
				end
			end
			for i = 1, 17 do
				S.text(world, root, "Value" .. i, "0", true)
			end
		end)
		local names = {}
		for i = 1, 17 do
			table.insert(names, "Value" .. i)
		end
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if lane == "facet" then
					if index <= 10 then
						toggles[index]:set(true)
					elseif index <= 14 then
						sliders[index - 10]:set(1)
					else
						pickers[index - 14]:set("high")
					end
				else
					plainValues[index] = "1"
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value" .. index), "1")
					if index <= 10 then
						S.find(world, "Toggle" .. index):AddTag("facet-selected")
					elseif index <= 14 then
						local slider = S.find(world, "Slider" .. (index - 10))
						assert(slider:FindFirstChild("Fill", true)).Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
						assert(slider:FindFirstChild("Thumb", true)).Position = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
					end
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, names)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "text-input-200",
	iterations = 200,
	what = "Type 200 characters through a native TextBox; validation rejects punctuation and accepts letters.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local value = S.model(world, lane, "")
		local accepted = ""
		local function validate(proposed: string): string?
			return if string.find(proposed, "[^a-z]") then nil else proposed
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.TextInput "Name" { value = assert(value), validate = validate, placeholder = "Player name" }
		end, function(screen)
			local input = S.create(world, "TextBox", "Name", screen, {
				Text = "",
				PlaceholderText = "Player name",
				ClearTextOnFocus = false,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44),
			})
			input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				local proposed = input.Text
				assert(type(proposed) == "string")
				local nextValue = validate(proposed)
				if nextValue then
					accepted = nextValue
				elseif proposed ~= accepted then
					input.Text = accepted
				end
			end)
		end)
		S.fire(world, "Name", "Focused")
		local editor = S.find(world, "Name")
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local text = editor.Text
				assert(type(text) == "string")
				editor.Text = text .. (if index % 10 == 0 then "!" else "a")
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return tostring(editor.Text)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "button-feedback-50",
	iterations = 3,
	what = "Set native GuiState to Hover, Press and Idle on 50 buttons; native StyleSheet transitions are outside this double's paint model.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i = 1, 50 do
				table.insert(children, UI.Button("Action" .. i)({ label = `Action {i}`, onActivate = function() end }))
			end
			return UI.Grid "Actions" { columns = 5, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.grid(world, screen, "Actions", 5)
			for i = 1, 50 do
				local button = S.button(world, root, "Action" .. i, `Action {i}`, function() end)
				button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(function()
					local state = button.GuiState
					button.BackgroundTransparency = if state == world.types.Enum.GuiState.Press
						then 0.25
						elseif state == world.types.Enum.GuiState.Hover then 0.1
						else 0
				end)
			end
		end)
		local buttons = {}
		for i = 1, 50 do
			table.insert(buttons, S.find(world, "Action" .. i))
		end
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local states =
					{ world.types.Enum.GuiState.Hover, world.types.Enum.GuiState.Press, world.types.Enum.GuiState.Idle }
				for _, button in buttons do
					world.engine.environment.poke(button, "GuiState", states[index])
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = {}
				for _, button in buttons do
					table.insert(rows, tostring(button.Text) .. ":" .. tostring(button.GuiState))
				end
				return table.concat(rows, "\n")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "stepper-segments-100",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Change a bounded quantity and a segmented choice 100 times through the application model.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local quantity, selected = S.model(world, lane, 0), S.model(world, lane, "a")
		local options: { Facet.PickerOption<string> } =
			{ { value = "a", label = "Solo" }, { value = "b", label = "Team" } }
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.VStack "Choices" {
				width = 640,
				gap = 8,
				UI.Stepper "Quantity" { value = assert(quantity), min = 0, max = 100 },
				UI.Picker "Mode" { selected = assert(selected), options = options, style = "segmented" },
				UI.Text "Summary" {
					text = function(use: Facet.Use)
						return `{use(assert(quantity))}:{use(assert(selected))}`
					end,
				},
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Choices")
			local stepper = S.stack(world, root, "Quantity", true)
			local count = 0
			S.button(world, stepper, "Decrease", "−", function()
				count = math.max(0, count - 1)
				S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value"), tostring(count))
			end)
			S.text(world, stepper, "Value", "0", true)
			S.button(world, stepper, "Increase", "+", function()
				count = math.min(100, count + 1)
				S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value"), tostring(count))
			end)
			local mode =
				S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Mode", root, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 44) })
			S.stack(world, mode, "Segments", true)
			for _, option in options do
				local label = option.label
				assert(type(label) == "string")
				S.button(world, mode, option.value, label, function() end)
			end
			S.text(world, root, "Summary", "0:a", true)
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local choice = if index % 2 == 0 then "a" else "b"
				if lane == "facet" then
					assert(quantity):set(index)
					assert(selected):set(choice)
				else
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Value"), tostring(index))
					S.setText(world, S.find(world, "Summary"), `{index}:{choice}`)
					local chosen, other = S.find(world, choice), S.find(world, if choice == "a" then "b" else "a")
					if not chosen:HasTag("facet-selected") then
						chosen:AddTag("facet-selected")
					end
					if other:HasTag("facet-selected") then
						other:RemoveTag("facet-selected")
					end
					local decrease, increase = S.find(world, "Decrease"), S.find(world, "Increase")
					if (index <= 0) ~= decrease:HasTag("facet-disabled") then
						if index <= 0 then
							decrease:AddTag("facet-disabled")
						else
							decrease:RemoveTag("facet-disabled")
						end
					end
					if (index >= 100) ~= increase:HasTag("facet-disabled") then
						if index >= 100 then
							increase:AddTag("facet-disabled")
						else
							increase:RemoveTag("facet-disabled")
						end
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return tostring(S.find(world, "Summary").Text)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

-- LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

--!strict

local NativeApp = require("../native_app")
local Types = require("./types")

return function(workload: Types.Workload)
	local snapshots: { string } = {}
	local lanes: { Types.Lane } = { "plain", "facet" }
	for _, lane in lanes do
		assert(lane == "plain" or lane == "facet")
		local world = NativeApp { textService = true }
		local before = world.engine.census()
		local scene = workload.prepare(world, lane)
		local ok, problem = pcall(function()
			for checkpoint = 0, workload.iterations do
				if checkpoint > 0 then
					scene.step(checkpoint)
				end
				local snapshot = scene.snapshot()
				if lane == "plain" then
					snapshots[checkpoint + 1] = snapshot
				else
					local reference = snapshots[checkpoint + 1]
					local difference = 1
					while
						difference <= math.min(#reference, #snapshot)
						and string.byte(reference, difference) == string.byte(snapshot, difference)
					do
						difference += 1
					end
					assert(
						snapshot == reference,
						`{workload.id} differs at checkpoint {checkpoint}, byte {difference}\nPLAIN: {string.sub(
							reference,
							difference,
							difference + 300
						)}\nFACET: {string.sub(snapshot, difference, difference + 300)}`
					)
				end
			end
		end)
		scene.stop()
		world.dispose()
		local after = world.engine.census()
		assert(after.live <= before.live, workload.id .. " leaked instances")
		assert(after.connections <= before.connections, workload.id .. " leaked connections")
		assert(ok, tostring(problem))
	end
end

--!strict

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Sender = {}

Sender.hosts = { "127.0.0.1", "localhost" }

function Sender.post(port: number, path: string, body: string?): (boolean, string?)
	local lastError = "no host answered"

	for _, host in Sender.hosts do
		local request: any = {
			Url = `http://{host}:{port}{path}`,
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			Body = body or "{}",
		}
		local ok, response = pcall(HttpService.RequestAsync, HttpService, request)

		if ok and response.Success then
			return true, nil
		end

		lastError = if ok then `{response.StatusCode} {response.StatusMessage}` else tostring(response)
	end

	return false, lastError
end

return Sender

--!strict

local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")
local Facet = require("../../src")
type BillboardProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").BillboardGuiNativeProps)
type FolderProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FolderNativeProps)

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "main-menu-cold",
	iterations = 1,
	what = "Mount a background, title, six actions and footer; runtime and control-factory setup is excluded.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local labels = { "Play", "Inventory", "Shop", "Settings", "Credits", "Exit" }
		local stop: () -> () = function() end
		return {
			step = function()
				stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
					local children: { Instance } = { UI.Text "Title" { text = "Outpost", textRole = "title" } }
					for _, label in labels do
						table.insert(children, UI.Button(label)({ label = label, onActivate = function() end }))
					end
					table.insert(children, UI.Text "Footer" { text = "Season 4" })
					return UI.VStack "Menu" { width = 640, gap = 8, surface = "surface", table.unpack(children) }
				end, function(screen)
					local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Menu")
					root.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					S.text(world, root, "Title", "Outpost")
					for _, label in labels do
						S.button(world, root, label, label, function() end)
					end
					S.text(world, root, "Footer", "Season 4")
				end)
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				if #world.target:GetChildren() == 0 then
					return "unmounted"
				end
				return S.snapshot(
					world,
					{ "Title", "Play", "Inventory", "Shop", "Settings", "Credits", "Exit", "Footer" }
				)
			end,
			stop = function()
				stop()
			end,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "hud-600-frames",
	iterations = 600,
	what = "Update health fill, ammo, currency and timer once per simulated frame.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local health, ammo, coins, timer =
			S.model(world, lane, 1), S.model(world, lane, "30"), S.model(world, lane, "0"), S.model(world, lane, "0:00")
		local plainFill: S.Node? = nil
		local plainAmmo: S.Node? = nil
		local plainCoins: S.Node? = nil
		local plainTimer: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.HStack "HUD" {
				width = 640,
				gap = 8,
				UI.ProgressView "Health" { value = assert(health) },
				UI.Text "Ammo" { text = assert(ammo) },
				UI.Text "Coins" { text = assert(coins) },
				UI.Text "Timer" { text = assert(timer) },
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "HUD", true)
			plainFill = S.progress(world, root, "Health", 1)
			plainAmmo = S.text(world, root, "Ammo", "30", true)
			plainCoins = S.text(world, root, "Coins", "0", true)
			plainTimer = S.text(world, root, "Timer", "0:00", true)
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				local h, a, c, t =
					1 - frame % 100 / 100,
					tostring(30 - frame % 30),
					tostring(frame * 5),
					string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(frame / 60), frame % 60)
				if lane == "facet" then
					assert(health):set(h)
					assert(ammo):set(a)
					assert(coins):set(c)
					assert(timer):set(t)
				else
					assert(plainFill).Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(h, 1)
					S.setText(world, assert(plainAmmo), a)
					S.setText(world, assert(plainCoins), c)
					S.setText(world, assert(plainTimer), t)
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, { "Ammo", "Coins", "Timer" }) .. "\nHealth:" .. S.fraction(world, "Health")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "progress-20-120-frames",
	iterations = 120,
	what = "Drive 20 measured progress fills with per-frame values; both lanes use the same linear frame sequence.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local values: { Facet.Value<number> } = {}
		local fills: { S.Node } = {}
		for _ = 1, 20 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(values, Compose.cell(0))
			end
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in values do
				table.insert(children, UI.ProgressView("Progress" .. i)({ value = value }))
			end
			return UI.VStack "Progress" { width = 640, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Progress")
			for i = 1, 20 do
				table.insert(fills, S.progress(world, root, "Progress" .. i, 0))
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				for i = 1, 20 do
					local fraction = math.min(1, frame / 120)
					if lane == "facet" then
						values[i]:set(fraction)
					else
						fills[i].Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
					end
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local rows = {}
				for i = 1, 20 do
					table.insert(rows, S.fraction(world, "Progress" .. i))
				end
				return table.concat(rows, ",")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "badges-30-300-updates",
	iterations = 300,
	what = "Update all 30 notification counts, 300 times; badges keep their native text nodes.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local values: { Facet.Value<string> } = {}
		local names: { string } = {}
		local nodes: { S.Node } = {}
		for i = 1, 30 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(values, Compose.cell("1"))
			end
			table.insert(names, "Badge" .. i)
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in values do
				table.insert(
					children,
					UI.Badge(names[i])({
						label = function(use: Facet.Use)
							return use(value)
						end,
					})
				)
			end
			return UI.Grid "Badges" { columns = 6, gap = 8, table.unpack(children) }
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.grid(world, screen, "Badges", 6)
			for _, name in names do
				local node = S.text(world, root, name, "1", true)
				node:RemoveTag("facet-type-body")
				S.tag(node, "facet-badge", "facet-badge-standard")
				table.insert(nodes, node)
				S.create(world, "UIPadding", "Padding", node)
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				for i = 1, 30 do
					local label = tostring((frame + i) % 99 + 1)
					if lane == "facet" then
						values[i]:set(label)
					else
						S.setText(world, nodes[i], label)
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, names)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "world-markers-50",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Update the labels of 50 native BillboardGui markers anchored to Parts.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose, Host = world.UI, world.Compose, world.Host
		local values: { Facet.Value<string> } = {}
		local names: { string } = {}
		local nodes: { S.Node } = {}
		for i = 1, 50 do
			if lane == "facet" then
				table.insert(values, Compose.cell("Target " .. i))
			end
			table.insert(names, "MarkerLabel" .. i)
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local children: { Instance } = {}
			for i, value in values do
				local anchor = Host.Part { Name = "Anchor" .. i, Anchored = true }
				table.insert(children, anchor)
				local props: BillboardProps = {
					Name = "Marker" .. i,
					Adornee = Compose.static(anchor),
					Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(120, 32),
					UI.Text(names[i])({ text = value }),
				}
				table.insert(children, Host.BillboardGui(props))
			end
			local props: FolderProps = { Name = "Markers", table.unpack(children) }
			return Host.Folder(props)
		end, function(screen)
			local root = S.create(world, "Folder", "Markers", screen)
			for i, name in names do
				local anchor = S.create(world, "Part", "Anchor" .. i, root, { Anchored = true })
				local billboard = S.create(
					world,
					"BillboardGui",
					"Marker" .. i,
					root,
					{ Adornee = anchor, Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(120, 32) }
				)
				table.insert(nodes, S.text(world, billboard, name, "Target " .. i, true))
			end
		end)
		return {
			step = function(frame: number)
				for i = 1, 50 do
					local label = `Target {i}: {frame}m`
					if lane == "facet" then
						values[i]:set(label)
					else
						S.setText(world, nodes[i], label)
					end
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return S.snapshot(world, names)
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

description: Módulo Luau para Roblox Studio. Revisa sus dependencias, permisos y compatibilidad antes de integrarlo en tu propia experiencia.

-- LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

--!strict

export type Filter = {
	include: { Instance }?,
	exclude: { Instance },
}

local Settings = {}

Settings.name = "Lunaut_Settings"
Settings.service = "ServerStorage"

Settings.template = [[
--!strict
return {
	include = {
	},
	exclude = {
	},
}
]]

local function getService(): Instance?
	local ok, service = pcall(game.GetService, game, Settings.service)
	return if ok then service else nil
end

function Settings.find(): ModuleScript?
	local service = getService()
	local found = service and service:FindFirstChild(Settings.name)

	if found and found:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return found
	end

	return nil
end

local function readList(value: unknown, field: string): ({ Instance }?, string?)
	if value == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end

	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `{field} should be a list of instances`
	end

	local list: { Instance } = {}

	for index, item in value :: { [unknown]: unknown } do
		if typeof(item) ~= "Instance" then
			return nil, `{field}[{tostring(index)}] is not an instance`
		end

		table.insert(list, item :: Instance)
	end

	return list, nil
end

function Settings.load(): (Filter?, string?)
	local module = Settings.find()

	if module == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local copy = module:Clone()
	local ok, result = pcall(require, copy)
	copy:Destroy()

	if not ok then
		return nil, `{Settings.name} failed to run: {result}`
	end

	if type(result) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `{Settings.name} should return a table with include and exclude`
	end

	local include, includeProblem = readList(result.include, "include")

	if includeProblem then
		return nil, `{Settings.name}: {includeProblem}`
	end

	local exclude, excludeProblem = readList(result.exclude, "exclude")

	if excludeProblem then
		return nil, `{Settings.name}: {excludeProblem}`
	end

	return {
		include = if include and #include > 0 then include else nil,
		exclude = exclude or {},
	}, nil
end

function Settings.open(plugin: Plugin): ModuleScript?
	local module = Settings.find()

	if module == nil then
		local service = getService()

		if service == nil then
			return nil
		end

		local created = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
		created.Name = Settings.name
		created.Source = Settings.template
		created.Parent = service
		module = created
	end

	plugin:OpenScript(module :: ModuleScript)
	return module
end

function Settings.isWatched(filter: Filter?, instance: Instance): boolean
	if filter == nil then
		return true
	end

	for _, excluded in filter.exclude do
		if instance == excluded or instance:IsDescendantOf(excluded) then
			return false
		end
	end

	if filter.include == nil then
		return true
	end

	for _, included in filter.include do
		if instance == included or instance:IsDescendantOf(included) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

return Settings

--!strict

local Settings = require(script.Parent.Settings)

export type Node = {
	Name: string,
	ClassName: string,
	Children: { Node }?,
}

local Tree = {}

Tree.services = {
	"Workspace",
	"Players",
	"Lighting",
	"MaterialService",
	"ReplicatedFirst",
	"ReplicatedStorage",
	"ServerScriptService",
	"ServerStorage",
	"StarterGui",
	"StarterPack",
	"StarterPlayer",
	"SoundService",
	"Teams",
	"TextChatService",
	"Chat",
	"LocalizationService",
	"TestService",
}

Tree.limit = 200000

local function isExcluded(filter: Settings.Filter?, instance: Instance): boolean
	if filter == nil then
		return false
	end

	for _, excluded in filter.exclude do
		if instance == excluded then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function Tree.build(root: DataModel, limit: number?, filter: Settings.Filter?): (Node, number)
	local maximum = limit or Tree.limit
	local count = 0

	local function visit(instance: Instance): Node
		count += 1
		local node: Node = { Name = instance.Name, ClassName = instance.ClassName }

		if count >= maximum then
			return node
		end

		local ok, children = pcall(instance.GetChildren, instance)

		if not ok or #children == 0 then
			return node
		end

		local nodes = {}

		for _, child in children do
			if count >= maximum then
				break
			end

			if not isExcluded(filter, child) then
				table.insert(nodes, visit(child))
			end
		end

		node.Children = nodes
		return node
	end

	local tree: Node = { Name = "game", ClassName = "DataModel", Children = {} }
	local include = filter and filter.include

	if include == nil then
		for _, name in Tree.services do
			local ok, service = pcall(root.FindService, root, name)

			if ok and service and not isExcluded(filter, service) then
				table.insert(tree.Children :: { Node }, visit(service))
			end
		end

		return tree, count
	end

	local made: { [Instance]: Node } = { [root] = tree }

	local function getNode(instance: Instance): Node?
		local existing = made[instance]

		if existing then
			return existing
		end

		local parent = instance.Parent

		if parent == nil then
			return nil
		end

		local parentNode = getNode(parent)

		if parentNode == nil then
			return nil
		end

		count += 1
		local node: Node = { Name = instance.Name, ClassName = instance.ClassName }
		parentNode.Children = parentNode.Children or {}
		table.insert(parentNode.Children :: { Node }, node)
		made[instance] = node
		return node
	end

	for _, included in include do
		local covered = false

		for _, other in include do
			if other ~= included and included:IsDescendantOf(other) then
				covered = true
				break
			end
		end

		if covered or included == root or not included:IsDescendantOf(root) or not Settings.isWatched(filter, included) then
			continue
		end

		local parent = included.Parent
		local parentNode = parent and getNode(parent)

		if parentNode and count < maximum then
			local node = visit(included)
			parentNode.Children = parentNode.Children or {}
			table.insert(parentNode.Children :: { Node }, node)
			made[included] = node
		end
	end

	return tree, count
end

return Tree

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Util)

local tool: Util.Tool = {
	name = "Anchor All",
	description = "Anchors every part in the selection, including parts inside models.",

	run = function(selection)
		local parts = Util.getParts(selection)
		if #parts == 0 then
			error("Select at least one part or model.", 0)
		end

		for _, part in parts do
			part.Anchored = true
		end

		return `Anchored {Util.plural(#parts, "part")}.`
	end,
}

return tool
