--!strict

local Types = require("./types")
local Roblox = require("@verify/src/roblox")
local Facet = require("../../src")
type ScreenProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ScreenGuiNativeProps)

export type Node = Roblox.Instance & {
	Activated: Roblox.Signal<>,
	DragEnd: Roblox.Signal<>,
	Completed: Roblox.Signal<unknown>,
	Pressed: Roblox.Signal<>,
	StateChanged: Roblox.Signal<unknown>,
	MouseEnter: Roblox.Signal<>,
	MouseLeave: Roblox.Signal<>,
	SelectionGained: Roblox.Signal<>,
}
export type Motion = {
	dialog: { enter: number, exit: number },
	toast: { enter: number, exit: number },
	radial: { enter: number, exit: number },
	travel: number,
	present: string,
	travelEase: string,
}
type Tweener = { Create: (Tweener, Node, unknown, { [string]: unknown }) -> Node }
type Playable = { Play: (Playable) -> () }
export type Path = { SetControlPoints: (Path, { unknown }) -> () }
type Binding = { name: string, keys: { Enum.KeyCode }, pressed: (() -> ())?, aim: ((unknown) -> ())? }
type Properties = {
	Text: string?,
	AutoLocalize: boolean?,
	BackgroundTransparency: number?,
	BorderSizePixel: number?,
	TextSize: number?,
	Size: UDim2?,
	TextXAlignment: Enum.TextXAlignment?,
	AutoButtonColor: boolean?,
	Selectable: boolean?,
	FillDirection: Enum.FillDirection?,
	SortOrder: Enum.SortOrder?,
	Padding: UDim?,
	ZIndexBehavior: Enum.ZIndexBehavior?,
	CellSize: UDim2?,
	CellPadding: UDim2?,
	FillDirectionMaxCells: number?,
	ClipsDescendants: boolean?,
	AutomaticCanvasSize: Enum.AutomaticSize?,
	PlaceholderText: string?,
	ClearTextOnFocus: boolean?,
	CanvasSize: UDim2?,
	CanvasPosition: Vector2?,
	Image: string?,
	AutomaticSize: Enum.AutomaticSize?,
	AspectRatio: number?,
	ScrollingDirection: Enum.ScrollingDirection?,
	Anchored: boolean?,
	Adornee: Roblox.Instance?,
}

local function model<T>(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane, value: T): Facet.Value<T>?
	return if lane == "facet" then world.Compose.cell(value) else nil
end

local function create(
	world: Types.World,
	class: string,
	name: string,
	parent: Roblox.Instance?,
	props: Properties?
): Node
	local node: Node = world.engine.new(class)
	node.Name = name
	if props then
		if props.Text ~= nil then
			node.Text = props.Text
		end
		if props.AutoLocalize ~= nil then
			node.AutoLocalize = props.AutoLocalize
		end
		if props.BackgroundTransparency ~= nil then
			node.BackgroundTransparency = props.BackgroundTransparency
		end
		if props.BorderSizePixel ~= nil then
			node.BorderSizePixel = props.BorderSizePixel
		end
		if props.TextSize ~= nil then
			node.TextSize = props.TextSize
		end
		if props.Size ~= nil then
			node.Size = props.Size
		end
		if props.TextXAlignment ~= nil then
			node.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment
		end
		if props.AutoButtonColor ~= nil then
			node.AutoButtonColor = props.AutoButtonColor
		end
		if props.Selectable ~= nil then
			node.Selectable = props.Selectable
		end
		if props.FillDirection ~= nil then
			node.FillDirection = props.FillDirection
		end
		if props.SortOrder ~= nil then
			node.SortOrder = props.SortOrder
		end
		if props.Padding ~= nil then
			node.Padding = props.Padding
		end
		if props.ZIndexBehavior ~= nil then
			node.ZIndexBehavior = props.ZIndexBehavior
		end
		if props.CellSize ~= nil then
			node.CellSize = props.CellSize
		end
		if props.CellPadding ~= nil then
			node.CellPadding = props.CellPadding
		end
		if props.FillDirectionMaxCells ~= nil then
			node.FillDirectionMaxCells = props.FillDirectionMaxCells
		end
		if props.ClipsDescendants ~= nil then
			node.ClipsDescendants = props.ClipsDescendants
		end
		if props.AutomaticCanvasSize ~= nil then
			node.AutomaticCanvasSize = props.AutomaticCanvasSize
		end
		if props.PlaceholderText ~= nil then
			node.PlaceholderText = props.PlaceholderText
		end
		if props.ClearTextOnFocus ~= nil then
			node.ClearTextOnFocus = props.ClearTextOnFocus
		end
		if props.CanvasSize ~= nil then
			node.CanvasSize = props.CanvasSize
		end
		if props.CanvasPosition ~= nil then
			node.CanvasPosition = props.CanvasPosition
		end
		if props.Image ~= nil then
			node.Image = props.Image
		end
		if props.AutomaticSize ~= nil then
			node.AutomaticSize = props.AutomaticSize
		end
		if props.AspectRatio ~= nil then
			node.AspectRatio = props.AspectRatio
		end
		if props.ScrollingDirection ~= nil then
			node.ScrollingDirection = props.ScrollingDirection
		end
		if props.Anchored ~= nil then
			node.Anchored = props.Anchored
		end
		if props.Adornee ~= nil then
			node.Adornee = props.Adornee
		end
	end
	node.Parent = parent
	return node
end

local function find(world: Types.World, name: string): Node
	local node: Node? = world.target:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	assert(node, "missing node " .. name)
	return node
end

local function tag(node: Node, ...: string)
	for _, name in { ... } do
		node:AddTag(name)
	end
end

local prepareHold: (Types.World, Node) -> () = function(_world: Types.World, _node: Node) end

local function text(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, value: string, bound: boolean?, kind: string?): Node
	local node = create(world, "TextLabel", name, nil, {
		Text = value,
		AutoLocalize = if bound then false else nil,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		TextXAlignment = world.types.Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	tag(node, "facet-text")
	if kind ~= "" then
		tag(node, "facet-type-" .. (kind or "body"))
	end
	node.Parent = parent
	if bound then
		prepareHold(world, node)
	end
	return node
end

local function button(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, label: string, activate: () -> ()): Node
	local node = create(world, "TextButton", name, nil, {
		Text = label,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Selectable = true,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
	})
	tag(node, "facet-button", "facet-role-default")
	node.Parent = parent
	node.Activated:Connect(function(...: unknown)
		activate()
	end)
	return node
end

type Hold = { constraint: Node, widest: number, length: number }
type Styled = { GetStyled: (Styled, string) -> unknown }

local function styled(node: Node, key: string): unknown
	return ((node :: unknown) :: Styled):GetStyled(key)
end
local holds = (setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: unknown) :: { [Node]: Hold }
local widths: { [string]: number } = {}

local function widthOf(world: Types.World, node: Node, value: string, ready: (number) -> ()): number?
	local service = world.textService
	if service == nil then
		local bounds: unknown = node.TextBounds
		return if typeof(bounds) == "Vector2" then bounds.X else 0
	end
	local face, size = styled(node, "FontFace"), styled(node, "TextSize")
	local key = `{tostring(face)}|{tostring(size)}|{value}`
	local known = widths[key]
	if known ~= nil then
		return known
	end
	local params = world.engine.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
	params.Text, params.Font, params.Size, params.Width = value, face, size, 0
	local function measure()
		local ok, measured: unknown = pcall(service.GetTextBoundsAsync, service, params)
		params:Destroy()
		if ok and typeof(measured) == "Vector2" then
			widths[key] = measured.X
			ready(measured.X)
		end
	end
	if task then
		task.spawn(measure)
	else
		measure()
	end
	return widths[key]
end

local function widen(world: Types.World, held: Hold, length: number, width: number)
	if length == held.length and width > held.widest then
		held.widest = width
		held.constraint.MinSize = world.types.Vector2.new(width, 0)
	end
end

local function holdFor(world: Types.World, node: Node): Hold
	local hold = holds[node]
	if hold == nil then
		local current = tostring(node.Text)
		local length = utf8.len(current) or #current
		local created: Hold = {
			constraint = create(world, "UISizeConstraint", "Hold", node),
			widest = 0,
			length = length,
		}
		holds[node] = created
		hold = created
		local width = widthOf(world, node, current, function(measured: number)
			widen(world, created, length, measured)
		end)
		if width then
			widen(world, created, length, width)
		end
	end
	return assert(hold)
end

prepareHold = function(world: Types.World, node: Node)
	holdFor(world, node)
end

local function setText(world: Types.World, node: Node, value: string)
	local previous = tostring(node.Text)
	if previous == value then
		return
	end
	local held = holdFor(world, node)
	node.Text = value
	local length = utf8.len(value) or #value
	if length ~= held.length then
		held.widest, held.length = 0, length
		held.constraint.MinSize = world.types.Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
	local width = widthOf(world, node, value, function(measured: number)
		widen(world, held, length, measured)
	end)
	if width then
		widen(world, held, length, width)
	end
end

local function stack(world: Types.World, parent: Node?, name: string, horizontal: boolean?): Node
	local node = create(world, "Frame", name, parent, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
	})
	create(world, "UIListLayout", "Layout", node, {
		FillDirection = if horizontal
			then world.types.Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
			else world.types.Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
		SortOrder = world.types.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		Padding = world.types.UDim.new(0, 8),
	})
	return node
end

local function connect(_world: Types.World, node: Node, event: string, callback: (...unknown) -> ())
	assert(event == "DragEnd")
	node.DragEnd:Connect(callback)
end

local function fire(world: Types.World, name: string, event: string, ...: unknown)
	world.engine.environment.fire(find(world, name), event, ...)
end

local function snapshot(world: Types.World, names: { string }): string
	local rows: { string } = {}
	for _, name in names do
		local node = find(world, name)
		local value = node.Text
		table.insert(rows, name .. ":" .. tostring(value))
	end
	return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

local metrics = Facet.themes.neutralPackage().metrics.motion
local motion: Motion = {
	dialog = assert(metrics.dialog),
	toast = assert(metrics.toast),
	radial = assert(metrics.radial),
	travel = assert(assert(metrics.durations).travel),
	present = assert(assert(metrics.easing).present),
	travelEase = assert(assert(metrics.easing).travel),
}

type Tweens = { service: Node, live: { [Node]: boolean }, stop: () -> () }
local tweening = (setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: unknown) :: { [Types.World]: Tweens }

local function tweensFor(world: Types.World): Tweens
	local existing = tweening[world]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local service: Node = world.engine.new("TweenService")
	local live: { [Node]: boolean } = {}
	local created: Tweens = {
		service = service,
		live = live,
		stop = function()
			for tween in live do
				tween:Destroy()
			end
			table.clear(live)
			service:Destroy()
			tweening[world] = nil
		end,
	}
	tweening[world] = created
	return created
end

local function animate(
	world: Types.World,
	node: Node,
	seconds: number,
	ease: string,
	goal: { [string]: unknown },
	done: (() -> ())?
)
	local tweens = tweensFor(world)
	local Enum = world.types.Enum
	local direction, name = string.match(ease, "^(%l+)(%u%a*)$")
	local style = if direction then (Enum.EasingStyle :: unknown) :: { [string]: Enum.EasingStyle } else nil
	local info = world.types.TweenInfo.new(
		seconds,
		if style and name then style[name] else Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
		if direction == "inOut"
			then Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
			elseif direction == "in" then Enum.EasingDirection.In
			else Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	)
	local tween = ((tweens.service :: unknown) :: Tweener):Create(node, info, goal)
	tweens.live[tween] = true
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		tweens.live[tween] = nil
		tween:Destroy()
		if done then
			done()
		end
	end)
	local playable = (tween :: unknown) :: Playable
	playable:Play()
end

local function inputs(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, priority: number, bindings: { Binding }): Node
	local context = create(world, "InputContext", name)
	context.Priority = priority
	context.Sink = true
	for _, binding in bindings do
		local action = create(world, "InputAction", binding.name, context)
		if binding.aim then
			action.Type = world.types.Enum.InputActionType.Direction2D
			action.StateChanged:Connect(binding.aim)
		end
		for _, key in binding.keys do
			local bound = create(world, "InputBinding", "InputBinding", action)
			bound.KeyCode = key
		end
		local pressed = binding.pressed
		if pressed then
			action.Pressed:Connect(function(...: unknown)
				pressed()
			end)
		end
	end
	context.Parent = parent
	return context
end

local function trap(world: Types.World, panel: Node)
	local Stop = world.types.Enum.SelectionBehavior.Stop
	panel.SelectionGroup = true
	panel.SelectionBehaviorUp = Stop
	panel.SelectionBehaviorDown = Stop
	panel.SelectionBehaviorLeft = Stop
	panel.SelectionBehaviorRight = Stop
end

local function focus(world: Types.World, target: Node): () -> ()
	local gui: Node? = world.guiService
	if gui == nil then
		return function() end
	end
	local service = gui
	local previous = service.SelectedObject
	service.SelectedObject = target
	return function()
		if service.SelectedObject == target then
			service.SelectedObject = previous
		end
	end
end

local function layer(world: Types.World, name: string, dismiss: () -> (), scrimTag: string?): Node
	local root = create(world, "CanvasGroup", name, nil, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	root.GroupTransparency = 1
	root.Active = true
	root.ZIndex = 100
	local scrim = create(world, "Frame", "Scrim", root, {
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	if scrimTag then
		tag(scrim, scrimTag)
	else
		scrim.BackgroundColor3 = world.types.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		scrim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
	end
	local outside = create(world, "TextButton", "DismissTarget", root, {
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Selectable = false,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	outside.Activated:Connect(function(...: unknown)
		dismiss()
	end)
	return root
end

local function tagged(world: Types.World, name: string): number
	local count = 0
	for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
		if node:HasTag(name) and (not node:IsA("GuiObject") or node.Visible == true) then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function sinks(world: Types.World): number
	local count = 0
	for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("InputContext") and node.Sink == true and node.Enabled == true then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end

local function tagsOf(world: Types.World, name: string): string
	local node = world.target:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if node == nil then
		return "absent"
	end
	local names = node:GetTags()
	table.sort(names)
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

local function themed(world: Types.World, screen: Node): () -> ()
	local stop = world.runtime.mount(function()
		return Facet.themes.createStyleSheet(world.runtime, Facet.themes.neutralPackage(), { types = world.types })
	end, screen)
	local sheet = screen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("StyleSheet")
	local link: Node = world.engine.new("StyleLink")
	link.StyleSheet = sheet
	link.Parent = screen
	local warm: Node = world.engine.new("Folder")
	warm.Name = "StateTags"
	for _, name in { "facet-selected", "facet-disabled", "facet-busy" } do
		warm:AddTag(name)
	end
	warm.Parent = screen
	return stop
end

local function mount(
	world: Types.World,
	lane: Types.Lane,
	facet: () -> Instance,
	plain: (Node) -> (),
	unthemed: boolean?
): () -> ()
	if lane == "facet" then
		local Host = world.Host
		local screen: Instance? = nil
		local stop = world.runtime.mount(function()
			return world.UI.provide(function()
				local props: ScreenProps = { Name = "Comparison", facet() }
				local made = Host.ScreenGui(props)
				screen = made
				return made
			end)
		end, world.target)
		local unstyle = if unthemed then nil else themed(world, (assert(screen) :: unknown) :: Node)
		return function()
			if unstyle then
				unstyle()
			end
			stop()
		end
	end
	local screen = create(world, "ScreenGui", "Comparison", world.target, {
		ZIndexBehavior = world.types.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	})
	plain(screen)
	local unstyle = if unthemed then nil else themed(world, screen)
	for _, node in screen:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
			((node :: unknown) :: Styled):GetStyled("Visible")
		end
	end
	return function()
		if unstyle then
			unstyle()
		end
		local tweens = tweening[world]
		if tweens then
			tweens.stop()
		end
		screen:Destroy()
	end
end

local function grid(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, columns: number): Node
	local node = create(world, "Frame", name, parent, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640, 480),
	})
	create(world, "UIGridLayout", "Layout", node, {
		CellSize = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(640 / columns - 8, 44),
		CellPadding = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
		FillDirectionMaxCells = columns,
		SortOrder = world.types.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	})
	return node
end

local function progress(world: Types.World, parent: Node, name: string, value: number): Node
	local root = stack(world, parent, name, true)
	local track = create(world, "Frame", "Track", root, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(240, 6) })
	local clip = create(world, "Frame", "FillClip", track, {
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	})
	return create(world, "Frame", "Fill1", clip, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(value, 1) })
end

local function fraction(world: Types.World, name: string): string
	local clip = find(world, name):FindFirstChild("Fill1", true)
	assert(clip)
	local size: unknown = clip.Size
	assert(typeof(size) == "UDim2")
	return string.format("%.4f", size.X.Scale)
end

local function setProgress(world: Types.World, name: string, value: number)
	local fill = assert(find(world, name):FindFirstChild("Fill1", true))
	fill.Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(value, 1)
end

return {
	model = model,
	create = create,
	find = find,
	text = text,
	button = button,
	tag = tag,
	setText = setText,
	stack = stack,
	connect = connect,
	fire = fire,
	snapshot = snapshot,
	mount = mount,
	grid = grid,
	progress = progress,
	fraction = fraction,
	setProgress = setProgress,
	motion = motion,
	animate = animate,
	inputs = inputs,
	trap = trap,
	focus = focus,
	layer = layer,
	tagged = tagged,
	sinks = sinks,
	tagsOf = tagsOf,
}

--!strict

local Ui = {}

export type Theme = {
	background: Color3,
	panel: Color3,
	border: Color3,
	text: Color3,
	dimmed: Color3,
	accent: Color3,
	danger: Color3,
	field: Color3,
}

export type Checkbox = {
	frame: Frame,
	set: (checked: boolean) -> (),
	changed: BindableEvent,
}

local accent = Color3.fromRGB(11, 132, 255)
local danger = Color3.fromRGB(214, 69, 69)

function Ui.getTheme(): Theme
	return {
		background = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 27),
		panel = Color3.fromRGB(44, 44, 50),
		border = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 78),
		text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240),
		dimmed = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170),
		accent = accent,
		danger = danger,
		field = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 41),
	}
end

function Ui.corner(parent: Instance, radius: number)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = parent
end

function Ui.label(parent: Instance, text: string, size: number, bold: boolean, order: number): TextLabel
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.Font = if bold then Enum.Font.SourceSansBold else Enum.Font.SourceSans
	label.TextSize = size
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Text = text
	label.LayoutOrder = order
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

function Ui.button(parent: Instance, text: string, height: number, order: number): TextButton
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
	button.TextSize = 18
	button.Text = text
	button.LayoutOrder = order
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Ui.corner(button, 4)
	button.Parent = parent
	return button
end

function Ui.checkbox(parent: Instance, title: string, description: string, order: number): Checkbox
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	frame.LayoutOrder = order
	frame.Parent = parent

	local box = Instance.new("TextButton")
	box.Name = "Box"
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
	box.Text = ""
	box.AutoButtonColor = false
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Ui.corner(box, 4)
	box.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Parent = box

	local name = Instance.new("TextButton")
	name.Name = "Title"
	name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 0)
	name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 26)
	name.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	name.TextSize = 18
	name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	name.Text = title
	name.Parent = frame

	local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hint.Name = "Description"
	hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
	hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	hint.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	hint.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	hint.TextSize = 15
	hint.TextWrapped = true
	hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hint.Text = description
	hint.Parent = frame

	local changed = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	local checked = false

	local function set(value: boolean)
		checked = value
		box:SetAttribute("Checked", value)
	end

	local function toggle()
		set(not checked)
		changed:Fire(checked)
	end

	box.Activated:Connect(toggle)
	name.Activated:Connect(toggle)

	return { frame = frame, set = set, changed = changed }
end

function Ui.paint(root: Instance, theme: Theme)
	local items = root:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(items, root)

	for _, item in items do
		local role = item:GetAttribute("Role")

		if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox") then
			item.TextColor3 = if item.Name == "Description" or role == "Hint" then theme.dimmed else theme.text
		end

		if item:IsA("UIStroke") then
			item.Color = theme.border
		end

		if item.Name == "Box" and item:IsA("TextButton") then
			item.BackgroundColor3 = if item:GetAttribute("Checked") then theme.accent else theme.field
		elseif role == "Primary" and item:IsA("TextButton") then
			item.BackgroundColor3 = if item:GetAttribute("Active") then theme.danger else theme.accent
			item.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		elseif role == "Secondary" and item:IsA("TextButton") then
			item.BackgroundColor3 = theme.panel
		elseif role == "Field" and item:IsA("TextBox") then
			item.BackgroundColor3 = theme.field
		elseif role == "Background" and item:IsA("GuiObject") then
			item.BackgroundColor3 = theme.background
		end
	end
end

return Ui

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Util)

local tool: Util.Tool = {
	name = "Copy Look",
	description = "Copies color, material and transparency from the first selected part to the others.",

	run = function(selection)
		local source = selection[1]
		if not source or not source:IsA("BasePart") then
			error("First select the part to copy the look from.", 0)
		end

		local count = 0
		for _, part in Util.getParts(selection) do
			if part ~= source then
				part.Color = source.Color
				part.Material = source.Material
				part.MaterialVariant = source.MaterialVariant
				part.Transparency = source.Transparency
				count += 1
			end
		end

		if count == 0 then
			error("Select at least 2 parts.", 0)
		end

		return `Copied the look of {source.Name} to {Util.plural(count, "part")}.`
	end,
}

return tool

--!strict

local Facet = require("../../src")
local Types = require("./types")
local S = require("./support")
type FrameProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FrameNativeProps)

local workloads: { Types.Workload } = {}

local function labels(world: Types.World, prefix: string): string
	local rows: { string } = {}
	for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("TextLabel") and type(node.Text) == "string" and string.sub(node.Text, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
			table.insert(rows, node.Text)
		end
	end
	table.sort(rows)
	return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "dialog-50-cycles",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Open a confirmation dialog, then activate Confirm and close it, 50 times. Both lanes add a scrim, an outside dismiss target, a selection trap, Back and Return input contexts and the theme dialog fade.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local open = S.model(world, lane, false)
		local confirmed = 0
		local panel: S.Node? = nil
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local actions: { Facet.DialogAction } = {
				{
					id = "Confirm",
					label = "Confirm",
					role = "default",
					onActivate = function()
						confirmed += 1
					end,
				},
			}
			local spec: Facet.DialogSpec = {
				isPresented = assert(open),
				onPresentedChange = function(value)
					assert(open):set(value)
				end,
				title = "Buy kart?",
				content = function()
					return UI.Text "Terms" { text = "Purchase costs 100 coins." }
				end,
				actions = actions,
			}
			return UI.Dialog "ConfirmDialog"(spec)
		end, function(screen)
			parent = screen
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if index % 2 == 1 then
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(open):set(true)
					else
						local Enum = world.types.Enum
						local contexts: { S.Node } = {}
						local restore = function() end
						local closing = false
						local function close()
							local shown = panel
							if shown == nil or closing then
								return
							end
							closing = true
							shown.Interactable = false
							for _, context in contexts do
								context.Enabled = false
							end
							restore()
							S.animate(
								world,
								shown,
								S.motion.dialog.exit,
								S.motion.present,
								{ GroupTransparency = 1 },
								function()
									shown:Destroy()
									panel = nil
								end
							)
						end
						local layer = S.layer(world, "DialogModal", close, "facet-scrim")
						panel = layer
						local body = S.stack(world, layer, "Panel")
						S.tag(body, "facet-dialog", "facet-panel")
						S.trap(world, body)
						body.ZIndex = 101
						local padding = S.create(world, "UIPadding", "UIPadding", body)
						for _, side in { "PaddingTop", "PaddingBottom", "PaddingLeft", "PaddingRight" } do
							padding[side] = world.types.UDim.new(0, 16)
						end
						S.create(world, "UICorner", "UICorner", body)
						S.text(world, body, "Title", "Buy kart?", nil, "heading")
						local scroll = S.create(world, "ScrollingFrame", "Content", body, {
							AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(320, 120),
						})
						S.text(world, scroll, "Terms", "Purchase costs 100 coins.")
						local row = S.stack(world, body, "Actions", true)
						local function confirm()
							if closing then
								return
							end
							confirmed += 1
							close()
						end
						local default = S.button(world, row, "Confirm", "Confirm", confirm)
						S.tag(default, "facet-accent")
						table.insert(
							contexts,
							S.inputs(world, layer, "FacetModalBack", 2000, {
								{
									name = "ModalBack",
									keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Escape, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB },
									pressed = close,
								},
							})
						)
						table.insert(
							contexts,
							S.inputs(world, layer, "FacetShortcut", 1999, {
								{ name = "Shortcut", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Return }, pressed = confirm },
							})
						)
						layer.Parent = assert(parent)
						restore = S.focus(world, default)
						S.animate(world, layer, S.motion.dialog.enter, S.motion.present, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
					end
				else
					S.fire(world, "Confirm", "Activated")
				end
				world.frame(1)
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return `{confirmed}:{labels(world, "Purchase costs")}\ndialog={S.tagged(world, "facet-dialog")} scrim={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-scrim"
				)} sinks={S.sinks(world)} confirm={S.tagsOf(world, "Confirm")} heading={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-type-heading"
				)}`
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "toast-stream-100",
	iterations = 200,
	what = "Show 100 one-shot result toasts. Each toast stays for four seconds and then closes. Both lanes put the toast in a panel row in a stack and use the theme toast enter and exit motion.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local initial: { number } = {}
		local messages = S.model(world, lane, initial)
		local panel: S.Node? = nil
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local remaining = 0
		local connection = world.engine.heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
			local shown = panel
			if lane == "plain" and shown then
				remaining -= dt
				if remaining <= 0 then
					panel = nil
					local row = assert(shown:FindFirstChild("ToastRow")) :: S.Node
					S.animate(world, row, S.motion.toast.exit, S.motion.present, {
						GroupTransparency = 1,
						Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, -16),
					}, function()
						shown:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end)
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local Host = world.Host
			local props: FrameProps = {
				Name = "Toasts",
				Compose.keyed {
					from = assert(messages),
					key = function(id: number)
						return id
					end,
					render = function(current: Facet.ReadOnlyValue<number>)
						return UI.Toast {
							message = function(use: Facet.Use)
								return `Reward {use(current)}`
							end,
						}
					end,
				},
			}
			return Host.Frame(props)
		end, function(screen)
			local stack = S.stack(world, screen, "ToastStack")
			local padding = S.create(world, "UIPadding", "UIPadding", stack)
			padding.PaddingTop = world.types.UDim.new(0, 16)
			parent = stack
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if index % 2 == 1 then
					local id = math.ceil(index / 2)
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(messages):set({ id })
					else
						local slot = S.create(world, "Frame", "ToastSlot", nil, {
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
							AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
						})
						local row = S.create(world, "CanvasGroup", "ToastRow", slot, {
							Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
							AutomaticSize = world.types.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
						})
						S.tag(row, "facet-snackbar", "facet-panel", "facet-floating")
						row.GroupTransparency = 1
						row.Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, -16)
						local padding = S.create(world, "UIPadding", "UIPadding", row)
						padding.PaddingLeft, padding.PaddingRight =
							world.types.UDim.new(0, 12), world.types.UDim.new(0, 12)
						padding.PaddingTop, padding.PaddingBottom =
							world.types.UDim.new(0, 8), world.types.UDim.new(0, 8)
						S.create(world, "UICorner", "UICorner", row)
						S.text(world, row, "Message", `Reward {id}`, nil, "")
						slot.Parent = assert(parent)
						panel = slot
						remaining = 4
						S.animate(world, row, S.motion.toast.enter, S.motion.present, {
							GroupTransparency = 0,
							Position = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
						})
					end
					world.frame()
				else
					world.frame(5)
					world.frame(1)
				end
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return `{labels(world, "Reward ")}\nsnackbar={S.tagged(world, "facet-snackbar")}`
			end,
			stop = function()
				connection:Disconnect()
				stop()
			end,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "tabs-5-100-switches",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Switch 100 times among five peer pages and keep each visited page and its content. Both lanes mark the current tab, show its selection indicator and add shoulder-button input contexts.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local selection = S.model(world, lane, "1")
		local current = "1"
		local pages: { [string]: S.Node } = {}
		local tabs: { Facet.Tab } = {}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			table.insert(tabs, {
				id = tostring(i),
				label = `Tab {i}`,
				content = function()
					return UI.Text("Page" .. i)({ text = `Page {i} content` })
				end,
			})
		end
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.TabView "Tabs" {
				selection = assert(selection),
				tabs = tabs,
				placement = "topBar",
				transition = false,
			}
		end, function(screen)
			local Enum = world.types.Enum
			local root = S.stack(world, screen, "Tabs")
			local bar = S.stack(world, root, "TabBar", true)
			local content = S.create(world, "Frame", "Content", root, {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			})
			local buttons: { [string]: S.Node } = {}
			local marks: { [string]: S.Node } = {}
			local function select(id: string)
				local previous = pages[current]
				if previous then
					previous.Visible = false
					buttons[current]:RemoveTag("facet-tab-current")
					marks[current].Visible = false
				end
				current = id
				local page = pages[id]
				if page == nil then
					local made = S.create(world, "Frame", id, nil, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = world.types.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					})
					made.SelectionGroup = true
					S.text(world, made, "Page" .. id, `Page {id} content`)
					made.Parent = content
					pages[id] = made
					page = made
				end
				assert(page).Visible = true
				buttons[id]:AddTag("facet-tab-current")
				marks[id].Visible = true
			end
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local id = tostring(i)
				local button = S.button(world, bar, "Tab" .. i, `Tab {i}`, function()
					select(id)
				end)
				S.tag(button, "facet-tab-item")
				local mark = S.create(world, "Frame", "SelectionIndicator", button, { BorderSizePixel = 0 })
				mark.Visible = false
				S.tag(mark, "facet-selection-indicator")
				buttons[id], marks[id] = button, mark
			end
			local function shift(by: number)
				select(tostring((tonumber(current) :: number - 1 + by) % 5 + 1))
			end
			local bumpers = {
				S.inputs(world, screen, "FacetPreviousTab", 50, {
					{
						name = "PreviousTab",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 },
						pressed = function()
							shift(-1)
						end,
					},
				}),
				S.inputs(world, screen, "FacetNextTab", 50, {
					{
						name = "NextTab",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 },
						pressed = function()
							shift(1)
						end,
					},
				}),
			}
			local gui: S.Node? = world.guiService
			local function sync()
				local selected: S.Node? = if gui then gui.SelectedObject :: S.Node? else nil
				local inside = selected ~= nil and selected:IsDescendantOf(bar)
				for _, context in bumpers do
					context.Enabled = inside
				end
			end
			if gui then
				gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SelectedObject"):Connect(sync)
			end
			sync()
			select("1")
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local id = tostring(index % 5 + 1)
				if lane == "facet" then
					assert(selection):set(id)
				else
					S.fire(world, "Tab" .. id, "Activated")
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				local id = if lane == "facet" then assert(selection):peek() else current
				local marked: { string } = {}
				for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
					if node:HasTag("facet-tab-current") then
						table.insert(marked, tostring(node.Text))
					end
				end
				return `{S.find(world, "Page" .. id).Text}:{labels(world, "Page ")}\ncurrent={table.concat(marked, ",")} indicators={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-selection-indicator"
				)} sinks={S.sinks(world)}`
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "radial-50-cycles",
	iterations = 100,
	what = "Open a four-command radial menu, select Wave and close it, 50 times. Both lanes draw four Path2D ring sectors, a centre close button, a selection preview, a scrim, gamepad and keyboard input contexts and the theme radial fade, and hide the launcher while the menu is open.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI = world.UI
		local open = S.model(world, lane, false)
		local actions = { "Wave", "Dance", "Point", "Cheer" }
		local items: { Facet.RadialItem<string> } = {}
		local selected = ""
		for _, label in actions do
			local item: Facet.RadialAction<string> = {
				id = label,
				label = label,
				onSelect = function()
					selected = label
				end,
			}
			table.insert(items, item)
		end
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local launcher: S.Node? = nil
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			local spec: Facet.RadialMenuSpec<string> =
				{ label = "Emotes", isPresented = assert(open), items = items, preset = "donut" }
			local RadialMenu: typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RadialMenuBuilder) = UI.RadialMenu
			return RadialMenu<<string>>(spec, "Emotes")
		end, function(screen)
			parent = screen
			launcher = S.button(world, screen, "Launcher", "Emotes", function() end)
		end)
		local Enum, D2, V2 = world.types.Enum, world.types.UDim2, world.types.Vector2
		local inner, outer, gap = 72, 152, 2
		local radius = (inner + outer) / 2
		local function arc(angle: number): { unknown }
			local trim = math.deg(math.asin(gap / 2 / radius))
			local from, to = math.rad(angle - 45 + trim), math.rad(angle + 45 - trim)
			local handle = 4 / 3 * math.tan((to - from) / 4) * radius
			local points: { unknown } = {}
			for _, at in { from, to } do
				local x, y = outer + math.sin(at) * radius, outer - math.cos(at) * radius
				local dx, dy = math.cos(at) * handle, math.sin(at) * handle
				table.insert(
					points,
					world.types.Path2DControlPoint.new(
						D2.fromOffset(x, y),
						D2.fromOffset(-dx, -dy),
						D2.fromOffset(dx, dy)
					)
				)
			end
			return points
		end
		local function openRing()
			local closing = false
			local candidate: number? = nil
			local buttons: { S.Node } = {}
			local wedges: { S.Node } = {}
			local contexts: { S.Node } = {}
			local restore = function() end
			local root: S.Node
			local function close()
				if closing then
					return
				end
				closing = true
				root.Interactable = false
				for _, context in contexts do
					context.Enabled = false
				end
				restore()
				assert(launcher).Visible = true
				S.animate(world, root, S.motion.radial.exit, S.motion.present, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, function()
					root:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			root = S.layer(world, "RadialModal", close)
			local ring = S.create(world, "Frame", "RadialPanel", root, {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = D2.fromOffset(2 * outer, 2 * outer),
			})
			ring.AnchorPoint = V2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			ring.Position = D2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			ring.ZIndex = 101
			S.trap(world, ring)
			local plate = S.create(world, "Frame", "SelectionPlate", root, { BorderSizePixel = 0 })
			plate.Visible = false
			S.tag(plate, "facet-tooltip")
			local preview = S.text(world, root, "SelectionPreview", "", nil, "caption")
			preview.Visible = false
			local function highlight(index: number?)
				local previous = candidate
				if previous then
					buttons[previous]:RemoveTag("facet-selected")
					wedges[previous]:RemoveTag("facet-radial-candidate")
				end
				candidate = index
				if index then
					S.tag(buttons[index], "facet-selected")
					S.tag(wedges[index], "facet-radial-candidate")
					preview.Text = actions[index]
				end
				preview.Visible = index ~= nil
				plate.Visible = index ~= nil
			end
			local function choose(index: number)
				if closing then
					return
				end
				selected = actions[index]
				close()
			end
			for index, label in actions do
				local angle = (index - 1) * 90
				local sector = S.create(world, "Frame", "Sector-" .. label, ring, {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = D2.fromScale(1, 1),
				})
				local wedge = S.create(world, "Path2D", "Sector", sector)
				wedge.Thickness = outer - inner
				wedge.Closed = false
				wedge.ZIndex = 102
				S.tag(wedge, "facet-radial-sector")
				local path = (wedge :: unknown) :: S.Path
				path:SetControlPoints(arc(angle))
				local button = S.button(world, sector, label, label, function()
					choose(index)
				end)
				S.tag(button, "facet-radial-item", "facet-radial-label", "facet-appearance-utility")
				button.AnchorPoint = V2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				button.Position = D2.fromOffset(
					outer + math.sin(math.rad(angle)) * radius,
					outer - math.cos(math.rad(angle)) * radius
				)
				button.ZIndex = 105
				button.MouseEnter:Connect(function(...: unknown)
					highlight(index)
				end)
				button.MouseLeave:Connect(function(...: unknown)
					highlight(nil)
				end)
				button.SelectionGained:Connect(function(...: unknown)
					highlight(index)
				end)
				buttons[index], wedges[index] = button, wedge
			end
			local center = S.button(world, root, "Center", "", close)
			S.tag(center, "facet-button-glyph", "facet-appearance-utility")
			center.AnchorPoint = V2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			center.Position = D2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			center.ZIndex = 106
			S.create(world, "UICorner", "UICorner", center)
			local icon = S.create(world, "ImageLabel", "LeadingIcon", center, {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = D2.fromOffset(20, 20),
			})
			S.tag(icon, "facet-icon")
			local function toward(index: number): () -> ()
				return function()
					highlight(index)
				end
			end
			table.insert(
				contexts,
				S.inputs(world, root, "FacetModalBack", 2000, {
					{ name = "ModalBack", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Escape, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB }, pressed = close },
				})
			)
			table.insert(
				contexts,
				S.inputs(world, root, "FacetRadial", 2000, {
					{
						name = "RadialAim",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 },
						aim = function(value: unknown)
							if typeof(value) ~= "Vector2" or value.Magnitude < 0.5 then
								return
							end
							highlight(math.floor((math.deg(math.atan2(value.X, value.Y)) + 45) % 360 / 90) + 1)
						end,
					},
					{
						name = "RadialCommit",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA, Enum.KeyCode.Return },
						pressed = function()
							if candidate then
								choose(candidate)
							end
						end,
					},
					{ name = "Radial-up", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp, Enum.KeyCode.Up }, pressed = toward(1) },
					{
						name = "Radial-right",
						keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight, Enum.KeyCode.Right },
						pressed = toward(2),
					},
					{ name = "Radial-down", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown, Enum.KeyCode.Down }, pressed = toward(3) },
					{ name = "Radial-left", keys = { Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft, Enum.KeyCode.Left }, pressed = toward(4) },
				})
			)
			assert(launcher).Visible = false
			root.Parent = assert(parent)
			restore = S.focus(world, buttons[1])
			S.animate(world, root, S.motion.radial.enter, S.motion.present, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
		end
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				if index % 2 == 1 then
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(open):set(true)
					else
						openRing()
					end
				else
					local target: S.Node? = nil
					for _, node in world.target:GetDescendants() do
						if node:IsA("TextButton") and node.Text == "Wave" then
							target = node
							break
						end
					end
					assert(target, "Wave target missing")
					world.engine.environment.fire(target, "Activated")
					if lane == "facet" then
						assert(open):set(false)
					end
				end
				world.frame(1)
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return `{selected}\nitems={S.tagged(world, "facet-radial-item")} sectors={S.tagged(
					world,
					"facet-radial-sector"
				)} sinks={S.sinks(world)} launcher={S.find(world, "Launcher").Visible} wave={S.tagsOf(world, "Wave")}`
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

table.insert(workloads, {
	id = "navigation-5-20-cycles",
	iterations = 200,
	what = "Push five child pages and pop them, 20 times; root has no Back action and covered pages remain retained.",
	prepare = function(world: Types.World, lane: Types.Lane): Types.Scene
		local UI, Compose = world.UI, world.Compose
		local initial: { Facet.NavigationEntry<number> } = {}
		local path = S.model(world, lane, initial)
		local depth = 0
		local pages: { S.Node } = {}
		local parent: S.Node? = nil
		local function plainPush(level: number)
			if #pages > 0 then
				pages[#pages].Visible = false
			end
			local page = S.stack(world, assert(parent), "Level" .. level)
			local bar = S.stack(world, page, "NavigationBar", true)
			if level > 0 then
				local back = S.button(world, bar, "Back" .. level, "", function() end)
				local row = S.stack(world, back, "Content", true)
				S.create(world, "ImageLabel", "LeadingIcon", row, { Size = world.types.UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20) })
				S.text(world, row, "Title", "Back")
			end
			S.text(world, bar, "Title", `Level {level}`)
			local destination = S.stack(world, page, "Destination")
			S.text(world, destination, "PageText" .. level, `Destination {level}`)
			table.insert(pages, page)
		end
		local destinations: { [string]: Facet.NavigationDestination<number> } = {
			level = {
				title = "Details",
				content = function(entry)
					assert(entry and entry.value)
					return UI.Text("PageText" .. entry.value)({ text = `Destination {entry.value}` })
				end,
			},
		}
		local stop = S.mount(world, lane, function()
			return UI.NavigationStack "Navigation" {
				path = assert(path),
				root = {
					title = "Home",
					content = function()
						return UI.Text "PageText0" { text = "Destination 0" }
					end,
				},
				destinations = destinations,
				transition = false,
			}
		end, function(screen)
			parent = S.stack(world, screen, "Navigation")
			plainPush(0)
		end)
		return {
			step = function(index: number)
				local phase = (index - 1) % 10
				depth += if phase < 5 then 1 else -1
				if lane == "facet" then
					local nextPath = table.clone(assert(path):peek())
					if phase < 5 then
						table.insert(nextPath, { id = "level", value = depth })
					else
						table.remove(nextPath)
					end
					assert(path):set(nextPath)
				elseif phase < 5 then
					plainPush(depth)
				else
					assert(table.remove(pages)):Destroy()
					pages[#pages].Visible = true
				end
				world.frame()
			end,
			snapshot = function()
				return tostring(S.find(world, "PageText" .. depth).Text) .. ":" .. labels(world, "Destination ")
			end,
			stop = stop,
		}
	end,
})

return workloads

local actionLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
actionLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
actionLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
actionLayout.Parent = actions

local sendButton = Ui.button(actions, "Send Once", 34, 1)
sendButton.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 1, 0)
sendButton:SetAttribute("Role", "Secondary")

local clearButton = Ui.button(actions, "Clear Editor", 34, 2)
clearButton.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 1, 0)
clearButton:SetAttribute("Role", "Secondary")

local settingsButton = Ui.button(actions, "Settings", 34, 3)
settingsButton.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 1, 0)
settingsButton:SetAttribute("Role", "Secondary")

local filterHint = Ui.label(root, `Settings opens ServerStorage.{Settings.name}: list instances in include to send only those, and in exclude to skip them.`, 15, false, 10)
filterHint:SetAttribute("Role", "Hint")

Ui.label(root, "Connection", 20, true, 11)
Ui.label(root, "Port", 17, false, 12)

local portBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
portBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
portBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
portBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
portBox.TextSize = 18
portBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
portBox.PlaceholderText = tostring(defaultPort)
portBox.LayoutOrder = 13
portBox:SetAttribute("Role", "Field")
Ui.corner(portBox, 4)
portBox.Parent = root

local portPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
portPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
portPadding.Parent = portBox

local portStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
portStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
portStroke.Parent = portBox

local portHint = Ui.label(root, "The same number as lunaut.studioPlugin.port in your editor. Press Enter to save.", 15, false, 14)
portHint:SetAttribute("Role", "Hint")

local syncing = false
local pending = false
local reachable: boolean? = nil
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local filter: Settings.Filter? = nil
local filterProblem: string? = nil
local settingsWatch: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local function getPort(): number
	return tonumber(plugin:GetSetting(portSetting)) or defaultPort
end

local function repaint()
	Ui.paint(root, Ui.getTheme())
end

local function say(text: string)
	if plugin:GetSetting(silentSetting) ~= true then
		print(`[Lunaut] {text}`)
	end
end

local schedule: () -> ()

local function loadFilter()
	local loaded, problem = Settings.load()
	filter = loaded

	if problem and problem ~= filterProblem and plugin:GetSetting(silentSetting) ~= true then
		warn(`[Lunaut] {problem}. Sending every instance until it is fixed.`)
	end

	filterProblem = problem

	if settingsWatch then
		settingsWatch:Disconnect()
		settingsWatch = nil
	end

	local module = Settings.find()

	if module and syncing then
		settingsWatch = module:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Source"):Connect(function()
			schedule()
		end)
	end
end

local function send(announce: boolean): boolean
	local port = getPort()
	loadFilter()
	local tree, count = Tree.build(game, nil, filter)
	local ok, problem = Sender.post(port, "/full", HttpService:JSONEncode({ tree = tree }))

	if ok then
		local scope = if filter and filter.include then ", filtered" elseif filter and #filter.exclude > 0 then ", with excludes" else ""
		status.Text = `Sent {count} instances{scope} to port {port} at {os.date("%H:%M:%S")}`

		if announce or reachable ~= true then
			say(`sent {count} instances to the editor on port {port}`)
		end
	else
		status.Text = `The editor did not answer on port {port}`

		if announce or reachable ~= false then
			warn(`[Lunaut] the editor did not answer on port {port} ({problem}). Turn on lunaut.studioPlugin.enabled in the editor and check the port.`)
		end
	end

	reachable = ok
	return ok
end

function schedule()
	if not syncing or pending then
		return
	end

	pending = true

	task.delay(0.5, function()
		pending = false

		if syncing then
			send(false)
		end
	end)
end

local function setSyncing(enabled: boolean)
	if syncing == enabled then
		return
	end

	syncing = enabled
	primary.Text = if enabled then "Stop Sync" else "Start Sync"
	primary:SetAttribute("Active", enabled)
	repaint()

	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	table.clear(connections)

	if not enabled then
		if settingsWatch then
			settingsWatch:Disconnect()
			settingsWatch = nil
		end

		status.Text = "Not syncing"
		say("sync stopped")
		return
	end

	local function onChange(instance: Instance)
		if instance.Name == Settings.name or Settings.isWatched(filter, instance) then
			schedule()
		end
	end

	table.insert(connections, game.DescendantAdded:Connect(onChange))
	table.insert(connections, game.DescendantRemoving:Connect(onChange))
	reachable = nil
	send(true)
end

primary.Activated:Connect(function()
	setSyncing(not syncing)
end)

sendButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	send(true)
end)

clearButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	local port = getPort()
	local ok, problem = Sender.post(port, "/clear")

	if ok then
		status.Text = "Cleared the instances in the editor"
		say("cleared the instances in the editor")
	else
		status.Text = `The editor did not answer on port {port}`
		warn(`[Lunaut] the editor did not answer on port {port} ({problem})`)
	end
end)

settingsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if Settings.open(plugin) == nil then
		warn(`[Lunaut] could not open {Settings.service}.{Settings.name}`)
	end
end)

local function bindSetting(checkbox: Ui.Checkbox, key: string)
	checkbox.set(plugin:GetSetting(key) == true)

	checkbox.changed.Event:Connect(function(checked: boolean)
		plugin:SetSetting(key, checked)
		repaint()
	end)
end

bindSetting(autoSync, autoSyncSetting)
bindSetting(silent, silentSetting)
bindSetting(openOnStart, openSetting)

portBox.Text = tostring(getPort())

portBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed: boolean)
	local port = tonumber(portBox.Text)

	if not enterPressed then
		portBox.Text = tostring(getPort())
		return
	end

	if port == nil or port < 1 or port > 65535 or port % 1 ~= 0 then
		warn(`[Lunaut] {portBox.Text} is not a port number`)
		portBox.Text = tostring(getPort())
		return
	end

	plugin:SetSetting(portSetting, port)
	say(`port set to {port}`)

	if syncing then
		reachable = nil
		send(true)
	end
end)

openButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled
end)

widget:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
	openButton:SetActive(widget.Enabled)
end)


plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	if settingsWatch then
		settingsWatch:Disconnect()
	end
end)

repaint()

if plugin:GetSetting(openSetting) == true then
	widget.Enabled = true
end

openButton:SetActive(widget.Enabled)

if plugin:GetSetting(autoSyncSetting) == true then
	setSyncing(true)
end

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Util)

local random = Random.new()

local tool: Util.Tool = {
	name = "Randomize Rotation",
	description = "Spins each selected part or model to a random angle around the world Y axis. Great for trees and rocks.",

	run = function(selection)
		local items = Util.getMovables(selection)
		if #items == 0 then
			error("Select at least one part or model.", 0)
		end

		for _, item in items do
			local pivot = item:GetPivot()
			local spin = CFrame.Angles(0, random:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi), 0)
			item:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pivot.Position) * spin * pivot.Rotation)
		end

		return `Rotated {Util.plural(#items, "object")}.`
	end,
}

return tool

--[[
	Builds the widget: a scrolling list of tool cards and a status bar.
	Colors follow the Studio theme (light or dark).
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local Studio = settings().Studio
local Color = Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor
local Modifier = Enum.StudioStyleGuideModifier

local STATUS_HEIGHT = 36

local Ui = {}

function Ui.mount(widget: DockWidgetPluginGui, tools: { Util.Tool }, onRun: (Util.Tool) -> (boolean, string))
	-- Every themed property is registered here so it can be recolored when the theme changes.
	local themed: { { instance: Instance, property: string, color: Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor } } = {}

	local function theme(instance: Instance, property: string, color: Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor)
		local entry = { instance = instance, property = property, color = color }
		table.insert(themed, entry)
		return entry
	end

	local function applyTheme()
		for _, entry in themed do
			(entry.instance :: any)[entry.property] = Studio.Theme:GetColor(entry.color, Modifier.Default)
		end
	end

	local function pad(parent: Instance, vertical: number, horizontal: number)
		local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, vertical)
		padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, vertical)
		padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, horizontal)
		padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, horizontal)
		padding.Parent = parent
	end

	local function label(text: string, font: Enum.Font, size: number, color: Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor): TextLabel
		local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		textLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
		textLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		textLabel.Font = font
		textLabel.TextSize = size
		textLabel.TextWrapped = true
		textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		textLabel.Text = text
		theme(textLabel, "TextColor3", color)
		return textLabel
	end

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	theme(root, "BackgroundColor3", Color.MainBackground)

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -STATUS_HEIGHT)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	theme(list, "ScrollBarImageColor3", Color.ScrollBar)
	pad(list, 8, 8)
	list.Parent = root

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = list

	local status = label("Select something, then click a tool.", Enum.Font.SourceSans, 14, Color.DimmedText)
	status.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
	status.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, STATUS_HEIGHT)
	status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -STATUS_HEIGHT)
	status.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	status.BorderSizePixel = 0
	theme(status, "BackgroundColor3", Color.Titlebar)
	local statusColor = theme(status, "TextColor3", Color.DimmedText)
	pad(status, 4, 10)
	status.Parent = root

	local function setStatus(ok: boolean, message: string)
		status.Text = message
		statusColor.color = if ok then Color.MainText else Color.ErrorText
		applyTheme()
	end

	for index, tool in tools do
		local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
		card.Name = tool.name
		card.Text = ""
		card.AutoButtonColor = true
		card.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
		card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		card.LayoutOrder = index
		card.BorderSizePixel = 1
		theme(card, "BackgroundColor3", Color.Button)
		theme(card, "BorderColor3", Color.ButtonBorder)
		pad(card, 6, 8)

		local cardLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		cardLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
		cardLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		cardLayout.Parent = card

		local title = label(tool.name, Enum.Font.SourceSansBold, 16, Color.ButtonText)
		title.LayoutOrder = 1
		title.Parent = card

		local description = label(tool.description or "", Enum.Font.SourceSans, 14, Color.DimmedText)
		description.LayoutOrder = 2
		description.Parent = card

		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			setStatus(onRun(tool))
		end)

		card.Parent = list
	end

	if #tools == 0 then
		label("No tools found. Check the Output window for errors.", Enum.Font.SourceSans, 14, Color.ErrorText).Parent =
			list
	end

	applyTheme()
	Studio.ThemeChanged:Connect(applyTheme)
	root.Parent = widget
end

return Ui

--!strict

type RobloxHost = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RobloxHost)
type RobloxTypes = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RobloxTypes)
type ComposeRuntime = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeRuntime)
local Facet = require("../src")
local engineLib = require("../tests/lib/native_engine")

export type State = {
	Facet: Facet.Facet,
	Compose: Facet.ComposeModule,
	runtime: Facet.Runtime,
	Host: RobloxHost,
	UI: Facet.Controls,
	engine: engineLib.Engine,
	target: any,
	types: RobloxTypes,
	viewport: { w: number, h: number },
	frame: (number?) -> (),
	dispose: () -> (),
	[string]: any,
}
return function(options: any?): State
	local opts = options or {}
	local measured = opts.textService == true
	local engine = engineLib.new(if measured
		then {
			textFits = function()
				return true
			end,
		}
		else nil)
	local elapsed = 0
	engine.clock = function()
		return elapsed
	end
	local runtime: ComposeRuntime = Facet.Roblox.createRuntime(engine)
	local target = engine.new("Folder")
	local textService: TextService? = nil
	if measured then
		textService = engine.new("TextService")
		engine.environment.fake(
			"TextService.GetTextBoundsAsync",
			function(_service: unknown, params: GetTextBoundsParams): Vector2
				return engine.types.Vector2.new(#params.Text * params.Size * 0.5, params.Size)
			end
		)
	end
	local root = Facet.Compose.createRootOwner(function()
		runtime.adopt(target)
	end, runtime.reactor)
	return {
		Facet = Facet,
		Compose = Facet.Compose,
		runtime = runtime,
		Host = (runtime.constructors :: unknown) :: RobloxHost,
		UI = Facet.controls(runtime, {
			types = engine.types,
			services = if textService then { TextService = textService } else nil,
		}),
		textService = textService,
		engine = engine,
		target = target,
		types = engine.types,
		viewport = opts.viewport or { w = 800, h = 600 },
		frame = function(dt: number?)
			elapsed += dt or 1 / 60
			engine.heartbeat:Fire(dt or 1 / 60)
		end,
		dispose = function()
			root.dispose()
			runtime:dispose()
			assert(#target:GetChildren() == 0, "benchmark leaked mounted nodes")
		end,
	}
end

--[[
	Shared helpers for tools. Use these instead of writing your own loops,
	so every tool treats the selection the same way.
]]

export type Tool = {
	-- Shown on the button. Keep it short, e.g. "Anchor All".
	name: string,
	-- One sentence shown under the name.
	description: string,
	-- Does the work. Return a short message for the status bar.
	-- Call error("message", 0) to show a problem; your changes are then undone.
	run: (selection: { Instance }) -> string?,
}

local Util = {}

-- Every BasePart in the selection, including parts inside selected models and folders.
-- Each part appears only once.
function Util.getParts(selection: { Instance }): { BasePart }
	local seen: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
	local parts: { BasePart } = {}

	local function add(instance: Instance)
		if instance:IsA("BasePart") and not seen[instance] then
			seen[instance] = true
			table.insert(parts, instance)
		end
	end

	for _, item in selection do
		add(item)
		for _, descendant in item:GetDescendants() do
			add(descendant)
		end
	end

	return parts
end

-- Selected parts and models that can be moved or rotated as a whole (with GetPivot / PivotTo).
function Util.getMovables(selection: { Instance }): { PVInstance }
	local movables: { PVInstance } = {}

	for _, item in selection do
		if item ~= workspace and (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Model")) then
			table.insert(movables, item)
		end
	end

	return movables
end

-- Util.plural(1, "part") -> "1 part", Util.plural(3, "part") -> "3 parts"
function Util.plural(count: number, word: string): string
	return `{count} {word}{if count == 1 then "" else "s"}`
end

return Util

export type scheduler = {
	cancel: (self: scheduler) -> (),
}

type net_event = {
	name: string,
}

type status = "safe" | "unsafe"

export type logger = (level: string, ...any) -> (...any)

export type service = {
	whose: (self: service) -> scheduler?,
	get_event: (self: service, name: string) -> net_event,
	get_status: (self: service) -> status?,
	get_entries: (self: service) -> { net_event },
	get_logger: (self: service) -> logger,
	as: <T>(self: service, value: any) -> T,
}

local events: { [string]: net_event } = {
	data = { name = "data" },
}

local service: service = {
	whose = function(self: service): scheduler?
		return nil
	end,
	get_event = function(self: service, name: string): net_event
		return events[name]
	end,
	get_status = function(self: service): status?
		return nil
	end,
	get_entries = function(self: service): { net_event }
		return {}
	end,
	get_logger = function(self: service): logger
		return nil :: any
	end,
	as = function<T>(self: service, value: any): T
		return value
	end,
}

local existing = events["data"]

return service

--[[
	Studio Toolkit - entry point.

	Loads every tool in the Tools folder, shows them in a dock widget and runs
	the clicked tool on the current selection with undo support.

	You don't need to touch this file to add a tool. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

local Ui = require(script.Ui)
local Util = require(script.Util)

local PREFIX = "[Studio Toolkit]"

local function loadTools(): { Util.Tool }
	local tools = {}

	for _, module in script.Tools:GetChildren() do
		if not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			continue
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
		if not ok then
			warn(`{PREFIX} Failed to load tool "{module.Name}": {result}`)
			continue
		end

		if type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.name) ~= "string" or type(result.run) ~= "function" then
			warn(`{PREFIX} Tool "{module.Name}" must return a table with name, description and run.`)
			continue
		end

		table.insert(tools, result)
	end

	table.sort(tools, function(a, b)
		return a.name < b.name
	end)

	return tools
end

-- Runs a tool as a single undo step. If the tool errors, its changes are reverted.
local function runTool(tool: Util.Tool): (boolean, string)
	local recording = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording(tool.name)
	local ok, result = pcall(tool.run, Selection:Get())

	if recording then
		ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(
			recording,
			if ok then Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit else Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel
		)
	end

	if ok then
		return true, if type(result) == "string" then result else `{tool.name}: done.`
	end
	return false, tostring(result)
end

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar("Studio Toolkit")
local button = toolbar:CreateButton("Toolkit", "Open Studio Toolkit", "")
button.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui(
	"StudioToolkit",
	DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(Enum.InitialDockState.Right, false, false, 280, 420, 220, 200)
)
widget.Name = "StudioToolkit"
widget.Title = "Studio Toolkit"

button.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled
end)

widget:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
	button:SetActive(widget.Enabled)
end)

-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

--!strict

local json = require("@std/json")
local process = require("@std/process")
local Lute = require("@verify/src/lute")
local Json = require("../tools/facet/lib/json")
local Retained = require("../tools/facet/lib/perf_retained")
local perf_runner = require("./perf_runner")
local perf_scenes = require("./perf_scenes")
local perf_profiles = require("./perf_profiles")
local nativeApp = require("./native_app")

type Scene = {
	name: string,
	samples: number,
	warmup: number,
	timing: () -> unknown,
	setup: (profile: perf_profiles.Profile) -> nativeApp.State,
	run: (state: perf_scenes.SceneState) -> unknown,
	afterRun: (state: perf_scenes.SceneState) -> (),
	teardown: (state: perf_scenes.SceneState) -> (),
}
type MemoryState = { world: nativeApp.State, fixture: perf_scenes.SceneState }

local function emit(fields: { [string]: json.Value })
	print("@@" .. json.serialize(fields))
end

local name = assert(process.args[2], "a paired scene name is required")
local memoryOnly = process.args[3] == "--memory-only"
local plantedBytes = tonumber(process.args[4] or "0")
local plantedOnlyWhileMounted = process.args[5] == "released"
assert(plantedBytes ~= nil and plantedBytes >= 0 and plantedBytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024 and plantedBytes % 1 == 0)
assert(memoryOnly or plantedBytes == 0, "retained allocation controls require the memory-only diagnostic")

local function findScene(sceneName: string, profile: perf_profiles.Profile): Scene?
	for _, candidate in perf_scenes do
		if candidate.name == sceneName then
			local source: unknown = candidate
			local samples, warmup = candidate.samples, candidate.warmup
			assert(
				type(samples) == "number" and type(warmup) == "number",
				"a paired scene needs declared sampling counts"
			)
			return {
				name = candidate.name,
				samples = samples,
				warmup = warmup,
				timing = function(): unknown
					return perf_runner.runScene(source, profile)
				end,
				setup = candidate.setup,
				run = candidate.run,
				afterRun = candidate.afterRun,
				teardown = candidate.teardown,
			}
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local profile = perf_profiles.get(perf_profiles.REFERENCE)
local scene = findScene(name, profile)
if scene == nil then
	emit({ scene = name, status = "missing" })
	process.exit(0)
end
assert(scene ~= nil)
local chosen: Scene = scene
local fields: { [string]: json.Value } = { scene = name, status = "ok", profile = profile.name }

local ok, problem = pcall(function()
	local record = chosen.timing()
	local total = Json.field(Json.field(record, "phases"), "total")
	fields.p50 = assert(Json.numberField(total, "p50_ms"))
	fields.p95 = assert(Json.numberField(total, "p95_ms"))
	fields.p99 = assert(Json.numberField(total, "p99_ms"))
	fields.samples = assert(Json.numberField(total, "samples"))
	local planted: { buffer } = {}
	local memory = Lute.memory.measure({
		setup = function()
			local state = chosen.setup(profile)
			if plantedBytes > 0 then
				table.insert(planted, buffer.create(plantedBytes))
			end
			local fixture: perf_scenes.SceneState =
				{ workload = state.workload, target = state.target, dispose = state.dispose }
			return { world = state, fixture = fixture }
		end,
		run = function(state: MemoryState)
			chosen.run(state.fixture)
		end,
		afterRun = function(state: MemoryState)
			chosen.afterRun(state.fixture)
		end,
		teardown = function(state: MemoryState)
			chosen.teardown(state.fixture)
			if plantedOnlyWhileMounted then
				table.clear(planted)
			end
		end,
		warmup = chosen.warmup,
		iterations = chosen.samples,
		rehearsals = 2,
	}, { cycles = Retained.CYCLES })
	for _, allocation in planted do
		assert(buffer.len(allocation) == plantedBytes)
	end
	fields.memory = {
		method = memory.method,
		cycles = memory.baseline.cycles,
		baselineHeapKb = memory.baseline.heapKb,
		mountedHeapKb = memory.mounted.heapKb,
		teardownHeapKb = memory.teardown.heapKb,
		mountedKb = memory.mountedKb,
		releasedKb = memory.releasedKb,
		teardownRetainedKb = memory.teardownRetainedKb,
		baselineAllocations = memory.baseline.allocations,
		mountedAllocations = memory.mounted.allocations,
		teardownAllocations = memory.teardown.allocations,
	}
	return true
end)
if not ok then
	emit({ scene = name, status = "failed", error = string.sub(tostring(problem), 1, 1000) })
	process.exit(0)
end
emit(fields)
process.exit(0)

--!strict
-- Shared types for the stage 1 feel prototype (client only).

export type SoundKind = "land" | "step" | "slide" | "break"
export type MaterialName = string -- a key of SoundBank.Materials

-- Sound bank data (Config/SoundBank)
export type SoundVariant = { Asset: string, File: string } -- Asset "" = not uploaded yet
export type Range = { Min: number, Max: number }
export type SoundKindEntry = {
	Variants: { SoundVariant },
	Volume: Range, -- 0..1 before master volume
	VolumeCurve: number, -- volume = Min + (Max - Min) * intensity ^ VolumeCurve
	Pitch: Range, -- PlaybackSpeed random range
	PitchHeavy: number, -- added to PlaybackSpeed at intensity 1
	Cooldown: number, -- seconds between two plays of this material + kind
}
export type SoundMaterialEntry = {
	MoveKind: "step" | "slide", -- what walking on it sounds like
	Kinds: { [string]: SoundKindEntry }, -- keys are SoundKind
}
export type SoundBankData = {
	Materials: { [MaterialName]: SoundMaterialEntry },
	DefaultMaterial: MaterialName,
	FallbackByEnum: { [string]: MaterialName }, -- Enum.Material.Name -> MaterialName
	Placeholders: { [string]: string }, -- SoundKind -> temporary sound path, "" = none
}

-- Ground and events
export type SurfaceHit = {
	part: BasePart,
	position: Vector3,
	normal: Vector3,
	distance: number, -- from the ray origin
	material: MaterialName,
}
export type LandingInfo = {
	position: Vector3,
	impactSpeed: number, -- studs/s, positive, vertical speed just before contact
	intensity: number, -- 0..1
	material: MaterialName,
	part: BasePart?, -- nil only when source == "state" and the ray found nothing
	normal: Vector3,
	airTime: number, -- seconds since leaving the ground
	source: "ray" | "state",
	time: number, -- os.clock()
}
export type StepInfo = {
	kind: "step" | "slide",
	position: Vector3,
	speed: number, -- horizontal studs/s
	intensity: number, -- 0..1
	material: MaterialName,
	part: BasePart?,
	time: number,
}
export type BreakInfo = {
	part: BasePart, -- the collider part that broke
	position: Vector3,
	material: MaterialName,
	intensity: number,
	time: number,
}
export type PressKind = "land" | "step"

-- Sound pool
export type PlayOptions = { volume: number, speed: number }
export type PoolStats = {
	players: number, -- warm AudioPlayers created
	ready: number,
	notReady: number,
	activeVoices: number,
	stolen: number, -- voices stopped to stay within budget
	skippedEmpty: number,
	skippedNotReady: number,
	skippedUnknown: number,
}

-- Landing detector (for experiment E4)
export type LandingStats = {
	landings: number,
	byRay: number,
	byState: number, -- ray missed, state fallback fired
	stateMissed: number, -- ray fired but Humanoid Landed state never came
	lateFramesMax: number, -- fired after the contact frame (0 = on time)
	lateFramesAvg: number,
	earlyFramesMax: number, -- fired before the contact frame
}

return {}

--!strict

local device_profiles = require("./profiles_data")

export type Profile = {
	name: string,
	title: string,
	viewport: { w: number, h: number },
	insets: { top: number, bottom: number, left: number, right: number },
	preferredInput: string,
	capabilities: { keyboard: boolean, mouse: boolean, touch: boolean, gamepad: boolean },
	displaySize: string,
	overscanInsets: { top: number, bottom: number, left: number, right: number },

	frameTargetHz: number,
	reference: boolean,
}

local perf_profiles = {}

local NO_OVERSCAN = { top = 0, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 }

local FLOOR: Profile = {
	name = "floorAndroid",
	title = "Floor low-end Android (360×640, touch)",
	viewport = { w = 360, h = 640 },
	insets = { top = 24, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 },
	preferredInput = "Touch",
	capabilities = { keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = true, gamepad = false },
	displaySize = "Small",
	overscanInsets = NO_OVERSCAN,
	frameTargetHz = 30,
	reference = true,
}

perf_profiles.REFERENCE = FLOOR.name

local function fromDevice(deviceName: string, preferredInput: string, caps, frameTargetHz: number): Profile
	local base = device_profiles.get(deviceName)
	assert(base ~= nil, `perf_profiles: unknown device_profiles class '{deviceName}'`)
	local facts = (base :: any).facts
	assert(type(facts) == "table", `perf_profiles: device profile '{deviceName}' declares no facts`)
	assert(type(facts.displaySize) == "string", `perf_profiles: device profile '{deviceName}' declares no displaySize`)
	return {
		name = base.name,
		title = base.title,
		viewport = table.clone(base.viewport),
		insets = table.clone(base.insets),
		preferredInput = preferredInput,
		capabilities = caps,
		displaySize = facts.displaySize,
		overscanInsets = table.clone(facts.overscanInsets or NO_OVERSCAN),
		frameTargetHz = frameTargetHz,
		reference = false,
	}
end

local PROFILES: { [string]: Profile } = {
	floorAndroid = FLOOR,
	phone = fromDevice("phone", "Touch", { keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = true, gamepad = false }, 60),
	tablet = fromDevice("tablet", "Touch", { keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = true, gamepad = false }, 60),
	desktop = fromDevice(
		"desktop",
		"KeyboardAndMouse",
		{ keyboard = true, mouse = true, touch = false, gamepad = false },
		60
	),

	consoleTenFoot = fromDevice(
		"console",
		"Gamepad",
		{ keyboard = false, mouse = false, touch = false, gamepad = true },
		60
	),
}

PROFILES.consoleTenFoot.name = "consoleTenFoot"

local ORDER = { "floorAndroid", "phone", "tablet", "desktop", "consoleTenFoot" }

function perf_profiles.list(): { string }
	return table.clone(ORDER)
end

function perf_profiles.get(name: string): Profile
	local p = PROFILES[name]
	assert(p ~= nil, `perf_profiles: unknown profile '{name}' (have: {table.concat(ORDER, ", ")})`)
	return p
end

return perf_profiles

--!strict

local SUFFIXES = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }

local function trimZeros(text: string): string
	if string.find(text, ".", 1, true) then
		text = (string.gsub(text, "0+$", ""))
		text = (string.gsub(text, "%.$", ""))
	end
	return text
end

local Format = {}

-- 950 -> "950", 1234 -> "1.23K", 45600 -> "45.6K", 1250000 -> "1.25M"
function Format.Short(value: number): string
	local n = math.floor(value)
	if n < 1000 then
		return tostring(n)
	end
	local v = n
	local i = 1
	while v >= 1000 and i < #SUFFIXES do
		v /= 1000
		i += 1
	end
	local text
	if v >= 100 then
		text = tostring(math.floor(v))
	elseif v >= 10 then
		text = trimZeros(string.format("%.1f", math.floor(v * 10) / 10))
	else
		text = trimZeros(string.format("%.2f", math.floor(v * 100) / 100))
	end
	return text .. SUFFIXES[i]
end

function Format.Multiplier(value: number): string
	return "x" .. trimZeros(string.format("%.2f", value))
end

return Format
