--!strict
local Compose = require("../src").Compose

local system = require("@std/system")
local Verify = require("@verify/src/core")

local perf_runner = {}

local ENGINE = "lute 1.0.1 (Luau)"
local QUALITY = "headless (no engine render; property writes only)"
local HEADLESS_NOTE = "Headless Lute timing is trend screening only — NOT an authoritative device result (§14.3). "
	.. "deviceMeasurement is the empty slot a real on-device capture fills."

type DeviceRow = {
	evidenceClass: string,
	scene: string,
	metrics: { frameWorkMs: { measured: boolean?, p95_ms: number? }? }?,
}

type EvidenceClass = {
	id: string,
	level: string,
	instrument: string,
	proves: string,
	cannotProve: string,
	rows: number?,
}

local EVIDENCE_CLASSES: { EvidenceClass } = {
	{
		id = "lute",
		level = "E1",
		instrument = "headless Lute on the development host",
		proves = "deterministic regressions in Facet's own decision/commit cost",
		cannotProve = "engine frame work, GPU/paint cost, or any device performance claim",
	},
	{
		id = "studio-emulated",
		level = "E3",
		instrument = "Roblox Studio Play session with a simulated device profile",
		proves = "the integrated adapter's real Instance/connection cost and frame work ON THE HOST",
		cannotProve = "low-end CPU/GPU, memory pressure, thermal or battery behavior",
	},
	{
		id = "desktop-retail",
		level = "E4",
		instrument = "retail Roblox client on the development desktop",
		proves = "non-Studio client behavior and desktop frame work",
		cannotProve = "mobile or console hardware behavior",
	},
	{
		id = "phone-physical",
		level = "E4",
		instrument = "the weakest supported physical Android device",
		proves = "the supported device floor",
		cannotProve = "console/ten-foot behavior or subjective feel",
	},
	{
		id = "console-physical",
		level = "E4",
		instrument = "the supported physical console / ten-foot path",
		proves = "gamepad delivery, overscan and console frame work",
		cannotProve = "mobile device behavior or subjective feel",
	},
}

perf_runner.EVIDENCE_CLASSES = EVIDENCE_CLASSES

local noNumber: number? = nil

local DEVICE_CLASSES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	["desktop-retail"] = true,
	["phone-physical"] = true,
	["console-physical"] = true,
}
perf_runner.DEVICE_CLASSES = DEVICE_CLASSES

perf_runner.CLASS = "lute"
perf_runner.LEVEL = "E1"

local PHYSICAL_REQUIRED_METRICS = {
	{ "updateMs", "M2_updateMs" },
	{ "instances", "M3_instances" },
	{ "connections", "M4_connections" },
	{ "memoryKb", "M5_memory", "memory" },
	{ "inputToVisibleMs", "M6_inputToCommittedWrite" },
}

function perf_runner.provenanceProblems(row: any): { string }
	local problems = {}
	if type(row) ~= "table" then
		return { "row is not a table" }
	end
	if DEVICE_CLASSES[row.evidenceClass] ~= true then
		return problems
	end
	if row.evidenceLevel ~= "E4" then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`evidenceLevel is {tostring(row.evidenceLevel)}; every physical class is published as E4 and E3 is the Studio level`
		)
	end

	local provenance = if type(row.provenance) == "table" then row.provenance else nil
	if provenance == nil then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			"carries no `provenance` block; a physical row has to say affirmatively what measured it"
		)
	else
		if provenance.isStudio ~= false then
			table.insert(problems, "provenance.isStudio must be the boolean false, stated, not absent")
		end
		if provenance.clientKind ~= "retail" then
			table.insert(problems, `provenance.clientKind is {tostring(provenance.clientKind)}; expected "retail"`)
		end
		for _, field in { "instrument", "deviceModel", "capturedAt", "attestedBy" } do
			local value = provenance[field]
			if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
				table.insert(problems, `provenance.{field} is missing or empty`)
			end
		end
	end
	local identity = if type(row.identity) == "table" then row.identity else {}
	if identity.studioVersion ~= nil then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`carries identity.studioVersion '{tostring(identity.studioVersion)}'; a retail client on real hardware has none`
		)
	end
	local device = if type(row.device) == "table" then row.device else {}
	local live = if type(device.live) == "table" then device.live else {}
	if live.deviceId ~= nil then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`carries device.live.deviceId '{tostring(live.deviceId)}'; that is a Studio device-simulator preset id`
		)
	end
	if type(live.source) == "string" and string.find(live.source, "StudioDeviceSimulator", 1, true) ~= nil then
		table.insert(problems, `device.live.source names the Studio device simulator: '{live.source}'`)
	end

	if type(live.scalingMode) == "string" and string.find(live.scalingMode, "DeviceSimulator", 1, true) ~= nil then
		table.insert(problems, `device.live.scalingMode is a Studio simulator value: '{live.scalingMode}'`)
	end

	if
		provenance ~= nil
		and type(provenance.deviceModel) == "string"
		and provenance.deviceModel ~= ""
		and type(device.name) == "string"
		and device.name ~= ""
		and provenance.deviceModel ~= device.name
	then
		table.insert(
			problems,
			`provenance.deviceModel '{provenance.deviceModel}' disagrees with device.name '{device.name}'`
		)
	end
	local metrics = if type(row.metrics) == "table" then row.metrics else {}
	local frameWork = metrics.frameWorkMs or metrics.M1_frameWorkMs
	if type(frameWork) ~= "table" or frameWork.measured ~= true then
		table.insert(problems, "carries no MEASURED frame-work metric (M1)")
	else
		local p95 = frameWork.p95_ms
		if type(p95) ~= "number" or p95 ~= p95 or p95 < 0 then
			table.insert(problems, `M1 p95_ms is {tostring(p95)}; a device row needs a finite, non-negative number`)
		end
	end
	for _, names in PHYSICAL_REQUIRED_METRICS do
		local found = false
		for _, name in names do
			if metrics[name] ~= nil then
				found = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not found then
			table.insert(problems, `metric {names[1]} is absent; an absent metric reads as a free one`)
		end
	end
	return problems
end

local DEFAULT_WARMUP = 60
local DEFAULT_SAMPLES = 240

local function blind(reason: string): any
	return { measured = false, reason = reason }
end
perf_runner.blind = blind

local function nowIso(): string
	return os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") :: string
end

local function hostOs(): string
	return `{system.os}/{system.arch}`
end

local function slope(ys: { number }): number
	local n = #ys
	if n < 2 then
		return 0
	end
	local sx, sy, sxx, sxy = 0, 0, 0, 0
	for i = 1, n do
		local x = i
		sx += x
		sy += ys[i]
		sxx += x * x
		sxy += x * ys[i]
	end
	local denom = n * sxx - sx * sx
	if denom == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return (n * sxy - sx * sy) / denom
end

type AsyncStats = { dropped: number, stale: number, completed: number }
function perf_runner.runScene(scene: any, profile: any, opts: any?): any
	local warmup = (opts and opts.warmup) or scene.warmup or DEFAULT_WARMUP
	local samples: number = (opts and opts.samples) or scene.samples or DEFAULT_SAMPLES
	local afterRun: ((unknown) -> ())? = scene.afterRun
	local asyncStats: ((unknown) -> AsyncStats)? = scene.asyncStats
	local extrasOf: ((unknown) -> unknown)? = scene.extras
	local teardown: ((unknown) -> ())? = scene.teardown
	local auditing = opts ~= nil and opts.memory == true
	if auditing then
		Compose.inspect.start({ maxOwners = math.huge, maxNodes = math.huge })
	end

	local state = scene.setup(profile)

	for _ = 1, warmup do
		scene.run(state)
		if afterRun then
			afterRun(state)
		end
	end

	local phaseSamples: { [string]: { number } } = { total = table.create(samples, noNumber) }
	local heapSeries: { number } = table.create(samples, noNumber)
	local resourceSeries = {}
	local function resources(): { instances: number, connections: number, registrations: number }
		local native = state.engine.census()
		local snapshot = Compose.inspect.snapshot()
		assert(snapshot.active and snapshot.droppedOwners == 0 and snapshot.droppedNodes == 0)
		local registrations = 0
		for _, roots in { snapshot.mounts, snapshot.detached } do
			for _, owner in roots do
				registrations += owner.totalHolding
			end
		end
		return { instances = native.live, connections = native.connections, registrations = registrations }
	end
	local resourceStart = if auditing then resources() else nil

	local heapFloorKb = gcinfo()

	local wallStart = os.clock()
	for i = 1, samples do
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local phases = scene.run(state)
		local total = os.clock() - t0
		phaseSamples.total[i] = total * 1000
		if phases ~= nil then
			for name, seconds in phases do
				local bucket = phaseSamples[name]
				if bucket == nil then
					bucket = table.create(samples, noNumber)
					phaseSamples[name] = bucket
				end
				table.insert(bucket, seconds * 1000)
			end
		end
		if afterRun then
			local settleStart = os.clock()
			afterRun(state)
			local bucket = phaseSamples.settle or {}
			phaseSamples.settle = bucket
			table.insert(bucket, (os.clock() - settleStart) * 1000)
		end
		heapSeries[i] = gcinfo()
		if auditing then
			table.insert(resourceSeries, resources())
		end
	end
	local wallSeconds = os.clock() - wallStart
	local allocGrowthKb = gcinfo() - heapFloorKb

	local registrations: any = blind("the scene exposes no Compose application owner")
	local owner = if type(state.core) == "table" then state.core.owner else nil
	if type(owner) == "table" then
		registrations = Compose.owner.size(owner)
	end
	local instances: any = blind("scene exposes no native engine boundary")
	local adapterHandlers: any = blind("native engine connection allocation requires engine capture")
	local liveConnections: any = registrations
	if state.engine and state.target then
		instances = #state.target:GetDescendants()
		local environment = state.engine.environment
		local connections = environment.connectionsOf(state.engine.heartbeat)
			+ environment.connectionsOfInstance(state.target)
		for _, node in state.target:GetDescendants() do
			connections += environment.connectionsOfInstance(node)
		end
		liveConnections = connections
	end

	local async: AsyncStats = { dropped = 0, stale = 0, completed = 0 }
	if asyncStats ~= nil then
		async = asyncStats(state)
	end

	local extras: any = nil
	if extrasOf ~= nil then
		extras = extrasOf(state)
	end

	if teardown ~= nil then
		teardown(state)
	end
	local resourceEnd = if auditing then resources() else nil
	if auditing then
		Compose.inspect.stop()
	end

	local phases: { [string]: any } = {}
	for name, bucket in phaseSamples do
		local summary = Verify.performance.summarize({
			samples = bucket,
			unit = "ms",
			context = { environment = "facet-lute", signal = name, timing = "observed" },
		})
		phases[name] = {
			p50_ms = summary.p50 or 0,
			p95_ms = summary.p95 or 0,
			p99_ms = summary.p99 or 0,
			samples = #bucket,
		}
	end

	local inputToVisible: any
	if phases.inputToVisible ~= nil then
		inputToVisible = {
			measured = true,
			p50_ms = phases.inputToVisible.p50_ms,
			p95_ms = phases.inputToVisible.p95_ms,
			p99_ms = phases.inputToVisible.p99_ms,
			note = "action dispatch -> committed visible property write, one synchronous chain; "
				.. "no frame, no scan-out — an upper bound on Facet's share only",
		}
	else
		inputToVisible = blind("scene drives no input")
	end

	return {
		scene = scene.name,
		requirement = scene.requirement,
		dataset = scene.dataset,

		evidenceClass = perf_runner.CLASS,
		evidenceLevel = perf_runner.LEVEL,

		device = profile.name,
		deviceTitle = profile.title,
		viewport = table.clone(profile.viewport),
		preferredInput = profile.preferredInput,
		displaySize = profile.displaySize,
		frameTargetHz = profile.frameTargetHz,
		quality = QUALITY,

		engine = ENGINE,
		host = hostOs(),
		timestamp = nowIso(),

		warmup = warmup,
		samples = samples,
		samplingMs = wallSeconds * 1000,

		phases = phases,

		metrics = {
			frameWorkMs = blind("headless Lute renders no frame; M1 requires an engine session"),
			updateMs = {
				measured = true,
				instrumented = auditing,
				p50_ms = phases.total.p50_ms,
				p95_ms = phases.total.p95_ms,
				p99_ms = phases.total.p99_ms,
			},
			instances = instances,
			connections = {
				measured = false,
				reason = "Compose owns reactive registrations; native Engine connections require engine capture.",
				adapterHandlers = adapterHandlers,
				reactiveRegistrations = registrations,
				note = "Compose owns reactive registrations; engine connections require native capture.",
			},
			memoryKb = {
				measured = true,
				heapFloorKb = heapFloorKb,
				allocRateKbPerSec = if wallSeconds > 0 then allocGrowthKb / wallSeconds else 0,
				heapSlopeKbPerIter = slope(heapSeries),
			},
			inputToVisibleMs = inputToVisible,
			themeSwap = if extras ~= nil and extras.themeSwap ~= nil
				then extras.themeSwap
				else blind("scene swaps no theme"),
		},

		allocRateKbPerSec = if wallSeconds > 0 then allocGrowthKb / wallSeconds else 0,
		heapSlopeKbPerIter = slope(heapSeries),
		liveRegistry = { registrations = registrations },
		liveConnections = liveConnections,
		resources = if auditing
			then {
				method = "instrumented pass with the scene warmup, sample count, workload and afterRun unchanged",
				start = resourceStart,
				iterations = resourceSeries,
				teardown = resourceEnd,
				churn = scene.memoryChurn == true,
			}
			else nil,
		async = async,
		extras = extras,

		deviceRun = false,
		authoritative = false,
		deviceMeasurement = {
			measured = false,
			note = "on-device capture goes here (phase/percentile numbers + build)",
			phases = nil,
		},
		note = HEADLESS_NOTE,
	}
end

function perf_runner.run(scenes: { any }, profiles: { any }, opts: any?): any
	local auditOnly = opts and opts.timing == false
	assert(not auditOnly or opts.memory == true, "an audit-only run requires resource measurements")
	local runs = {}
	for _, scene in scenes do
		for _, profile in profiles do
			local settings = if opts then table.clone(opts) else nil
			if settings and not auditOnly then
				settings.memory = nil
			end
			local row = perf_runner.runScene(scene, profile, settings)
			if opts and opts.memory and not auditOnly then
				local settings = table.clone(opts)
				settings.memory = true
				row.resources = perf_runner.runScene(scene, profile, settings).resources
			end
			table.insert(runs, row)
		end
	end

	local present: { [string]: number } = {}
	for _, r in runs do
		present[r.evidenceClass] = (present[r.evidenceClass] or 0) + 1
	end
	local classes = {}
	for _, c in perf_runner.EVIDENCE_CLASSES do
		local entry = table.clone(c)
		entry.rows = present[c.id] or 0
		table.insert(classes, entry)
	end
	return {
		schema = "facet-perf/2",
		environment = {
			engine = ENGINE,
			host = hostOs(),
			quality = QUALITY,
			timestamp = nowIso(),
			evidenceClass = perf_runner.CLASS,
			evidenceLevel = perf_runner.LEVEL,
			deviceRun = false,
			authoritative = false,
			note = HEADLESS_NOTE,
		},

		evidenceClasses = classes,
		referenceProfile = nil,
		runs = runs,
	}
end

function perf_runner.ceilingMsFor(frameTargetHz: number, uiShare: number): number
	assert(frameTargetHz > 0, "frameTargetHz must be positive")
	return (1000 / frameTargetHz) * uiShare
end

function perf_runner.checkBudgets(report: any, budgets: any, referenceTiming: boolean?): any
	local ref = budgets.referenceProfile
	local violations: {
		{
			kind: "foreign-reference-row"
				| "trend"
				| "frame-ceiling"
				| "class-mismatch"
				| "unmeasured-device-row"
				| "device",
			scene: string,
			device: string,
			requirement: string,
			observedMs: number,
			budgetMs: number,
			hint: string,
		}
	} =
		{}
	local skipped = {}

	local byScene: { [string]: any } = {}
	local displaced: { any } = {}
	for _, r in report.runs do
		if referenceTiming == false then
			continue
		end
		if r.device == ref then
			if DEVICE_CLASSES[r.evidenceClass] == true then
				table.insert(displaced, { scene = r.scene, evidenceClass = r.evidenceClass })
			else
				assert(
					not (r.metrics and r.metrics.updateMs and r.metrics.updateMs.instrumented == true),
					"historical timing budgets require uninstrumented scene rows"
				)
				byScene[r.scene] = r
			end
		end
	end

	for _, d in displaced do
		table.insert(violations, {
			kind = "foreign-reference-row" :: "foreign-reference-row",
			scene = d.scene,
			device = ref,
			requirement = "UI-PERF-002",
			observedMs = -1,
			budgetMs = 0,
			hint = `a row of class '{tostring(d.evidenceClass)}' names the reference device '{ref}' for scene `
				.. `'{tostring(d.scene)}'. Only headless rows are the trend reference; a device row cannot stand in `
				.. `for the run it would displace.`,
		})
	end
	for scene, budget in budgets.scenes do
		if referenceTiming == false then
			continue
		end
		local run = byScene[scene]
		if run == nil then
			table.insert(violations, {
				kind = "trend" :: "trend",
				scene = scene,
				device = ref,
				requirement = budget.requirement,
				observedMs = -1,
				budgetMs = budget.total_p95_ms,
				hint = `no reference-device run recorded for scene '{scene}' — is it registered in bench/perf_scenes.luau?`,
			})
		else
			local observed = run.phases.total.p95_ms
			if observed > budget.total_p95_ms then
				table.insert(violations, {
					kind = "trend" :: "trend",
					scene = scene,
					device = ref,
					requirement = budget.requirement,
					observedMs = observed,
					budgetMs = budget.total_p95_ms,
					hint = budget.hint,
				})
			end

			if budget.ceilingMs ~= nil and observed > budget.ceilingMs then
				table.insert(violations, {
					kind = "frame-ceiling" :: "frame-ceiling",
					scene = scene,
					device = ref,
					requirement = budget.requirement,
					observedMs = observed,
					budgetMs = budget.ceilingMs,
					hint = `scene '{scene}' costs more than {budget.ceilingMs}ms — the share of a `
						.. `{budget.frameTargetHz}Hz frame Facet may occupy — on a host FASTER than every `
						.. `supported device, so it cannot hold the frame target anywhere. Fix the scene's `
						.. `hot path; re-baselining does not make this one go away.`,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	for className, budget in (budgets.deviceBudgets or {}) do
		local rows: { DeviceRow } = {}
		for _, r in report.runs do
			if r.evidenceClass == className then
				table.insert(rows, r)
			end
		end
		if budget.measured ~= true then
			table.insert(skipped, {
				class = className,
				reason = "budget declared but not yet measured on that hardware (PENDING_PHYSICAL)",
				budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,
			})
		elseif #rows == 0 then
			table.insert(violations, {
				kind = "class-mismatch" :: "class-mismatch",
				scene = "*",
				device = className,
				requirement = budget.requirement or "UI-PERF-002",
				observedMs = -1,
				budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,

				hint = `device budget '{className}' cannot be enforced: this report contains no rows of `
					.. `that evidence class (it has {#report.runs} rows, class `
					.. `'{if report.environment ~= nil then tostring(report.environment.evidenceClass) else "unstated"}'). `
					.. `Emulator or headless data must never fill a physical row.`,
			})
		else
			for _, r in rows do
				local frameWork = r.metrics and r.metrics.frameWorkMs
				local observed = if type(frameWork) == "table" and frameWork.measured == true
					then frameWork.p95_ms
					else nil

				if type(observed) == "number" and (observed ~= observed or observed < 0) then
					observed = nil
				end
				if type(observed) ~= "number" then
					table.insert(violations, {
						kind = "unmeasured-device-row" :: "unmeasured-device-row",
						scene = r.scene or "*",
						device = className,
						requirement = budget.requirement or "UI-PERF-002",
						observedMs = -1,
						budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,
						hint = `a row labelled '{className}' carries no usable measured frame work (absent, blind, `
							.. `negative or NaN), so it cannot satisfy `
							.. `that device's budget. A device budget is met by a NUMBER, not by an evidence-class `
							.. `string — relabelling a row has never been, and must never become, a way to pass.`,
					})
				elseif observed > budget.budgetMs then
					table.insert(violations, {
						kind = "device" :: "device",
						scene = r.scene,
						device = className,
						requirement = budget.requirement or "UI-PERF-002",
						observedMs = observed,
						budgetMs = budget.budgetMs,
						hint = `scene '{r.scene}' exceeded the {className} frame budget`,
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return { ok = #violations == 0, violations = violations, skipped = skipped }
end

--!strict
-- Server-side bus for "something happened" facts that quests (and later stats) count:
--   Snow (units dug), Sell (1 per sale), Coins (coins from a sale), Find (1 per treasure),
--   Minutes (1 per minute played), Potion (1 per potion drunk), Snowball (1 per player hit),
--   Green (1 per tapped swing that hit the green zone of the hit meter),
--   Drift (1 per snowdrift dug up, to its owner), Enemy (1 per snow monster beaten), Egg (1 per egg opened),
--   Boss (1 per world boss beaten, to every fighter with a reward),
--   Cleared (1 per "Island cleared!": the owner dug out their whole island), Cave (1 per Frost Caves level cleared),
--   Seed (seeds found), Plant / Harvest (1 per seed planted / fruit picked in the greenhouse),
--   Melt (snow loaded into the Snow Melter), Feed (1 per fruit fed to a pet), Enchant (1 per new pet enchant level),
--   Full (1 per swing that filled the backpack), AutoSwing (1 per automatic swing: hold or the Auto button),
--   StarterPack (1 when the Starter Pack popup was shown), CrystalChest (1 per crystal chest opened),
--   World (1 per world unlocked), BigPet (1 for the first Epic-or-better pet ever),
--   DailyChest (the number of the Daily Chest just opened).
-- Services fire facts without knowing who listens (QuestService, GardenFunnelService, OfferService), so none has to
-- require them.

local GameEvents = {}

local event = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

function GameEvents.Fire(player: Player, kind: string, amount: number)
	if amount > 0 then
		event:Fire(player, kind, amount)
	end
end

function GameEvents.Connect(handler: (player: Player, kind: string, amount: number) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	return event.Event:Connect(handler)
end

return GameEvents

--!strict
export type SceneState = { workload: { [string]: any }, target: any, dispose: () -> () }
local nativeApp = require("./native_app")
local workloads = require("../examples/performance/lab/workloads")
local dataset = require("../examples/performance/lab/dataset")
local rows = require("../examples/performance/lab/rows")
local parchment = require("../examples/themes/fantasy_parchment")
local compactPointer = require("../examples/themes/compact_pointer")
local glossyTouch = require("../examples/themes/glossy_touch")
local ornate = require("../examples/themes/fantasy_ornate")
local styleProperties = require("../tests/lib/style_properties")
type RuleProperties = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RuleProperties)
local sampling: { [string]: { number } } = {
	["virtual-list-scroll"] = { 160, 40 },
	["native-scroll-drag"] = { 160, 40 },
	["dense-hud"] = { 160, 40 },
	["stylesheet-state-churn"] = { 160, 40 },
	["async-image-grid"] = { 600, 30 },
	["screen-lifecycle-churn"] = { 120, 30 },
	["theme-swap-flat"] = { 160, 40 },
	["theme-swap-metrics"] = { 160, 40 },
	["dense-motion"] = { 160, 40 },
	["control-motion"] = { 160, 40 },
	["theme-swap-assets"] = { 160, 40 },
	["lab-dense-scroll"] = { 120, 30 },
	["lab-collection-churn"] = { 600, 25 },
	["adaptive-navigation-images"] = { 120, 20 },
	["navigation-customization"] = { 120, 20 },
	["alert-present-dismiss"] = { 120, 30 },
	["picker-menu-open-close"] = { 120, 30 },
	["picker-segmented-textsize"] = { 120, 30 },
	["radial-menu-open-close"] = { 120, 30 },
}
local requirements = {
	["alert-present-dismiss"] = "UI-LIFE-002",
	["collection-mutation"] = "UI-RUNTIME-002",
	["lab-collection-churn"] = "UI-RUNTIME-002",
	["locale-textsize-change"] = "UI-ENV-001",
	["native-scroll-drag"] = "UI-NATIVE-001",
	["picker-segmented-textsize"] = "UI-ENV-001",
	["screen-lifecycle-churn"] = "UI-LIFE-002",
	["scroll-focus-traversal"] = "UI-FOCUS-001",
	["settings-churn"] = "UI-LIFE-002",
	["shadow-storm"] = "UI-STYLE-001",
	["stylesheet-state-churn"] = "UI-STYLE-001",
	["theme-swap-assets"] = "UI-PERF-002",
	["theme-swap-flat"] = "UI-PERF-002",
	["theme-swap-metrics"] = "UI-PERF-002",
	["virtual-list-scroll"] = "UI-RUNTIME-002",
}
local metricProperties = {
	CornerRadius = true,
	FontFace = true,
	LineHeight = true,
	PaddingBottom = true,
	PaddingLeft = true,
	PaddingRight = true,
	PaddingTop = true,
	Size = true,
	TextSize = true,
	Thickness = true,
}
local function ruleSnapshot(root: Instance): { [string]: RuleProperties }
	local rules: { [string]: RuleProperties } = {}
	for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
		if node:IsA("StyleRule") then
			rules[`{node.Selector}#{node.Priority}`] = styleProperties(node)
		end
	end
	return rules
end
local function imageSnapshot(root: Instance): { [Instance]: string }
	local images: { [Instance]: string } = {}
	for _, node in root:GetDescendants() do
		if (node:IsA("ImageLabel") or node:IsA("ImageButton")) and node.Image ~= "" then
			images[node] = `{node.Image}|{node.Visible}|{node.ImageTransparency}`
		end
	end
	return images
end
local function imageChanges(before: { [Instance]: string }, after: { [Instance]: string }): number
	local changes = 0
	for node, image in after do
		if before[node] ~= image then
			changes += 1
		end
	end
	for node in before do
		if after[node] == nil then
			changes += 1
		end
	end
	return changes
end
local function themeSwap(state: SceneState)
	local before, images = ruleSnapshot(state.target), imageSnapshot(state.target)
	local first = state.workload.themeControls[2]
	state.workload.step()
	local after = ruleSnapshot(state.target)
	local paint, metric, rules = 0, 0, 0
	for key, properties in after do
		rules += 1
		local previous = before[key] or {}
		for property, value in properties do
			if tostring(previous[property]) ~= tostring(value) then
				if metricProperties[property] then
					metric += 1
				else
					paint += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		measured = true,
		basis = "StyleRule property differential and skin image census; Engine geometry is not solved headlessly.",
		rules = rules,
		paintChanges = paint,
		metricChanges = metric,
		imageChanges = imageChanges(images, imageSnapshot(state.target)),
		controlsRetained = state.workload.themeControls[2] == first and not first:isDestroyed(),
	}
end
local function segmentedFlip(state: SceneState)
	local function probe()
		local size, segments = nil, 0
		for _, node in state.target:GetDescendants() do
			local textual = node.ClassName == "TextButton" and node:HasTag("facet-segment")
			if textual and (node.Text == "Easy" or node.Text == "Normal" or node.Text == "Hard") then
				segments += 1
				if node.Text == "Normal" then
					size = node.TextSize
				end
			end
		end
		return size, segments
	end
	local before, segments = probe()
	state.workload.step()
	local after = probe()
	return { segments = segments, textSizeBefore = before, textSizeAfter = after }
end
local scenes = {}
for _, name in workloads.ORDER do
	local counts = sampling[name] or { 240, 60 }
	table.insert(scenes, {
		name = name,
		memoryChurn = name == "settings-churn"
			or name == "collection-mutation"
			or name == "lab-collection-churn"
			or name == "virtual-list-scroll"
			or name == "lab-dense-scroll"
			or name == "stylesheet-state-churn"
			or name == "screen-lifecycle-churn"
			or name == "async-image-grid"
			or name == "alert-present-dismiss"
			or name == "picker-menu-open-close"
			or name == "radial-menu-open-close",
		requirement = requirements[name] or "UI-PERF-001",
		dataset = workloads.DATASETS[name],
		samples = counts[1],
		warmup = counts[2],
		setup = function(profile)
			local world = nativeApp({ viewport = profile.viewport })
			world.rowBuilder = rows.build
			world.rowSize = rows.estimate(world)
			if name == "theme-swap-flat" then
				local package = parchment.build(world.Facet.themes)
				world.themePackages = { package, package }
				world.themeNames = { "Daylight", "Candlelight" }
			elseif name == "theme-swap-metrics" then
				world.themePackages = {
					compactPointer.build(world.Facet.themes),
					(glossyTouch.build(world.Facet.themes)),
				}
			elseif name == "theme-swap-assets" then
				local neutral = world.Facet.themes.define(world.Facet.themes.neutralPackage())
				assert(neutral)
				world.themePackages = {
					neutral,
					(ornate.build(world.Facet.themes)),
				}
			end
			local workload
			world.runtime.mount(function()
				workload = workloads.create(world, name, dataset)
				local build = workload.build :: () -> Instance
				return world.Host.ScreenGui { build() }
			end, world.target)
			world.workload = workload
			if name == "radial-menu-open-close" then
				for _ = 1, 3 do
					world.frame()
				end
			end
			if name == "adaptive-navigation-images" or name == "navigation-customization" then
				world.frame()
			end
			return world
		end,
		run = function(state: SceneState)
			return state.workload.step()
		end,
		afterRun = function(state: SceneState)
			local workloadAfterRun: (() -> ())? = state.workload.afterRun
			if workloadAfterRun then
				workloadAfterRun()
			end
		end,
		asyncStats = function(state: SceneState)
			return state.workload.async or { completed = 0, stale = 0, dropped = 0 }
		end,
		teardown = function(state: SceneState)
			state.dispose()
		end,
		extras = function(state: SceneState)
			local w = state.workload
			local springs: { unknown }? = w.springs
			local logicalRows: { peek: (unknown) -> { unknown } }? = w.rows
			local windowStatus: { peek: (unknown) -> { retained: number } }? = w.status
			local boosts: { peek: (unknown) -> number }? = w.boosts
			local boostText: { Text: string }? = w.boostText
			return {
				dragMoves = w.dragMoves,
				drops = w.drops,
				tagsPerPass = w.tagCount,
				opens = w.opens,
				closes = w.closes,
				settled = w.settled,
				settleFrames = w.settleFrames,
				surfaceItems = w.surfaceItems,
				presentation = w.presentation,
				springs = if springs then #springs else nil,
				springsMoving = w.springsMoving,
				beatCallbacks = w.beatCallbacks,
				rekeys = w.rekeys,
				flips = w.flips,
				pulses = w.pulses,
				pops = w.pops,
				segmented = if name == "picker-segmented-textsize" then segmentedFlip(state) else nil,
				workloadVersion = workloads.VERSION,
				datasetVersion = dataset.VERSION,
				logicalRows = if logicalRows then #logicalRows:peek() else nil,
				windowedRows = if windowStatus then windowStatus:peek().retained else nil,
				contentBuilds = state.workload.contentBuilds,
				motionSteps = state.workload.motionSteps,
				motionTransactions = state.workload.motionTransactions,
				staggerHeld = state.workload.staggerHeld,
				flipsSeen = state.workload.flipsSeen,
				shakesSeen = state.workload.shakesSeen,
				popsSeen = state.workload.popsSeen,
				beats = state.workload.beats,
				themeSwap = if string.sub(name, 1, 11) == "theme-swap-" then themeSwap(state) else nil,
				geometryMeasured = false,
				activationCount = if boosts then boosts:peek() else nil,
				activationText = if boostText then boostText.Text else nil,
				measurementChange = if name == "shadow-storm"
					then "100 unchanged native shadows and runtime settle. Removed Facet presenter refresh/style_lint have no replacement CPU phase; Engine shadow painting is unmeasured. This is not a shadow rendering speedup."
					else "Compose and control property/event cost only. Roblox layout, text measurement, native selection, StyleSheet resolution and image fetching require Studio/retail evidence.",
			}
		end,
	})
end
return scenes

-- event "OpsIssue" (CustomField01 = kind, 02 = detail), so failed loads and stuck receipts show up as numbers.

local AnalyticsService = game:GetService("AnalyticsService")

local Ops = {}

function Ops.Issue(player: Player?, kind: string, detail: string?)
	warn(`[Ops] {kind}: {detail or ""}`)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player, "OpsIssue", 1, {
			[Enum.AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.CustomField01.Name] = kind,
			[Enum.AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.CustomField02.Name] = string.sub(detail or "", 1, 50),
		})
	end)
end

return Ops

local Progression = require("../packages/progression/src/Progression")
local Combat = require("../packages/combat/src/Combat")
local Economy = require("../packages/economy/src/Economy")

local bag, bagError = Inventory.create(6, {
	potion = { maxStack = 10 },
	sword = { maxStack = 1, equipmentSlot = "hand" },
}, { hand = true })
assert(bag, bagError)

local withSword, swordError = Inventory.add(bag, "sword", 1)
assert(withSword, swordError)
local equipped, equipmentError = Inventory.equip(withSword, 1)
assert(equipped, equipmentError)

local wallet, walletError = Economy.create(100)

local catalogue, catalogueError = Economy.createCatalogue({ potion = { itemId = "potion", price = 15, maxQuantity = 5 } })

		viewport = { w = 1024, h = 768 },
		insets = { top = 58, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 },

		viewport = { w = 768, h = 1024 },
		insets = { top = 58, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 },

	},

		name = "desktop",
		title = "Desktop (1280×720)",
		viewport = { w = 1280, h = 720 },
		insets = { top = 58, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 },

		},
	},
}

local ORDER = { "phone", "phoneLandscape", "phoneNotchLandscape", "tablet", "tabletPortrait", "desktop", "console" }

function device_profiles.list(): { string }
	return table.clone(ORDER)
end

function device_profiles.get(name: string): Profile?
	return PROFILES[name]
end

function device_profiles.apply(env: any, name: string): Profile
	local profile = PROFILES[name]
	assert(profile ~= nil, `unknown device profile '{name}' (have: {table.concat(ORDER, ", ")})`)
	env:set("viewportRect", { x = 0, y = 0, w = profile.viewport.w, h = profile.viewport.h })
	env:set("coreSafeInsets", table.clone(profile.insets))

	env:set("deviceSafeInsets", { top = 0, bottom = 0, left = 0, right = 0 })

	for key, value in profile.facts do
		env:set(key, if type(value) == "table" then table.clone(value) else value)
	end
	return profile
end

return device_profiles

--!strict
-- Per-player minimum interval between actions, with violation counting.
-- One limiter per remote or action; requests over the limit are dropped and counted.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WARN_EVERY = 50 -- log once per this many violations from one player

export type RateLimiter = {
	Name: string,
	Interval: number,
	Last: { [Player]: number },
	Violations: { [Player]: number },
	Allow: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> boolean,
}

local RateLimiter = {}
RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter

local limiters: { RateLimiter } = {}

function RateLimiter.new(name: string, interval: number): RateLimiter
	local self = setmetatable({
		Name = name,
		Interval = interval,
		Last = {},
		Violations = {},
	}, RateLimiter) :: any
	table.insert(limiters, self)
	return self
end

function RateLimiter.Allow(self: RateLimiter, player: Player): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	local last = self.Last[player]
	if last and now - last < self.Interval then
		local count = (self.Violations[player] or 0) + 1
		self.Violations[player] = count
		if count % WARN_EVERY == 0 then
			warn(string.format("[RateLimiter] %s: %s (%d) over the limit %d times", self.Name, player.Name, player.UserId, count))
		end
		return false
	end
	self.Last[player] = now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for _, limiter in limiters do
		limiter.Last[player] = nil
		limiter.Violations[player] = nil
	end
end)

return RateLimiter

--!strict
type FrameProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FrameProps)

type ComposeModule = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeModule)
type RobloxHost = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RobloxHost)
type FrameNativeProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").FrameNativeProps)
type ScreenGuiProps = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ScreenGuiProps)
type Child = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").Child)
type RobloxTypes = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").RobloxTypes)
type ComposeRuntime = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").ComposeRuntime)
type OrderedControls = typeof(require("@repo/tools/typecheck/aliases").OrderedControls)
type ReadOnlyValue<T> = typeof(require("@repo/src/vendor/compose/core").accumulator<<T, number>>(nil :: never))
type Use = <T>(ReadOnlyValue<T>) -> T
local Facet = require("../src")
local VerifyRoblox = require("@verify/src/roblox")
local Compose: ComposeModule = Facet.Compose
local nativeApp = require("./native_app")
local authoringMotion = require("./authoring_motion")
type RampState = {
	read Host: RobloxHost,
	read types: RobloxTypes,
	read runtime: ComposeRuntime,
	read target: Instance,
	read frame: (number?) -> (),
}
type BenchRow = { id: string, name: string }
type BenchSort = { column: string, direction: "ascending" | "descending" }

export type Scenario = {
	name: string,
	requirement: string,
	setup: () -> any,
	run: (any) -> (),
	teardown: ((any) -> ())?,
	samples: number?,
	warmup: number?,
}

local scenarios: { Scenario } = {}
local function add(
	name: string,
	setup: () -> any,
	run: (any) -> (),
	options: { requirement: string?, teardown: ((any) -> ())?, samples: number?, warmup: number? }?
)
	local scenario: Scenario = {
		name = name,
		requirement = if options and options.requirement then options.requirement else "UI-PERF-001",
		setup = setup,
		run = run,
		teardown = options and options.teardown,
		samples = options and options.samples,
		warmup = options and options.warmup,
	}
	scenario.name = name
	scenario.requirement = scenario.requirement or "UI-PERF-001"
	scenario.setup = setup
	scenario.run = run
	scenario.teardown = scenario.teardown or function(state)
		state.dispose()
	end
	table.insert(scenarios, scenario)
end

local function reactive(setup: ({ [string]: any }) -> ()): { [string]: any }
	local state: { [string]: any } = {}
	local root = Compose.createRootOwner(function(owner)
		state.owner = owner
		setup(state)
	end)
	state.dispose = root.dispose
	return state
end

add("hud-binding-storm", function()
	return reactive(function(state)
		state.speed, state.n, state.renders = Compose.cell(0), 0, 0
		local rounded = Compose.formula(function(use: Use)
			return math.floor(use(state.speed))
		end)
		local label = Compose.formula(function(use: Use)
			return `{use(rounded)} sps`
		end)
		Compose.owner.watchStatic(state.owner, label, function()
			state.renders += 1
		end)
	end)
end, function(state)
	state.n += 1
	for index = 1, 100 do
		state.speed:set(state.n * 100 + index)
	end
end)

add("settings-churn", function()
	return reactive(function() end)
end, function(state)
	local owner = Compose.owner.createChild(state.owner)
	Compose.withOwner(owner, function()
		local draft, status = Compose.cell(false), Compose.cell("idle")
		local label = Compose.formula(function(use: Use)
			return `music: {use(draft) and "on" or "off"} ({use(status)})`
		end)
		Compose.owner.watchStatic(owner, label, function() end)
		draft:set(true)
		status:set("confirmed")
	end)
	Compose.owner.dispose(owner)
end, { requirement = "UI-LIFE-002" })

add("collection-mutation", function()
	return reactive(function(state)
		state.items, state.keys, state.n = {}, {}, 50
		state.apply = function(keys: { string })
			local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			for _, key in keys do
				wanted[key] = true
			end
			for key, owner in state.items do
				if not wanted[key] then
					Compose.owner.dispose(owner)
					state.items[key] = nil
				end
			end
			for _, key in keys do
				if state.items[key] == nil then
					local owner = Compose.owner.createChild(state.owner)
					Compose.withOwner(owner, function()
						Compose.cell(key)
					end)
					state.items[key] = owner
				end
			end
		end
		for index = 1, 50 do
			state.keys[index] = `item-{index}`
		end
		state.apply(state.keys)
	end)
end, function(state)
	local keys = state.keys
	table.insert(keys, table.remove(keys, 1))
	state.n += 1
	keys[#keys] = `item-{state.n}`
	state.apply(keys)
end, { requirement = "UI-RUNTIME-002" })

add("collection-selection-update", function()
	local world = nativeApp()
	local items: { BenchRow } = {}
	for index = 1, 2048 do
		items[index] = { id = `r{index}`, name = `Row {index}` }
	end
	local selection: Facet.Value<{ [string]: boolean }> = Compose.cell({ r1 = true })
	local Host = world.Host
	world.runtime.mount(function()
		local spec: Facet.KeyedCollectionSpec<BenchRow, string> = {
			from = items,
			key = "id",
			selection = selection,
			selectionMode = "single",
			itemSize = 40,
			render = function(current)
				return Host.TextLabel {
					Text = function(use: Use): string
						return use(current).name
					end,
				}
			end,
		}
		return world.UI.VirtualList(spec)
	end, world.target)
	world.frame()
	return { selection = selection, n = 0, frame = world.frame, dispose = world.dispose }
end, function(state)
	state.n += 1
	local key = `r{(state.n - 1) % 2048 + 1}`
	state.selection:set({ [key] = true })
	state.frame()
	assert(state.selection:peek()[key] == true, "valid selection was pruned")
end, { requirement = "UI-RUNTIME-002", samples = 500, warmup = 50 })

add("sparse-update-under-load", function()
	return reactive(function(state)
		state.signals, state.n = {}, 0
		for index = 1, 200 do
			local value = Compose.cell(index)
			local doubled = Compose.formula(function(use: Use)
				return use(value) * 2
			end)
			Compose.owner.watchStatic(state.owner, doubled, function() end)
			table.insert(state.signals, value)
		end
	end)
end, function(state)
	state.n += 1
	state.signals[1]:set(1000 + state.n)
end)

add("reserved-slot-record-update", function()
	local world = nativeApp()
	local items: { BenchRow } = {}
	local slots: { string } = {}
	for index = 1, 128 do
		items[index] = { id = `r{index}`, name = `Row {index}` }
		slots[index] = items[index].id
	end
	local rows = Compose.cell(items)
	local labels: { [string]: TextLabel } = {}
	local Host = world.Host
	world.runtime.mount(function()
		local spec: Facet.KeyedCollectionSpec<BenchRow, string> = {
			from = rows,
			key = "id",
			slots = slots,
			mode = "all",
			itemSize = 40,
			render = function(current, _placement, key)
				local label = Host.TextLabel {
					Text = function(use: Use): string
						return use(current).name
					end,
				}
				Compose.watch(function(use: Use)
					labels[if type(key) == "string" then key else use(key)] = label
				end)
				return label
			end,
		}
		return world.UI.VirtualList(spec)
	end, world.target)
	world.frame()
	return { rows = rows, labels = labels, n = 0, frame = world.frame, dispose = world.dispose }
end, function(state)
	state.n += 1
	local current: { BenchRow } = state.rows:peek()
	local rows = table.clone(current)
	local index = (state.n - 1) % #rows + 1
	local previous = rows[index]
	local name = `Updated {state.n}`
	rows[index] = { id = previous.id, name = name }
	state.rows:set(rows)
	state.frame()
	assert(state.labels[previous.id].Text == name, "reserved slot did not publish its updated record")
end, { requirement = "UI-RUNTIME-002", samples = 200, warmup = 20 })

add("mounted-slice-update-storm", function()
	local world = nativeApp()
	world.speed, world.n = Compose.cell(0), 0
	world.runtime.mount(function()
		return world.Host.ScreenGui {
			world.Host.TextLabel {
				Text = function(use: Use)
					return `{use(world.speed)} sps`
				end,
				TextSize = 18,
			},
			world.UI.Button { label = "Boost", onActivate = function() end },
		}
	end, world.target)
	return world
end, function(state)
	state.n += 1
	for index = 1, 50 do
		state.speed:set(state.n * 50 + index)
	end
	state.frame()
end)

local function rampTree(Host: RobloxHost, depth: number, index: number): GuiObject
	if depth == 0 then
		return Host.TextLabel { Name = `T{index}`, Text = "leaf" }
	end
	local children: { Name: string, [number]: Child } = { Name = `V{index}`, Host.UIListLayout {} }
	for child = 1, 3 do
		table.insert(children, rampTree(Host, depth - 1, child))
	end
	return Host.Frame((children :: unknown) :: FrameProps)
end
local rampSetup: () -> RampState = nativeApp
for _, inherited in { false, true } do
	add(if inherited then "mount-ramp-inherited" else "mount-ramp", rampSetup, function(state: RampState)
		local stop = state.runtime.mount(function(): ScreenGui
			local color = if inherited
				then state.types.Color3.fromRGB(119, 190, 255)
				else state.types.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local group: CanvasGroup = state.Host.CanvasGroup {
				Interactable = not inherited,
				GroupColor3 = color,
				rampTree(state.Host, 7, 1),
			}
			return state.Host.ScreenGui { group }
		end, state.target)
		stop()
		state.frame()
		assert(#state.target:GetChildren() == 0, "mount ramp leaked a screen")
	end, { samples = 60, warmup = 5 })
end

	world.runtime.mount(function()
		local columns: { Facet.TableColumn<BenchRow, string> } = {

					return world.Host.TextLabel {

			{

					return world.Host.TextLabel {
						TextSize = 14,
						Text = function(use: Use)
							return use(current).name
						end,
					}

	for _, child in node:GetChildren() do
		if child.ClassName == className then
			return child
		end
		local found = descendant(child, className)
		if found then
			return found
		end
	end
	return nil
end

--!strict

local Combat = {}

export type State = { read health: number, read maxHealth: number, read shield: number }
export type Rules = { canDamage: boolean?, flatReduction: number?, multiplier: number?, shieldPiercing: boolean? }
export type Damage = { read state: State, read healthDamage: number, read absorbed: number, read killed: boolean }

local MAX_VALUE = 1000000000

local function bounded(value: unknown, minimum: number, maximum: number): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end

function Combat.create(maxHealth: number, shield: number?): (State?, string?)
	local initialShield = if shield == nil then 0 else shield
	if not bounded(maxHealth, 0, MAX_VALUE) or maxHealth <= 0 or not bounded(initialShield, 0, MAX_VALUE) then
		return nil, "invalid_health"
	end
	return table.freeze({ health = maxHealth, maxHealth = maxHealth, shield = initialShield }), nil
end

function Combat.damage(state: State, amount: number, rules: Rules?): (Damage?, string?)
	if not bounded(amount, 0, MAX_VALUE) or amount <= 0 then
		return nil, "invalid_damage"
	end
	if rules ~= nil and typeof(rules) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "invalid_rules"
	end
	local configuration: Rules = rules or {}
	if configuration.canDamage ~= nil and typeof(configuration.canDamage) ~= "boolean" then
		return nil, "invalid_rules"
	end
	if configuration.shieldPiercing ~= nil and typeof(configuration.shieldPiercing) ~= "boolean" then
		return nil, "invalid_rules"
	end
	local reduction = if configuration.flatReduction == nil then 0 else configuration.flatReduction
	local multiplier = if configuration.multiplier == nil then 1 else configuration.multiplier
	if not bounded(reduction, 0, MAX_VALUE) or not bounded(multiplier, 0, 100) then
		return nil, "invalid_rules"
	end
	if configuration.canDamage == false then
		return nil, "damage_denied"
	end
	if state.health <= 0 then
		return nil, "target_dead"
	end
	local resolved = math.max(0, amount - reduction) * multiplier
	local absorbed = if configuration.shieldPiercing then 0 else math.min(state.shield, resolved)
	local healthDamage = math.min(state.health, resolved - absorbed)
	local nextState = table.freeze({ health = state.health - healthDamage, maxHealth = state.maxHealth, shield = state.shield - absorbed })
	return table.freeze({ state = nextState, healthDamage = healthDamage, absorbed = absorbed, killed = nextState.health == 0 }), nil
end

function Combat.heal(state: State, amount: number): (State?, string?)
	if not bounded(amount, 0, MAX_VALUE) or amount <= 0 then
		return nil, "invalid_healing"
	end
	if state.health <= 0 then
		return nil, "target_dead"
	end
	return table.freeze({ health = math.min(state.maxHealth, state.health + amount), maxHealth = state.maxHealth, shield = state.shield }), nil
end

Combat.Limits = table.freeze({ health = MAX_VALUE, shield = MAX_VALUE, damage = MAX_VALUE, multiplier = 100 })

return table.freeze(Combat)

--!strict
-- Synchronous signal: Fire runs handlers in connection order, in the same frame.
-- A failing handler is reported with warn; the other handlers still run.

export type Connection = { Connected: boolean, Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> () }
export type Signal<T...> = {
	Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, handler: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
	DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Entry = {
	handler: (...any) -> (),
	connection: Connection,
}

local Signal = {}

-- Message handler for xpcall: prints the error with a stack trace.
local function reportError(err: any): any
	warn(debug.traceback("Signal handler error: " .. tostring(err)))
	return err
end

function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
	local entries: { Entry } = {}
	local signal: any = {}

	function signal.Connect(_self: Signal<T...>, handler: (T...) -> ()): Connection
		local connection: any = { Connected = true }
		local entry: Entry = { handler = handler :: any, connection = connection }

		connection.Disconnect = function(self: Connection)
			if not self.Connected then
				return
			end
			self.Connected = false
			local index = table.find(entries, entry)
			if index then
				table.remove(entries, index)
			end
		end

		table.insert(entries, entry)
		return connection
	end

	function signal.Fire(_self: Signal<T...>, ...: T...)
		-- Iterate over a snapshot: handlers may connect or disconnect during Fire.
		local snapshot = table.clone(entries)
		for _, entry in snapshot do
			if entry.connection.Connected then
				xpcall(entry.handler, reportError, ...)
			end
		end
	end

	function signal.DisconnectAll(_self: Signal<T...>)
		for _, entry in table.clone(entries) do
			entry.connection.Connected = false
		end
		table.clear(entries)
	end

	return signal
end

return Signal

--!strict

local Core = require("@verify/src/core")
local Eval = require("@verify/src/agent-eval")

export type Identity = {
	suite: string,
	task: string,
	agent: string,
	adapter: string,
	model: string,
	seed: number,
	judgeModel: string,
}

local DEFAULT_IDENTITY: Identity = {
	suite = "facetbench-run",
	task = "run",
	agent = "codex-sol",
	adapter = "codex",
	model = "gpt-6.1-sol",
	seed = 1,
	judgeModel = "gpt-6.1-sol",
}
table.freeze(DEFAULT_IDENTITY)

local devices = { "desktop", "phone-portrait", "phone-landscape", "tablet", "console" }
local outcomes = {
	"hub",
	"driving",
	"queue",
	"race",
	"scoreboard",
	"results",
	"shop",
	"garage",
	"loadout",
	"drivers",
	"crates",
	"daily-rewards",
	"codes",
	"boosts",
	"quests",
	"offer",
	"mechanic",
	"settings",
	"livery",
	"voting",
	"quick-chat",
	"upgrades",
	"party",
	"tutorial",
	"authority",
	"persistence",
	"adaptation",
	"stability",
	"progression",
}
local screens = { "hub", "shop", "garage", "livery", "race", "results", "tutorial" }

local function positive(value: number?): number
	assert(value ~= nil and value > 0 and value < math.huge, "a finite positive measurement is required")
	return value
end

local function cases(results: { Eval.RunResult }, judgments: { Eval.Judgment }, identity: Identity?): { Core.NamedCase }
	local expected = identity or DEFAULT_IDENTITY
	local collection: { Core.NamedCase } = {}
	local function add(id: string, body: (Core.Context) -> ())
		table.insert(collection, { id = id, name = id, timeoutSeconds = 30, run = body })
	end
	local function arm(id: string): Eval.RunResult
		local found: Eval.RunResult? = nil
		for _, result in results do
			if result.arm == id then
				assert(found == nil, "the comparison requires exactly one " .. id .. " run")
				found = result
			end
		end
		assert(found, "missing " .. id .. " run")
		return found
	end
	add("pair/identity", function(t)
		t:expect(#results):toBe(2)
		for _, id in { "plain", "facet" } do
			local run = arm(id)
			t:expect(run.suite):toBe(expected.suite)
			t:expect(run.task):toBe(expected.task)
			t:expect(run.agent):toBe(expected.agent)
			t:expect(run.adapter):toBe(expected.adapter)
			t:expect(run.model):toBe(expected.model)
			t:expect(run.seed):toBe(expected.seed)
			t:expect(run.parent):toBe(nil)
		end
	end)
	add("facet/completion", function(t)
		local run = arm("facet")
		t:expect(run.status):toBe("completed")
		t:expect(run.passed):toBe(true)
		t:expect(run.checksPassed):toBe(true)
		t:expect(#run.exceeded):toBe(0)
		t:expect(positive(run.metrics.wallSeconds) <= 1800):toBe(true)
		for _, id in { "submission", "submission-unchanged" } do
			local found: Eval.CheckResult? = nil
			for _, check in run.checks do
				if check.id == id then
					assert(found == nil, "duplicate submission check")
					found = check
				end
			end
			assert(
				found and found.required and found.kind == "verify" and found.passed,
				"missing submission integrity: " .. id
			)
			t:expect(#found.cases):toBe(1)
			t:expect(found.cases[1].id):toBe("submission/unchanged")
			t:expect(found.cases[1].status):toBe("passed")
		end
	end)
	for _, device in devices do
		add("facet/behavior/" .. device, function(t)
			local statuses: { [string]: string } = {}
			local play: Eval.CheckResult? = nil
			for _, check in arm("facet").checks do
				if check.id == "play" then
					assert(play == nil, "duplicate player-outcome check")
					play = check
				end
			end
			assert(play and play.required and play.kind == "verify", "required Verify player-outcome check is missing")
			for _, outcome in play.cases do
				assert(statuses[outcome.id] == nil, "duplicate outcome: " .. outcome.id)
				statuses[outcome.id] = outcome.status
			end
			for _, outcome in outcomes do
				local id = device .. "/play/" .. outcome
				t:expect(statuses[id] == "passed"):toBeTrueWith("required player outcome: " .. id)
			end
		end)
	end
	add("cost/complete-usage", function(t)
		for _, id in { "plain", "facet" } do
			local run = arm(id)
			t:expect(run.status):toBe("completed")
			t:expect(run.session.usageSource ~= "none"):toBe(true)
			t:expect(run.session.malformed):toBe(0)
			local metrics = run.metrics
			positive(metrics.totalTokens)
			t:expect(metrics.totalTokens)
				:toBe(
					metrics.inputTokens + metrics.cacheCreationTokens + metrics.cacheReadTokens + metrics.outputTokens
				)
		end
	end)
	add("cost/tokens", function(t)
		local ratio = positive(arm("facet").metrics.totalTokens) / positive(arm("plain").metrics.totalTokens)
		t:expect(ratio <= 0.5):toBeTrueWith("Facet total tokens / Plain total tokens = " .. tostring(ratio))
	end)
	add("cost/wall", function(t)
		local ratio = positive(arm("facet").metrics.wallSeconds) / positive(arm("plain").metrics.wallSeconds)
		t:expect(ratio <= 0.6):toBeTrueWith("Facet author wall / Plain author wall = " .. tostring(ratio))
	end)
	add("cost/turn-latency", function(t)
		local facet = positive(Eval.stats.median(arm("facet").metrics.turnLatencies))
		local plain = positive(Eval.stats.median(arm("plain").metrics.turnLatencies))
		t:expect(facet < plain):toBeTrueWith("Facet median turn latency / Plain = " .. tostring(facet / plain))
	end)
	for _, device in devices do
		add("runtime/" .. device, function(t)
			local prefix = "play.perf." .. device .. "."
			local plain, facet = arm("plain").scores, arm("facet").scores
			for _, scores in { plain, facet } do
				t:expect(scores[prefix .. "returned"]):toBe(1)
				t:expect(scores[prefix .. "mountTimedOut"]):toBe(0)
				for _, metric in { "heapReturnRatio", "guiReturnRatio" } do
					t:expect(positive(scores[prefix .. metric]) < 1.05):toBeTrueWith(metric .. " retains less than 5%")
				end
			end
			for _, state in { "idle", "shop", "race" } do
				for _, scores in { plain, facet } do
					t:expect(positive(scores[prefix .. state .. ".frames"]) >= 120)
						:toBeTrueWith(state .. " needs 120 frames")
				end
				for _, percentile in { "p50", "p95" } do
					local key = prefix .. state .. "." .. percentile
					local ratio = positive(facet[key]) / positive(plain[key])
					t:expect(ratio < 1.05)
						:toBeTrueWith(state .. " " .. percentile .. " frame ratio = " .. tostring(ratio))
				end
			end
			for _, metric in { "finalHeapKb", "finalGuiMb" } do
				local ratio = positive(facet[prefix .. metric]) / positive(plain[prefix .. metric])
				t:expect(ratio < 1.05):toBeTrueWith(metric .. " ratio = " .. tostring(ratio))
			end
		end)
	end
	add("visual/coverage", function(t)
		for _, id in { "plain", "facet" } do
			local captures: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			for _, capture in arm(id).captures do
				assert(capture.size > 0 and #capture.sha256 == 64, "capture bytes need a content hash")
				captures[capture.device .. "/" .. capture.label] = true
			end
			for _, device in devices do
				for _, screen in screens do
					t:expect(captures[device .. "/" .. screen] == true)
						:toBeTrueWith(id .. "/" .. device .. "/" .. screen)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	add("visual/preference", function(t)
		local scores: { [string]: number } = {}
		for _, judgment in judgments do
			assert(
				judgment.task == expected.task and judgment.agent == expected.agent and judgment.seed == expected.seed,
				"wrong judgment identity"
			)
			assert(scores[judgment.device] == nil, "duplicate device judgment")
			assert(judgment.status == "judged", "a skipped, failed, or forfeited comparison is not a visual win")
			assert(#judgment.presentations == 2, "both presentation orders are required")
			assert(
				judgment.presentations[1].first ~= judgment.presentations[2].first,
				"presentation order was not reversed"
			)
			local observed = 0
			for _, presentation in judgment.presentations do
				assert(
					presentation.model == expected.judgeModel and presentation.verdict ~= nil,
					"wrong or missing judge model"
				)
				local choice = presentation.verdict.overall
				observed += if choice == "tie"
					then 0.5
					elseif
						choice == "first" and presentation.first == "a"
						or choice == "second" and presentation.first == "b"
					then 1
					else 0
			end
			local score = judgment.scoreA
			assert(score ~= nil and score >= 0 and score <= 1, "missing visual preference score")
			assert(score == observed / 2, "preference score differs from the two recorded judgments")
			assert(
				judgment.a == "facet" and judgment.b == "plain" or judgment.a == "plain" and judgment.b == "facet",
				"wrong compared arms"
			)
			scores[judgment.device] = if judgment.a == "facet" then score else 1 - score
			t:attach(judgment.device .. "-judgment", "application/json", Eval.lute.encode(judgment))
		end
		local total = 0
		for _, device in devices do
			assert(scores[device] ~= nil, "missing judgment for " .. device)
			total += scores[device]
		end
		t:expect(#judgments):toBe(#devices)
		t:expect(total / #devices >= 0.7):toBeTrueWith("Facet blind preference = " .. tostring(total / #devices))
	end)
	return collection
end

return { DEFAULT_IDENTITY = DEFAULT_IDENTITY, cases = cases }

--!strict

local Economy = {}

export type Wallet = { read balance: number, read maxBalance: number }
export type Offer = { read itemId: string, read price: number, read maxQuantity: number }
export type OfferInput = { itemId: string, price: number, maxQuantity: number? }
export type Catalogue = { [string]: Offer }
export type AddItems<T> = (T, string, number) -> (T?, string?)
export type Purchase<T> = { read wallet: Wallet, read inventory: T, read offerId: string, read itemId: string, read quantity: number, read totalCost: number }

local MAX_BALANCE = 1000000000000
local MAX_PRICE = 1000000000
local MAX_QUANTITY = 1000000

local function integer(value: unknown, minimum: number, maximum: number): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= minimum and value <= maximum and value % 1 == 0
end

local function identifier(value: unknown): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 96
end

function Economy.create(balance: number?, maxBalance: number?): (Wallet?, string?)
	local initial = if balance == nil then 0 else balance
	local maximum = if maxBalance == nil then MAX_BALANCE else maxBalance
	if not integer(maximum, 0, MAX_BALANCE) or not integer(initial, 0, maximum) then
		return nil, "invalid_balance"
	end
	return table.freeze({ balance = initial, maxBalance = maximum }), nil
end

function Economy.credit(wallet: Wallet, amount: number): (Wallet?, string?)
	if not integer(amount, 0, MAX_BALANCE) then
		return nil, "invalid_amount"
	end
	if amount > wallet.maxBalance - wallet.balance then
		return nil, "balance_limit"
	end
	return table.freeze({ balance = wallet.balance + amount, maxBalance = wallet.maxBalance }), nil
end

function Economy.debit(wallet: Wallet, amount: number): (Wallet?, string?)
	if not integer(amount, 0, MAX_BALANCE) then
		return nil, "invalid_amount"
	end
	if amount > wallet.balance then
		return nil, "insufficient_funds"
	end
	return table.freeze({ balance = wallet.balance - amount, maxBalance = wallet.maxBalance }), nil
end

function Economy.createCatalogue(offers: { [string]: OfferInput }): (Catalogue?, string?)
	if typeof(offers) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "invalid_catalogue"
	end
	local catalogue: Catalogue = {}
	local count = 0
	for offerId, offer in offers do
		count += 1
		if count > 1024 or not identifier(offerId) or typeof(offer) ~= "table" or not identifier(offer.itemId) then
			return nil, "invalid_offer"
		end
		local maximum = if offer.maxQuantity == nil then MAX_QUANTITY else offer.maxQuantity
		if not integer(offer.price, 0, MAX_PRICE) or not integer(maximum, 1, MAX_QUANTITY) then
			return nil, "invalid_offer"
		end
		catalogue[offerId] = table.freeze({ itemId = offer.itemId, price = offer.price, maxQuantity = maximum })
	end
	return table.freeze(catalogue), nil
end

-- The injected adder must return a new inventory without mutating its input.
-- Commit both returned values together in the consuming game's server code.
function Economy.purchase<T>(wallet: Wallet, inventory: T, catalogue: Catalogue, offerId: string, quantity: number, addItems: AddItems<T>): (Purchase<T>?, string?)
	if not identifier(offerId) then
		return nil, "invalid_offer_id"
	end
	local offer = catalogue[offerId]
	if not offer then
		return nil, "unknown_offer"
	end
	if not integer(quantity, 1, offer.maxQuantity) then
		return nil, "invalid_quantity"
	end
	if typeof(addItems) ~= "function" then
		return nil, "invalid_inventory_adapter"
	end
	-- These configured bounds keep integer multiplication below 2^53.
	local cost = offer.price * quantity
	if cost > wallet.balance then
		return nil, "insufficient_funds"
	end
	local nextInventory, inventoryError = addItems(inventory, offer.itemId, quantity)
	if nextInventory == nil then
		return nil, inventoryError or "inventory_rejected"
	end
	local nextWallet = table.freeze({ balance = wallet.balance - cost, maxBalance = wallet.maxBalance })
	return table.freeze({ wallet = nextWallet, inventory = nextInventory, offerId = offerId, itemId = offer.itemId, quantity = quantity, totalCost = cost }), nil
end

Economy.Limits = table.freeze({ balance = MAX_BALANCE, price = MAX_PRICE, quantity = MAX_QUANTITY, offers = 1024 })

return table.freeze(Economy)

--!strict
-- Damped spring of unit mass (contract "Dynamics v1", D7.8). Pure math, no state.
-- New modules use it; the older private springStep copies stay as they are.

local Spring = {}

local MAX_SUBSTEP = 1 / 120 -- numerical step limit, not a balance number

local function isFinite(n: number): boolean
	return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

-- One semi-implicit Euler step towards target; dt is cut into sub-steps of at most 1/120 s.
-- Bad input (NaN, infinity, dt <= 0, stiffness <= 0) returns x, v unchanged.
function Spring.Step(
	x: number,
	v: number,
	target: number,
	stiffness: number,
	dampingRatio: number,
	dt: number
): (number, number)
	if
		not isFinite(x)
		or not isFinite(v)
		or not isFinite(target)
		or not isFinite(stiffness)
		or not isFinite(dampingRatio)
		or not isFinite(dt)
		or dt <= 0
		or stiffness <= 0
	then
		return x, v
	end
	local damping = 2 * math.max(dampingRatio, 0) * math.sqrt(stiffness)
	local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt / MAX_SUBSTEP))
	local h = dt / steps
	for _ = 1, steps do
		local accel = -stiffness * (x - target) - damping * v
		v += accel * h
		x += v * h
	end
	return x, v
end

-- True when both the distance to target and the speed are within eps.
function Spring.IsSettled(x: number, v: number, target: number, eps: number): boolean
	return math.abs(x - target) <= eps and math.abs(v) <= eps
end

return Spring

--!strict

local Inventory = {}

export type Definition = { read maxStack: number, read equipmentSlot: string? }
export type Definitions = { [string]: Definition }
export type Stack = { read itemId: string, read quantity: number }
export type State = {
	read capacity: number,
	read definitions: Definitions,
	read slots: { [number]: Stack },
	read equipmentSlots: { [string]: boolean },
	read equipped: { [string]: number },
}
export type Entry = { read slot: number, read itemId: string, read quantity: number }

local MAX_CAPACITY = 512
local MAX_QUANTITY = 1000000

local function integer(value: unknown, minimum: number, maximum: number): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number"
		and value == value
		and value >= minimum
		and value <= maximum
		and value % 1 == 0
end

local function identifier(value: unknown): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 96
end

local function updated(state: State, slots: { [number]: Stack }?, equipped: { [string]: number }?): State
	return table.freeze({
		capacity = state.capacity,
		definitions = state.definitions,
		equipmentSlots = state.equipmentSlots,
		slots = if slots then table.freeze(slots) else state.slots,
		equipped = if equipped then table.freeze(equipped) else state.equipped,
	})
end

local function itemError(state: State, itemId: string, quantity: number): string?
	if not identifier(itemId) then
		return "invalid_item_id"
	end
	if not state.definitions[itemId] then
		return "unknown_item"
	end
	if not integer(quantity, 1, MAX_QUANTITY) then
		return "invalid_quantity"
	end
	return nil
end

function Inventory.create(capacity: number, definitions: Definitions, equipmentSlots: { [string]: boolean }?): (State?, string?)
	if not integer(capacity, 1, MAX_CAPACITY) then
		return nil, "invalid_capacity"
	end
	if typeof(definitions) ~= "table" or (equipmentSlots ~= nil and typeof(equipmentSlots) ~= "table") then
		return nil, "invalid_definitions"
	end
	local allowed: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local slotCount = 0
	for name, enabled in equipmentSlots or {} do
		slotCount += 1
		if not identifier(name) or enabled ~= true or slotCount > 32 then
			return nil, "invalid_equipment_slots"
		end
		allowed[name] = true
	end
	local copied: Definitions = {}
	local count = 0
	for itemId, definition in definitions do
		count += 1
		if count > 1024 or not identifier(itemId) or typeof(definition) ~= "table" then
			return nil, "invalid_definitions"
		end
		if not integer(definition.maxStack, 1, MAX_QUANTITY) then
			return nil, "invalid_stack_limit"
		end
		local equipmentSlot = definition.equipmentSlot
		if equipmentSlot ~= nil then
			if not identifier(equipmentSlot) or not allowed[equipmentSlot] then
				return nil, "invalid_equipment_slot"
			end
			if definition.maxStack ~= 1 then
				return nil, "equipment_must_not_stack"
			end
		end
		copied[itemId] = table.freeze({ maxStack = definition.maxStack, equipmentSlot = equipmentSlot })
	end
	if count == 0 then
		return nil, "invalid_definitions"
	end
	return table.freeze({
		capacity = capacity,
		definitions = table.freeze(copied),
		slots = table.freeze({}) :: { [number]: Stack },
		equipmentSlots = table.freeze(allowed),
		equipped = table.freeze({}) :: { [string]: number },
	}), nil
end

function Inventory.count(state: State, itemId: string): (number?, string?)
	if not identifier(itemId) or not state.definitions[itemId] then
		return nil, "unknown_item"
	end
	local total = 0
	for _, stack in state.slots do
		if stack.itemId == itemId then
			total += stack.quantity
		end
	end
	return total, nil
end

function Inventory.list(state: State): { Entry }
	local entries: { Entry } = {}
	for slot = 1, state.capacity do
		local stack = state.slots[slot]
		if stack then
			table.insert(entries, table.freeze({ slot = slot, itemId = stack.itemId, quantity = stack.quantity }))
		end
	end
	return table.freeze(entries)
end

function Inventory.add(state: State, itemId: string, quantity: number): (State?, string?)
	local problem = itemError(state, itemId, quantity)
	if problem then
		return nil, problem
	end
	local limit = state.definitions[itemId].maxStack
	local space = 0
	for slot = 1, state.capacity do
		local stack = state.slots[slot]
		if not stack then
			space += limit
		elseif stack.itemId == itemId then
			space += limit - stack.quantity
		end
	end
	if quantity > space then
		return nil, "inventory_full"
	end
	local slots = table.clone(state.slots)
	local remaining = quantity
	-- Existing matching stacks take priority over empty slots.
	for slot = 1, state.capacity do
		local stack = slots[slot]
		if stack and stack.itemId == itemId and remaining > 0 then
			local added = math.min(remaining, limit - stack.quantity)
			slots[slot] = table.freeze({ itemId = itemId, quantity = stack.quantity + added })
			remaining -= added
		end
	end
	for slot = 1, state.capacity do
		if not slots[slot] and remaining > 0 then
			local added = math.min(remaining, limit)
			slots[slot] = table.freeze({ itemId = itemId, quantity = added })
			remaining -= added
		end
	end
	return updated(state, slots, nil), nil
end

function Inventory.remove(state: State, itemId: string, quantity: number): (State?, string?)
	local problem = itemError(state, itemId, quantity)
	if problem then
		return nil, problem
	end
	local total = Inventory.count(state, itemId)
	if total == nil or total < quantity then
		return nil, "insufficient_items"
	end
	local slots = table.clone(state.slots)
	local equipped = table.clone(state.equipped)
	local remaining = quantity
	for slot = 1, state.capacity do
		local stack = slots[slot]
		if stack and stack.itemId == itemId and remaining > 0 then
			local removed = math.min(remaining, stack.quantity)
			remaining -= removed
			if removed == stack.quantity then
				slots[slot] = nil
				for name, equippedSlot in equipped do
					if equippedSlot == slot then
						equipped[name] = nil
					end
				end
			else
				slots[slot] = table.freeze({ itemId = itemId, quantity = stack.quantity - removed })
			end
		end
	end
	return updated(state, slots, equipped), nil
end

function Inventory.move(state: State, from: number, to: number): (State?, string?)
	if not integer(from, 1, state.capacity) or not integer(to, 1, state.capacity) then
		return nil, "invalid_slot"
	end
	local source = state.slots[from]
	if not source then
		return nil, "empty_slot"
	end
	if from == to then
		return state, nil
	end
	local target = state.slots[to]
	if target then
		if target.itemId ~= source.itemId then
			return nil, "incompatible_target"
		end
		if target.quantity + source.quantity > state.definitions[source.itemId].maxStack then
			return nil, "stack_full"
		end
	end
	local slots = table.clone(state.slots)
	local equipped = table.clone(state.equipped)
	slots[from] = nil
	slots[to] = if target then table.freeze({ itemId = source.itemId, quantity = target.quantity + source.quantity }) else source
	for name, slot in equipped do
		if slot == from then
			equipped[name] = to
		end
	end
	return updated(state, slots, equipped), nil
end

function Inventory.equip(state: State, slot: number): (State?, string?)
	if not integer(slot, 1, state.capacity) then
		return nil, "invalid_slot"
	end
	local stack = state.slots[slot]
	if not stack then
		return nil, "empty_slot"
	end
	local name = state.definitions[stack.itemId].equipmentSlot
	if not name then
		return nil, "not_equippable"
	end
	local equipped = table.clone(state.equipped)
	equipped[name] = slot
	return updated(state, nil, equipped), nil
end

function Inventory.unequip(state: State, name: string): (State?, string?)
	if not identifier(name) or not state.equipmentSlots[name] then
		return nil, "invalid_equipment_slot"
	end
	local equipped = table.clone(state.equipped)
	equipped[name] = nil
	return updated(state, nil, equipped), nil
end

function Inventory.getEquipped(state: State, name: string): (Stack?, string?)
	if not identifier(name) or not state.equipmentSlots[name] then
		return nil, "invalid_equipment_slot"
	end
	local slot = state.equipped[name]
	return if slot then state.slots[slot] else nil, nil
end

Inventory.Limits = table.freeze({ capacity = MAX_CAPACITY, quantity = MAX_QUANTITY, identifierLength = 96 })

return table.freeze(Inventory)

--!strict
-- Camera zoom limits for a small creature and a short kick on landing.
-- The standard camera is untouched: the kick is added after it and removed before it on the next frame,
-- so the offset can never feed back into the standard camera and drift.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FeelConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local CameraCfg = FeelConfig.Camera

local BIND_APPLY = "FeelCameraKick"
local BIND_RESTORE = "FeelCameraKickRestore"

local CameraKick = {}

local started = false
local offset = 0 -- spring displacement, 1 = full kick
local speed = 0 -- spring speed
local savedMinZoom: number? = nil
local savedMaxZoom: number? = nil
local cameraBefore: CFrame? = nil -- camera CFrame before our offset
local cameraAfter: CFrame? = nil -- camera CFrame as we left it

-- Exact solution of a damped spring (mass one) over dt; stable for any dt.
local function springStep(x: number, v: number, stiffness: number, ratio: number, dt: number): (number, number)
	if dt <= 0 or stiffness <= 0 then
		return x, v
	end
	local w = math.sqrt(stiffness)
	local z = math.max(ratio, 0)
	if z >= 1 then
		-- critical damping; stronger damping is treated the same
		local e = math.exp(-w * dt)
		local c = v + w * x
		return e * (x + c * dt), e * (v - w * c * dt)
	end
	local wd = w * math.sqrt(1 - z * z)
	local e = math.exp(-z * w * dt)
	local cs = math.cos(wd * dt)
	local sn = math.sin(wd * dt)
	return e * (x * cs + (v + z * w * x) / wd * sn), e * (v * cs - (w * w * x + z * w * v) / wd * sn)
end

-- Undo our offset before the standard camera runs (only if nobody else changed the camera since).
local function restoreCamera()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera and cameraBefore and cameraAfter and camera.CFrame == cameraAfter then
		camera.CFrame = cameraBefore
	end
	cameraBefore = nil
	cameraAfter = nil
end

local function applyKick(dt: number)
	if offset == 0 and speed == 0 then
		return
	end
	offset, speed = springStep(offset, speed, CameraCfg.KickStiffness, CameraCfg.KickDamping, dt)
	-- rest: a quarter of the smallest visible kick
	local rest = CameraCfg.KickMinIntensity * 0.5 * 0.5
	local w = math.sqrt(math.max(CameraCfg.KickStiffness, 0))
	local speedTerm = if w > 0 then math.abs(speed) / w else 0
	if math.abs(offset) <= rest and speedTerm <= rest then
		offset = 0
		speed = 0
		return
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera == nil then
		return
	end
	local before = camera.CFrame
	local moved = (before + Vector3.new(0, -CameraCfg.KickDown * offset, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(CameraCfg.KickTilt * offset), 0, 0)
	camera.CFrame = moved
	cameraBefore = before
	cameraAfter = camera.CFrame
end

function CameraKick.Start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true
	offset = 0
	speed = 0
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	if player then
		savedMinZoom = player.CameraMinZoomDistance
		savedMaxZoom = player.CameraMaxZoomDistance
		-- set the wider side first so the pair is never inverted
		if CameraCfg.MinZoom > player.CameraMaxZoomDistance then
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = CameraCfg.MaxZoom
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = CameraCfg.MinZoom
		else
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = CameraCfg.MinZoom
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = CameraCfg.MaxZoom
		end
	end
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND_RESTORE, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, restoreCamera)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND_APPLY, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, applyKick)
end

function CameraKick.Stop()
	if not started then
		return
	end
	started = false
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_APPLY)
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_RESTORE)
	restoreCamera()
	offset = 0
	speed = 0
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	if player and savedMinZoom and savedMaxZoom then
		if savedMinZoom > player.CameraMaxZoomDistance then
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = savedMaxZoom
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = savedMinZoom
		else
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = savedMinZoom
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = savedMaxZoom
		end
	end
	savedMinZoom = nil
	savedMaxZoom = nil
end

function CameraKick.Kick(intensity: number)
	if not started or type(intensity) ~= "number" or intensity ~= intensity then
		return
	end
	local power = math.clamp(intensity, 0, 1)
	if power < CameraCfg.KickMinIntensity then
		return
	end
	-- a new kick replaces the rebound speed; displacement adds up but never exceeds a full kick
	offset = math.min(math.max(offset, 0) + power, 1)
	speed = 0
end

return CameraKick
