--!strict

local Progression = {}

export type Rewards = { [number]: { [string]: number } }
export type State = { read experience: number, read level: number, read thresholds: { number }, read rewards: Rewards }
export type Grant = { read level: number, read id: string, read amount: number }
export type Award = { read state: State, read gainedLevels: { number }, read rewards: { Grant }, read acceptedExperience: number }

local MAX_EXPERIENCE = 1000000000

local function integer(value: unknown, minimum: number, maximum: number): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= minimum and value <= maximum and value % 1 == 0
end

function Progression.create(thresholds: { number }, rewards: Rewards?): (State?, string?)
	if typeof(thresholds) ~= "table" or (rewards ~= nil and typeof(rewards) ~= "table") then
		return nil, "invalid_configuration"
	end
	local count = 0
	for index in thresholds do
		count += 1
		if not integer(index, 1, 1000) or count > 1000 then
			return nil, "invalid_curve"
		end
	end
	if count == 0 or thresholds[1] ~= 0 then
		return nil, "invalid_curve"
	end
	local copied: { number } = {}
	local previous = -1
	for level = 1, count do
		local threshold = thresholds[level]
		if not integer(threshold, 0, MAX_EXPERIENCE) or threshold <= previous then
			return nil, "invalid_curve"
		end
		copied[level] = threshold
		previous = threshold
	end
	local copiedRewards: Rewards = {}
	for level, levelRewards in rewards or {} do
		if not integer(level, 2, count) or typeof(levelRewards) ~= "table" then
			return nil, "invalid_reward"
		end
		local rewardCount = 0
		local entries: { [string]: number } = {}
		for id, amount in levelRewards do
			rewardCount += 1
			if typeof(id) ~= "string" or #id == 0 or #id > 96 or not integer(amount, 1, MAX_EXPERIENCE) or rewardCount > 64 then
				return nil, "invalid_reward"
			end
			entries[id] = amount
		end
		copiedRewards[level] = table.freeze(entries)
	end
	return table.freeze({ experience = 0, level = 1, thresholds = table.freeze(copied), rewards = table.freeze(copiedRewards) }), nil
end

function Progression.award(state: State, amount: number): (Award?, string?)
	if not integer(amount, 0, MAX_EXPERIENCE) then
		return nil, "invalid_experience"
	end
	local experience = math.min(state.experience + amount, state.thresholds[#state.thresholds])
	local level = state.level
	local gained: { number } = {}
	local grants: { Grant } = {}
	while level < #state.thresholds and experience >= state.thresholds[level + 1] do
		level += 1
		table.insert(gained, level)
		local levelRewards = state.rewards[level]
		if levelRewards then
			-- Sort IDs so reward delivery has a reproducible order.
			local ids: { string } = {}
			for id in levelRewards do
				table.insert(ids, id)
			end
			table.sort(ids)
			for _, id in ids do
				table.insert(grants, table.freeze({ level = level, id = id, amount = levelRewards[id] }))
			end
		end
	end
	local nextState = table.freeze({ experience = experience, level = level, thresholds = state.thresholds, rewards = state.rewards })
	return table.freeze({
		state = nextState,
		gainedLevels = table.freeze(gained),
		rewards = table.freeze(grants),
		acceptedExperience = experience - state.experience,
	}), nil
end

function Progression.toNextLevel(state: State): number
	local nextThreshold = state.thresholds[state.level + 1]
	return if nextThreshold then nextThreshold - state.experience else 0
end

Progression.Limits = table.freeze({ levels = 1000, experience = MAX_EXPERIENCE, rewardsPerLevel = 64 })

return table.freeze(Progression)

--!strict

local Core = require("@verify/src/core")
local Lute = require("@verify/src/lute")
local Evidence = require("@verify/src/evidence")
local Files = require("../tools/facet/lib/files")
local Hash = require("../tools/facet/lib/hash")
local Json = require("../tools/facet/lib/json")
local PowerShell = require("@verify/src/lute/powershell")
local Run = require("../tools/facet/lib/run")
local system = require("@std/system")

local SAVE = [[
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type @'
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class SealWindow {
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr window);
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsIconic(IntPtr window);
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr window, int command);
	[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern void keybd_event(byte key, byte scan, uint flags, UIntPtr extra);
}
'@
$place = '%s'
$studio = Get-Process -Id %d
$window = $studio.MainWindowHandle
if ($window -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { throw 'the kept Studio has no main window' }
$before = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).LastWriteTimeUtc
if ([SealWindow]::IsIconic($window)) { [void][SealWindow]::ShowWindow($window, 3) }
$attempt = 0
while ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).LastWriteTimeUtc -le $before) {
	$attempt += 1
	if ($attempt -gt 5) { throw 'Studio did not save the place' }
	$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10)
	while ([SealWindow]::GetForegroundWindow() -ne $window) {
		if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw 'the kept Studio did not take focus' }
		[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x12, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
		[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x12, 0, 2, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
		[void][SealWindow]::SetForegroundWindow($window)
		Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
	}
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x11, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x53, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x53, 0, 2, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	[SealWindow]::keybd_event(0x11, 0, 2, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
	$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(30)
	while (((Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).LastWriteTimeUtc -le $before) -and ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)) {
		Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
	}
}
$size = -1
while ($size -ne (Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).Length) {
	$size = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $place).Length
	Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
}
]]

local SAVE_MACOS = [[
place="$1"
pid="$2"
before=$(stat -f %m "$place") || exit 1
attempt=0
while [ "$(stat -f %m "$place")" -le "$before" ]; do
	attempt=$((attempt + 1))
	if [ "$attempt" -gt 5 ]; then
		echo "Studio did not save the place" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	osascript \
		-e 'on run argv' \
		-e 'tell application "System Events"' \
		-e 'set kept to first process whose unix id is ((item 1 of argv) as integer)' \
		-e 'set frontmost of kept to true' \
		-e 'delay 0.5' \
		-e 'if not (frontmost of kept) then error "the kept Studio did not take focus"' \
		-e 'keystroke "s" using command down' \
		-e 'end tell' \
		-e 'end run' "$pid" || exit 1
	waited=0
	while [ "$(stat -f %m "$place")" -le "$before" ] && [ "$waited" -lt 120 ]; do
		sleep 0.25
		waited=$((waited + 1))
	done
done
size=-1
while [ "$size" != "$(stat -f %z "$place")" ]; do
	size=$(stat -f %z "$place")
	sleep 1
done
]]

export type Platform = "windows" | "macos" | "other"

local function platform(): Platform
	if system.win32 then
		return "windows"
	end
	return if system.macos then "macos" else "other"
end

local function saveCommand(on: Platform, place: string, pid: number): { string }
	if on == "windows" then
		return PowerShell.command(SAVE:format(string.gsub(string.gsub(place, "/", "\\"), "'", "''"), pid))
	elseif on == "macos" then
		return { "/bin/sh", "-c", SAVE_MACOS, "seal", place, tostring(pid) }
	end
	error(
		"this platform has no way to save the kept Studio place. Save it in Studio, then run facetbench snapshot --place PATH",
		0
	)
end

local function save(evidence: string): string
	local kept = Json.decode(Files.read(evidence .. "/studio-place.json"))
	local place = Files.absolute((assert(Json.stringField(kept, "place"), "the kept Studio has no place")))
	local pid = assert(Json.numberField(kept, "pid"), "the kept Studio has no process")
	local on = platform()
	local saved = Run.capture(saveCommand(on, place, pid))
	if not saved.ok and on == "macos" then
		error(
			"could not save the kept Studio place: "
				.. saved.stderr
				.. saved.stdout
				.. "\nSystem Events sends the Command-S. Allow the program that runs lute under Privacy & Security, Accessibility, "
				.. "or save the place in the kept Studio and run facetbench snapshot --place PATH. The author's place is not changed by a failed save.",
			0
		)
	end
	assert(saved.ok, "could not save the kept Studio place: " .. saved.stderr .. saved.stdout)
	return place
end

local function read(directory: string): Core.Report
	local envelope = Lute.parse(Files.read(directory .. "/submission.verify.json"))
	return Core.decode(Json.field(envelope, "report"))
end

local function subject(report: Core.Report): Core.ArtifactProvenance
	assert(report.total == 1 and report.passed == 1, "submission capture did not pass")
	local evidence = report.results[1].evidence
	assert(evidence and #evidence.checkpoints == 1, "submission checkpoint is missing")
	local artifact = evidence.checkpoints[1].artifacts[1]
	assert(artifact and artifact.provenance, "submission provenance is missing")
	return artifact.provenance
end

local function validate(place: string?, directory: string): Core.Report
	return Core.runCases({
		{
			id = "submission/unchanged",
			name = "submission/unchanged",
			timeoutSeconds = 120,
			run = function(t: Core.Context)
				local saved = read(directory)
				local provenance = subject(saved)
				local verified = Lute.evidenceStore.validate(saved, {
					runId = provenance.runId,
					build = { digest = provenance.build.digest },
					requireClean = false,
					directory = directory .. "/objects",
					maxAgeSeconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
					required = {
						{
							caseId = "submission/capture",
							actors = { "author" },
							checkpoints = { "place" },
							devices = { "studio" },
						},
					},
				})
				t:expect(verified.ok):toBeTrueWith(Evidence.explain(verified))
				t:expect(Hash.sha256(Files.read(directory .. "/game.rbxl"))):toBe(provenance.build.digest)
				if place ~= nil then
					t:expect(Hash.sha256(Files.read(place))):toBe(provenance.build.digest)
				end
			end,
		},
	}, { executor = "submission-integrity" }, os.clock)
end

local function capture(place: string, directory: string, runId: string): Core.Report
	place, directory = Files.absolute(place), Files.absolute(directory)
	assert(Files.isFile(place), "save the authored Studio place before capturing it")
	assert(
		string.sub(string.lower(place), 1, #directory + 1) ~= string.lower(directory) .. "/",
		"capture needs the saved original place"
	)
	if Files.exists(directory .. "/submission.verify.json") then
		return validate(place, directory)
	end
	assert(not Files.exists(directory), "an incomplete snapshot already exists; do not replace submitted bytes")
	local bytes = Files.read(place)
	assert(
		string.sub(bytes, 1, 8) == "<roblox!" or string.find(bytes, "<roblox", 1, true) ~= nil,
		"submission is not a Roblox place"
	)
	local digest = Hash.sha256(bytes)
	local report = Core.runCases({
		{
			id = "submission/capture",
			name = "submission/capture",
			run = function(t: Core.Context)
				t:checkpoint("author", "place")
			end,
		},
	}, {
		executor = "submission-place",
		capabilities = { "capture" },
		bind = function(): Core.CaseHost
			return {
				name = "submission-place",
				capabilities = { "capture" },
				environment = {},
				now = os.clock,
				invoke = function(): unknown
					return nil
				end,
				capture = function(): { Core.Artifact }
					return { { name = "game.rbxl", reference = place, mediaType = "application/octet-stream" } }
				end,
			}
		end,
	}, os.clock)
	local sealed = Lute.evidenceStore.seal(report, {
		runId = runId,
		device = "studio",
		directory = directory .. "/objects",
		build = { commit = "unversioned", tree = digest, clean = false, digest = digest },
	})
	assert(#sealed.issues == 0, "Verify could not seal the place: " .. Lute.encode(sealed.issues))
	local evidence = assert(sealed.report.results[1].evidence)
	local store = Lute.evidenceStore.localDirectory(directory .. "/objects")
	local frozen, problem = store.get(evidence.checkpoints[1].artifacts[1].reference)
	assert(frozen, problem or "sealed place is unavailable")
	assert(Hash.sha256(Files.read(place)) == digest, "the place changed while capturing the submission")
	assert(Hash.sha256(frozen) == digest, "the frozen place differs from the submission")
	Files.write(directory .. "/game.rbxl", frozen)
	Lute.gate.writeReport(directory .. "/submission.verify.json", runId, sealed.report)
	return validate(place, directory)
end

local function seal(evidence: string, runId: string): Core.Report
	local directory = evidence .. "/submission"
	if Files.exists(directory .. "/submission.verify.json") then
		return validate(nil, directory)
	end
	return capture(save(evidence), directory, runId)
end

return { capture = capture, validate = validate, seal = seal, saveCommand = saveCommand, platform = platform }

--!strict
-- Pool of local station elements (contract "Dynamics v1", D7.3). Client only; the server never sees these parts.
-- Shapes: "Block", "Ball" (ellipsoid: block + sphere mesh, any size), "Cylinder" (Roblox cylinder, axis along X),
-- or a ReplicatedStorage.ModelTemplates name (MeshPart clone; missing template -> Block).
-- Acquire returns a part with Parent = nil: the caller positions, colours and parents it (Workspace.StationVisuals.*).
-- Create parts only from a mechanic's Setup, never in an animation frame.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ModelVisuals = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("ModelVisuals"))

local ElementPool = {}

local MIN_SIZE = 0.05 -- smallest element side, studs (guards bad sizes)
local DEFAULT_COLOR = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local DEFAULT_MATERIAL = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

local free: { [string]: { BasePart } } = {} -- pool key -> hidden parts
local keyOf: { [BasePart]: string } = {} -- every part made here -> its pool key
local liveSet: { [BasePart]: boolean } = {}
local liveCount = 0
local freeCount = 0
local createdCount = 0
local warned: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local function warnOnce(key: string, message: string)
	if warned[key] then
		return
	end
	warned[key] = true
	warn("[ElementPool] " .. message)
end

local function cleanSize(size: Vector3): Vector3
	local function axis(n: number): number
		if n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then
			return MIN_SIZE
		end
		return math.max(n, MIN_SIZE)
	end
	return Vector3.new(axis(size.X), axis(size.Y), axis(size.Z))
end

-- Local-only part flags (D7 intro).
local function applyFlags(part: BasePart)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Massless = true
end

local function makePrimitive(shape: string): BasePart
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if shape == "Cylinder" then
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	elseif shape == "Ball" then
		-- a Ball part is forced to a uniform size; a sphere mesh fills any box (bubbles, domes)
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
		mesh.Parent = part
	else
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	end
	return part
end

-- Returns the pool key and a new part for that shape.
local function create(shape: string): (string, BasePart)
	if shape == "Block" or shape == "Ball" or shape == "Cylinder" then
		return shape, makePrimitive(shape)
	end
	local template = ModelVisuals.GetTemplate(shape)
	if template then
		local clone = template:Clone()
		for _, child in clone:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("BaseScript") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		return shape, clone
	end
	warnOnce("template:" .. shape, "no ModelTemplates." .. shape .. ", using Block")
	return "Block", makePrimitive("Block")
end

local function resetLook(part: BasePart)
	part.Parent = nil
	part.Color = DEFAULT_COLOR
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
	part.Reflectance = 0
	if not part:IsA("MeshPart") then
		part.Material = DEFAULT_MATERIAL
	end
	local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
	if mesh then
		mesh.Scale = Vector3.one
		mesh.Offset = Vector3.zero
	end
end

function ElementPool.Acquire(shape: string, size: Vector3): BasePart
	local wanted = if type(shape) == "string" and shape ~= "" then shape else "Block"
	-- a missing template is pooled as Block; reuse that list directly
	local key = wanted
	if wanted ~= "Block" and wanted ~= "Ball" and wanted ~= "Cylinder" and not ModelVisuals.GetTemplate(wanted) then
		key = "Block"
	end
	local list = free[key]
	local part: BasePart
	if list and #list > 0 then
		part = table.remove(list) :: BasePart
		freeCount -= 1
	else
		local madeKey, made = create(wanted)
		key = madeKey
		part = made
		keyOf[part] = key
		createdCount += 1
		applyFlags(part)
	end
	part.Size = cleanSize(size)
	liveSet[part] = true
	liveCount += 1
	return part
end

function ElementPool.Release(part: BasePart)
	local key = keyOf[part]
	if key == nil then
		warnOnce("foreign", "Release of a part the pool did not make: " .. part:GetFullName())
		return
	end
	if not liveSet[part] then
		return -- already free
	end
	liveSet[part] = nil
	liveCount -= 1
	resetLook(part)
	applyFlags(part)
	local list = free[key]
	if list == nil then
		list = {}
		free[key] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, part)
	freeCount += 1
end

function ElementPool.GetStats(): { live: number, free: number, created: number }
	return { live = liveCount, free = freeCount, created = createdCount }
end

-- Destroys every part the pool made (live ones too). Call only after every mechanic tore down.
function ElementPool.Clear()
	for part in keyOf do
		part:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(free)
	table.clear(keyOf)
	table.clear(liveSet)
	liveCount = 0
	freeCount = 0
	createdCount = 0
end

return ElementPool

--!strict

local Inventory = require("../packages/inventory/src/Inventory")
local Progression = require("../packages/progression/src/Progression")
local Combat = require("../packages/combat/src/Combat")
local Economy = require("../packages/economy/src/Economy")

local passed = 0
local failed = 0
local function test(name: string, body: () -> ())
	local ok, message = pcall(body)
	if ok then
		passed += 1
		print("PASS", name)
	else
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message))
	end
end

local function bag(capacity: number?): Inventory.State
	local state, problem = Inventory.create(capacity or 4, {
		ore = { maxStack = 10 },
		sword = { maxStack = 1, equipmentSlot = "hand" },
		hat = { maxStack = 1, equipmentSlot = "head" },
	}, { hand = true, head = true })
	assert(state, problem)
	return state
end

test("inventory fills matching stacks before empty slots", function()
	local first = Inventory.add(bag(), "ore", 12)
	assert(first)
	local moved = Inventory.move(first, 1, 3)
	assert(moved)
	local added = Inventory.add(moved, "ore", 5)
	assert(added)
	assert(added.slots[1] == nil and added.slots[2].quantity == 7 and added.slots[3].quantity == 10)
	assert(Inventory.count(added, "ore") == 17)
end)

test("full inventory rejects the entire addition", function()
	local original = Inventory.add(bag(1), "ore", 8)
	assert(original)
	local result, problem = Inventory.add(original, "ore", 3)
	assert(result == nil and problem == "inventory_full")
	assert(original.slots[1].quantity == 8)
end)

test("remove crosses stacks and rejects insufficient items", function()
	local original = Inventory.add(bag(), "ore", 15)
	assert(original)
	local removed = Inventory.remove(original, "ore", 12)
	assert(removed and removed.slots[1] == nil and removed.slots[2].quantity == 3)
	local rejected, problem = Inventory.remove(removed, "ore", 4)
	assert(rejected == nil and problem == "insufficient_items")
	assert(Inventory.count(original, "ore") == 15 and Inventory.count(removed, "ore") == 3)
end)

test("move merges completely or leaves state unchanged", function()
	local original = Inventory.add(bag(), "ore", 15)
	assert(original)
	local rejected, problem = Inventory.move(original, 2, 1)
	assert(rejected == nil and problem == "stack_full")
	local reduced = Inventory.remove(original, "ore", 8)
	assert(reduced)
	local merged = Inventory.move(reduced, 1, 2)
	assert(merged and merged.slots[2].quantity == 7 and merged.slots[1] == nil)
	assert(Inventory.count(original, "ore") == 15)
end)

test("equipment follows a moved stack and clears on removal", function()
	local original = Inventory.add(bag(), "sword", 1)
	assert(original)
	local equipped = Inventory.equip(original, 1)
	assert(equipped and equipped.equipped.hand == 1)
	local moved = Inventory.move(equipped, 1, 4)
	assert(moved and moved.equipped.hand == 4)
	local removed = Inventory.remove(moved, "sword", 1)
	assert(removed and removed.equipped.hand == nil)
	assert(equipped.equipped.hand == 1)
end)

test("equipment replaces a slot without deleting owned items", function()
	local original = Inventory.add(bag(), "sword", 2)
	assert(original)
	local first = Inventory.equip(original, 1)
	assert(first)
	local second = Inventory.equip(first, 2)
	assert(second and second.equipped.hand == 2 and Inventory.count(second, "sword") == 2)
	local cleared = Inventory.unequip(second, "hand")
	assert(cleared and Inventory.getEquipped(cleared, "hand") == nil)
	local invalid, problem = Inventory.unequip(second, "back")
	assert(invalid == nil and problem == "invalid_equipment_slot")
end)

test("inventory rejects invalid values, indexes and definitions", function()
	local state = bag()
	for _, amount in { 0, -1, 1.5, 0 / 0, math.huge } do
		local result, problem = Inventory.add(state, "ore", amount)
		assert(result == nil and problem == "invalid_quantity")
	end
	assert(Inventory.add(state, "missing", 1) == nil)
	assert(Inventory.move(state, 0, 1) == nil)
	assert(Inventory.equip(state, 1) == nil)
	assert(Inventory.create(0, { ore = { maxStack = 10 } }) == nil)
	assert(Inventory.create(1, { sword = { maxStack = 2, equipmentSlot = "hand" } }, { hand = true }) == nil)
end)

test("inventory state and configuration are isolated and immutable", function()
	local definitions = { ore = { maxStack = 10 } }
	local state = Inventory.create(2, definitions)
	assert(state)
	definitions.ore.maxStack = 100
	local added = Inventory.add(state, "ore", 12)
	assert(added and added.slots[1].quantity == 10 and next(state.slots) == nil)
	assert(table.isfrozen(added) and table.isfrozen(added.slots) and table.isfrozen(added.slots[1]))
	local entries = Inventory.list(added)
	assert(#entries == 2 and entries[1].slot == 1 and entries[2].slot == 2)
end)

test("progression crosses exact and multiple level thresholds", function()
	local state = Progression.create({ 0, 100, 250, 500 }, { [2] = { coins = 5 }, [3] = { coins = 10 } })
	assert(state)
	local exact = Progression.award(state, 100)
	assert(exact and exact.state.level == 2 and #exact.rewards == 1 and exact.rewards[1].amount == 5)
	local multiple = Progression.award(state, 300)
	assert(multiple and multiple.state.level == 3 and #multiple.gainedLevels == 2 and #multiple.rewards == 2)
	assert(Progression.toNextLevel(multiple.state) == 200 and state.level == 1)
end)

test("progression caps experience and does not repeat earned rewards", function()
	local state = Progression.create({ 0, 100 }, { [2] = { coins = 5 } })
	assert(state)
	local capped = Progression.award(state, 1000)
	assert(capped and capped.state.experience == 100 and capped.acceptedExperience == 100)
	local again = Progression.award(capped.state, 50)
	assert(again and #again.rewards == 0 and #again.gainedLevels == 0 and Progression.toNextLevel(again.state) == 0)
end)

test("progression validates curves, rewards and experience", function()
	assert(Progression.create({ 1, 100 }) == nil)
	assert(Progression.create({ 0, 100, 100 }) == nil)
	assert(Progression.create({ [1] = 0, [3] = 100 }) == nil)
	assert(Progression.create({ 0, 100 }, { [1] = { coins = 1 } }) == nil)
	assert(Progression.create({ 0, 100 }, { [2] = { coins = -1 } }) == nil)
	local state = Progression.create({ 0, 100 })
	assert(state)
	for _, amount in { -1, 0.5, 0 / 0, math.huge } do
		assert(Progression.award(state, amount) == nil)
	end
end)

test("progression copies configuration and orders reward IDs", function()
	local curve = { 0, 100 }
	local rewards = { [2] = { z = 2, a = 1 } }
	local state = Progression.create(curve, rewards)
	assert(state)
	curve[2] = 200
	rewards[2].a = 99
	local award = Progression.award(state, 100)
	assert(award and award.state.level == 2 and award.rewards[1].id == "a" and award.rewards[1].amount == 1)
end)

test("combat applies reductions then multiplier and shield", function()
	local target = Combat.create(100, 20)
	assert(target)
	local result = Combat.damage(target, 30, { flatReduction = 5, multiplier = 2 })
	assert(result and result.absorbed == 20 and result.healthDamage == 30 and result.state.health == 70)
	assert(target.health == 100 and target.shield == 20)
end)

test("combat rejects denied attacks and supports shield piercing", function()
	local target = Combat.create(100, 20)
	assert(target)
	local denied, problem = Combat.damage(target, 10, { canDamage = false })
	assert(denied == nil and problem == "damage_denied")
	local piercing = Combat.damage(target, 10, { shieldPiercing = true })
	assert(piercing and piercing.state.health == 90 and piercing.state.shield == 20)
	local blocked = Combat.damage(target, 10, { flatReduction = 100 })
	assert(blocked and blocked.healthDamage == 0 and blocked.absorbed == 0)
end)

test("combat bounds health and refuses damage/healing after death", function()
	local target = Combat.create(100)
	assert(target)
	local lethal = Combat.damage(target, 1000)
	assert(lethal and lethal.killed and lethal.state.health == 0 and lethal.healthDamage == 100)
	assert(Combat.damage(lethal.state, 1) == nil and Combat.heal(lethal.state, 1) == nil)
	local wounded = Combat.damage(target, 30)
	assert(wounded)
	local healed = Combat.heal(wounded.state, 1000)
	assert(healed and healed.health == 100)
end)

test("combat rejects non-finite values and invalid rules", function()
	assert(Combat.create(0) == nil and Combat.create(math.huge) == nil)
	local target = Combat.create(100)
	assert(target)
	for _, amount in { -1, 0, 0 / 0, math.huge } do
		assert(Combat.damage(target, amount) == nil)
	end
	assert(Combat.damage(target, 10, { multiplier = -1 }) == nil)
	assert(Combat.damage(target, 10, { flatReduction = 0 / 0 }) == nil)
end)

test("economy credits and debits bounded integer balances", function()
	local wallet = Economy.create(100, 200)
	assert(wallet)
	local credited = Economy.credit(wallet, 50)
	assert(credited and credited.balance == 150)
	local debited = Economy.debit(credited, 25)
	assert(debited and debited.balance == 125 and wallet.balance == 100)
	local overflow, overflowError = Economy.credit(credited, 51)
	assert(overflow == nil and overflowError == "balance_limit")
	local overdraft, overdraftError = Economy.debit(wallet, 101)
	assert(overdraft == nil and overdraftError == "insufficient_funds")
end)

test("economy rejects invalid money and shop configuration", function()
	assert(Economy.create(0.5) == nil and Economy.create(-1) == nil)
	local wallet = Economy.create(100)
	assert(wallet)
	for _, amount in { -1, 0.5, 0 / 0, math.huge } do
		assert(Economy.credit(wallet, amount) == nil and Economy.debit(wallet, amount) == nil)
	end
	assert(Economy.createCatalogue({ ore = { itemId = "ore", price = -1 } }) == nil)
	assert(Economy.createCatalogue({ ore = { itemId = "ore", price = 1.5 } }) == nil)
end)

test("purchase returns consistent new wallet and inventory", function()
	local original = bag()
	local wallet = Economy.create(100)
	local catalogue = Economy.createCatalogue({ ore = { itemId = "ore", price = 7, maxQuantity = 5 } })
	assert(wallet and catalogue)
	local result, problem = Economy.purchase(wallet, original, catalogue, "ore", 3, Inventory.add)
	assert(result, problem)
	assert(result.totalCost == 21 and result.wallet.balance == 79 and Inventory.count(result.inventory, "ore") == 3)
	assert(wallet.balance == 100 and Inventory.count(original, "ore") == 0)
end)

test("failed purchase leaves both original states unchanged", function()
	local original = Inventory.add(bag(1), "ore", 10)
	local wallet = Economy.create(100)
	local catalogue = Economy.createCatalogue({ ore = { itemId = "ore", price = 7 } })
	assert(original and wallet and catalogue)
	local result, problem = Economy.purchase(wallet, original, catalogue, "ore", 1, Inventory.add)
	assert(result == nil and problem == "inventory_full")
	assert(wallet.balance == 100 and Inventory.count(original, "ore") == 10)
end)

test("shop rejects unowned offers, excessive quantity and insufficient funds", function()
	local original = bag()
	local wallet = Economy.create(5)
	local catalogue = Economy.createCatalogue({ ore = { itemId = "ore", price = 7, maxQuantity = 2 } })
	assert(wallet and catalogue)
	assert(Economy.purchase(wallet, original, catalogue, "missing", 1, Inventory.add) == nil)
	assert(Economy.purchase(wallet, original, catalogue, "ore", 3, Inventory.add) == nil)
	local result, problem = Economy.purchase(wallet, original, catalogue, "ore", 1, Inventory.add)
	assert(result == nil and problem == "insufficient_funds")
end)

test("shop snapshots prices, permits free offers and avoids unsafe totals", function()
	local offers = { ore = { itemId = "ore", price = 0, maxQuantity = 2 } }
	local catalogue = Economy.createCatalogue(offers)
	local wallet = Economy.create(0)
	assert(catalogue and wallet)
	offers.ore.price = 999
	local result = Economy.purchase(wallet, bag(), catalogue, "ore", 2, Inventory.add)
	assert(result and result.wallet.balance == 0 and Inventory.count(result.inventory, "ore") == 2)
	local expensive = Economy.createCatalogue({ ore = { itemId = "ore", price = 1000000000 } })
	assert(expensive)
	assert(Economy.purchase(wallet, bag(), expensive, "ore", 1000000, Inventory.add) == nil)
end)

print(string.format("%d passed, %d failed", passed, failed))
if failed > 0 then
	error("Behaviour checks failed")
end

--!strict

local fs = require("@std/fs")
local process = require("@std/process")
local Audit = require("@verify/src/roblox/ui-audit")
local Core = require("@verify/src/core")
local Lute = require("@verify/src/lute")
local Actions = require("../../../../tools/play/host/actions")
local Check = require("../../../../tools/play/host/check")
local Play = require("../../../../tools/play/host/play")
local QA = require("../../../../tools/play/host/qa")
local Space = require("../../../../tools/play/host/space")

local routes = {
	{ "shop", "Shop", "Store" },
	{ "garage", "Garage", "Karts" },
	{ "inventory", "Inventory", "Parts" },
	{ "drivers", "Drivers", "Driver" },
	{ "crates", "Crates", "Crate" },
	{ "daily-rewards", "Daily Rewards", "Daily", "Rewards" },
	{ "codes", "Codes", "Redeem" },
	{ "settings", "Settings", "Options" },
	{ "boosts", "Boosts", "Boost" },
	{ "quests", "Quests", "Missions" },
	{ "offer", "Offer", "Offers" },
	{ "play", "Play", "Race" },
	{ "livery", "Livery", "Customize" },
	{ "track-vote", "Track Vote", "Vote" },
	{ "quick-chat", "Quick Chat", "Chat" },
	{ "upgrades", "Upgrades", "Upgrade" },
	{ "party", "Party", "Friends" },
	{ "tutorial", "Tutorial", "Help" },
}

local function signature(qa: QA.QA): string
	local values = qa:texts()
	for index, value in values do
		values[index] = string.gsub(string.lower(value), "%d+", "#")
	end
	table.sort(values)
	return table.concat(values, "\n")
end

local function stability(qa: QA.QA, context: Core.Context, screen: string)
	local actions: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, action in qa:find({ role = "button" }, 1000) do
		if action.interactable then
			actions[action.path] = true
		end
	end
	qa:call("frameStability", { action = "begin" })
	context:defer(function()
		qa:call("frameStability", { action = "end" })
	end)
	qa:sleep(2)
	local observed = qa:call("frameStability", { action = "end" })
	context:attach(screen .. "-idle-geometry", "application/json", Lute.encode(observed))
	Check.that(context, Check.number(observed, "frames") >= 30, "idle geometry has at least 30 rendered frames")
	local faults = Check.field(observed, "faults")
	assert(type(faults) == "table", "idle geometry needs native observations")
	for _, fault in faults :: { unknown } do
		local path = Check.field(fault, "path")
		assert(type(path) == "string", "idle geometry needs an object path")
		local object = string.gsub(path, "#%d+$", "")
		Check.that(context, actions[object] ~= true, "idle action geometry moved: " .. object)
	end
end

local function observe(qa: QA.QA, context: Core.Context, screen: string)
	qa:dump(screen)
	qa:capture("navigation-" .. screen)
	local output: string? = nil
	for index, word in process.args do
		if word == "--outputs" then
			output = process.args[index + 1]
		end
	end
	assert(output, "navigation observation needs --outputs")
	local dump =
		Audit.decode(Lute.parse(fs.readFileToString(output .. "/dumps/" .. qa.device.id .. "/" .. screen .. ".json")))
	local audit = Audit.analyze(dump, { touch = qa.device.mode == "touch", gamepad = qa.device.mode == "gamepad" })
	context:attach(screen .. "-audit", "application/json", Lute.encode(audit))
	for _, rule in
		{
			"text-truncated",
			"text-clipped",
			"contrast-low",
			"offscreen",
			"outside-safe-area",
			"touch-target-small",
			"interactive-overlap",
			"focus-hidden",
		}
	do
		local summary = audit.rules[rule]
		Check.that(context, summary == nil or summary.count == 0, screen .. ": " .. rule)
	end
	Check.that(context, Space.textClear(dump), "text does not overlap")
	Check.that(context, Space.safeContent(dump), "content clears core UI and cutouts")
	Check.that(context, Space.visibleScrimsCover(dump), "visible scrims cover the screen")
	Check.that(context, Space.selectionValid(dump), "selection is valid")
	for _, element in dump.elements do
		if element.visible and element.text ~= nil and element.text.content ~= "" then
			Check.that(context, element.text.size >= 14, "visible text has a readable size")
		end
	end
	if qa.device.mode == "touch" then
		local controls = qa:call("touchControls")
		Check.that(context, Check.field(controls, "available") == true, "native touch controls are observable")
		local raw = Check.field(controls, "rectangles")
		assert(type(raw) == "table", "native touch rectangles are required")
		local rectangles: { Space.TouchRect } = {}
		for _, item in raw :: { unknown } do
			local path = Check.field(item, "path")
			table.insert(rectangles, {
				path = if type(path) == "string" then path else nil,
				x = Check.number(item, "rect", "x"),
				y = Check.number(item, "rect", "y"),
				width = Check.number(item, "rect", "width"),
				height = Check.number(item, "rect", "height"),
			})
		end
		context:attach(screen .. "-touch-controls", "application/json", Lute.encode(controls))
		Check.that(context, Space.touchControlsClear(dump, rectangles), "content clears actual touch controls")
	end
end

local scenario: Play.Scenario = { sessions = {} }
for _, device in { "desktop", "phone-portrait", "phone-landscape", "tablet", "console" } do
	local cases: { Play.Case } = {}
	for _, route in routes do
		local screen = route[1]
		table.insert(cases, {
			id = "navigation/" .. screen,
			tier = "universal" :: "universal",
			screen = screen,
			shot = "navigation-" .. screen,
			run = function(qa, context)
				local root = Actions.captureRoot(qa)
				context:defer(function()
					local recovered, detail = Actions.returnToRoot(qa, root)
					Check.that(context, recovered, "return after " .. screen .. ": " .. detail)
				end)
				local target: QA.Query? = nil
				for index = 2, #route do
					local candidate: QA.Query = { role = "button", text = string.lower(route[index]) }
					if Actions.reveal(qa, candidate) then
						target = candidate
						break
					end
				end
				Check.that(context, target ~= nil, "a player can discover " .. screen)
				local before = signature(qa)
				Check.tap(qa, context, target :: QA.Query, "open " .. screen)
				local settled = qa:call("perf", { action = "settle", quiet = 0.1, limit = 20 })
				Check.that(context, Check.field(settled, "timedOut") == false, screen .. " settles")
				Check.that(
					context,
					signature(qa) ~= before,
					screen .. " changes visible content beyond a running counter"
				)
				stability(qa, context, screen)
				observe(qa, context, screen)
				local returned, detail = Actions.returnToRoot(qa, root)
				Check.that(context, returned, "return from " .. screen .. ": " .. detail)
				local reachable, reason = Actions.returned(qa, target :: QA.Query, nil, root)
				Check.that(context, reachable, "restore the opener: " .. reason)
			end,
		})
	end
	table.insert(scenario.sessions, { device = device, cases = cases })
end

Play.main(scenario, debug.info(1, "s"))

local FacetTypes = require("../../src")

type FacetModule = FacetTypes.Facet
type FacetControls = FacetTypes.Controls
type ReadOnlyValue<T> = FacetTypes.ReadOnlyValue<T>
type Use = <T>(ReadOnlyValue<T>) -> T
type Item = { id: string, name: string, category: string }
type Model = { items: ReadOnlyValue<{ Item }> }

return function(Facet: FacetModule, UI: FacetControls, model: Model): Instance
	local category = Facet.Compose.cell("all")
	local itemsSpec: FacetTypes.KeyedCollectionSpec<Item, string> = {
		UI.fill(),
		from = function(use: Use)
			local selected = use(category)
			local filtered: { Item } = {}
			for _, item in use(model.items) do
				if selected == "all" or item.category == selected then
					table.insert(filtered, item)
				end
			end
			return filtered
		end,
		key = "id",
		minColumnWidth = 180,
		minColumns = 2,
		itemSize = 80,
		scrollReset = category,
		render = function(current: ReadOnlyValue<Item>): GuiObject
			return UI.Text "ItemName" {
				text = function(use: Use)
					return use(current).name
				end,
				textRole = "heading",
			}
		end,
	}
	local options: { FacetTypes.PickerOption<string> } = {
		{ value = "all", label = "All" },
		{ value = "tools", label = "Tools" },
		{ value = "outfits", label = "Outfits" },
	}
	local pickerSpec: FacetTypes.SinglePickerSpec<string> = {
		label = "Category",
		style = "segmented",
		selected = category,
		options = options,
	}
	return UI.Screen "Categories" {
		padding = "m",
		gap = "m",
		UI.Text "Title" { text = "Collection", textRole = "title" },
		UI.Picker "CategoryTabs"(pickerSpec),
		UI.VirtualGrid "Items"(itemsSpec),
	}
end

--!strict
-- On-screen debug text for the feel experiments. Does nothing unless FeelConfig.Debug.Overlay is true.
-- Lines are given by the loader; this module reads no other module.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local FeelConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))

-- Overlay layout (screen placement of a debug label, not feel numbers).
local MARGIN = 8 -- px from the top-left corner, below the Roblox top bar
local TEXT_SIZE = 14
local BACKGROUND_ALPHA = 0.5
local WIDTH_SCALE = 0.5

local FeelDebug = {}

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local label: TextLabel? = nil
local order: { string } = {}
local lines: { [string]: string } = {}

local function render()
	if not label then
		return
	end
	local parts = table.create(#order)
	for _, key in order do
		table.insert(parts, lines[key])
	end
	label.Text = table.concat(parts, "\n")
end

function FeelDebug.Start()
	if not FeelConfig.Debug.Overlay or gui then
		return
	end
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "FeelDebug"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = false
	screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "Lines"
	text.Active = false
	text.Interactable = false
	text.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(WIDTH_SCALE, 0)
	text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MARGIN, MARGIN)
	text.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = BACKGROUND_ALPHA
	text.BorderSizePixel = 0
	text.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
	text.TextSize = TEXT_SIZE
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	text.TextWrapped = true
	text.Text = ""
	text.Parent = screen

	screen.Parent = playerGui
	gui = screen
	label = text
	render()
end

function FeelDebug.SetLine(key: string, text: string)
	if not FeelConfig.Debug.Overlay then
		return
	end
	if lines[key] == nil then
		table.insert(order, key)
	end
	lines[key] = text
	render()
end

function FeelDebug.Stop()
	if gui then
		gui:Destroy()
	end
	gui = nil
	label = nil
	table.clear(order)
	table.clear(lines)
end

return FeelDebug

--!strict
local FacetTypes = require("../../src")

type Use = FacetTypes.Use
type FacetModule = FacetTypes.Facet
type FacetControls = FacetTypes.Controls
type Result = { ok: boolean, rewards: { string }?, reason: string? }
type Model = { redeem: (code: string) -> Result }

return function(Facet: FacetModule, UI: FacetControls, model: Model): Instance
	local Compose = Facet.Compose
	local code = Compose.cell("")
	local busy = Compose.cell(false)
	local message = Compose.cell("")
	return UI.Screen "CodeRedeem" {
		padding = "m",
		gap = "m",
		UI.Text "Title" { text = "Redeem a code", textRole = "title" },
		UI.TextInput "Code" {
			label = "Code",
			value = code,
			enabled = function(use: Use)
				return not use(busy)
			end,
		},
		UI.Button "Redeem" {
			label = "Redeem",
			appearance = "emphasis",
			busy = busy,
			enabled = function(use: Use)
				return use(code) ~= "" and not use(busy)
			end,
			onActivate = function()
				busy:set(true)
				local result = model.redeem(code:peek())
				message:set(
					if result.ok
						then "Received: " .. table.concat(result.rewards or {}, ", ")
						else result.reason or "Redeem failed"
				)
				busy:set(false)
			end,
		},
		UI.Text "Result" { text = message, textRole = "body", wrap = true },
	}
end

--!strict
-- Catches the local creature touching the ground in the contact frame (or one frame earlier) and reports the force.
-- Main path: ray down while falling (predicts contact). Fallback: Humanoid state Landed.
-- Does not play sound, touch visuals or camera, and ignores other creatures.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local FeelConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local FeelTypes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FeelTypes"))
local Signal = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Signal"))
local SurfaceProbe = require(script.Parent.SurfaceProbe)

type LandingInfo = FeelTypes.LandingInfo
type LandingStats = FeelTypes.LandingStats
type SurfaceHit = FeelTypes.SurfaceHit

local LandingDetector = {}

LandingDetector.Landed = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<LandingInfo>

-- Session state (reset by Start/Stop)
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local character: Model? = nil
local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local root: BasePart? = nil

local frame = 0
local inAir = false
local airStart = 0
local armed = false -- may fire; cleared after one touch, set again by Jumping/Freefall or RearmHeight
local touched = true -- ground contact seen since the last fire (height rearm needs it, so an early fire can't repeat)
local lastFallVy = 0 -- last negative vertical speed while in air
local lastDt = 0 -- last Heartbeat step, for the state path ray length
local wasFalling = false
local lastRayFireAt = -math.huge
local awaitingState = false -- ray fired, waiting for Humanoid Landed (for stateMissed)

-- E4 frame pairing: fire frame vs contact frame
local pendingFireFrame: number? = nil
local pendingContactFrame: number? = nil

local stats = {
	landings = 0,
	byRay = 0,
	byState = 0,
	stateMissed = 0,
	lateFramesMax = 0,
	lateSum = 0,
	lateCount = 0,
	earlyFramesMax = 0,
}

local function bodyHeight(r: BasePart): number
	return r.Size.Y * 0.5 + FeelConfig.Character.HipHeight
end

local function intensityFor(impactSpeed: number): number
	local landing = FeelConfig.Landing
	local span = landing.MaxImpactSpeed - landing.MinImpactSpeed
	if span <= 0 then
		return 1
	end
	return math.clamp((impactSpeed - landing.MinImpactSpeed) / span, 0, 1)
end

-- Returns true when this is a landing by speed and air time
local function passes(impactSpeed: number, airTime: number): boolean
	return impactSpeed >= FeelConfig.Landing.MinImpactSpeed and airTime >= FeelConfig.Landing.MinAirTime
end

local function recordLate(late: number)
	stats.lateSum += late
	stats.lateCount += 1
	if late > stats.lateFramesMax then
		stats.lateFramesMax = late
	end
end

local function onFireFrame()
	local contact = pendingContactFrame
	if contact ~= nil then
		recordLate(frame - contact)
		pendingContactFrame = nil
	else
		pendingFireFrame = frame
	end
end

local function onContactFrame()
	touched = true
	local fired = pendingFireFrame
	if fired ~= nil then
		local early = frame - fired
		if early > stats.earlyFramesMax then
			stats.earlyFramesMax = early
		end
		recordLate(0)
		pendingFireFrame = nil
	elseif armed then
		if passes(-lastFallVy, os.clock() - airStart) then
			pendingContactFrame = frame -- a real landing the ray missed; the state fallback may come
		else
			-- Soft touch (small step, short hop): consume it without an event, StepDriver handles it
			armed = false
			inAir = false
		end
	end
end

-- Leaving the ground: new air phase, may fire again
local function rearm()
	if awaitingState then
		stats.stateMissed += 1
		awaitingState = false
	end
	if not inAir then
		inAir = true
		airStart = os.clock()
		lastFallVy = 0
	end
	armed = true
	pendingFireFrame = nil
	pendingContactFrame = nil
end

local function fire(info: LandingInfo)
	armed = false
	touched = false
	inAir = false
	stats.landings += 1
	if info.source == "ray" then
		stats.byRay += 1
	else
		stats.byState += 1
	end
	onFireFrame()
	if FeelConfig.Debug.LogLandings == true then
		print(
			string.format(
				"[Landing] %s speed=%.1f int=%.2f air=%.2fs mat=%s part=%s",
				info.source,
				info.impactSpeed,
				info.intensity,
				info.airTime,
				info.material,
				if info.part then info.part:GetFullName() else "nil"
			)
		)
	end
	LandingDetector.Landed:Fire(info)
end

-- Ground below the creature within `length`; ignores surfaces above our bottom (a ledge beside us).
-- Returns the hit and gap = distance from our bottom to the surface (<= 0 means touching).
local function groundBelow(r: BasePart, height: number, length: number, ignore: { Instance }): (SurfaceHit?, number)
	local hit = SurfaceProbe.CastFootprint(r, length, ignore)
	if hit == nil then
		return nil, 0
	end
	local gap = hit.distance - height
	if gap < -FeelConfig.Probe.Margin then
		return nil, 0
	end
	return hit, gap
end

local function onHeartbeat(dt: number)
	local r = root
	local char = character
	if r == nil or char == nil or r.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	frame += 1
	lastDt = dt
	local vy = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	local ignore = { char :: Instance }
	local height = bodyHeight(r)
	local fallStep = math.max(-vy, 0) * dt * FeelConfig.Landing.PredictFrames
	local length = height + fallStep + FeelConfig.Probe.Margin

	-- One footprint cast per frame while falling or waiting for the contact frame
	local hit: SurfaceHit? = nil
	local gap = 0
	local casted = false
	if wasFalling or (armed and vy < 0) then
		hit, gap = groundBelow(r, height, length, ignore)
		casted = true
	end

	-- Contact frame for E4: first frame after a fall where the bottom reaches the surface (gap <= 0)
	-- or the creature stops falling (vy >= 0). The root sinks below its rest height on impact, so vy >= 0 alone is late.
	if wasFalling and (vy >= 0 or (hit ~= nil and gap <= 0)) then
		wasFalling = false
		onContactFrame()
	end

	if not armed then
		if not touched then
			return
		end
		-- Rearm when lifted above RearmHeight after a contact (one center ray)
		if SurfaceProbe.Cast(r.Position, height + FeelConfig.Landing.RearmHeight, ignore) ~= nil then
			return
		end
		rearm()
	end

	if vy >= 0 then
		return
	end
	if not inAir then
		-- Falling without a state change (e.g. pushed off): treat as airborne from now
		inAir = true
		airStart = os.clock()
	end
	wasFalling = true
	lastFallVy = vy

	if not casted then
		hit, gap = groundBelow(r, height, length, ignore)
	end
	if hit == nil or math.max(gap, 0) > fallStep then
		return
	end
	local ground = hit :: SurfaceHit

	local now = os.clock()
	local impactSpeed = -vy
	local airTime = now - airStart
	if not passes(impactSpeed, airTime) then
		-- Too early or too slow: keep watching; a real soft contact is consumed in onContactFrame
		return
	end

	lastRayFireAt = now
	awaitingState = true
	fire({
		position = ground.position,
		impactSpeed = impactSpeed,
		intensity = intensityFor(impactSpeed),
		material = ground.material,
		part = ground.part,
		normal = ground.normal,
		airTime = airTime,
		source = "ray",
		time = now,
	})
end

-- Humanoid Landed usually arrives about one frame before the ray would fire (Studio, 60 fps),
-- so in practice this path reports most landings; the ray covers a missing state.
local function onStateChanged(_old: Enum.HumanoidStateType, new: Enum.HumanoidStateType)
	if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		rearm()
		return
	end
	if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	touched = true
	if awaitingState then
		awaitingState = false
	end
	if now - lastRayFireAt <= FeelConfig.Landing.StateFallbackWindow then
		return -- the ray already reported this touch
	end
	if not armed then
		return
	end

	local r = root
	local h = humanoid
	local char = character
	if r == nil or h == nil or char == nil then
		return
	end
	-- Speed: the faster of now and the last falling frame (state may come before or after contact)
	local fallVy = math.min(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, lastFallVy)
	local impactSpeed = -fallVy
	local airTime = now - airStart
	if not passes(impactSpeed, airTime) then
		armed = false
		inAir = false
		pendingContactFrame = nil
		return
	end

	-- Reach the surface the creature is about to hit: the predicted fall plus two more frames
	local height = bodyHeight(r)
	local reach = impactSpeed * lastDt * (FeelConfig.Landing.PredictFrames + 2)
	local hit = groundBelow(r, height, height + reach + FeelConfig.Probe.Margin, { char :: Instance })
	local info: LandingInfo
	if hit ~= nil then
		info = {
			position = hit.position,
			impactSpeed = impactSpeed,
			intensity = intensityFor(impactSpeed),
			material = hit.material,
			part = hit.part,
			normal = hit.normal,
			airTime = airTime,
			source = "state",
			time = now,
		}
	else
		-- Nothing found by the ray: only now fall back to Humanoid.FloorMaterial
		info = {
			position = r.Position - Vector3.new(0, height, 0),
			impactSpeed = impactSpeed,
			intensity = intensityFor(impactSpeed),
			material = SurfaceProbe.ResolveMaterial(nil, h.FloorMaterial),
			part = nil,
			normal = Vector3.yAxis,
			airTime = airTime,
			source = "state",
			time = now,
		}
	end
	fire(info)
end

local function resetSession()
	frame = 0
	inAir = false
	airStart = os.clock()
	armed = false
	touched = true
	lastFallVy = 0
	lastDt = 0
	wasFalling = false
	lastRayFireAt = -math.huge
	awaitingState = false
	pendingFireFrame = nil
	pendingContactFrame = nil
end

function LandingDetector.Stop(): ()
	for _, c in connections do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	connections = {}
	character = nil
	humanoid = nil
	root = nil
	resetSession()
end

function LandingDetector.Start(char: Model): ()
	LandingDetector.Stop()
	if typeof(char) ~= "Instance" or not char:IsA("Model") then
		warn("[LandingDetector] Start needs a character Model")
		return
	end
	character = char

	-- Attach as soon as both Humanoid and HumanoidRootPart exist (they may arrive after CharacterAdded)
	local attached = false
	local function tryAttach()
		if attached or character ~= char then
			return
		end
		local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if h == nil or r == nil or not r:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		attached = true
		humanoid = h
		root = r :: BasePart
		table.insert(connections, h.StateChanged:Connect(onStateChanged))
		table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onHeartbeat))
	end

	table.insert(connections, char.ChildAdded:Connect(tryAttach))
	tryAttach()
end

function LandingDetector.GetStats(): LandingStats
	return {
		landings = stats.landings,
		byRay = stats.byRay,
		byState = stats.byState,
		stateMissed = stats.stateMissed,
		lateFramesMax = stats.lateFramesMax,
		lateFramesAvg = if stats.lateCount > 0 then stats.lateSum / stats.lateCount else 0,
		earlyFramesMax = stats.earlyFramesMax,
	}
end

function LandingDetector.ResetStats(): ()
	stats.landings = 0
	stats.byRay = 0
	stats.byState = 0
	stats.stateMissed = 0
	stats.lateFramesMax = 0
	stats.lateSum = 0
	stats.lateCount = 0
	stats.earlyFramesMax = 0
end

return LandingDetector

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 200)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40) -- เริ่มต้นด้วยสีเทา
frame.Parent = screenGui

-- ฟังก์ชันเปลี่ยนสีพื้นหลังของ Frame แบบค่อยๆ เปลี่ยนสีไปเรื่อยๆ
local function changeColor()
    while true do
        -- สุ่มค่าสี RGB
        local randomColor = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255), math.random(0, 255))
        
        -- ตั้งค่าการไล่สีด้วย Tween
        local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(2), {BackgroundColor3 = randomColor})
        
        -- เริ่มการเปลี่ยนสี
        tween:Play()
        
        -- รอให้การไล่สีเสร็จสมบูรณ์ก่อนทำใหม่
        tween.Completed:Wait()
    end
end

-- เริ่มการเปลี่ยนสีพื้นหลังของ Frame
spawn(changeColor)

-- ชื่อที่มุมซ้ายบน

-- สร้างปุ่มปิด

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)

xTextBox.PlaceholderText = "ใส่ X"

xTextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 50)
xTextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
xTextBox.Parent = frame

-- พิกัด Y
local yTextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
yTextBox.PlaceholderText = "ใส่ Y"
yTextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 30)
yTextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 90)
yTextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
yTextBox.Parent = frame

-- พิกัด Z
local zTextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
zTextBox.PlaceholderText = "ใส่ Z"
zTextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 30)
zTextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 130)
zTextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
zTextBox.Parent = frame

-- ปุ่มวาร์ป
local teleportButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
teleportButton.Text = "วาร์ป"
teleportButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 40)
teleportButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 170)
teleportButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
teleportButton.Parent = frame

-- ฟังก์ชันวาร์ปเมื่อกดปุ่ม
teleportButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        -- อ่านค่าจากกล่องข้อความและแปลงเป็นตัวเลข
        local x = tonumber(xTextBox.Text) or 0
        local y = tonumber(yTextBox.Text) or 0
        local z = tonumber(zTextBox.Text) or 0

        -- ตั้งตำแหน่งตัวละครตามค่าที่กรอกในกล่อง
        character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z)
    else
        print("ไม่พบตัวละคร!")
    end
end)

-- ปุ่ม "โจรสลัด" สำหรับวาร์ปไปยังตำแหน่งเฉพาะ
local pirateButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
pirateButton.Text = "โจรสลัด"
pirateButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 40)
pirateButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 210)
pirateButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255)
pirateButton.Parent = frame

pirateButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        -- วาร์ปไปยังตำแหน่งของโจรสลัด
        character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-2825, 214, 1517)
    else
        print("ไม่พบตัวละคร!")
    end
end)

-- ฟังก์ชันสำหรับลากหน้าต่าง
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        -- เริ่มต้นการลากเมื่อคลิกที่หน้าต่าง
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
    end
end)

frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        -- คำนวณตำแหน่งใหม่ของหน้าต่าง
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

frame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        -- ยกเลิกการลากเมื่อปล่อยเมาส์
        dragging = false
    end
end)

-- เพิ่มปุ่มพับ
local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizeButton.Text = "_"
minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 0)
minimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
minimizeButton.Parent = frame

-- สร้างไอคอนเมื่อพับ
local minimizedIcon = Instance.new("Frame")
minimizedIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
minimizedIcon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) -- สีแดง
minimizedIcon.Visible = false
minimizedIcon.Parent = screenGui

-- ฟังก์ชันสำหรับพับ/ขยาย
minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if frame.Visible then
        -- คำนวณตำแหน่งของไอคอนสีแดงให้ตรงกลางของหน้าต่างเมนู
        local iconX = frame.Position.X.Offset + (frame.Size.X.Offset / 0.24) - (minimizedIcon.Size.X.Offset / 0.24)
        local iconY = frame.Position.Y.Offset + (frame.Size.Y.Offset / 0.28) - (minimizedIcon.Size.Y.Offset / 0.28)
        minimizedIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, iconX, 0, iconY)
        
        -- หดหน้าต่างและแสดงไอคอนสีแดง
        frame.Visible = false
        minimizedIcon.Visible = true
    end
end)

-- ฟังก์ชันสำหรับคลิกไอคอนสีแดงเพื่อขยาย
minimizedIcon.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        -- ขยายหน้าต่างเมื่อคลิกที่ไอคอน
        frame.Visible = true
        minimizedIcon.Visible = false
    end
end)

--!strict
-- The only writer of the own root velocity and Humanoid.WalkSpeed on stations (contract "Dynamics v1", D7.5).
-- Boosters, launches and bounces ask here; the work happens in RunService.PreSimulation (before physics).
-- Bad input (NaN, infinity, zero direction) is ignored without errors.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Stations = require(Config:WaitForChild("Stations"))
local FeelConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local StationTypes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("StationTypes"))

type MotionInfo = StationTypes.MotionInfo
type MotionMode = StationTypes.MotionMode

local MotionDriver = {}

-- Fallback until Config/Stations.Booster.MaxForce exists (the "Constraint" method; Д2 decides the value).
local FALLBACK_MAX_FORCE = 10000
local MIN_DIRECTION = 1e-3 -- numerical guard: shorter horizontal vectors count as zero

type BoostState = { dir: Vector3, speed: number, lastCall: number }
type ExitState = { dir: Vector3, from: number, start: number }
type LaunchState = {
	target: Vector3,
	flight: number,
	pending: boolean, -- velocity not written yet (first PreSimulation does it)
	horizontal: Vector3, -- held every frame until landing
	start: number,
	guard: number, -- Landed earlier than this after start is ignored (still rising)
}
type BounceState = {
	rise: number, -- vertical speed
	forward: Vector3?, -- horizontal velocity held until landing
	pending: boolean,
	start: number,
	guard: number,
	kicks: number,
}

local character: Model? = nil
local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local root: BasePart? = nil
local attachment: Attachment? = nil
local constraint: LinearVelocity? = nil
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local boost: BoostState? = nil
local exit: ExitState? = nil
local launch: LaunchState? = nil
local bounce: BounceState? = nil
local baseWalkSpeed: number? = nil -- WalkSpeed before the boost changed it
local landedAt = -math.huge

local info: MotionInfo = { mode = "Walk", speed = 0, since = os.clock() }

local function isFinite(n: number): boolean
	return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

local function finiteVector(v: Vector3): boolean
	return isFinite(v.X) and isFinite(v.Y) and isFinite(v.Z)
end

local function flat(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end

local function gravity(): number
	local g = Workspace.Gravity
	if not isFinite(g) or g <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return g
end

local function setMode(mode: MotionMode)
	if info.mode ~= mode then
		info.mode = mode
		info.since = os.clock()
	end
end

local function boosterConfig(): any
	return Stations.Booster :: any
end

local function method(): string
	local m = boosterConfig().Method
	return if m == "Constraint" then "Constraint" else "Velocity"
end

local function disableConstraint()
	local c = constraint
	if c then
		c.Enabled = false
	end
end

local function restoreWalkSpeed()
	local h = humanoid
	local base = baseWalkSpeed
	if h and base then
		h.WalkSpeed = base
	end
	baseWalkSpeed = nil
end

local function endBoost()
	boost = nil
	exit = nil
	disableConstraint()
	restoreWalkSpeed()
end

-- Finds the root and humanoid of the current character; makes the constraint once per root.
local function resolve(): (BasePart?, Humanoid?)
	local char = character
	if char == nil then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local r = root
	if r == nil or r.Parent == nil then
		local found = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		r = if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then found else nil
		root = r
		attachment = nil
		constraint = nil
	end
	local h = humanoid
	if h == nil or h.Parent == nil then
		h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		humanoid = h
		if h then
			table.insert(
				connections,
				h.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
					if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
						landedAt = os.clock()
					end
				end)
			)
		end
	end
	if r and attachment == nil then
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Name = "MotionAttachment"
		a.Parent = r
		attachment = a
		local c = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
		c.Name = "MotionBoost"
		c.Attachment0 = a
		c.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		c.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Line
		c.LineDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		c.LineVelocity = 0
		local force = boosterConfig().MaxForce
		c.MaxForce = if type(force) == "number" and force > 0 then force else FALLBACK_MAX_FORCE
		c.Enabled = false
		c.Parent = r
		constraint = c
	end
	return r, h
end

-- Horizontal speed along dir is raised to at least speed; cross and vertical parts stay.
local function atLeastAlong(velocity: Vector3, dir: Vector3, speed: number): Vector3
	local along = velocity:Dot(dir)
	if along < speed then
		return velocity + dir * (speed - along)
	end
	return velocity
end

local function stepBoost(r: BasePart, h: Humanoid?, now: number): boolean
	local cfg = boosterConfig()
	local b = boost
	if b then
		if now - b.lastCall <= cfg.CoyoteSeconds then
			if method() == "Constraint" and constraint then
				local c = constraint :: LinearVelocity
				c.LineDirection = b.dir
				c.LineVelocity = b.speed
				c.Enabled = true
			else
				disableConstraint()
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = atLeastAlong(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, b.dir, b.speed)
			end
			if h then
				h.WalkSpeed = b.speed
			end
			return true
		end
		-- left the track: carry the speed down to normal
		boost = nil
		disableConstraint()
		exit = { dir = b.dir, from = b.speed, start = now }
	end
	local e = exit
	if e then
		local base = baseWalkSpeed or FeelConfig.Character.WalkSpeed
		local span = cfg.ExitCarrySeconds
		local k = if span > 0 then math.clamp((now - e.start) / span, 0, 1) else 1
		if k >= 1 then
			endBoost()
			return false
		end
		local speed = e.from + (base - e.from) * k
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = atLeastAlong(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, e.dir, speed)
		if h then
			h.WalkSpeed = speed
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function stepLaunch(r: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local l = launch
	if l == nil then
		return false
	end
	local g = gravity()
	if l.pending then
		local t = l.flight
		local delta = l.target - r.Position
		-- v = (delta - 1/2 * (0, -g, 0) * T^2) / T
		local v = (delta - Vector3.new(0, -g, 0) * (0.5 * t * t)) / t
		if not finiteVector(v) then
			launch = nil
			return false
		end
		l.pending = false
		l.start = now
		l.horizontal = flat(v)
		l.guard = if g > 0 then math.max(v.Y, 0) / g else 0
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v
		return true
	end
	local maxCarry = (Stations.Launch :: any).MaxCarrySeconds
	local elapsed = now - l.start
	if elapsed > maxCarry or (landedAt > l.start + l.guard) then
		launch = nil
		return false
	end
	local v = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(l.horizontal.X, v.Y, l.horizontal.Z)
	return true
end

local function stepBounce(r: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local b = bounce
	if b == nil then
		return false
	end
	local v = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local horizontal = flat(v)
	local fwd = b.forward
	if fwd then
		horizontal = fwd
	end
	if b.pending then
		b.pending = false
		b.start = now
		local g = gravity()
		b.guard = if g > 0 then b.rise / g else 0
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, b.rise, horizontal.Z)
		return true
	end
	local maxCarry = (Stations.Launch :: any).MaxCarrySeconds
	local elapsed = now - b.start
	if elapsed > maxCarry or landedAt > b.start + b.guard then
		bounce = nil
		return false
	end
	local vy = v.Y
	-- the ground controller may eat the first kick: restore the ballistic speed, at most twice
	local expected = b.rise - gravity() * elapsed
	if expected > 0 and vy < expected * 0.5 and b.kicks < 2 then
		b.kicks += 1
		vy = expected
	end
	if fwd or vy ~= v.Y then
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, vy, horizontal.Z)
	end
	return true
end

local function onPreSimulation(_dt: number)
	local r, h = resolve()
	if r == nil then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local mode: MotionMode = "Walk"
	if stepLaunch(r, now) then
		mode = "Launch"
	elseif stepBounce(r, now) then
		mode = "Bounce"
	end
	-- boost keeps running under a bounce (rare); a launch cancelled it already
	if stepBoost(r, h, now) and mode == "Walk" then
		mode = "Boost"
	end
	setMode(mode)
	local speed = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
	info.speed = if isFinite(speed) then speed else 0
end

function MotionDriver.Start(char: Model)
	MotionDriver.Stop()
	if typeof(char) ~= "Instance" or not char:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	character = char
	resolve()
	table.insert(connections, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(onPreSimulation))
end

function MotionDriver.Stop()
	endBoost()
	launch = nil
	bounce = nil
	for _, c in connections do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	local c = constraint
	if c then
		c:Destroy()
	end
	local a = attachment
	if a then
		a:Destroy()
	end
	constraint = nil
	attachment = nil
	character = nil
	humanoid = nil
	root = nil
	landedAt = -math.huge
	info.mode = "Walk"
	info.speed = 0
	info.since = os.clock()
end

function MotionDriver.Boost(direction: Vector3, speed: number)
	if character == nil or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or type(speed) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	if not finiteVector(direction) or not isFinite(speed) or speed <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local dir = flat(direction)
	if dir.Magnitude < MIN_DIRECTION then
		return
	end
	dir = dir.Unit
	if launch then
		return -- a launch owns the velocity until it lands
	end
	if boost == nil and exit == nil then
		local h = humanoid
		baseWalkSpeed = if h then h.WalkSpeed else FeelConfig.Character.WalkSpeed
	end
	exit = nil
	boost = { dir = dir, speed = speed, lastCall = os.clock() }
end

function MotionDriver.Launch(target: Vector3, flightSeconds: number): boolean
	if character == nil or typeof(target) ~= "Vector3" or type(flightSeconds) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	if not finiteVector(target) or not isFinite(flightSeconds) or flightSeconds <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local r, h = resolve()
	if r == nil then
		return false
	end
	endBoost()
	bounce = nil
	if h then
		h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end
	launch = {
		target = target,
		flight = flightSeconds,
		pending = true,
		horizontal = Vector3.zero,
		start = os.clock(),
		guard = 0,
	}
	return true
end

function MotionDriver.Bounce(height: number, forward: Vector3?)
	if character == nil or type(height) ~= "number" or not isFinite(height) or height <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if launch then
		return
	end
	local fwd: Vector3? = nil
	if typeof(forward) == "Vector3" and finiteVector(forward) then
		local f = flat(forward)
		if f.Magnitude >= MIN_DIRECTION then
			fwd = f
		end
	end
	local r, h = resolve()
	if r == nil then
		return
	end
	local rise = math.sqrt(2 * gravity() * height)
	if not isFinite(rise) or rise <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if h then
		h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end
	bounce = { rise = rise, forward = fwd, pending = true, start = os.clock(), guard = 0, kicks = 0 }
end

function MotionDriver.GetInfo(): MotionInfo
	return { mode = info.mode, speed = info.speed, since = info.since }
end

return MotionDriver

--!strict
-- Robux prices as Roblox will charge this player. With Managed Pricing a price differs by region and
-- during price tests (30-100% of the base price), so the UI must not show the Config number.
-- MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync called on the client returns the local player's price
-- (PriceInRobux). Config Price is only the fallback: while the answer is on its way, if it fails, and
-- for items with Id = 0. Every pass and product is asked once per session, all at once (the engine
-- batches concurrent calls), starting when this module is first required; nothing waits for it.
-- Prices.Changed fires when a price arrives: redraw the text then.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Passes = require(Config:WaitForChild("Passes"))
local Products = require(Config:WaitForChild("Products"))

export type Kind = "Pass" | "Product"

local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
local RETRY_SECONDS = 20 -- times the attempt number

local Prices = {}

local changed = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
Prices.Changed = changed.Event -- (kind: Kind, key: string)

local loaded: { [string]: number } = {} -- "Product/StarterPack" -> Robux for this player
local requested: { [string]: boolean } = {}

-- Id in Creator Hub and the Config price of a pass or product (0, 0 for an unknown key).
local function lookup(kind: Kind, key: string): (number, number)
	if kind == "Pass" then
		local pass = Passes.Get(key)
		if pass then
			return pass.Id, pass.Price
		end
		return 0, 0
	end
	local product = Products.Get(key)
	if product then
		return product.Id, product.Price
	end
	return 0, 0
end

local function fetch(kind: Kind, key: string)
	local id = lookup(kind, key)
	local cacheKey = kind .. "/" .. key
	if id <= 0 or requested[cacheKey] then
		return
	end
	requested[cacheKey] = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local infoType = if kind == "Pass" then Enum.InfoType.GamePass else Enum.InfoType.Product
		for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
			local ok, info = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync(id, infoType)
			end)
			if ok then
				local price = if type(info) == "table" then tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) else nil
				if price and price >= 1 and price < math.huge then
					loaded[cacheKey] = math.floor(price)
					changed:Fire(kind, key)
				end
				return -- answered (an item off sale has no price: the Config one stays)
			end
			task.wait(RETRY_SECONDS * attempt)
		end
	end)
end

-- Robux this player pays for a pass or product: Roblox's price once known, the Config price until then.
function Prices.Get(kind: Kind, key: string): number
	local price = loaded[kind .. "/" .. key]
	if price then
		return price
	end
	fetch(kind, key)
	local _, fallback = lookup(kind, key)
	return fallback
end

-- "R$ 99" for a pass or product (Kind and key as in Config/Offers: Kind = "Pass" | "Product", Item = key).
function Prices.Text(kind: Kind, key: string): string
	return "R$ " .. Prices.Get(kind, key)
end

-- True once Roblox's price for it is known (otherwise Get returns the Config price).
function Prices.IsLive(kind: Kind, key: string): boolean
	return loaded[kind .. "/" .. key] ~= nil
end

for _, pass in Passes.List do
	fetch("Pass", pass.Key)
end
for _, product in Products.List do
	fetch("Product", product.Key)
end

return Prices
