--!strict
-- Event -> sound: material + kind -> random variant (no repeat in a row) -> volume and pitch by intensity -> SoundPool.
-- Does not detect ground, does not know the character, does not create players.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local SoundBank = require(Config:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local FeelConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local FeelTypes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FeelTypes"))
local SoundPool = require(script.Parent.SoundPool)

type MaterialName = FeelTypes.MaterialName
type SoundKind = FeelTypes.SoundKind
type SoundKindEntry = FeelTypes.SoundKindEntry

local SoundEngine = {}

local KNOWN_KINDS: { [string]: boolean } = { land = true, step = true, slide = true, ["break"] = true }

local rng = Random.new()
local lastPlayAt: { [string]: number } = {} -- "material/kind" -> os.clock() of the last play
local lastAsset: { [string]: string } = {} -- "material/kind" -> asset played last time
local warnedSilent: { [string]: boolean } = {} -- "material/kind" already reported as silent
local landingPitchOffset = 0 -- added to the PlaybackSpeed of landing sounds only (SetLandingPitchOffset)

local function warnOnce(key: string, message: string)
	if not warnedSilent[key] then
		warnedSilent[key] = true
		warn(message)
	end
end

local function isFiniteNumber(x: any): boolean
	return typeof(x) == "number" and x == x and x ~= math.huge and x ~= -math.huge
end

local function checkRange(where: string, range: any)
	if typeof(range) ~= "table" or not isFiniteNumber(range.Min) or not isFiniteNumber(range.Max) then
		warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: range is not {Min, Max}", where))
	elseif range.Min > range.Max then
		warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: Min > Max", where))
	end
end

function SoundEngine.Init(): ()
	local materials = SoundBank.Materials
	if materials[SoundBank.DefaultMaterial] == nil then
		warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] DefaultMaterial %q is not in SoundBank.Materials", tostring(SoundBank.DefaultMaterial)))
	end
	for enumName, name in SoundBank.FallbackByEnum do
		if materials[name] == nil then
			warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] FallbackByEnum.%s -> unknown material %q", enumName, tostring(name)))
		end
	end
	for kind, _ in SoundBank.Placeholders do
		if not KNOWN_KINDS[kind] then
			warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] Placeholders: unknown kind %q", kind))
		end
	end
	for name, material in materials do
		local moveKind = material.MoveKind
		if moveKind ~= "step" and moveKind ~= "slide" then
			warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: MoveKind must be step or slide", name))
		elseif material.Kinds[moveKind] == nil and (material.Kinds.step ~= nil or material.Kinds.slide ~= nil) then
			-- a material with neither (a pickup sound such as Note) is never walked on, so it needs no move kind
			warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: no %s kind for its MoveKind", name, moveKind))
		end
		for kind, entry in material.Kinds do
			local where = name .. "/" .. kind
			if not KNOWN_KINDS[kind] then
				warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: unknown kind", where))
			end
			if typeof(entry.Variants) ~= "table" or #entry.Variants == 0 then
				warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: no variants", where))
			else
				for _, variant in entry.Variants do
					local asset = variant.Asset
					if typeof(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and not SoundPool.IsKnown(asset) then
						warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: %s has no warm players", where, asset))
					end
				end
			end
			checkRange(where .. ".Volume", entry.Volume)
			checkRange(where .. ".Pitch", entry.Pitch)
			if not isFiniteNumber(entry.VolumeCurve) or entry.VolumeCurve < 0 then
				warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: bad VolumeCurve", where))
			end
			if not isFiniteNumber(entry.PitchHeavy) then
				warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: bad PitchHeavy", where))
			end
			if not isFiniteNumber(entry.Cooldown) or entry.Cooldown < 0 then
				warn(string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: bad Cooldown", where))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Random non-empty asset, never the same as last time when there are 2+ candidates
local function pickAsset(key: string, entry: SoundKindEntry): string?
	local candidates: { string } = {}
	for _, variant in entry.Variants do
		if variant.Asset ~= "" then
			table.insert(candidates, variant.Asset)
		end
	end
	local count = #candidates
	if count == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if count == 1 then
		return candidates[1]
	end
	local previous = lastAsset[key]
	local index = rng:NextInteger(1, count)
	if candidates[index] == previous then
		-- shift to a different one; candidates are distinct in practice, step past equal neighbours
		for _ = 1, count - 1 do
			index = index % count + 1
			if candidates[index] ~= previous then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return candidates[index]
end

local function playWithOffset(material: MaterialName, kind: SoundKind, intensity: number, pitchOffset: number): boolean
	local materials = SoundBank.Materials
	local name = if typeof(material) == "string" and materials[material] ~= nil
		then material
		else SoundBank.DefaultMaterial
	local materialEntry = materials[name]
	if materialEntry == nil then
		return false -- DefaultMaterial missing, reported in Init
	end

	local key = name .. "/" .. tostring(kind)
	local entry = materialEntry.Kinds[kind]
	if entry == nil then
		warnOnce(key, string.format("[SoundEngine] %s has no %s sound, silent", name, tostring(kind)))
		return false
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local last = lastPlayAt[key]
	if last ~= nil and now - last < entry.Cooldown then
		return false
	end

	local asset = pickAsset(key, entry)
	if asset == nil then
		local placeholder = SoundBank.Placeholders[kind]
		if FeelConfig.Debug.UsePlaceholders == true and typeof(placeholder) == "string" and placeholder ~= "" then
			asset = placeholder
		else
			warnOnce(key, string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: no uploaded variants, silent", key))
			return false
		end
	end
	local chosen = asset :: string

	local x = if isFiniteNumber(intensity) then math.clamp(intensity, 0, 1) else 0
	local volume = entry.Volume.Min + (entry.Volume.Max - entry.Volume.Min) * x ^ entry.VolumeCurve
	local speed = rng:NextNumber(entry.Pitch.Min, entry.Pitch.Max) + entry.PitchHeavy * x + pitchOffset

	lastPlayAt[key] = now
	lastAsset[key] = chosen
	return SoundPool.Play(chosen, { volume = volume, speed = speed })
end

function SoundEngine.Play(material: MaterialName, kind: SoundKind, intensity: number): boolean
	return playWithOffset(material, kind, intensity, 0)
end

-- Like Play (variant, volume by intensity, Cooldown), but PlaybackSpeed = speed exactly (no Pitch, no PitchHeavy).
-- speed not a number or <= 0 -> same as Play. Used for notes (Chime, pitched Press).
function SoundEngine.PlayAt(material: MaterialName, kind: SoundKind, intensity: number, speed: number): boolean
	if not isFiniteNumber(speed) or speed <= 0 then
		return SoundEngine.Play(material, kind, intensity)
	end
	local materials = SoundBank.Materials
	local name = if typeof(material) == "string" and materials[material] ~= nil
		then material
		else SoundBank.DefaultMaterial
	local materialEntry = materials[name]
	if materialEntry == nil then
		return false
	end

	local key = name .. "/" .. tostring(kind)
	local entry = materialEntry.Kinds[kind]
	if entry == nil then
		warnOnce(key, string.format("[SoundEngine] %s has no %s sound, silent", name, tostring(kind)))
		return false
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local last = lastPlayAt[key]
	if last ~= nil and now - last < entry.Cooldown then
		return false
	end

	local asset = pickAsset(key, entry)
	if asset == nil then
		local placeholder = SoundBank.Placeholders[kind]
		if FeelConfig.Debug.UsePlaceholders == true and typeof(placeholder) == "string" and placeholder ~= "" then
			asset = placeholder
		else
			warnOnce(key, string.format("[SoundEngine] %s: no uploaded variants, silent", key))
			return false
		end
	end
	local chosen = asset :: string

	local x = if isFiniteNumber(intensity) then math.clamp(intensity, 0, 1) else 0
	local volume = entry.Volume.Min + (entry.Volume.Max - entry.Volume.Min) * x ^ entry.VolumeCurve

	lastPlayAt[key] = now
	lastAsset[key] = chosen
	return SoundPool.Play(chosen, { volume = volume, speed = speed })
end

function SoundEngine.SetLandingPitchOffset(offset: number): ()
	landingPitchOffset = if isFiniteNumber(offset) then offset else 0
end

function SoundEngine.PlayLanding(info: FeelTypes.LandingInfo): ()
	if typeof(info) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	playWithOffset(info.material, "land", info.intensity, landingPitchOffset)
end

function SoundEngine.PlayStep(info: FeelTypes.StepInfo): ()
	if typeof(info) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	SoundEngine.Play(info.material, info.kind, info.intensity)
end

function SoundEngine.PlayBreak(info: FeelTypes.BreakInfo): ()
	if typeof(info) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	SoundEngine.Play(info.material, "break", info.intensity)
end

return SoundEngine

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

local AnimationLoader = {}
AnimationLoader.__index = AnimationLoader

type AnimationLoaderState = {
    animator: Animator?,
    cache: { [Animation]: AnimationTrack },
    connections: { RBXScriptConnection },
    destroyed: boolean,
}

export type AnimationLoader = typeof(setmetatable({} :: AnimationLoaderState, AnimationLoader))

function AnimationLoader.new(animator: Animator): AnimationLoader
    assert(animator and animator:IsA("Animator"), "AnimationLoader requires a valid Animator")
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            animator = animator,
            cache = {},
            connections = {},
            destroyed = false,
        } :: AnimationLoaderState,
        AnimationLoader
    )
    return self
end

function AnimationLoader:LoadTrack(
    animation: Animation,
    priority: Enum.AnimationPriority?,
    fadeTime: number?,
    weight: number?,
    speed: number?
): AnimationTrack
    assert(not self.destroyed, "AnimationLoader has been destroyed")
    local animator = assert(self.animator, "AnimationLoader has no Animator")
    local track = self.cache[animation]
    if not track then
        track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        self.cache[animation] = track
    end
    track.Priority = priority or Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play(fadeTime or 0.1, weight or 1, speed or 1)
    return track
end

function AnimationLoader:PlayById(
    assetId: string,
    priority: Enum.AnimationPriority?,
    fadeTime: number?,
    weight: number?,
    speed: number?
): AnimationTrack?
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = assetId
    local numericId = assetId:match("%d+")
    animation.Name = if numericId then "Anim_" .. numericId else "Anim"
    local track: AnimationTrack = self:LoadTrack(animation, priority, fadeTime, weight, speed)
    self.connections[#self.connections + 1] = track.Stopped:Connect(function()
        self.cache[animation] = nil
        track:Destroy()
        animation:Destroy()
    end)
    return track
end

function AnimationLoader:StopAll(fadeTime: number?)
    for _, track in pairs(self.cache) do
        if track.IsPlaying then
            track:Stop(fadeTime or 0.1)
        end
    end
end

function AnimationLoader:Destroy()
    if self.destroyed then
        return
    end
    self.destroyed = true
    for _, conn in ipairs(self.connections) do
        conn:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(self.connections)
    self:StopAll(0)
    table.clear(self.cache)
    self.animator = nil
end

return AnimationLoader

--!strict
-- Warm AudioPlayers for every non-empty Asset in SoundBank, plus an own-voice budget.
-- The only module that knows the Audio API. Graph:
-- AudioPlayer -> Wire -> AudioFader "Master" -> Wire -> AudioDeviceOutput (2D), all in SoundService.FeelAudio.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local SoundBank = require(Config:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local FeelConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local FeelTypes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FeelTypes"))

type PlayOptions = FeelTypes.PlayOptions
type PoolStats = FeelTypes.PoolStats

type Voice = {
	player: AudioPlayer,
	startedAt: number, -- os.clock() of the last start, 0 = never
	speed: number, -- PlaybackSpeed of the last start
	playing: boolean, -- started and not stopped by us; see isActive
}

local SoundPool = {}

local inited = false
local folder: Folder? = nil
local voicesByAsset: { [string]: { Voice } } = {}
local allVoices: { Voice } = {}

local stats = {
	stolen = 0,
	skippedEmpty = 0,
	skippedNotReady = 0,
	skippedUnknown = 0,
}

-- Master volume 0..1 set by SetMasterVolume; may be set before Init, applied in Init
local masterVolume = 1
local masterFader: AudioFader? = nil

local warnedEmpty = false
local warnedOverLimit = false
local warnedUnknown: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local function isFiniteNumber(x: any): boolean
	return typeof(x) == "number" and x == x and x ~= math.huge and x ~= -math.huge
end

local function connect(source: Instance, target: Instance, parent: Instance)
	local wire = Instance.new("Wire")
	wire.SourceInstance = source
	wire.TargetInstance = target
	wire.Parent = parent
end

-- A voice counts as playing until its expected end. IsPlaying is not read (docs tag it Roblox Security; E2).
local function isActive(voice: Voice, now: number): boolean
	if not voice.playing then
		return false
	end
	local length = voice.player.TimeLength
	-- Unknown length (not loaded) counts as finished so the budget never locks up
	if length <= 0 or voice.speed <= 0 or now >= voice.startedAt + length / voice.speed then
		voice.playing = false
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function stopVoice(voice: Voice)
	voice.player:Stop()
	voice.playing = false
end

-- Every non-empty Asset and Placeholder, sorted so the MaxPlayers cut is stable
local function collectAssets(): { string }
	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local list: { string } = {}
	local function add(asset: any)
		if typeof(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and not seen[asset] then
			seen[asset] = true
			table.insert(list, asset)
		end
	end
	for _, material in SoundBank.Materials do
		for _, entry in material.Kinds do
			for _, variant in entry.Variants do
				add(variant.Asset)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, path in SoundBank.Placeholders do
		add(path)
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

function SoundPool.Init(): ()
	if inited then
		return
	end
	inited = true

	local audio = FeelConfig.Audio
	local old = SoundService:FindFirstChild("FeelAudio")
	if old ~= nil then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "FeelAudio"

	local fader = Instance.new("AudioFader")
	fader.Name = "Master"
	fader.Volume = masterVolume * audio.MasterVolume
	fader.Parent = root
	masterFader = fader

	local output = Instance.new("AudioDeviceOutput")
	output.Name = "Output"
	output.Parent = root
	connect(fader, output, root)

	local total = 0
	for _, asset in collectAssets() do
		local list: { Voice } = {}
		for _ = 1, audio.PlayersPerAsset do
			if total >= audio.MaxPlayers then
				if not warnedOverLimit then
					warnedOverLimit = true
					warn(string.format("[SoundPool] over Audio.MaxPlayers (%d), extra players skipped", audio.MaxPlayers))
				end
				break
			end
			local player = Instance.new("AudioPlayer")
			player.Name = asset
			player.AutoLoad = true
			player.Looping = false
			player.Asset = asset
			player.Parent = root
			connect(player, fader, root)
			total += 1
			local voice: Voice = { player = player, startedAt = 0, speed = 1, playing = false }
			table.insert(list, voice)
			table.insert(allVoices, voice)
		end
		if #list > 0 then
			voicesByAsset[asset] = list
		end
	end

	root.Parent = SoundService
	folder = root
end

function SoundPool.SetMasterVolume(volume: number): ()
	if not isFiniteNumber(volume) then
		return
	end
	masterVolume = math.clamp(volume, 0, 1)
	local fader = masterFader
	if fader ~= nil then
		fader.Volume = masterVolume * FeelConfig.Audio.MasterVolume
	end
end

function SoundPool.WaitUntilReady(timeout: number): (boolean, number)
	local limit = if isFiniteNumber(timeout) and timeout > 0 then timeout else 0
	local started = os.clock()
	while true do
		local notReady = 0
		for _, voice in allVoices do
			if not voice.player.IsReady then
				notReady += 1
			end
		end
		if notReady == 0 then
			return true, 0
		end
		if os.clock() - started >= limit then
			return false, notReady
		end
		task.wait()
	end
end

function SoundPool.IsKnown(asset: string): boolean
	return typeof(asset) == "string" and voicesByAsset[asset] ~= nil
end

function SoundPool.Play(asset: string, options: PlayOptions): boolean
	if typeof(asset) ~= "string" or asset == "" then
		stats.skippedEmpty += 1
		if not warnedEmpty then
			warnedEmpty = true
			warn("[SoundPool] Play with an empty asset (sound not uploaded yet), skipped")
		end
		return false
	end

	local list = voicesByAsset[asset]
	if list == nil then
		stats.skippedUnknown += 1
		if not warnedUnknown[asset] then
			warnedUnknown[asset] = true
			warn(string.format("[SoundPool] unknown asset %s, skipped", asset))
		end
		return false
	end

	if typeof(options) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local volume = options.volume
	local speed = options.speed
	if typeof(volume) ~= "number" or typeof(speed) ~= "number" or volume ~= volume or speed ~= speed then
		return false -- NaN or wrong type: do not play
	end
	volume = math.clamp(volume, 0, 1)
	speed = math.clamp(speed, 0.5, 2)

	-- Candidates: ready players (or all of them when PlayWhenNotReady)
	local allowNotReady = FeelConfig.Audio.PlayWhenNotReady == true
	local now = os.clock()
	local chosen: Voice? = nil
	local oldest: Voice? = nil
	for _, voice in list do
		if allowNotReady or voice.player.IsReady then
			if not isActive(voice, now) then
				chosen = voice
				break
			end
			if oldest == nil or voice.startedAt < (oldest :: Voice).startedAt then
				oldest = voice
			end
		end
	end
	if chosen == nil then
		chosen = oldest
	end
	if chosen == nil then
		stats.skippedNotReady += 1
		return false
	end
	local voice = chosen :: Voice

	-- Own-voice budget: stop the oldest playing voice until there is room
	local maxVoices = FeelConfig.Audio.MaxOwnVoices
	while true do
		local active = 0
		local victim: Voice? = nil
		for _, other in allVoices do
			if other ~= voice and isActive(other, now) then
				active += 1
				if victim == nil or other.startedAt < (victim :: Voice).startedAt then
					victim = other
				end
			end
		end
		if active < maxVoices or victim == nil then
			break
		end
		stopVoice(victim :: Voice)
		stats.stolen += 1
	end

	-- Play() only resumes, so restart explicitly
	local player = voice.player
	player:Stop()
	player.TimePosition = 0
	player.Volume = volume
	player.PlaybackSpeed = speed
	player:Play()
	voice.startedAt = now
	voice.speed = speed
	voice.playing = true
	return true
end

function SoundPool.GetStats(): PoolStats
	local now = os.clock()
	local ready = 0
	local active = 0
	for _, voice in allVoices do
		if voice.player.IsReady then
			ready += 1
		end
		if isActive(voice, now) then
			active += 1
		end
	end
	return {
		players = #allVoices,
		ready = ready,
		notReady = #allVoices - ready,
		activeVoices = active,
		stolen = stats.stolen,
		skippedEmpty = stats.skippedEmpty,
		skippedNotReady = stats.skippedNotReady,
		skippedUnknown = stats.skippedUnknown,
	}
end

function SoundPool.Destroy(): ()
	local f = folder
	if f ~= nil then
		f:Destroy()
	end
	folder = nil
	masterFader = nil
	voicesByAsset = {}
	allVoices = {}
	inited = false
end

return SoundPool

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

local IKSetup = {}

export type IKChainConfig = {
    parent: Instance,
    endEffector: BasePart | Bone,
    chainRoot: BasePart | Bone,
    target: Attachment | BasePart,
    type: Enum.IKControlType?,
    smoothTime: number?,
    p: number?,
}

function IKSetup.create(config: IKChainConfig): IKControl
    local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
    ik.Type = config.type or Enum.IKControlType.Position
    ik.EndEffector = config.endEffector
    ik.ChainRoot = config.chainRoot
    if config.target:IsA("Attachment") then
        ik.Target = config.target :: Attachment
    else
        local targetAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        targetAttachment.Name = "IKTarget"
        targetAttachment.Parent = config.target :: BasePart
        ik.Target = targetAttachment
    end
    ik.SmoothTime = config.smoothTime or 0.1
    ik.Weight = config.p or 1
    ik.Parent = config.parent
    ik.Enabled = true
    return ik
end

function IKSetup.createHingeConstraint(
    parent: BasePart,
    attachment0: Attachment,
    attachment1: Attachment,
    lowerAngle: number?,
    upperAngle: number?
): HingeConstraint
    local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
    hinge.Attachment0 = attachment0
    hinge.Attachment1 = attachment1
    hinge.LimitsEnabled = true
    hinge.LowerAngle = lowerAngle or -90
    hinge.UpperAngle = upperAngle or 90
    hinge.Restitution = 0
    hinge.Parent = parent
    return hinge
end

return IKSetup

--!strict
-- Steps and slides of the local creature by distance travelled (the creature has no legs).
-- Does not catch landings, does not play sound, no slide loops (slides are short sounds by distance).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local SoundBank = require(Config:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local FeelConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local FeelTypes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FeelTypes"))
local Signal = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Signal"))
local SurfaceProbe = require(script.Parent.SurfaceProbe)

type StepInfo = FeelTypes.StepInfo
type SurfaceHit = FeelTypes.SurfaceHit
type LandingInfo = FeelTypes.LandingInfo

local StepDriver = {}

StepDriver.Stepped = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<StepInfo>

local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local character: Model? = nil
local root: BasePart? = nil

local ground: SurfaceHit? = nil -- last grounded hit, nil in air
local distance = 0 -- horizontal studs since the last step
local lastMaterial: string? = nil
local suppressUntil = 0

local function intensityFor(speed: number): number
	local step = FeelConfig.Step
	local span = step.MaxSpeedForIntensity - step.MinSpeed
	if span <= 0 then
		return 1
	end
	return math.clamp((speed - step.MinSpeed) / span, step.MinIntensity, 1)
end

local function onHeartbeat(dt: number)
	local r = root
	local char = character
	if r == nil or char == nil or r.Parent == nil then
		ground = nil
		return
	end

	local height = r.Size.Y * 0.5 + FeelConfig.Character.HipHeight
	local grounded = FeelConfig.Probe.GroundedDistance
	local hit = SurfaceProbe.CastFootprint(r, height + grounded, { char :: Instance })
	if hit == nil or hit.distance - height > grounded then
		ground = nil
		return
	end
	ground = hit

	-- Material change under the creature resets the counter
	if hit.material ~= lastMaterial then
		lastMaterial = hit.material
		distance = 0
	end

	local v = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speed = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
	if speed < FeelConfig.Step.MinSpeed then
		return
	end
	distance += speed * dt

	local materialEntry = SoundBank.Materials[hit.material] or SoundBank.Materials[SoundBank.DefaultMaterial]
	local kind: "step" | "slide" = if materialEntry ~= nil and materialEntry.MoveKind == "slide" then "slide" else "step"
	local threshold = if kind == "slide" then FeelConfig.Step.SlideDistance else FeelConfig.Step.StepDistance
	if distance < threshold then
		return
	end
	distance = 0

	local now = os.clock()
	if now < suppressUntil then
		return -- just landed: the landing sound covers this step
	end
	StepDriver.Stepped:Fire({
		kind = kind,
		position = hit.position,
		speed = speed,
		intensity = intensityFor(speed),
		material = hit.material,
		part = hit.part,
		time = now,
	})
end

function StepDriver.Stop(): ()
	for _, c in connections do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	connections = {}
	character = nil
	root = nil
	ground = nil
	distance = 0
	lastMaterial = nil
	suppressUntil = 0
end

function StepDriver.Start(char: Model): ()
	StepDriver.Stop()
	if typeof(char) ~= "Instance" or not char:IsA("Model") then
		warn("[StepDriver] Start needs a character Model")
		return
	end
	character = char

	-- Attach once HumanoidRootPart exists (it may arrive after CharacterAdded)
	local attached = false
	local function tryAttach()
		if attached or character ~= char then
			return
		end
		local r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if r == nil or not r:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end
		attached = true
		root = r :: BasePart
		table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onHeartbeat))
	end

	table.insert(connections, char.ChildAdded:Connect(tryAttach))
	tryAttach()
end

function StepDriver.NotifyLanded(_info: LandingInfo): ()
	distance = 0
	suppressUntil = os.clock() + FeelConfig.Step.SuppressAfterLanding
end

function StepDriver.GetGround(): SurfaceHit?
	return ground
end

return StepDriver

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

local TweenHelper = {}

export type TweenConfig = {
    duration: number,
    easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?,
    easingDirection: Enum.EasingDirection?,
    repeatCount: number?,
    reverses: boolean?,
    delayTime: number?,
}

local TweenService: TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function buildTweenInfo(config: TweenConfig): TweenInfo
    return TweenInfo.new(
        config.duration,
        config.easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
        config.easingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
        config.repeatCount or 0,
        config.reverses or false,
        config.delayTime or 0
    )
end

function TweenHelper.tween(
    instance: Instance,
    properties: { [string]: any },
    config: TweenConfig
): Tween
    local info = buildTweenInfo(config)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, info, properties)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
end

function TweenHelper.tweenAsync(
    instance: Instance,
    properties: { [string]: any },
    config: TweenConfig
): boolean
    local tween = TweenHelper.tween(instance, properties, config)
    local completed = false
    local conn: RBXScriptConnection?
    conn = tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        completed = true
        if conn then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
    while not completed do
        task.wait()
    end
    return completed
end

function TweenHelper.sequence(steps: {
    {
        instance: Instance,
        properties: { [string]: any },
        config: TweenConfig,
    }
}): ()
    local current = 1
    local function playNext()
        if current > #steps then
            return
        end
        local step = steps[current]
        current += 1
        local tween = TweenHelper.tween(step.instance, step.properties, step.config)
        local conn: RBXScriptConnection?
        conn = tween.Completed:Once(function()
            if conn then
                conn:Disconnect()
            end
            playNext()
        end)
    end
    playNext()
end

return TweenHelper

--!strict
-- Ray down -> part -> our sound material (SoundMaterial attribute, then Enum fallback, then default).
-- Does not decide landing vs step, does not cache parts between frames.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local SoundBank = require(Config:WaitForChild("SoundBank"))
local FeelConfig = require(Config:WaitForChild("FeelConfig"))
local FeelTypes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FeelTypes"))

type SurfaceHit = FeelTypes.SurfaceHit
type MaterialName = FeelTypes.MaterialName

local SurfaceProbe = {}

local params: RaycastParams? = nil
local warnedValues: { [string]: boolean } = {} -- unknown SoundMaterial values already reported

local function getParams(): RaycastParams
	local p = params
	if p == nil then
		p = RaycastParams.new()
		p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params = p
	end
	return p :: RaycastParams
end

local function isFiniteNumber(x: any): boolean
	return typeof(x) == "number" and x == x and x ~= math.huge and x ~= -math.huge
end

-- Horizontal unit vector from a direction; falls back to a world axis when nearly vertical
local function flatten(v: Vector3, fallback: Vector3): Vector3
	local flat = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.5 then
		return fallback
	end
	return flat.Unit
end

function SurfaceProbe.Init(): ()
	getParams()
end

function SurfaceProbe.ResolveMaterial(part: BasePart?, enumMaterial: Enum.Material): MaterialName
	local materials = SoundBank.Materials
	if part ~= nil then
		local maxDepth = FeelConfig.Probe.AttributeSearchDepth
		local inst: Instance? = part
		local depth = 0
		while inst ~= nil and inst ~= Workspace and depth <= maxDepth do
			local value = inst:GetAttribute("SoundMaterial")
			if value ~= nil then
				if typeof(value) == "string" and materials[value] ~= nil then
					return value
				end
				local key = tostring(value)
				if not warnedValues[key] then
					warnedValues[key] = true
					warn(
						string.format(
							"[SurfaceProbe] unknown SoundMaterial %q on %s, using %s",
							key,
							inst:GetFullName(),
							SoundBank.DefaultMaterial
						)
					)
				end
				return SoundBank.DefaultMaterial
			end
			inst = inst.Parent
			depth += 1
		end
	end
	if typeof(enumMaterial) == "EnumItem" then
		local fallback = SoundBank.FallbackByEnum[enumMaterial.Name]
		if fallback ~= nil and materials[fallback] ~= nil then
			return fallback
		end
	end
	return SoundBank.DefaultMaterial
end

function SurfaceProbe.Cast(origin: Vector3, distance: number, ignore: { Instance }): SurfaceHit?
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or not isFiniteNumber(distance) or distance <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local p = getParams()
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -distance, 0), p)
	if result == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local inst = result.Instance
	if not inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	local part = inst :: BasePart
	return {
		part = part,
		position = result.Position,
		normal = result.Normal,
		distance = result.Distance,
		material = SurfaceProbe.ResolveMaterial(part, result.Material),
	}
end

function SurfaceProbe.CastFootprint(root: BasePart, distance: number, ignore: { Instance }): SurfaceHit?
	if typeof(root) ~= "Instance" or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	local center = root.Position
	local hit = SurfaceProbe.Cast(center, distance, ignore)
	if hit ~= nil then
		return hit
	end

	-- Center missed: 4 rays from the footprint edge (forward, back, left, right)
	local radius = root.Size.X * 0.5 * FeelConfig.Probe.FootprintRadiusFactor
	local cf = root.CFrame
	local forward = flatten(cf.LookVector, Vector3.zAxis) * radius
	local right = flatten(cf.RightVector, Vector3.xAxis) * radius
	local best: SurfaceHit? = nil
	for _, offset in { forward, -forward, -right, right } do
		local h = SurfaceProbe.Cast(center + offset, distance, ignore)
		if h ~= nil and (best == nil or h.distance < (best :: SurfaceHit).distance) then
			best = h
		end
	end
	return best
end

return SurfaceProbe

-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    AudioBus.lua
    A small music/SFX bus helper using the modern audio graph.

    - Creates separate AudioFader instances for Music and SFX buses.
    - Wires AudioPlayers (you provide) through the appropriate bus to a shared
      AudioDeviceOutput.
    - Supports ducking: temporarily lower music volume while SFX play, then
      restore.

    Usage:
        local AudioBus = require(path.to.AudioBus)
        local bus = AudioBus.new()

        local musicPlayer = Instance.new("AudioPlayer")
        musicPlayer.AssetId = "rbxassetid://MUSIC_ID"
        musicPlayer.Looping = true
        bus:attachMusic(musicPlayer)
        musicPlayer:Play()

        local sfxPlayer = Instance.new("AudioPlayer")
        sfxPlayer.AssetId = "rbxassetid://SFX_ID"
        bus:attachSfx(sfxPlayer)
        bus:playSfxWithDuck(sfxPlayer, 0.3, 1.5) -- duck music to 0.3 for 1.5s
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local AudioBus = {}
AudioBus.__index = AudioBus

export type AudioBus = typeof(setmetatable(
    {} :: {
        musicFader: AudioFader,
        sfxFader: AudioFader,
        output: AudioDeviceOutput,
        musicVolume: number,
    },
    AudioBus
))

local function makeFader(parent: Instance, name: string, volume: number): AudioFader
    local fader = Instance.new("AudioFader")
    fader.Name = name
    fader.Volume = volume
    fader.Parent = parent
    return fader
end

local function wire(source: Instance, target: Instance, parent: Instance): Wire
    local w = Instance.new("Wire")
    w.SourceInstance = source
    w.TargetInstance = target
    w.Parent = parent
    return w
end

function AudioBus.new(): AudioBus
    local output = Instance.new("AudioDeviceOutput")
    output.Name = "BusOutput"
    output.Parent = SoundService

    local musicFader = makeFader(SoundService, "MusicFader", 1)
    local sfxFader = makeFader(SoundService, "SfxFader", 1)

    -- Bus → output
    wire(musicFader, output, SoundService)
    wire(sfxFader, output, SoundService)

    return setmetatable({
        output = output,
        musicFader = musicFader,
        sfxFader = sfxFader,
        musicVolume = 1,
    }, AudioBus) :: AudioBus
end

function AudioBus:attachMusic(player: AudioPlayer): ()
    -- Ensure the player has a parent so it can be wired
    if not player.Parent then
        player.Parent = SoundService
    end
    wire(player, self.musicFader, SoundService)
end

function AudioBus:attachSfx(player: AudioPlayer): ()
    if not player.Parent then
        player.Parent = SoundService
    end
    wire(player, self.sfxFader, SoundService)
end

function AudioBus:setMusicVolume(volume: number, fadeTime: number?): ()
    fadeTime = fadeTime or 0.2
    self.musicVolume = volume
    local tween = TweenService:Create(self.musicFader, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime), { Volume = volume })
    tween:Play()
end

function AudioBus:playSfxWithDuck(player: AudioPlayer, duckTo: number?, duckDuration: number?): ()
    duckTo = duckTo or 0.3
    duckDuration = duckDuration or 1.5
    local original = self.musicVolume
    self:setMusicVolume(duckTo, 0.1)
    player:Play()
    task.delay(duckDuration, function()
        self:setMusicVolume(original, 0.5)
    end)
end

function AudioBus:destroy(): ()
    for _, obj in ipairs({ self.musicFader, self.sfxFader, self.output }) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

return AudioBus

--!strict
-- Touch particles (contract "Dynamics v1", D7.6). Client only. One ParticleEmitter per kind on one invisible
-- anchor part. Emit only moves an attachment and calls :Emit(n); all emitter settings are made in Init.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local ConfigFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Stations = require(ConfigFolder:WaitForChild("Stations"))
local Icons: any = require(ConfigFolder:WaitForChild("Icons"))

local fxCfg: any = Stations.Fx or {}
local kinds: any = fxCfg.Kinds or {}
local MAX_PER_SECOND: number = fxCfg.MaxPerSecond or 160
local MAX_PER_EMIT: number = fxCfg.MaxPerEmit or 12

local FALLBACK_KIND = "Sparkle"
local WINDOW_SECONDS = 1
local EPSILON = 1e-6
local STATION_VISUALS_NAME = "StationVisuals"
local ANCHOR_NAME = "Fx"

type Emitter = { attachment: Attachment, emitter: ParticleEmitter, def: any }
type Record = { time: number, count: number }

local TouchFx = {}

local emitters: { [string]: Emitter } = {}
local anchor: BasePart? = nil
local ready = false
local warned: { [string]: boolean } = {}

-- one-second window of emitted counts, oldest first
local records: { Record } = {}
local windowTotal = 0
local emittedTotal = 0
local droppedTotal = 0

local function warnOnce(key: string, message: string)
	if warned[key] then
		return
	end
	warned[key] = true
	warn("[TouchFx] " .. message)
end

local function finite(n: number): boolean
	return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

local function finiteVector(v: Vector3): boolean
	return finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z)
end

local function prune(now: number)
	while #records > 0 and records[1].time <= now - WINDOW_SECONDS do
		windowTotal -= records[1].count
		table.remove(records, 1)
	end
end

local function reducedMotion(): boolean
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return (GuiService :: any).ReducedMotionEnabled
	end)
	return ok and value == true
end

local function colorSequence(colors: { Color3 }): ColorSequence
	if #colors == 0 then
		return ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	end
	if #colors == 1 then
		return ColorSequence.new(colors[1])
	end
	local keys = {}
	for i, color in colors do
		table.insert(keys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((i - 1) / (#colors - 1), color))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(keys)
end

-- "" = leave the emitter's default texture; "Icon:<Key>" = Config/Icons[Key]
local function applyTexture(emitter: ParticleEmitter, kind: string, texture: string)
	if texture == "" then
		return
	end
	local key = string.match(texture, "^Icon:(.+)$")
	if key == nil then
		warnOnce("texture:" .. kind, "unsupported texture for " .. kind .. ", default kept")
		return
	end
	local image = Icons[key]
	if type(image) ~= "string" or image == "" then
		warnOnce("icon:" .. key, "no image for Icon:" .. key .. ", default kept")
		return
	end
	emitter.Texture = image
end

local function makeEmitter(kind: string, def: any, parent: Attachment): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = kind
	emitter.Enabled = false
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
	emitter.Color = colorSequence(def.Colors or {})
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(def.Speed)
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(def.Lifetime)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, def.Size),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
	emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -def.Gravity, 0)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(def.Spread, def.Spread)
	emitter.Drag = def.Drag
	emitter.LightEmission = def.LightEmission
	applyTexture(emitter, kind, def.Texture or "")
	emitter.Parent = parent
	return emitter
end

function TouchFx.Init(): ()
	if ready then
		return
	end

	local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(STATION_VISUALS_NAME)
	if folder == nil or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
		local newFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		newFolder.Name = STATION_VISUALS_NAME
		newFolder.Parent = Workspace
		folder = newFolder
	end
	local old = folder:FindFirstChild(ANCHOR_NAME)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = ANCHOR_NAME
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Parent = folder
	anchor = part

	for kind, def in kinds do
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = kind
		attachment.Parent = part
		local emitter = makeEmitter(kind, def, attachment)
		emitters[kind] = { attachment = attachment, emitter = emitter, def = def }
	end

	ready = true
end

function TouchFx.Emit(kind: string, position: Vector3, normal: Vector3, intensity: number): ()
	if not ready then
		return
	end
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" or not finiteVector(position) then
		return
	end

	local entry = emitters[kind]
	if entry == nil then
		warnOnce("kind:" .. tostring(kind), "unknown kind " .. tostring(kind) .. ", using " .. FALLBACK_KIND)
		entry = emitters[FALLBACK_KIND]
		if entry == nil then
			return
		end
	end

	local power = 0
	if type(intensity) == "number" and finite(intensity) then
		power = math.clamp(intensity, 0, 1)
	end

	local count = math.min(math.round(entry.def.Count * (0.5 + 0.5 * power)), MAX_PER_EMIT)
	if reducedMotion() then
		count = math.max(1, math.round(count / 2))
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	prune(now)
	local send = math.max(0, math.min(count, MAX_PER_SECOND - windowTotal))
	droppedTotal += count - send
	if send <= 0 then
		return
	end
	table.insert(records, { time = now, count = send })
	windowTotal += send
	emittedTotal += send

	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	if typeof(normal) == "Vector3" and finiteVector(normal) and normal.Magnitude > EPSILON then
		up = normal.Unit
	end
	entry.attachment.WorldPosition = position
	entry.attachment.WorldAxis = up
	entry.emitter:Emit(send)
end

function TouchFx.GetStats(): { emitted: number, perSecond: number, dropped: number }
	prune(os.clock())
	return { emitted = emittedTotal, perSecond = windowTotal, dropped = droppedTotal }
end

function TouchFx.Stop(): ()
	ready = false
	if anchor then
		anchor:Destroy()
	end
	anchor = nil
	emitters = {}
	table.clear(records)
	windowTotal = 0
end

return TouchFx

--[[
ServiceHelper.lua
Small utilities for working with Roblox services and modules safely.

local ServiceHelper = require(...)
local Players = ServiceHelper.getService("Players")
local MyModule = ServiceHelper.requireModule("MyModule") -- waits safely
]]

local ServiceHelper = {}

function ServiceHelper.getService(serviceName: string): Instance
    return game:GetService(serviceName)
end

local DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: number = 10

function ServiceHelper.requireModule<T>(moduleName: string, parent: Instance?, timeout: number?): T
    local moduleParent = parent or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local module = moduleParent:WaitForChild(moduleName, timeout or DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
    if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        return require(module) :: T
    end
    error("Module not found or not a ModuleScript: " .. moduleName)
end

return ServiceHelper

--!strict
-- Client-only world effects from Roblox's built-in particle textures (nothing uploaded): snow puffs
-- under the shovel, the PERFECT hit, the meteor impact, and a camera shake that never drifts.
-- Recipes follow the roblox-vfx skill (vfx-design.md, vfx-craft.md §4–5, vfx-camera-world.md) tuned
-- for Frosty Plush: pastel colors and low Brightness under our soft Bloom (Threshold 1.4), no dark
-- layers. Everything is built once and reused (round-robin rigs); nothing is created per hit.
-- Phones on Automatic quality and low graphics settings get the light variant: fewer particles.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Vfx = {}

-- Built-in textures, white with the shape in alpha (the particle Color tints them).
Vfx.Textures = {
	Glow = "rbxasset://textures/particles/explosion01_implosion_main.dds", -- soft round glow
	Ring = "rbxasset://textures/particles/explosion01_shockwave_main.dds", -- soft ring
	Star = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds", -- four-point star
}

-- Light variant -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local light = false

local function readQuality()
	local ok, level = pcall(function()
		return UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").SavedQualityLevel
	end)
	if not ok then
		light = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
	elseif level == Enum.SavedQualitySetting.Automatic then
		-- Automatic does not expose its level: phones keep to the ~100 particles a second budget.
		light = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
	else
		light = level.Value <= 3
	end
end

-- True on phones with Automatic graphics and on low settings: effects play with fewer particles.
function Vfx.IsLight(): boolean
	return light
end

-- Builders ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function sequence(points: { { number } }): NumberSequence
	local keys = {}
	for _, point in points do
		table.insert(keys, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keys)
end

local function colors(points: { { any } }): ColorSequence
	local keys = {}
	for _, point in points do
		table.insert(keys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(keys)
end

type Layer = { Emitter: ParticleEmitter, Count: number, Light: number, Delay: number }
type Rig = { Attachment: Attachment, Layers: { Layer } }

local function newRig(name: string): Rig
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = name
	attachment.Parent = Workspace.Terrain
	return { Attachment = attachment, Layers = {} }
end

-- One layer of a rig: an emitter that bursts `count` particles (`lightCount` in the light variant)
-- `delay` seconds after the effect starts. Emitters never run on their own (Rate 0).
local function layer(rig: Rig, count: number, lightCount: number, delay: number, props: { [string]: any }): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = props.Name or "Layer"
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Enabled = false
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
	emitter.LightInfluence = 0
	for key, value in props do
		if key ~= "Name" then
			(emitter :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	emitter.Parent = rig.Attachment
	table.insert(rig.Layers, { Emitter = emitter, Count = count, Light = lightCount, Delay = delay })
	return emitter
end

-- Particles stay in world space after they leave, so a rig can move to the next hit right away.
local function fire(rig: Rig, position: Vector3)
	rig.Attachment.Position = position
	for _, entry in rig.Layers do
		local count = if light then entry.Light else entry.Count
		if count > 0 then
			local emitter = entry.Emitter
			if entry.Delay > 0 then
				task.delay(entry.Delay, function()
					emitter:Emit(count)
				end)
			else
				emitter:Emit(count)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Camera shake --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rotation only. Last frame's offset is taken back off just before the camera scripts run, so the
-- view never builds up a tilt (vfx-camera-world.md); several shakes add up and fade on their own.

type Shake = { Magnitude: number, Start: number, Duration: number, Roughness: number, Seed: number }
local shakes: { Shake } = {}
local applied = CFrame.identity

-- `magnitude` in degrees, faded out over `duration` seconds; `roughness` is how fast it wobbles.
function Vfx.Shake(magnitude: number, duration: number, roughness: number?)
	if not (magnitude > 0 and duration > 0) then
		return
	end
	table.insert(shakes, {
		Magnitude = magnitude,
		Start = os.clock(),
		Duration = duration,
		Roughness = roughness or 12,
		Seed = math.random() * 100,
	})
end

local function undoShake()
	if applied ~= CFrame.identity then
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			camera.CFrame *= applied:Inverse()
		end
		applied = CFrame.identity
	end
end

local function applyShake()
	if #shakes == 0 then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local pitch, yaw, roll = 0, 0, 0
	for index = #shakes, 1, -1 do
		local shake = shakes[index]
		local age = now - shake.Start
		local t = age / shake.Duration
		if t >= 1 then
			table.remove(shakes, index)
		else
			local power = shake.Magnitude * (1 - t) * (1 - t) * 2 -- math.noise stays within about ±0.5
			local phase = age * shake.Roughness
			pitch += math.noise(phase, shake.Seed, 0.5) * power
			yaw += math.noise(shake.Seed, phase, 1.5) * power
			roll += math.noise(2.5, shake.Seed, phase) * power * 0.5
		end
	end
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		applied = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch), math.rad(yaw), math.rad(roll))
		camera.CFrame *= applied
	end
end

-- Snow under the shovel -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Soft round puffs that pop up and hang, plus a few crumbs that fall: cartoon snow, not smoke.

-- White and pale tints vanish against the snow field (checked in Studio): puffs are a clear ice blue,
-- unlit, that deepens as they fade.
local SNOW_LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(172, 204, 247)
local SNOW_SHADE = Color3.fromRGB(144, 182, 240)
local snow: Rig
local snowPuffs: ParticleEmitter
local snowCrumbs: ParticleEmitter

local function buildSnow()
	snow = newRig("VfxSnow")
	snowPuffs = layer(snow, 0, 0, 0, {
		Name = "Puffs",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(SNOW_LIGHT, SNOW_SHADE),
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.7 }, { 0.2, 2.2 }, { 1, 1.7 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0 }, { 0.55, 0.15 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.75),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 9),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 55),
		Drag = 4,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -5, 0),
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
		RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40),
		ZOffset = 0.2,
	})
	snowCrumbs = layer(snow, 0, 0, 0, {
		Name = "Crumbs",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(SNOW_SHADE),
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.2 }, { 0.1, 0.55 }, { 1, 0.12 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0 }, { 0.75, 0 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 17),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35),
		Drag = 1,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -50, 0),
		ZOffset = 0.3,
	})
end

-- Snow flying up from a dig, a drift or a beaten monster; more snow, more puffs (capped for phones).
function Vfx.SnowBurst(position: Vector3, units: number)
	local puffs = math.clamp(2 + math.floor(units / 3), 2, 6)
	local crumbs = math.clamp(3 + math.floor(units / 2), 3, 14)
	if light then
		puffs, crumbs = math.ceil(puffs / 2), math.ceil(crumbs / 2)
	end
	snow.Attachment.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	snowPuffs:Emit(puffs)
	snowCrumbs:Emit(crumbs)
end

-- PERFECT -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A quick warm flash and a gold star, then little stars, snow streaks that shoot out and stop, and
-- a small ring; a light camera nudge. Small and short: it can fire every swing.

local PERFECT_RIGS = 2
local perfectRigs: { Rig } = {}
local nextPerfect = 1

local function buildPerfect(rig: Rig)
	layer(rig, 1, 1, 0, {
		Name = "Flash",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 214)),
		LightEmission = 0.6,
		Brightness = 1.8,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 4.5 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0.15 }, { 1, 0.8 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.09),
		ZOffset = 1.5,
	})
	layer(rig, 1, 1, 0, {
		Name = "Flare",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Star,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90)),
		LightEmission = 0.4,
		Brightness = 1.5,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.25, 5 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.16),
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(-12, 12),
		ZOffset = 2,
	})
	layer(rig, 4, 3, 0.03, {
		Name = "Stars",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Star,
		Color = colors({ { 0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 50) }, { 1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 130) } }),
		LightEmission = 0.15,
		Brightness = 1.4,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 0 }, { 0.12, 1.9 }, { 1, 0.2 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.75),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(9, 15),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 55),
		Drag = 3,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -12, 0),
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
		RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-200, 200),
		ZOffset = 1,
	})
	layer(rig, 8, 5, 0.04, {
		Name = "Streaks",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(SNOW_LIGHT),
		Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel,
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(-90),
		Squash = sequence({ { 0, 2.5 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.7 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.4),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(24, 36),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70),
		Drag = 7,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -25, 0),
		ZOffset = 0.8,
	})
	layer(rig, 1, 1, 0.05, {
		Name = "Ring",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Ring,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 80)),
		LightEmission = 0.3,
		Brightness = 1.3,
		Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular,
		Speed = NumberRange.new(0.001), -- a flat sprite needs a direction to lie across
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.zero,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.45, 6 }, { 1, 7 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0.1 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.32),
		ZOffset = 0.3,
	})
end

function Vfx.Perfect(position: Vector3)
	local rig = perfectRigs[nextPerfect]
	nextPerfect = nextPerfect % PERFECT_RIGS + 1
	fire(rig, position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
	Vfx.Shake(0.35, 0.2, 18)
end

-- Meteor impact -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Flash and flare, a flat shockwave disc racing over the snow, a ring, warm puffs that keep growing
-- after the flash, snow chunks and embers thrown up, and dark icy cracks that spread, hold and melt.

local IMPACT_RIGS = 2
local CRACKS = 7
local CRACK_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(40, 62, 112)
local CRACK_HOLD = 1.3 -- seconds the cracks stay before they melt
local CRACK_FADE = 1
local WAVE_SIZE = 34 -- studs across at the end

type Segment = { Part: Part, From: Vector3, To: Vector3, Width: number }
type Impact = { Rig: Rig, Wave: Part, Cracks: { Part }, Token: number }
local impacts: { Impact } = {}
local nextImpact = 1
local vfxFolder: Folder
local random = Random.new()

local function effectPart(name: string, shape: Enum.PartType?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Parent = vfxFolder
	return part
end

local function buildImpact(): Impact
	local rig = newRig("VfxMeteor")
	layer(rig, 1, 1, 0, {
		Name = "Flash",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 180)),
		LightEmission = 0.7,
		Brightness = 2,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 20 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0.1 }, { 1, 0.7 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.12),
		ZOffset = 4,
	})
	layer(rig, 1, 1, 0, {
		Name = "Flare",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Star,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120)),
		LightEmission = 0.5,
		Brightness = 1.8,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 4 }, { 0.3, 24 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.14),
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(-10, 10),
		ZOffset = 5,
	})
	layer(rig, 1, 1, 0.04, {
		Name = "Ring",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Ring,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 228, 196)),
		LightEmission = 0.3,
		Brightness = 1.4,
		Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular,
		Speed = NumberRange.new(0.001),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.zero,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 3 }, { 0.4, 26 }, { 1, 32 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5),
		ZOffset = 0.5,
	})
	layer(rig, 9, 5, 0.05, {
		Name = "Puffs",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		-- Lit by the fire at first, then plain snow (smoke takes the fire's color where it is lit).
		Color = colors({ { 0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 170) }, { 0.15, SNOW_LIGHT }, { 1, SNOW_SHADE } }),
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 3 }, { 0.3, 7 }, { 1, 9 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0 }, { 0.6, 0.25 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.5),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(75, 75),
		Drag = 4,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
		RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30),
		TimeScale = 0.85,
		ZOffset = 1,
	})
	layer(rig, 14, 8, 0.05, {
		Name = "Chunks",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(SNOW_SHADE),
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.6 }, { 0.1, 1.6 }, { 1, 0.4 } }),
		Transparency = sequence({ { 0, 0 }, { 0.8, 0 }, { 1, 1 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9, 1.3),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(28, 45),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35),
		Drag = 1,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -55, 0),
		ZOffset = 1.5,
	})
	layer(rig, 8, 4, 0.06, {
		Name = "Embers",
		Texture = Vfx.Textures.Glow,
		Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 80), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 60)),
		LightEmission = 1,
		Brightness = 1.6,
		Size = sequence({ { 0, 0.5 }, { 1, 0 } }),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.2),
		Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 34),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
		Drag = 2,
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -20, 0),
		ZOffset = 2,
	})

	local wave = effectPart("Shockwave", Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	wave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 212, 170)
	local cracks = {}
	for _ = 1, CRACKS * 2 do -- a root and a thinner tip per crack
		local part = effectPart("Crack")
		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.Color = CRACK_COLOR
		table.insert(cracks, part)
	end
	return { Rig = rig, Wave = wave, Cracks = cracks, Token = 0 }
end

-- Height of the snow (or floor) under a point, so the cracks lie on the surface.
local surfaceParams = RaycastParams.new()
surfaceParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

local function surfaceAt(point: Vector3, fallback: number): number
	local zones = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	if not zones then
		return fallback
	end
	surfaceParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zones }
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), surfaceParams)
	return if hit then hit.Position.Y else fallback
end

-- The top of whatever lies under `position` (snow tile, drift, floor), for effects on the ground.
function Vfx.Surface(position: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(position.X, surfaceAt(position, position.Y), position.Z)
end

local function growSegment(segment: Segment, delay: number, token: number, impact: Impact)
	local part = segment.Part
	local direction = segment.To - segment.From
	local length = direction.Magnitude
	local flat = CFrame.lookAt(segment.From, segment.To)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(segment.Width, 0.08, 0.05)
	part.CFrame = flat
	part.Transparency = 1
	task.delay(delay, function()
		if impact.Token ~= token then
			return
		end
		part.Transparency = 0
		TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = Vector3.new(segment.Width, 0.08, length),
			CFrame = flat * CFrame.new(0, 0, -length / 2),
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function Vfx.MeteorImpact(target: Vector3)
	local impact = impacts[nextImpact]
	nextImpact = nextImpact % IMPACT_RIGS + 1
	impact.Token += 1
	local token = impact.Token
	local ground = Vfx.Surface(target)

	fire(impact.Rig, ground + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))

	-- The shockwave: a thin flat disc that races out and fades (the cheapest strong trick).
	local wave = impact.Wave
	-- It lies just under the cracks and is gone in a blink, so it reads as a pulse, not a plate.
	local flat = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.04, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	wave.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 2, 2)
	wave.CFrame = flat
	wave.Transparency = 0.4
	local pulse = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(wave, pulse, { Size = Vector3.new(0.1, WAVE_SIZE, WAVE_SIZE), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

	-- Cracks: jagged, uneven, each a thick root that turns once into a thinner tip.
	local count = if light then CRACKS - 2 else CRACKS
	local turn = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	for index = 1, CRACKS do
		local root = impact.Cracks[index * 2 - 1]
		local tip = impact.Cracks[index * 2]
		if index > count then
			root.Transparency = 1
			tip.Transparency = 1
			continue
		end
		local angle = turn + index * math.pi * 2 / count + random:NextNumber(-0.45, 0.45)
		local direction = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
		local start = ground + direction * random:NextNumber(1.2, 2.8)
		local bend = angle + random:NextNumber(0.35, 0.6) * (if random:NextNumber() < 0.5 then -1 else 1)
		local middle = start + direction * random:NextNumber(2.5, 5.5)
		local finish = middle + Vector3.new(math.cos(bend), 0, math.sin(bend)) * random:NextNumber(2.2, 4)
		local function lift(point: Vector3): Vector3
			return Vector3.new(point.X, surfaceAt(point, ground.Y) + 0.1, point.Z)
		end
		local delay = 0.05 + index * 0.015
		growSegment({ Part = root, From = lift(start), To = lift(middle), Width = random:NextNumber(0.5, 0.66) }, delay, token, impact)
		growSegment({ Part = tip, From = lift(middle), To = lift(finish), Width = random:NextNumber(0.24, 0.34) }, delay + 0.12, token, impact)
	end
	task.delay(CRACK_HOLD, function()
		if impact.Token ~= token then
			return
		end
		local melt = TweenInfo.new(CRACK_FADE, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		for _, part in impact.Cracks do
			if part.Transparency < 1 then
				TweenService:Create(part, melt, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Start ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function build()
	readQuality()
	pcall(function()
		UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("SavedQualityLevel"):Connect(readQuality)
	end)

	vfxFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	vfxFolder.Name = "ClientVfx"
	vfxFolder.Parent = Workspace

	buildSnow()
	for _ = 1, PERFECT_RIGS do
		local rig = newRig("VfxPerfect")
		buildPerfect(rig)
		table.insert(perfectRigs, rig)
	end
	for _ = 1, IMPACT_RIGS do
		table.insert(impacts, buildImpact())
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("VfxShakeUndo", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, undoShake)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("VfxShakeApply", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, applyShake)
	-- A new character gets a fresh camera subject: drop any shake still running.
	Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		table.clear(shakes)
	end)
end

build()

return Vfx

--[[
BudgetMonitor.lua
Utilities for inspecting and configuring DataStore request budgets at server startup.
Call early in a Script under ServerScriptService (once per server).

Example:
local BudgetMonitor = require(...)
BudgetMonitor.configureForBusyServer()
BudgetMonitor.printAllBudgets()
]]

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local BudgetMonitor = {}

type RequestTypeEntry = {
    name: string,
    requestType: Enum.DataStoreRequestType,
}

local REQUEST_TYPES: { RequestTypeEntry } = {
    { name = "StandardRead", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRead },
    { name = "StandardWrite", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardWrite },
    { name = "StandardList", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardList },
    { name = "StandardRemove", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRemove },
    { name = "OrderedRead", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedRead },
    { name = "OrderedWrite", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedWrite },
    { name = "OrderedRemove", requestType = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedRemove },
    -- Note: GetVersionAsync/GetVersionAtTimeAsync count as StandardRead, not separate budget categories.
    -- OrderedList is intentionally omitted: GetRequestBudgetForRequestType always returns 0 for it.
}

local REQUEST_TYPES_BY_NAME: { [string]: Enum.DataStoreRequestType } = {
    StandardRead = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRead,
    StandardWrite = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardWrite,
    StandardList = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardList,
    StandardRemove = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRemove,
    OrderedRead = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedRead,
    OrderedWrite = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedWrite,
    OrderedList = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedList,
    OrderedRemove = Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedRemove,
}

function BudgetMonitor.printAllBudgets()
    print("=== Current DataStore Request Budgets ===")
    for _, entry in REQUEST_TYPES do
        local budget = DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(entry.requestType)
        print(string.format("%-20s : %d", entry.name, budget))
    end
    print("OrderedList            : budget inspection always returns 0")
end

function BudgetMonitor.configureForBusyServer()
    -- Example aggressive but reasonable settings for a popular game or migration server.
    -- Tune based on your actual concurrent player count and workload.
    -- Call this ONLY during server initialization, once per type.

    local function safeSet(
        requestTypeName: string,
        requestType: Enum.DataStoreRequestType,
        base: number,
        perPlayer: number
    )
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            DataStoreService:SetRateLimitForRequestType(requestType, base, perPlayer)
        end)
        if ok then
            print("Configured", requestTypeName, "base=", base, "perPlayer=", perPlayer)
        else
            warn("Failed to set rate limit for", requestTypeName, err)
        end
    end

    -- These are examples — respect the per-type constraints documented in the class reference.
    -- The per-player StandardWrite value here matches the Roblox default (40). Lowering it reduces
    -- per-server burst but can cause write throttling under load; raising it increases headroom
    -- but also raises the ceiling on how much a single server can consume.
    safeSet("StandardRead", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRead, 2000, 50)
    safeSet("StandardWrite", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardWrite, 1500, 40)
    safeSet("StandardList", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardList, 300, 5)
    safeSet("StandardRemove", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRemove, 1000, 20)

    safeSet("OrderedRead", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedRead, 1500, 40)
    safeSet("OrderedWrite", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedWrite, 1000, 20)
    -- OrderedList: SetRateLimitForRequestType accepts the enum, but GetRequestBudgetForRequestType
    -- always returns 0 for it, so the limit cannot be inspected at runtime.
    safeSet("OrderedList", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedList, 150, 3)
    safeSet("OrderedRemove", Enum.DataStoreRequestType.OrderedRemove, 800, 15)
end

function BudgetMonitor.waitForAnyBudget(requestTypeName: string, timeout: number?): boolean
    local enumItem = REQUEST_TYPES_BY_NAME[requestTypeName]
    if not enumItem then
        return false
    end
    if requestTypeName == "OrderedList" then
        warn(
            "Cannot wait for budget of "
                .. requestTypeName
                .. "; GetRequestBudgetForRequestType always returns 0 for this type."
        )
        return false
    end

    local start = os.clock()
    while DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(enumItem) <= 0 do
        if os.clock() - start > (timeout or 30) then
            return false
        end
        task.wait(0.25)
    end
    return true
end

return BudgetMonitor

--!strict
-- Loads and saves player profiles with ProfileStore (session lock, autosave, save on leave and on shutdown).
-- profile.Data IS the live table PlayerState changes, so every change is saved automatically.
-- ProfileStore owns shutdown saving (its own BindToClose); do not add another.
-- Studio without DataStore access (unpublished place, API access off): ProfileStore itself switches to an
-- in-memory mock store there, so profiles load but are not saved. In a live server ProfileStore always uses
-- the real DataStore, and a failed load is a kick, never a fresh template.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ProfileStore = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("ProfileStore")) :: any
local PlayerState = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Services"):WaitForChild("PlayerState"))
local Ops = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Util"):WaitForChild("Ops"))
local Rules = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("Rules"))

-- Studio playtests write to a separate store so test data never leaks into the live game.
local STORE_NAME = if RunService:IsStudio() then "ASMRTower_Studio_v1" else "ASMRTower_Live_v1"

local KICK_LOAD_FAILED = "Could not load your data. Please rejoin."
local KICK_OUTDATED = "This server is outdated. Please rejoin to get the latest version."
local KICK_TIMEOUT = "Loading took too long. Please rejoin."
local KICK_STOLEN = "Your data was opened on another server. Please rejoin."

-- v1 -> v2 (Dynamics v1): the route got shorter, so checkpoint indexes moved to the start of the same zone.
-- Schema constants, not balance: frozen on purpose, never read from Config.
local V1_ZONE_STARTS = { 0, 4, 9 } -- zone 1, 2, 3 first checkpoint in v2 numbering
local V1_ZONE_LAST = 18 -- v1 finish index
local V2_FINISH = 14
-- Album keys that exist in v1 but not in the 26-entry album of v2.
local V1_REMOVED_ALBUM_KEYS = { "Crayon.land", "Crayon.step", "Butter.land" }

-- Old index -> new index. Not a number -> 0. 0..5 -> 0, 6..11 -> 4, 12..17 -> 9, 18 (finish) -> 14.
local function mapCheckpointV1(value: any): number
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value < 6 then
		return 0
	elseif value < 12 then
		return V1_ZONE_STARTS[2]
	elseif value < V1_ZONE_LAST then
		return V1_ZONE_STARTS[3]
	end
	return V2_FINISH
end

-- Pure step: only Checkpoint, BestCheckpoint and Album change; notes, upgrades, rewards, FinishCount stay.
-- Not idempotent by itself (4 would map to 0): migrate() runs it once, only for Version 1 data.
local function migrateV1toV2(data: any)
	data.Checkpoint = mapCheckpointV1(data.Checkpoint)
	data.BestCheckpoint = mapCheckpointV1(data.BestCheckpoint)
	if type(data.Album) == "table" then
		for _, key in V1_REMOVED_ALBUM_KEYS do
			data.Album[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- migrations[v] turns version v data into version v + 1. Runs before Reconcile.
-- A new version = a new step; the number is given by the Tech Lead before the branch starts.
local migrations: { [number]: (data: any) -> () } = {
	[1] = migrateV1toV2,
}

local DataService = {}

local store: any = nil
local profiles: { [Player]: any } = {}
local leaving: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
local started: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

-- "ok" | "newer" (saved by a newer server, never downgrade) | "broken" (no usable version number).
local function migrate(data: any): string
	local version = data.Version
	if version == nil then
		version = 1
	end
	if type(version) ~= "number" or version ~= version or math.floor(version) ~= version or version < 1 then
		return "broken"
	end
	if version > PlayerState.CurrentVersion then
		return "newer"
	end
	while version < PlayerState.CurrentVersion do
		local step = migrations[version]
		if step then
			step(data)
		end
		version += 1
		data.Version = version
	end
	return "ok"
end

local function kick(player: Player, message: string)
	if player.Parent == Players then
		player:Kick(message)
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	if started[player] then
		return
	end
	started[player] = true

	-- No profile after LoadKickSeconds -> a clear kick instead of an endless "Loading...".
	task.delay(Rules.Session.LoadKickSeconds, function()
		if player.Parent == Players and not PlayerState.IsLoaded(player) then
			Ops.Issue(player, "LoadTimeout", tostring(player.UserId))
			kick(player, KICK_TIMEOUT)
		end
	end)

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return store:StartSessionAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, {
			Cancel = function()
				return player.Parent ~= Players
			end,
		})
	end)
	local profile = if ok then result else nil
	if profile == nil then
		if player.Parent == Players then
			Ops.Issue(player, "LoadFailed", if ok then tostring(player.UserId) else tostring(result))
			kick(player, KICK_LOAD_FAILED)
		end
		return
	end

	local verdict = migrate(profile.Data)
	if verdict ~= "ok" then
		-- Leave the saved data exactly as it was.
		profile:EndSession()
		if verdict == "newer" then
			Ops.Issue(player, "OutdatedServer", tostring(profile.Data.Version))
			kick(player, KICK_OUTDATED)
		else
			Ops.Issue(player, "LoadFailed", "bad version " .. tostring(profile.Data.Version))
			kick(player, KICK_LOAD_FAILED)
		end
		return
	end
	profile:AddUserId(player.UserId)
	profile:Reconcile()

	profile.OnSessionEnd:Connect(function()
		local ours = profiles[player] == profile
		if ours then
			profiles[player] = nil
		end
		PlayerState.Unload(player)
		-- Kick only when another server took the save while the player is still here.
		if ours and not leaving[player] and player.Parent == Players and not ProfileStore.IsClosing then
			Ops.Issue(player, "SessionStolen", tostring(player.UserId))
			kick(player, KICK_STOLEN)
		end
	end)

	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		profile:EndSession()
		return
	end
	profiles[player] = profile

	local loaded, err = pcall(PlayerState.Load, player, profile.Data)
	if not loaded then
		Ops.Issue(player, "LoadFailed", "PlayerState.Load: " .. tostring(err))
		profiles[player] = nil
		PlayerState.Unload(player)
		profile:EndSession()
		kick(player, KICK_LOAD_FAILED)
	end
end

-- The live profile (reserved for receipts after MVP: LastSavedData, OnAfterSave, Save, IsActive).
function DataService.GetProfile(player: Player): any
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.Init()
	if store then
		return
	end
	store = ProfileStore.New(STORE_NAME, PlayerState.Template())

	ProfileStore.OnError:Connect(function(message, storeName, key)
		warn(`[DataService] ProfileStore error ({storeName} / {key}): {message}`)
	end)
	ProfileStore.OnOverwrite:Connect(function(storeName, key)
		warn(`[DataService] Profile overwritten: {storeName} / {key}`)
	end)
	ProfileStore.OnCriticalToggle:Connect(function(isCritical)
		warn("[DataService] DataStore critical state:", isCritical)
	end)

	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.spawn(function()
			while ProfileStore.DataStoreState == "NotReady" do
				task.wait()
			end
			if ProfileStore.DataStoreState ~= "Access" then
				warn(`[DataService] Studio without DataStore access ({ProfileStore.DataStoreState}): profiles are kept in memory and NOT saved`)
			end
		end)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		leaving[player] = true
		local profile = profiles[player]
		profiles[player] = nil
		if profile then
			profile:EndSession()
		end
		PlayerState.Unload(player)
		task.defer(function()
			leaving[player] = nil
			started[player] = nil
		end)
	end)
end

return DataService
